notes.title: New DLC: KR Vaporwave Dreams Tileset
notes.notes:
Need some striking pink and teal tiles to build a fitting backdrop for your vaporwav-inspired game? Then the KR Vaporwave Dreams Tileset is for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3998300/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Vaporwave_Dreams_Tileset/

Kokoro Reflections has fully leaned into the vaporwave aesthetic to create this MV/MZ-sized tileset, offering up bright colors, sharp angles, and Grecian pillars and statues to decorate the space.

A1, A2, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets are filled with blue, teal, and pink tiles that take the vaporwave aesthetic to the next level. Build a tall tiled apartment building surrounded by pink and teal palm trees that holds your hero’s home, and furnish it with color-coded appliances and decor. Send your hero to their job at an office where bulky computer monitors let off a soft glow and the break room is filled with comfy armchairs that face the room’s built-in fishtank wall. Don’t forget to let your hero have some fun during their time off! Create dark bars lit by neon lights that pump music through massive speakers, or let your hero enjoy some peace and quiet in a statue garden filled with statues and old broken pillars.

This pack also includes character sprites for glass and wooden doors to let your heroes get around their world’s buildings, and a massive spinning disco ball to help turn any room into a dance floor! Pick up the KR Vaporwave Dreams Tileset and give your heroes a neon world to enjoy!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Star Land Tileset
notes.notes:
Visit a whole new world of color and magic with the KR Star Land Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3998290/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Star_Land_Tileset/

Create a kooky and colorful world for your heroes to explore with the KR Star Land Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has crafted another MV/MZ-sized tileset to help you build the game of your dreams, especially if your dreams include bright and cheery places. Travel along gooey rivers and between tall striped hills to visit star-studded fields and comforting star-themed bedrooms where your heroes can rest, level up, and prepare for their next exciting adventure!

A1 sheets with 4 color variations (blue, green, orange, and pink), A2, A4, and A5 tiles are perfect for building cute mountains that lead high into the sky, and 3 B sheets are filled with rainbows, swirly trees, and stars to add a ton of whimsy to your maps. Let your heroes explore seemingly normal hills where angled brown dirt walls slowly change to blue, green, orange, or pink walls that couldn’t possibly exist in nature. Sprinkle star-topped tree trunks into your forests that offer special buffs to your heroes, and use the pack’s collection of stars and rainbows to help your heroes find their way to important parts of your maps.

This pack also includes a shiny gold treasure chest character sprite so your heroes can find goodies while wandering the dreamscape along with 3 parallax backgrounds to sit behind the colorful hills. Have your game’s sky be bright blue with some puffy white clouds during the day and switch to a deep blue gradient with cartoon stars when  night falls. If you’ve been looking for some cute tiles to make a dream world for your heroes to visit when they sleep, or you just want a colorful game to suit your happy story, check out the KR Star Land Tileset!

notes.title: New DLC: KR World of Candy Tileset
notes.notes:
Get ready for a sweet new set of map materials for your game! The KR World of Candy Tileset is out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3998280/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_World_of_Candy_Tileset/

Treat your sweet tooth to a delicious wonderland with the KR World of Candy Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has cooked up a sweet MV/MZ-sized tileset to add a land of candy to your fantastical world. Give your elves gingerbread houses to live in, your rivers a yummy chocolate twist, your roads a gumdrop button fence, and more with this pack!

A1, A2, A3, A4, and 2 B sheets are filled with sweet and salty treats for you to play with. Replace boring trees in a forest with tall lollipops that attract monsters with their sticky sweetness, or sneak a few random gumball trees into a normal forest that drop healing gumballs for your heroes to chew. Follow bouncy pink gummy roads to magical towns where macarons act as tables and chocolate wafers are carved into benches, and climb the cliffs of Cake Mountain to delve deep into the rock candy mines. Oversized cupcakes, ice cream cones, and cotton candy can act as obvious points of interest on your maps, and mark important routes with candy cane and pretzel arches. Do you just want to add a little whimsy to your game world? Then top your bakeries with piped frosting and bunches of sprinkles!

This pack also includes example maps for MV and MZ so you can easily copy the tile passability, or just get some inspiration for how to put all the pieces together. Pick up the KR World of Candy Tileset and give your players sweet dreamscapes and cavity-inducing dungeons!

notes.title: New DLC: Heroine Character Generator 11 for MZ
notes.notes:
Expand your MZ Generator choices with the new Heroine Character Generator 11 for MZ, out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3998260/RPG_Maker_MZ__Heroine_Character_Generator_11_for_MZ/

Send your party members to school to master their powers and compete with other groups with the Heroine Character Generator 11 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft is back with another pack of generator parts to help your heroines dress their best. 62 new parts offer up a variety of options to help you fill your modern worlds with even more characters. Give your heroine slightly pointed ears to hint at a magical heritage, let the city’s different schools each have unique uniforms, and suit up in dark green tactical gear when it’s time to defeat evil!

3 AccA, 9 AccB, 1 Cloak, 20 Clothing, 1 Ear, 3 Eyebrows, 5 Eyes, 1 Face, 2 Glasses, 5 Mouths, 2 Noses, 5 Front Hair, and 5 Rear Hair pieces are perfect for creating distinct party members and NPCs who can travel across the game world, strike a pose in battle, yell during cutscenes, and more! Let your heroine dress differently depending on the time of day and what she’s up to by having her wear a school uniform and a cute flower in her hair when attending lessons, and relax in a track suit and baseball cap during her off time. Create a princess NPC with long flowing hair and a gorgeous kimono with bright eyes who shows her emotions through the tilt of her eyebrows. This pack also includes updated grad_common and grad_eyes images so you can give your characters some new color palettes to make them stand out even more. If you’ve been searching for some more school uniforms or just need a few more expressions for your party members to make during dramatic cutscenes, check out the Heroine Character Generator 11 for MZ pack!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Luminous Abyss Tileset, KR Phosphor Forest Tileset
notes.notes:
Explore bioluminescent oceans and magical forests with two new tilesets from Kokoro Reflections! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3903410/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Luminous_Abyss_Tileset/

Explore the darkest depths of the ocean where the only light is bioluminescent coral with the KR Luminous Abyss Tileset! Kokoro Reflections dives back into underwater MV/MZ-sized tiles with this pack, offering up a variety of cool blue rocks and dirt to help you build locations that sunlight can’t touch. A1, A2, A4, A5, and 4 unique B sheets (with a number of variations that adds up to 18 sheets) can create dark rocky ocean floors, caverns filled with lava and magic-infused walls, whale graveyards, ethereal coral gardens, and more!

Reward your players for finishing a difficult sidequest with an item that lets them breathe underwater, and create incredible locations for them to explore with these tiles. Let them wander around angled cliff faces and behind natural stone arches in search of sunken treasure or cave openings, and break up the monotony of blue and gray stone with pops of color from neon pink, blue, and green veins of crystal. Coral and aquatic plants can add a bit more light to the world, in 3 main color gradients (purple/blue, purple/blue/green, and rainbow) so you can mix and match to fit the area. This pack also includes a character sprite for black smoke so that you can show pools of magma interacting with the ocean’s water. Or skip the water entirely and use these tiles to create caves with pockets of air deep underground! Pick up the KR Luminous Abyss Tileset and give your heroes new cool spaces to visit!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3903400/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Phosphor_Forest_Tileset/

Give your magical forest an uncommon vibe with the KR Phosphor Forest Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a MV/MZ-sized tileset perfect for making a dark dungeon deep in the middle of a forest. Instead of a ton of autotiles to choose from, use 3 black ground tiles with varying amounts of grass to point your heroes in the right direction, and have the visual focus be on bioluminescent mushrooms and flowers! Small fairy rings of mushrooms and little glowing flowers can add a hint of magic to relatively normal maps with lush bushes and trees, and massive mushrooms and moonflowers that loom over your heroes’ heads will surely let them know that they’re not in a normal forest anymore. Organic lines of moss and vines are perfect for making the edges of the explorable area, so you can create open spaces without filling the entire map with tiles. Add a glowing river that cuts through the maps that can act as healing points or refill magic potions, or make a pool of water with a waterfall emptying into it the center of the forest that also acts as the home to a powerful optional boss.

This pack also includes 3 character sprites for glowing orbs. Use them to mark the path for your heroes, or have them act as fearful fairies that vanish if your heroes get too close. Or have pale orbs react to touch to light up the area to reveal hidden pathways and treasures. If you’ve been wanting to add a unique magical spring tucked away in a normal forest, pick up the KR Phosphor Forest Tileset!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Vintage Cars - 60s and 70s Animation Pack, KR Vintage Steam Train Ti
notes.notes:
Dress up your transportation with two new vintage transportation themed packs from Kokoro Reflections!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3903390/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Vintage_Cars__60s_and_70s_Animation_Pack/

Become the king of the road with the KR Vintage Cars - 60s and 70s Animation Pack! Kokoro Reflections is here with a massive set of MV/MZ-sized car character sheets to turn your empty roads into auto shows. 19 different characters inspired by 60s and 70s cars are ready to fill your streets with racing muscle cars, have convertibles cruise beachside roads, give your farms some fitting trucks, and more! Have your heroes travel the world in a VW-inspired bus so that no matter where they go they’ll always have a place to rest and recover, or let them zip around the highways in bright red hot rods with cool flared fins. Tell your players that your game takes place in the 70s by showing the roads filled with station wagons and rounded bugs, or use the pack’s stylish coupes to make your world feel modern without having to state a specific date.

Each car comes in 25 colors so your traffic jams can become rainbows of color! Fill the roads with NPC cars in browns, greens, and blues while your heroes and villains drive around in bright reds and purples so it’s always easy to see which cars are important. Let your players buy their favorite car and then attach specific buffs to different colors, so a teal car increases their magic attack while silver increases all defense and fuschia adds a boost to charisma. Or just give your players the option to repaint their cars whenever they want and have those changes show when they’re driving around! If you’ve been wanting to add more good looking cars to your games, pick up the KR Vintage Cars - 60s and 70s Animation Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3903380/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Vintage_Steam_Train_Tileset/

All aboard! Leave navigation to the experts while your heroes rest between dungeons (or solve a murder mystery) thanks to the KR Vintage Steam Train Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another transportation themed MV/MZ-sized tileset to help your heroes get around a large world. Add some train tracks to all of your cities and turn fast travel points into awesome steam trains that roll into town with intricate red and gray locomotives and a long train of passenger cars. Create side quests where your heroes need to keep a train safe while it’s transporting fuel or important NPCs, or just let your heroes wander carriage interiors to choose whether to fully heal with a nap in bunk beds or gain a buff by eating some tasty food in the meal car.

A2, A4, B and C sheet tiles are perfect for making wooden carriages with soft green carpets leading your heroes to their seats with metal storage racks about their heads, or follow the rugs farther to reach separate compartments where small tables can hold suitcases and bunk beds are built into the walls. If your heroes snuck onto a train instead, have them hide out behind wooden crates and barrels in the stark metal cargo cars. This pack also includes 11 character sheets to help you add moving trains to your maps. Have the locomotive engine, tanker cars, wood cars, cargo cars, and passenger cars travel in the cardinal directions to show how connected your game’s world is, and use the wooden doors to keep your heroes from entering other people’s compartments before a passenger is murdered. Pick up the KR Vintage Steam Train Tileset pack and let your heroes travel comfortably!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Quartz Cave Tileset, KR Wrath of the Volcano Tileset
notes.notes:
Two new dungeon tilesets from Kokoro Reflections! Explore Quartz Caves or Volcanic terrain with these two new resource packs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3903370/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Quartz_Cave_Tileset/

Explore deep caves filled with massive crystals thanks to the KR Quartz Cave Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has created an MV/MZ-sized tileset inspired by the incredible Naica Mine, with large stone stalactites and translucent white crystals piercing up through the floor. Send your heroes into a dungeon formed by water and heat and untouched by humans to find large gems that can be used in magical crafting, and add more gorgeous crystals to monster-filled dungeons!

A1, A2, A4, and 3 B sheets include all the stone and quartz tiles you could want to build maze-like mines and massive crystal-filled caverns. Create a seemingly normal cave entrance with dirt floors and brown stone walls, but hint at something special further in with small bunches of crystals poking out of the floor. As your heroes explore deeper, have the floor shift from packed dirt to sandy floors where sand flows like a waterfall from the ceiling and reveal spots of crystals in the walls. Lead them down unassuming tunnels by embedding trails of glowing crystals in the floor, and stud the larger caves with crystal bunches that are three times taller than your heroes. Let nature form pathways by having angled stone walls and piles of rocks force your heroes in specific directions, or make mazes of crystals where your heroes need to walk behind and between the crystal pillars to find their way out of the cave. Pick up the KR Quartz Cave Tileset and add a new type of cave for your heroes to conquer!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3903350/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Wrath_of_the_Volcano_Tileset/

Send your heroes deep into the wilderness where volcanic magic twists lava into incredible forms with the KR Wrath of the Volcano Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a new MV/MZ-sized tileset that is filled with flowing lava, glowing crystals, and scorched stones ready to help you create dangerous dungeons where one wrong step could leave your heroes missing a foot! A1, A2, A4, and 3 B sheets offer a variety of grass and dirt floors for your heroes to safely walk on while wandering between rivers of lava and glowing holes in the ground that almost certainly lead to lava lakes. Let them explore less lava-filled areas where burnt tree trunks are one of the only signs that normal plants used to grow there and old wooden bridges connect cliffs that are studded with massive boulders. Warn your players that there’s something mystical about the area with glowing rings of mushrooms and twisting plants rise out of the ground, and force hard decisions by having thin lines of lava criss-cross shortcuts so your players have to choose whether to be injured for a quick trip to next section or take their time with the longer, safer path.

13 character sprites for lava flows and glowing orbs give you even more ways to make your maps more dangerous! Have fountains of lava burst out of the ground so your players need to plan their movement carefully, or use large springs of lava flowing down cliffs as roadblocks until your players find a way to plug them to move deeper into the dungeon. And that’s not even the end of this pack! Each tileset also comes in a blue version so you can double the fun. Use the blue lava to show that the deadly heat has been decreased, or make it a fully magical volcano where mana is so dense that it can physically harm your heroes! Pick up the KR Wrath of the Volcano Tileset and challenge your heroes with maps that are too hot to touch!

"UNDERMAX - Simple Cooking System Plugin" is a plugin that adds a cooking system to your game. By combining multiple ingredients and items, players can create unique dishes, special items, and valuable crafting materials.

notes.title: New DLC: RPG Monsters Asset Pack 3, Time Elements - Character Expansion 2
notes.notes:
New Monsters from Elv Games with RPG Monsters Asset Pack 3, New characters from Finalbossblues with Time Elements - Character Expansion 2, both AVAILABLE NOW!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3903320/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Monsters_Asset_Pack_3/

Battle grinning gremlins and hulking humanoids with the RPG Monsters Asset Pack 3! Elv Games continues their front view enemy series with 90 more pixel art images to fill out your troops with new creatures. 18 new monster designs are ready to add more combat possibilities to your fights, with muscular-armed monsters that can slam your heroes into the ground with powerful punches, bird-like creatures that can blast your heroes with wind magic from their green crystal wings, and insectoid bipedal beasts that slash with sharp orange spikes! Teach your players how to defeat physically strong foes by sending them against short monsters that focused solely on their arms and skipped leg day, and then test them with boss battles where towering ogres and armored creatures offer up stronger versions of the punches and strikes the smaller enemies used. Have your heroes find rare lizards that have crystals on their head that sell for a lot of gold, or create side quests where mischievous antennaed gremlins need to be defeated to help the local farmers.

Each enemy comes in 5 color variations (4 base colors and 1 glowing green version), so you can make your battles even more intriguing! Use the brown, green, black, and red beefy ogres to show their elemental weaknesses, or have the sharp-toothed round gremlin be white, purple, or black randomly so that each encounter feels brand new. If you’ve been looking for more front view enemies for your heroes to fight, check out the RPG Monsters Asset Pack 3!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3903280/RPG_Maker_MZ__Time_Elements__Character_Expansion_2/

Add some ruff characters to your party and let your fisherman NPCs actually fish with the Time Elements - Character Expansion 2! Finalbossblues is here with an excellent addition to their Time Elements character generator, adding new pieces to their generator to give you even more options when it comes to character looks. Add a town full of beastmen with animal heads and tails, make your ship captain a bit suspect by giving him a pirate’s hat, dress city guards up in heavy armor, and more with this pack!

This pack introduces 4 hair styles, 3 beastman heads, 4 tops, 4 bottoms, 4 tails, 3 back hair styles, 3 hats, and 7 weapons that you can mix and match with the base generator to make tons of new sprites! Create canine, feline, and serpentine beastmen with fluffy (or scaled) heads and tails, and dress them up in new skirts and armored tops. Each generator part is set up with multiple behavior options, so you can easily create a hero who can walk around, pick up items, jump ledges, and even swing down tools or weapons! That’s not all though, this expansion also includes fishing behaviors set up to match the already-made generator parts, so you can make your own custom heroine and then give her a fishing rod to cast into any waterways in the hopes of catching a tasty fish or finding some sunken treasure.

Almost every piece comes in multiple color variations, so you can give your hunter character a brown or black raccoon skin cap and update your swordsman with a bronze, steel, or gold blade depending on what they’ve equipped! Make it easy on your players to find specific wolfman NPCs by having them all have different fur colors, or give certain shopkeepers the same outfit color in every town so that your players always know who to visit to buy more items. Pick up the Time Elements - Character Expansion 2 and upgrade your party and towns with even more interesting characters!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Dwarf Kingdom Tileset, KR Gothic Castle Tileset
notes.notes:
Two new tilesets from Kokoro Reflections! Build your Dwarven Kingdom and Gothic Castles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3881670/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Dwarf_Kingdom_Tileset/

Build an underground city filled with bearded blacksmiths and glittering gemstones with the KR Dwarf Kingdom Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has crafted a set of MV/MZ-sized tiles to help you create stone towns, cozy rooms, and sprawling tunnels all carved out of the center of mountains or deep underground. 2 A1 sheets, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets are full of stone, metal, and wooden tiles that can build rich dwarven mansions, dirt-filled mines, giant barrels that act as tiny bedrooms, and more! Make a small mountainside village with blue tile roofs and metal pipes connecting every building that acts as the entrance to a monster-filled cavern, or build a city inside a volcano with lava pooling around the edges and massive metal chains hooked onto the edges of the buildings to make sure they don’t fall into the fiery lake. Create unique inns where every room is built in an oversized wooden barrel, or keep things simple with mine tracks that weave between stalagmites and lead to colorful jewels stuck into jagged stone walls.

This pack also includes 16 character images for objects to add extra business to your mines! Light tunnels with flickering flames and have mine carts rolling around the tracks filled with jewels to show that the mine is still active even with monsters roaming around. Power the underground village with large wooden waterwheels and gears spinning on the sides of buildings, and reward your players for searching alleys with a barrel-shaped treasure chest. Sample maps for MV and MZ are also included to help inspire you and figure out the tileset passability, just in case you’re not sure what will work best. If your game includes dwarven cities or you want to build some dark caves that reveal an ancient civilization, pick up the KR Dwarf Kingdom Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831960/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Gothic_Castle_Tileset/

Dare your players to spend the night in a mansion that definitely looks haunted with the KR Gothic Castle Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with a MV/MZ-sized tileset to let you create interior and exterior maps for a dark castle. Have your heroes approach the large entrance through a garden of small flowers and bramble hedges, and set your players on edge with looming dark spires stabbing up into the sky and large stained glass windows that don’t let nearly as much light through as you would expect. Visit abandoned chapels, courtyards with broken fountains, kitchens with half-drunk glasses of red wine (it is wine, right?) sitting on the otherwise empty counters, bedrooms with ornate untouched beds and worn coffins tucked in the corners, and more with this pack!

A1, A2, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets are filled with desaturated tiles perfect for creating creepy locations. Trap your heroes in the castle until their mission is completed with wrought-iron fences surrounding the buildings, and decorate stone walls with carved inlays and arches in between ornate windows. Have your heroes search through libraries with towering bookshelves and paintings hanging on wallpapered walls in the hopes of finding a clue on who used to live there, or have them hunt down sneaky vampires by finding staircases into stone basements that were hidden under metal stoves or in the large fireplace that unlocked when the nearby organ plays a certain melody. This pack also includes 10 character images of doors and water fountains to help your players get around the mansion and to add some subtle movement to the garden maps. notes.title: New DLC: Fantasy Character Pack 3, KR Wizard Widgets Animations Pack 2
notes.notes:
New Heroes from Gee-kun-soft! New animated magical artifacts from Kokoro Reflections! Get Fantasy Character Pack 3 and KR Wizard Widgets Animations Pack 2 today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831940/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Character_Pack_3/

Fill your party with armored knights and samurai thanks to the Fantasy Character Pack 3! Gee-kun-soft is back with 16 new characters who can flesh out your party, fill your towns with helpful NPCs, and serve as deadly antagonists. Each character comes with an MZ-style walking character sprite, SV batter, front-view enemy images (with 13 recolors and versions with magical effects), faceset with 8 emotions, and busts with 8 emotions so that you can easily add them wherever you want.

5 knights and 7 samurai offer your players options for their party composition, or use them as NPCs who can teach your heroes new skills. Let your players choose the blonde knight armed with a lance and shield or the upbeat samurai with a powerful bow to help defeat a dragon, and learn new defensive skills from a heavily armored swordswoman or a wise white-haired samurai tactician. Want some less common party members? A dragon knight, harpy, a male priest, and even satan can add unique combat styles for your battles, or cause trouble when they launch a surprise attack on your party!

This pack also includes high-resolution full body images of each character, so that you can resize them to perfectly fit your game’s resolution for cutscenes or add art of them to your game’s codex. Pick up Fantasy Character Pack 3 and add an upbeat priest, a stoic tactician, a sword-swinging knight, and more to your game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831950/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Wizard_Widgets_Animations_Pack_2/

Fill your wizard’s towers and magical dungeons with even more doodads and glowing objects thanks to the KR Wizard Widgets Animations Pack 2! Kokoro Reflections continues their character sprite packs with another set of animations to take your magic laboratories and mystical puzzles to the next level. 11 new objects are ready to fill your maps with impressive displays of magic, from floating swords to massive gilded doors into another realm!

Use this pack’s tall tower of candles to light up dark corners, or show off the local wizard’s skills by using fairy lanterns made from large glowing crystals to make sure the city’s streets are always bright. Let your heroes talk to distant groups via large translucent orbs, or have them visit those groups by using a massive Faberge egg doorway that lets them instantly teleport to its connected twin. Glowing platforms and tables can act as obvious points of interest in mazes, or use them as healing spots in a town’s main hall.

Each object comes in multiple colors, so that every area can look different. Color code dungeons so that your players have a good idea of what type of enemies will appear, or place the different colored obelisks around your world map that will unlock new more dangerous areas if your players activate them. Need some new ways to reward your heroes? Then throw down some pod sprites that start as a ball and expand upwards as magic crystals are fed into it, eventually glowing to reveal a rare item! Place large glowing glass jars around the dungeon that offer your players a choice: leave the jar alone so they continue to light up the area or take the useful item inside the jar knowing that that will plunge the area into darkness. If your mages need more cool objects to decorate their homes or your guilds need some impressive ways to communicate, check out the KR Wizard Widgets Animations Pack 2!

notes.title: New DLC: RPG Monsters Asset Pack 2, KR Wizard Widgets Animations Pack
notes.notes:
[p]Even more new monsters to fight from Elv Games with RPG Monsters Asset Pack 2! Plus an amazing collection of animated objects from Kokoro Reflections to decorate your world with magical artifacts with the KR Wizard Widgets Animations Pack!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831920/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Monsters_Asset_Pack_2/"][/dynamiclink]

Challenge even more cute and killer enemies with the RPG Monsters Asset Pack 2! Elv Games continues their series of pixel art front view enemy images with 18 new monster designs for your heroes to face off against! Battle fluffy critters, electrified demons, muscular humanoids, and more with this pack! Send your heroes into a lush forest where little imps grow leaves to help them sneak up on their prey and cute kitties distract adventurers with their fluffy cheeks so they don’t spot their long, sharp claws. Or fill a once-busy mine with single-eyed bat creatures and small stocky monsters that use their large ears to track down anyone making noise in the tunnels!

Each enemy comes in 4 color variations as well as 1 special glowing green version, meaning you have 90 enemies to choose from! Have armless horned monsters come in green, blue, brown, and purple to make each battle feel like your heroes are facing a new group of enemies, or give the creatures with yellow lightning bolts on their bellies purple, black, red, or white body colors to warn your players about how strong they are. Use the glowing green versions to act as rare high level enemies, or give your heroes a special skill that lets them charm an enemy and use the special version so that your players can easily tell which enemy is on their side with a quick glance. If you’ve been wanting some more front view enemies for your heroes to fight, pick up the RPG Monsters Asset Pack 2!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831930/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Wizard_Widgets_Animations_Pack/"][/dynamiclink]

Is your wizard’s tower looking drab? Does your sorceress’ study lack magical artifacts? Is your magical school missing that spark of magic? Then you need the KR Wizard Widgets Animations Pack! Kokoro Reflections has created a massive pack of object sprites to add some movement and magic to all your maps. Let your players fast travel through magical mirrors, gain extra experience at sparkling flame fountains, see where to go next with a crystal ball, and more with this pack’s animated sprites!

12 different objects are ready to add interesting and helpful events to all your maps. Glowing cauldrons and floating wands can act as crafting points for your mages to make new spells or potions, or use them as level up locations for your party. Use sparkles floating up from the ground, gilded mirrors that contain a portal, and hatches that open after some magic is pumped into them to help your party move around the game, or have them be decorative objects so that a magician’s room or noble’s library have some extra animations. Large gems that rise from the ground and crystals trapped in metal cages can light up dark areas or play important roles in puzzles, or add them to a castle just to show how rich the king is.

And that’s not all! Each object comes in a rainbow of color variations, so you can easily show that a dungeon is full of wind magic-wielding enemies with glowing green crystals and swirling green spell circles. Or have a portal cycle through different colors so that your players can warp to multiple places from a single shimmering portal. If you’ve been searching for more magical crystals or just need some cool spell circles to decorate your dungeons, check out the KR Wizard Widgets Animations Pack![/p]

notes.title: New DLC: KR Legendary Palaces - Cerberus, Winlu Fantasy - Destroyed Exteriors
notes.notes:
KR Legendary Palaces - Cerberus Tileset, Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Destroyed Exterior

Two new tilesets from two of our favorite creators: Check out Kokoro Reflections new Legendary Palaces - Cerberus Tileset, and Winlu's new Fantasy Tileset - Destroyed Exterior!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831890/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Cerberus_Tileset/

Give your guardian of the underworld a fitting castle with the KR Legendary Palaces - Cerberus Tileset! Kokoro Reflections continues their Legendary Palaces series with a flaming set of MV/MZ-sized tiles that’ll make your heroes think they’ve entered the molten core of the world. Have your heroes carefully cross blackened bridges over rivers of lava and climb ladders to avoid the glowing gaze of 3-headed dog statues, or let your heroes race up the stairs and battle every guard in the way to reach the throne room! Stump your heroes with magic circles that teleport them to new locations in the castle, and create puzzles where your heroes need to push crystals into the right spots so that they’ll light up and unlock treasure chests.

A1, A2, A4, and A5 tiles along with a B sheet are filled with burning and charred tiles to help you create dungeon hallways and rooms for your heroes to explore. Floors and walls in black and orange can help lead your heroes to the main throne room with herringbone patterns, or switch from orange tiles to black where lava has pooled in the room and darkened the floor with soot. Stud the walls top thin pillars with orange crystals and remind your heroes that a challenging fight awaits them with statues of monstrous dogs staring from alcoves in the hallways. This pack also includes a black and orange treasure chest character sprite so that your heroes can be rewarded for exploring the lava-filled corridors or solving tricky puzzles based on lighting up the palace’s crystal lamps. Check out the KR Legendary Palaces - Cerberus Tileset and add a new infernal dungeon for your heroes to conquer!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831900/RPG_Maker_MZ__Winlu_Fantasy_Tileset__Destroyed_Exterior/

Did your hero’s village suffer a bandit attack but still look clean? Does a ruined and abandoned city still look like someone is caring for the roofs and town square? Then you need the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Destroyed Exterior pack! Winlu has created an add-on pack to their Fantasy Tileset series to help you show just how damaged a town has become. 4 versions of A3 tiles and 3 versions of B sheet tiles along with 2 more B sheets are perfectly set so you can swap out a full sheet to instantly turn a normal happy town into a busted ruin barely hanging on after the demon lord’s army passed through. Or mix and match the two sets to give specific spots of damage to buildings, such as a collapsed chimney and tile roof filled with holes making a house unlivable, at least until your heroes chip in to repair it. Help tell the story of an empty village with hanging laundry still up on the line but splattered with blood and arrows piercing barrels that villagers may have tried to hide behind, or give your heroes a mystery to solve with shattered windows and torn sacks of grain being the only hints that something keeps attacking the town at night.

This pack also includes tiles set up as characters so that you can easily add them to your maps. Top your bell towers and chapels with collapsing spires and thoughtfully place holes in every roof that reveal the interior support beams. Hang broken wooden signs over shop doors so that your heroes know what type of items they may find in the mostly-empty buildings, or use a busted sign as a marker for a shop that can be invested in and improved as your heroes get stronger and gather more money. If your game includes any attacks that destroy villages or you want to let your players slowly repair a town, pick up the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Destroyed Exterior pack!

notes.title: New DLC: Doomsday Zombies, KR High Score Arcade Tileset
notes.notes:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831880/RPG_Maker_MZ__Doomsday_Zombies/

Fill your post-apocalyptic game with horrific monsters thanks to the Doomsday Zombies pack! PVGames continues their Doomsday series with another set of character pieces, this time focusing on the living dead. More than 50 pieces for sprites and full body images are ready to dress your zombies not only to impress your players, but scare the life out of them when the unassuming firefighter corpse stands up and starts chasing them!

Choose from 6 different colors of emaciated bases to build your zombie, and dress them up in 12 torn and dirtied pants along with 22 ruined tops to remind your players that that zombie had been a living person not too long ago. Use different uniforms to warn your players that a zombie in a tactical vest will be a tough fight, or offer unique rewards to taking out a zombie that’s dressed as a cook or surgeon. 9 hat and helmet options can keep your players from taking your zombies out with a single hit to the head, and 3 accessories can add some well-placed splatters of blood.

Each zombie character sheet also includes a number of multi-frame animations in 8 directions. Have your zombie enemies sway in place until your players get too close and then run after them with arms outstretched! Show that a building could contain survivors by having zombies swarm and attack the door, or decorate your maps with fallen zombies to tell your players that someone powerful has already visited the area. Pick up the Doomsday Zombies pack and build your own army of undead!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699040/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_High_Score_Arcade_Tileset/

Spend your afternoons beating the best with the KR High Score Arcade Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a modern MV/MZ-size tileset to help you build a neon dreamland filled with every arcade machine you could want. Give your slice-of-life game a new date spot where your players can show off their skills a foosball, replace normal items shops with arcades where vending machines offer the normal goods and a high score can unlock rare equipment, use the arcade as a place where your players can replay their favorite minigames, and more with this pack!

A2, A4, and 2 B sheets offer up stark black and neon blue and pink walls and floors to build your arcade rooms, with patterns including checkerboards, diamonds, and hexagons to let you make distinct areas in the main room or add some focal point walls. Glowing arches and pillars can add some futuristic vibes to the rooms, and add a few windows that switch from light to dark to show your players that time is passing while they play. Fill the space with upright arcade machines in bright colors, and set up areas with more specific types of games mounted motorcycle racing games or physical games like ping-pong and billiards.

This pack also includes 4 double door and 6 bathroom door characters (with a lit and unlit version each) so that your heroes can explore more than one room in the arcade. If you’ve been wanting to include an arcade to contain all the minigames you’ve made, or you want a fun way for your players to level up their stats outside of battles, check out the KR High Score Arcade Tileset!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Amusement Park Tileset, RPG Monsters Asset Pack 1
notes.notes:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3766040/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Amusement_Park_Tileset/

Let your heroes enjoy a day of fun with the KR Amusement Park Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a new MV/MZ-sized tileset filled with modern carnival rides to turn any empty field into a fantastic fairground! A1, A2, A3, A4, and 4 B sheets are ready to build bright tents and buildings where fun games and sweet treats are everywhere the eye can see. Build a cozy party in a city park where wooden picnic tables are set up near small grills and inflatable bouncy castles surround colorful play structures so the kids can have tons of fun while the adults chat. Or have a traveling circus come to town for a few weeks in the middle of your slice-of-life game to break up the monotony of farming! Let your players decide if they want to visit the food stalls to buy all sorts of candies and fried food, or spend their time in the rows of games where they can test their skills at ring toss, darts, tests of strength, and more to win prizes.

This pack also includes 5 character sprites for doors and bathroom stalls so your heroes and NPCs can have some privacy, along with 10 sprites of rides and more to add spinning and twirling fun to your maps! Have a ticket booth with swinging gate keep your players from rushing onto rides before buying tickets, and decorate the paths with bouncing balloons that lead your heroes to a massive merry-go-round, towering ferris wheel, whirling pendulum ride, and spinning tilt-a-whirl where they can have fun and maybe even gain a stat buff. Pick up the KR Amusement Park Tileset and build a carnival where anything can happen!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3766060/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Monsters_Asset_Pack_1/

Update your front view battles with some adorable pixel art creatures thanks to the RPG Monsters Asset Pack 1! Elv Games is here with a new series of battlers, this time focusing on front view monsters to challenge your heroes. 18 different dragon and plant-inspired enemy designs are ready to surprise your heroes while they explore the forests and mountains around their home town. Start your inexperienced heroes off by fighting small creatures with tall horns and little winged dragons that can barely float a foot off the ground, and teach them early about status effects by facing serenely-smiling flowers that can poison them with a burst of pollen. As your players get used to your battle system, throw buff lizardmen, petal-haired goblins, and wingless dragons covered in thick scales at them to keep your players on their toes, or use the stronger-looking monsters as a warning that your players have entered a deadlier area on accident!

Each enemy comes with 5 color variations, so you have 90 battlers to choose from! Have little wyverns be red, pink, purple, or black depending on their locations, or make the living flowers be orange, blue, brown, or purple depending on what type of debuff they can cause. Want to have a rare version of an enemy that offers a challenging fight and huge rewards? Then make sure your players recognize them when they appear by using the green color variations that have a glowing white outline! If you’ve been hoping for some new battlers for your front view fights or want to add some cute dragons to your game, check out the RPG Monsters Asset Pack 1!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Fantasy Market - Weapons Tileset, Doomsday Character Creator Kit 1
notes.notes:
[p]Time to get a new weapon, populate the shelves with the new KR Fantasy Market - Weapons Tileset! Or maybe you need new heroes and villains for your post apocalyptic game? Check out the new Doomsday Character Creator Kit 1!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3766020/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Fantasy_Market__Weapons_Tileset/"][/dynamiclink]

Make sure your heroes can visit the best weapon shop in town with the KR Fantasy Market - Weapons Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with their Fantasy Market series, this time offering up more than 50 different weapon types for your party to purchase. From daggers to war fans, clubs to katanas, boomerangs to crowbars, if your heroes need a weapon they’ll likely find it in this pack! 5 B sheets offer hundreds of weapon tiles to decorate your shops and give your players choices when it comes to equipment. Each weapon type comes in 3 sizes (with growing complexity) and 6 color variations that can show elemental strengths for the weapon, meaning you can offer daggers with water, wind, fire, or earth elemental buffs to make defeating some enemies easier. Or have your whip-wielding hero slowly upgrade his equipment from a simple whip to a two-headed whip to finally a devastating cat o’ nine tails. Choose unique weapons for each party member so that instead of a squad of swordmasters, your party consists of glaive users, masters of maces, miner-turned-fighters with pickaxes, sharpshooting sling-wielders, and more!

Don’t forget about mapping a shop! A2, A4, and B tile sheets are ready to help you build a shop with tables to display the different options and a forge where the store’s owner can make your hero new weapons if they bring her specific crafting ingredients. This pack also includes MV and MZ example projects to give you some more ideas for how to use the tiles. Pick up the KR Fantasy Market - Weapons Tileset and give each of your towns a wonderful weapon shop to visit!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3766000/RPG_Maker_MZ__Doomsday_Character_Creator_Kit_1/"][/dynamiclink]

Build your team of survivors and the NPCs they befriend with the Doomsday Character Creator Kit 1! PVGames continues their Doomsday series with a massive pack of 100+ body and outfit images that you can layer to dress your characters up exactly how you imagine them. With bases, hair, tops, bottoms, accessories, weapons, and more, the men and women who survived the apocalypse will still be able to look good while staying safe. Start your players with a character who’s dressed in scraps and suffering from amnesia, and have them fight or scavenge their way into leather jackets or armored gear to make survival much more likely, and let your players decide whether their survivor uses pistols, axes, machetes, or shotguns in battle. Use the full body images with 16 poses to let your players see their characters close up during cutscenes, or use them for NPCs so your players can tell if their conversation is going well based on their expressions.

Walking sprites and portraits aren’t all you’ll find in this pack! Each sprite sheet comes with a ton of behaviors that you can grab to add even more life to your game, with resting poses, attacks, interactions, and more. Have NPCs stand around safe zones with different idle animations so they all feel different, and let your players climb, jump, sneak, and run to gather all the possible items they could need. And if a conversation goes south? Then have your survivors pull out their weapons on the map before the battle starts. Just because it’s the apocalypse doesn’t mean that nobody is around, so give your game some suitably grungy characters with the Doomsday Character Creator Kit 1!
[/p]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699180/RPG_Maker_MZ__Bit_by_Bit_Sound__16_Bit_Fantasy_Music_2/

Inspired by the music of the SNES, each track is ready to turn a farm map into a cozy starting point for your farmhand-turned-hero, a village into a pillaged ruin, and an old mine into the creepy home of a monstrous lich!

Give your game’s first village a calm music track while your players are introduced to your game world with “Farm Boy” and its relaxed beat, at least until the village is attacked! Fight back against enemies while “The Big Bad Revealed” plays its heavy drum beats and organ music, and let your heroes slowly take in the horrors of their destroyed village while the somber piano and flutes of “Dire Times” plays in the background. Want to take a break from the serious discussions and battles, and just let your party members laugh and bicker? Then give them a silly cutscene where “Silly Sidekicks” plays its quirky melody and brass horns toot along. Or keep a side quest where your heroes have to explore an abandoned mansion from being too spooky with the track “You Didn’t Tell Me This Place was Haunted” playing its upbeat tunes.

Each track comes in M4a, Ogg, and Wav file formats, so you can easily add them to your favorite engine. Pick up the Bit by Bit Sound - 16 Bit Fantasy Music 2 pack and help your players fully immerse themselves in your game with carefully crafted music tracks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3765950/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Elf_Kingdom_Tileset/

Create an intricate castle town deep in the forest with the KR Elf Kingdom Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has made another MV/MZ-sized tileset to help you make a town full of magic and beauty. A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 5 B sheets offer up all the tiles you need to make interior and exterior maps fit for elves! Make a castle with towering roof spires and curving staircases, inns with furniture carved from silver, and weapon shops filled with magically-augmented blades!

Gray, brown, and green walls and floors are the perfect starting point for any building your town will need, and you can choose between simple blank and decoratively carved walls and floors to show the importance of the people who live or work there. Show the skill of the craftsmen in the area with stained glass windows filled with green glass and furniture made from swooping curved silver, while keeping the town in touch with nature with lush ivy climbing the walls of the houses and large trees scattered through the town. Let your heroes gain temporary buffs with platefuls of fresh fruit in the inn, or offer a place to rest with draped green cloth and cushions covering most of the floor.

This pack also includes character sprites for fire, doors, and a treasure chest to decorate your maps. Hide silver and emerald treasure chests behind locked stained glass doors, and make sure every room is lit with ethereal flames. Build a city filled with elegant architecture and creeping ivy with the KR Elf Kingdom Tileset!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Aquarium Tileset, Puppy Park
notes.notes:
This week, we present you with two perfect packs to give your characters time to relax! Enjoy sea life with the new KR Aquarium Tileset! Or spend some time with canine friends with Puppy Park!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699190/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Aquarium_Tileset/

Give your heroes a chance to unwind and enjoy watching fish swim by with the KR Aquarium Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another modern set of tiles designed for MV and MZ, this time focusing on all the objects you could need to build an indoor aquarium. A1, A2, A3, A4, and 4 B sheets are filled with a variety of walls and floors to help you build rooms where the focal points shine: the huge tanks of water! Layer the tank tiles over the water A1 tiles to create coral-filled aquariums with subtle movements that are wonderful backdrops for the animals. Mark important information with signs written on the walls and large arrows guiding your heroes around the space, and add a unique item shop to your game with a gift shop filled with cloth armor and buff-giving plushies!

The real stars of this pack are the character sprites, with 30 fish and other aquatic critters to populate your tanks! Fill the smaller tanks with bright tropical fish and bobbing seahorses, and give your players a shock in the underwater tunnel when a massive shark appears from the darkness and swims overhead. Separate the lobster, hermit crab, and shrimp tanks from the octopus and moray eel tanks by using this pack’s glass doors and escalators to break large spaces into multiple levels and rooms. If you’ve been wanting to give your hero an option to take a date to the aquarium or you have been hoping to make a relaxed slice-of-life game where you care for koi and axolotls, pick up the KR Aquarium Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699150/RPG_Maker_MZ__Puppy_Park/

Add hundreds of small dogs to your game with the Puppy Park pack! Yiula is here with a massive pack of character sprites and MV/MZ-sized tiles to help you build large dog parks for your heroes to enjoy. With more than 30 dog breeds to choose from (and tons of color variations for each), you can make sure that every dog has their own distinct look! From corgis to mini pinschers and basset hounds to yorkies, if you’ve been looking for small dog breeds this pack likely has what you’re looking for. Need a tan pomeranian? This pack has it! Want to give your hero a gray dachshund and white maltese? Or want to make your shopkeeper a brown pug? You can with this pack!

Want to show off even more of a dog’s personality? Then use the included accessories to turn a boring bulldog into a bow-wearing princess! Collars and bows in different colors can easily help your players recognize certain dogs, and add some silly personality to a pooch with glasses, a frisbee hanging from their mouth, and even their tongue swinging while they walk. 

And if all that wasn’t enough, dog sprites aren’t the only thing in this pack! 6 A1, 5 A2, 1 A5, and 14 B sheets are filled with different types of grounds, cliffs, shrubbery, and rails so you can make the perfect dog park for your game. Want the canine fun to continue even in the menus? Then grab one of the 10 windowskins with bone or paw print details and replace human portraits with puppy silhouettes. If you’re making a game with dogs as the main characters, or you just want to include your favorite dog breed in your game, check out the Puppy Park pack!

notes.title: New Tilesets: KR Tribal Fort, Winlu Fantasy Exterior Add-on Farm + Pack Updates
notes.notes:
Two new tilesets for RPG Maker! A new Tribal Fort set from Kokoro Reflections! A new Farm Add-on for Winlu Fantasy! Plus tons of updates to existing packs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699140/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Tribal_Fort_Tileset/

Build a protected village for your orc heroine to live in with the KR Tribal Fort Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a MV/MZ-sized tileset ready to help you build wooden huts and thick log walls to keep the village safe from deadly monsters and dangerous adventurers! A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 5 B sheets are ready to build exteriors and interiors filled with all the spikes, skulls, and weaponry an orc could wish for. Create buildings with wooden logs tied together with ropes and decorated with bones, and mark the chief’s home with draped red cloth off its roof. Create arenas for the villagers to train in with curved walls of logs, or mark combat areas with large curved bone and set up an armory hut filled with gnarly weapons nearby so fights are always fair. Let your heroes recover in rooms with roughly hammered together shelves and beds made from animal hides, and lock troublemakers up in wooden cages!

This pack also includes character sprites for log gates, a wooden treasure chest, a cloth curtain to use as a door, and rotating meat that you can set up over a campfire. Reward your players patience by having the raw meat they stick over the fire turn into a stat-boosting roasted meal, and stop your players from leaving the village too early by keeping the massive wooden gates firmly closed until they’re properly equipped. If your orc heroine needs a strong place to call home, or you want to give your adventurers a new place to challenge orcs and goblins, pick up the KR Tribal Fort Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699160/RPG_Maker_MZ__Winlu_Fantasy_Exterior_Addon_Farm_Tiles/

Give your players a lovely farm to run when they’re not off adventuring with the Winlu Fantasy Exterior Add-on Farm Tiles pack! Winlu is back with another addition to their Fantasy Exterior series, this time focusing on healthy plants and rustic charm to turn any houses you’ve already built into a working farm. 1 B sheet includes wood and thatch angled roofs to build barns, and short stone walls to keep your wheat fields separate from your livestock. Chicken coops and feed troughs are perfect for keeping your animals fed and safe, and some scattered piles of hay can add to the feeling that this is a busy farm with a working windmill.

And once you’ve set up the map, add more life to your farm with this pack’s character sprites! Have white and brown cows wander a grassy field where they can be milked, and give pigs some treats in the hopes of them digging up some useful items. Chickens can offer eggs (just watch out for the aggressive rooster!), and swarms of bees can be carefully followed back to their hive to gather healing honey. If animals aren’t your hero’s focus, then fill the fields with wheat, corn, and sunflowers that all grow and await harvesting. Smaller plots can grow carrots, cabbages, turnips, grapes, pumpkins, and tomatoes that your heroes could sell for extra cash, and let your heroes smash the rocks that appear in the fields to possibly find gold or silver ore. Pick up the Winlu Fantasy Exterior Add-on Farm Tiles pack and add some money-making farms to your towns and villages!

notes.title: New: Another World Heroine Generator 7 for MZ, KR Fantasy Market - Magic Tileset
notes.notes:
More generator parts to make your Heroines! New tiles to create magic shops and markets!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699060/RPG_Maker_MZ__Another_World_Heroine_Generator_7_for_MZ/

Add a demonic swordswoman, uniform-wearing shopkeeper, and upbeat healer to your party with the Another World Heroine Generator 7 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft expands their MZ generator collection once more, with 40 new generator parts to add even more appearances to your heroines and NPCs! Give your military base a variety of uniforms so it’s easier on your players to spot who they need to talk to next, and upgrade your party members’ battle outfits with flowing fabric or lightweight armor. Let your characters have haircuts that reflect their personalities, and give each of your youthful heroines their own shining eyes with a bright spark of positivity that can’t be extinguished even by the demon lord!

2 AccB, 3 Beast Ear horns, 20 Clothing, 5 Eye, 5 Front Hair, and 5 Rear Hair parts offer up stylish new options for your female characters. Turn your human heroine into a demon with horns coming out of her forehead at the start of your game, and let your players visually know when it’s time to explore a dungeon by swapping out her plain uniform with a skirt for a kimono-inspired dress with long flowing sleeves. Or show when she’s had a major life change by having her cut her long straight hair into a short bob with this pack’s rear hair options. If your heroines have been needing a new wardrobe or you just want to add some cool new horns to your demon villagers, check out the Another World Heroine Generator 7 for MZ pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699660/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Fantasy_Market__Magic_Tileset/

Stock all of the shops with the reagents and tools your magicians and alchemists could dream of with the KR Fantasy Market - Magic Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with a set of MV/MZ-sized tiles to add that extra layer of detail to your store maps that you’ve been dreaming of! A2, A4, and 1 B sheet offers warm wood and stone floors and walls to give your shops basic rooms, as well as counters, windows, and rugs to add a cozier vibe to the space. Keep your heroes from seeing the best items on sale by having those stored safely in the basement or on the second floor which can only be reached by using the stairs with the shopkeeper’s permission.

But the real highlight of this pack are the 5 B sheets filled with useful objects for your heroes to purchase! With spellbooks, maps, crystals, keys, accessories, potions, and more to choose from, you’re sure to be able to fill all of your shops with interesting items for sale. Help your players easily tell what a shopkeeper sells by placing bottles of health potions and bags of herbs on their table, or let your players wander between a shop’s tables and purchase the exact mystery box they want by interacting with it on the map! Have your heroes pick up new wizard robes or statues that boost their stats when placed in their home, or use this pack’s crystals or lit lanterns as markers so your players can easily tell how many dungeons they’ve completed. Add some on-map options for shopping or just give all of your mages’ rooms a visual upgrade with the KR Fantasy Market - Magic Tileset!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Crystal Castle Tileset, Time Elements - Castle and Catacombs
notes.notes:
Two new tilesets in two of our most popular styles! KR Crystal Castle Tileset and Time Elements - Castle and Catacombs are here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479440/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Crystal_Cavern_Tileset/

Send your heroes into glittering halls and shining altar rooms with the KR Crystal Castle Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a massive set of MV/MZ-sized tiles to help you build new locations for your players to enjoy and your heroes to explore. A2, A4, and A5 tiles along with 2 B sheets include all the walls, floors, and decorations you could need to create palace and church interiors. Have your heroes search a church chapel that had been cursed, where even the small flower beds by the doorway had been turned into hard jewels, or create mystical dungeons filled with pillars and crystal statues that form wherever magic levels grow too high.

Once crystal castle is already amazing, but what if you could have 10 different castles scattered around your world? This pack has you covered, with 10 different recolors to fit the mood you’re aiming for! Ruby, sunstone, topaz, emerald, aquamarine, sapphire, amethyst, rose quartz, onyx, and diamond versions can help you create a full rainbow of dungeons for your heroes to explore, or mix and match the sheets to create cool blue and green underwater palaces and deadly red and black lairs for the final boss. This pack’s 8 character sprites include 5 doors to help your heroes get inside the castle and search different rooms, while the decorative treasure chest can reward anyone who goes out of their way to explore and solve the dungeon’s puzzles. Use the 2 sheets of twinkles to highlight important points in a room, or use them just to make the maps even sparklier. So if you’ve been wanting to add some cool themed castles to your game, pick up the KR Crystal Castle Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699030/RPG_Maker_MZ__Time_Elements__Castle_and_Catacombs/

Visit gilded royal throne rooms and silent stone crypts with the Time Elements - Castle and Catacombs pack! Finalbossblues is back with a new entry into their Time Elements series, this time giving us tons of details to turn any trip to the kingdom’s castle into an exciting plot point or helpful side quest. A1, A2, 4 A5, and 2 B sheets offer up all you need to create lovely castle exteriors and creepy catacomb interiors. Cross over a moat to reach the castle’s stone walls and head through the open wooden doors to wander around hallways decorated with velvet drapes and stained glass windows until it’s time to meet with the king. Or skip over all the formalities and head deeper and deeper down the stairs to reach the red brick sewers or blue stone catacombs where the undead have started to gather. Fill the dungeons with the remains of nobles scattered like rubble and riches stored in stone tombs that can only be found after battling your way through dark hallways and stone rooms!

Keep your heroes out of the royal bedchambers with locked doors and light up even the darkest hallways with torches thanks to this pack’s 6 character sprite sheets! Use locked gates as part of puzzles deep in the dungeons, or have your heroes escape a tricky situation by sneaking through a floor grate into the sewers below after they’re thrown in jail for regicide. Each sheet comes in 3 sizes (original, Ace-sized, and MV/MZ-sized), so you can easily add them to your current project no matter the engine! If you’re in need of an incredible castle for your heroes to explore, or you just want to add to your Time Elements collection, pick up the Time Elements - Castle and Catacombs pack!

notes.title: New DLC: Hero Character Generator 2 for MZ, MGC Animations Collection Vol 3
notes.notes:
More character generator parts! More particle animations! Check out our two new packs for MZ!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688880/RPG_Maker_MZ__Hero_Character_Generator_2_for_MZ/

Give your hero a cute pet, a new haircut, and a powerful sci-fi spacesuit with the Hero Character Generator 2 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft is back with another set of MZ generator parts for your male characters, this time offering up 51 parts to choose from. 7 AccA, 6 AccB, 1 Cloak, 20 Clothing, 5 Eyes, 2 Facial Mark, 5 Front Hair, and 5 Rear Hair parts are ready to add some much-needed helmets to your sci-fi games and some important fantasy accessories that every game has been lacking: pets! Give your gruff and buff fighter some new armor and an adorable cat-like critter that hangs off his shoulder to let players know that he’s not as mean as he looks. Or reward your hero with a blue alien doggo for completing a tough side quest, so while he runs around space stations with his purple helmet and matching spacesuit he also has a cute companion! 

Give your military party member some dress whites and matching hat when he needs to meet with important officers, and let your healer wear an extravagant gilded robe to help distract from his eyepatch. Show that an NPC has a punk attitude with some two-tone hair, or give them glaring eyes to make it seem like they’re always in a bad mood. Pick up the Hero Character Generator 2 for MZ pack and give your heroes some gorgeous new outfits and recognizable accessories so your players can easily find the character they’re looking for!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688870/RPG_Maker_MZ__MGC_Animations_Collection_Vol_3/

Buff your heroes and your battles with the MGC Animations Collection Vol 3! ManuGamingCreations is back with another set of Effekseer animations for MZ to add some extra flair to your skills. Power up your paladins with glowing swords, make it easy for your players to tell what element resistance is being put on their party members with different casting animations, burn enemies with roaring flames, and more with this pack!

76 animations are split into 9 different sections to make it easy to find what you want. 8 casting types, 13 flames, 5 holy sword moves, 7 cero blasts, and 13 runes and spells offer up a bunch of options to power up your mages’ skill sets and add some interesting buff/debuff animations to all your party members. And if that wasn’t enough, there are also more random animations in the variety and RPG sections: 14 in variety #1 that include sci-fi blasts and explosions in various colors, 5 in variety #2 that include dark X-shaped attacks, 8 in RPG #1 with purple moves that drain the target before exploding, and 3 in RPG #2 that include a fire attack that pours lava over its target!

This pack also includes an MZ project so you can see how each animation can work with the default sounds, or copy-paste them into your game to quickly add new moves to your battles. If you’ve been wanting to upgrade your different spells or need to annihilate enemies with overwhelming explosions, check out the MGC Animations Collection Vol 3!

notes.title: New DLC: Doomsday Tiles - Core Urban Ruins, KR Party Time! Celebration Tileset
notes.notes:
Bring the party to your game with the new KR Party Tile! Celebration Tileset... or descend into the apocalypse with the new Doomsday Tiles - Core Urban Ruins!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3609040/RPG_Maker_MZ__Doomsday_Tiles__Core_Urban_Ruins/

Build sprawling cities for your hero to search and survive in with the Doomsday Tiles Urban pack! PVGames continues their Doomsday series with a huge set of 3D-modeled tiles perfect for building concrete and steel city parallax maps. This pack includes more than 7,500 images to help your maps match your vision, with towering buildings, shattered asphalt, piles of rubble, and crates and barrels ready to create busy streets and quiet alleys to explore. Each tile comes in multiple angles so you could even fill a whole room with boxes and have it not look repetitive!

Lead your players’ eyes to specific streets by placing destroyed cars and concrete barricades along the path, and make sure that it’s clear which roads aren’t walkable with massive craters in the ground and piles of bricks and trash from nearby buildings that have partially collapsed. Build custom houses with a variety of flooring and wall options, and add some helpful supplies to the ruined rooms by placing bottles of water and fuel cans on scorched tables and tucked behind broken bookshelves. Need a few more buildings to fill out a city block, but don’t have any specific designs in mind for them? Then grab one of this pack’s 100+ building exteriors to add those necessary buildings to the background. 30+ building and room interiors also make it easy to create little areas to reward your players who check every alley and unlock every door they come across. If you’ve been dreaming of making a post-apocalyptic game or want to make a city that was abandoned after the Zombie Wars, pick up the Doomsday Tiles Urban pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3609020/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Party_Time_Celebration_Tileset/

Throw the biggest party of all time after defeating the demon lord with the KR Party Time Celebration Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is at it again, this time giving us a massive set of MV/MZ-sized tiles to turn any map into an incredible party! Fill a parking lot with food trucks and carnival game stands for an impromptu fair, turn your heroine’s living room into a dream birthday party with bobbing balloons and piles of sweet treats, and celebrate the end of the harvest season with an awards ceremony where your players can receive gold trophies for growing the biggest pumpkin!

Autotile tables covered in bright tablecloths are ready to turn any open area into a party venue, and 4 B sheets cover just about anything you could think of to make a party amazing! Put all sorts of tasty treats on tables and make sure everyone has a place to sit with cushioned folding chairs, and add tons of color to even the hallways with hanging streamers and drapes. But that’s not all! Parties can have their own colorful themes, so each B and C sheet comes in 9 different colors (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, pink, purple, white, and black) for a total of 20 B sheets! Give your necromancer party member a suitably dark birthday party with black balloons and cake, while your swordmaster can have all of the pink and purple banners and presents that he has been dreaming of. Or mix and match the sets yourself to create a cheery rainbow-themed event!

Need to add some movement to your maps? Then make use of this pack’s more than 50 character sheets, with colorful balloons bobbing in place (or popping thanks to a flying dart), baseballs that can fly into stacked bottles to knock them over, flickering candles on top of cakes and cupcakes, and even a gray pickup truck to help move everything to the party’s location! So if you’ve been wanting to add birthday parties to your modern game or need an over-the-top wedding reception for your heroes to sneak into, check out the KR Party Time Celebration Tileset!

notes.title: New DLC: Battle Scene Music Pack, Doomsday Tiles - Core Rural Ruins
notes.notes:
Accentuate your combat with energetic tracks with the new Battle Scene Music Pack! Build out your apocalyptic world with the new Doomsday Tiles - Core Rural Ruins Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3609010/RPG_Maker_MZ__Battle_Scene_Music_Pack/

Fill boss battles with roaring electric guitars and energetic drums with the Battle Scene Music Pack! Ayato Sound Create is back with another music pack, and this pack’s 10 BGMs are ready to add some extra oomph to your modern game’s combat, with heavy drum beats keeping your players’ heart thumping and electric guitars and basses offering up some fast-paced melodies to help your players’ focus entirely on surviving the fight. 5 different themes are different enough to keep things feeling new without totally changing the music’s genre, with 4 metalcore, 1 gothic, 1 hardcore, 2 modern, and 2 emo style tracks! Choose a track with the right rhythm for your fight, and switch to a harsher song when the enemies are stronger than your players expect or change to a lighter song to let your players know when they’ve leveled up enough that the enemies won’t give them a challenge anymore.

Don’t forget that you can use these tracks for more than just battles! Give your stealth mission a surprising soundtrack when your heroes sneak into an active concert, and clue your players into dangerous areas when they stumble into somewhere they aren’t ready to be yet. Each track comes in M4a and looping Ogg file formats, so it’s easy to use in your favorite engine. If your game has a battle in a metal club or you want your final fight to feel like even the music will thrash your heroes if your players aren’t careful, check out the Battle Scene Music Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3608990/RPG_Maker_MZ__Doomsday_Tiles__Core_Rural_Ruins/

Build a small town showing its years of neglect after the apocalypse with the Doomsday Tiles - Core Rural Ruins pack! PVGames is back with another massive set of 3D modeled assets to help you craft incredible parallax maps for your heroes to explore. Let your heroes wander between decrepit storefronts, over asphalt bridges that have partially crumbled away, through parking lots that have been taken over by grasses and bushes, and more with this pack! Each tile comes in multiple angles so you can perfectly place each tile to fit your vision. And with more than 6,500 images to choose from, you’re sure to be able to build all the abandoned towns and forgotten small cities your game needs.

Create streets blocked by rusted cars and lined with battered wooden fences that lead into an almost deathly silent town. Search for life-saving items in barrels and crates scattered between houses and stacked  in locked basements, and gather medicinal herbs from broken greenhouses and from under playground equipment. Explore nearby forests filled with a variety of trees and lost trash that can be turned into something useful, and let your players rest up in old beds they find in ruined houses that are filled with memories of the family that once happily lived there.

Want to add a few more buildings and warehouses to your maps but don’t need to spend ages getting them looking just right? Then use this pack’s 29 prebuilt building exteriors to make sure your towns don’t look too empty! 11 empty building interiors and 8 empty room interiors are also perfect when you want to add another room to a location but don’t need it to be a specific size or shape. Just add in all the furniture and debris the room needs, and you’re ready to go! If you’ve been wanting to create a vast destroyed world for your modern heroine to explore, then pick up the Doomsday Tiles - Core Rural Ruins pack!

notes.title: Official DLC: 5 DLCs released, including a new popular tileset series!
notes.notes:
This week, two new products in the “SERIALGAMES LivingGoodCity TILESET” series, a tile set that allows you to create maps surrounded by gorgeous flowers, and a new “Demon Lord Army Set” of Enemy materials in a plug-in useful for production!
