notes.title: New DLC: KR Ruins Kit, Rogue Adventure - Ruins Tileset
notes.notes:
These ruin tilesets won't ruin your game! Check out the new KR Ruins Kit and Rogue Adventure - Ruins Tilesets!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3608980/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Ruins_Kit/

Destroy your hero’s hometown and give him a painful reason to defeat the dark lord with the KR Ruins Kit! Kokoro Reflections is back with a unique MV/MZ-sized pack that’s meant to be used with other tiles. Instead of having to replace an entire tileset style to show damage, create your own ruined villages with this pack! Overlays for A2 and A4 tiles along with 4 B sheets offer a lot of ways to damage and destroy a previously peaceful house. Remove the roof of a building and top its walls with broken stone, and stream trash and broken planks of wood around it to show where parts of the building ended up. Coat walls with smudges of dark grime and growing moss, or cover them with graffiti from the local hooligans. Want to show that the town was recently destroyed? Then drop splatters of blood all over the town square and leave a few skeletons tucked away in corners where NPCs thought they could safely hide. Need to show that it’s been more than a decade since someone entered a cursed village? Let plants and nature grow freely from holes in walls and have vines hanging between houses. And if you want a meteorite to have struck the town to start all the troubles, then make use of this pack’s holes and pits with mysteriously colored liquids in the bottoms!

This pack also includes 3 character sprites of fire (with small, medium, and large flames) to block off areas from your players and to show that there’s really no way to save everyone in the town after a bandit raid! Dripping water and skittering rat sprites can add some slight movement to a village that was abandoned years ago, and thick dark smoke can help lure your players to a house that still has something important inside. 5 fog and 3 parallax images in hazy black and bloody red are also ready to add some extra oomph to your damaged towns. Pick up the KR Ruins Kit and show your players just how much the village’s in your game can change depending on the players’ choices!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115760/RPG_Maker_MZ__Rogue_Adventure__Ruins_Tileset/

Explore dungeons created hundreds of years ago with the Rogue Adventure - Ruins Tileset! ELV Games continues their Rogue Adventure series with Ace and MV/MZ-sized tiles to create mossy temple exteriors and smooth dungeon interiors. A1, A2, A3, A5, and 12 B sheets include all the tiles you’ll need to create a bunch of dungeons scattered across your game world! Choose from light and dark stone to build mossy buildings surrounded by lush grass and small algae-filled ponds, and have crypts and tombstones warn your players that undead enemies may be around. Let your heroes unlock doors to side rooms that offer up more lore to the dungeon with benches and pots that show people actually lived there, and create dramatic ceremony rooms with raised platforms and broken columns around a pool of blood that mysteriously stays red no matter how many years have past.

This pack also includes 21 character sprites for objects to add puzzles, flames, and mystical guiding messages to your dungeons! Light up hallways with flickering flames and mark important doorways with glowing runes that switch between green and blue, or show that magic flows through the entire area by having columns release runes made of energy into the air. Challenge your players with puzzles where they need to step onto buttons in specific sequences, and give them easy ways to escape with large waypoints that let them return to the dungeon after a quick pit stop in the nearest town. If you’ve been looking for stone hallways and mossy floors for your heroes to explore, pick up the Rogue Adventure - Ruins Tileset!

notes.title: Great News for Polish Creators! Polish Language Support Now Available for RMMZ
notes.notes:
🎉 Great News for Polish Creators! Polish Language Support Now Available for RPG MAKER MZ 🎮🇵🇱
We have some exciting news for our Polish-speaking community!

RPG MAKER MZ now officially supports the Polish language!
This update will make it easier and more comfortable than ever for Polish creators to bring their game ideas to life.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38018723/7e54d3da4b7325917c36f1e762a211ff232fd1ab.jpg[/img]

Thank you for being a part of our journey—and happy game making!

notes.title: New DLC: Pixel Battlers Monsters Pack 3, RPG Character Pack 17
notes.notes:
New monsters to fight and new... demons to join the party.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3608940/RPG_Maker_MZ__Pixel_Battlers_Monsters_Pack_3/

Battle buff demons, swift beasts, and cute baby spiders with the Pixel Battlers Monsters Pack 3! ELV Games continues their pixel art series of front view battlers with 144 more enemy images to add even more unique battles to your games. Challenge your players with monsters that evolve in the middle of a fight, tiny creatures that can call for powerful backup, alien enemies that multiply when low on health, and more with this pack!

Help your players get used to your battle system by fighting smiling frogs, chubby rodents, and little-legged spiders in the starting forest dungeon, and as your players gain confidence increase the size and deadliness of the frogs and spiders and add some bipedal feline foes that can strike quickly with sharpened claws! Introduce intelligent enemies with short goblins and bone mask-wearing creatures, and make sure that your players understand that new tactics are necessary when a group of goblins calls in a weighty troll to help. Keep your players out of areas that are too deadly for them before they’re ready with solid stone golems that block their path, or force them into a battle with overpowered demons if they’re warned about a dungeon but enter it anyway.

Each enemy comes in 4 color variations, so that it’s easy to color-code elemental weaknesses or give your players clues that the noxious green demon wields poison-based attacks and the buff red-winged centaur can fling fireballs at will. Every image also comes in two sizes so that it’s easy to use it in Ace, MV/MZ, or your favorite engine. If you’ve been needing more monsters to fill your dungeons or just want to add some adorable frog foes into your game, check out the Pixel Battlers Monsters Pack 3!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3608970/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Character_Pack_17/

Charm your heroes, heroines, and players with the RPG Character Pack 17! Gee-kun-soft’s latest MZ-style character pack offers up 16 succubuses to add some devilish fun to your game world. Add the demon lord’s top soldiers to your game with this group of ladies who have a variety of horns, wings, tails, and lightweight outfits that will distract your heroes in combat while the succubuses steal their hearts (and life)!

Each character comes with walking and downed sprites, front view enemy battlers with 13 color variations, facesets with 8 emotions, SV battlers, and waist-up busts with 8 emotions so that you can use these ladies wherever you want! Have a blue-skinned, bat-winged, smiling succubus be a repeating foe that challenges your hero to a battle every time they complete a dungeon, and give your players the chance to woo a two-tailed thief to have her join the party instead of robbing them. Or ditch the trope of the main character being a teen boy and tell a story about the challenges of being a succubus in the demon lord’s army who just wants to enjoy life and settle down!

This pack also includes high-res images of each character, so you can introduce them from head-to-toe! Resize the images to perfectly fit your screen size, or add them into your game’s codex so players can remind themselves who each succubus is and what they’re favorite treats are. If your game has been lacking some mischievous NPCs or you want a unique heroine to lead a ragtag party, check out the RPG Character Pack 17!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Transportation - Cruise Ship, Summerwind Saga - Abandoned Mines
notes.notes:
Travel in style on a Cruise Ship with the a new KR Transportation tileset! Delve into deep mines with a new Summerwind Saga tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549620/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Transportation_Station__Cruise_Ship_Tileset/

Let your heroes take a break from saving the world and just enjoy a trip with the KR Transportation Station - Cruise Ship Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another tileset to improve your modern settings, this time focusing on the ins and outs of cruise ships so your heroes can have a great vacation. A1, A2, A4, and 4 B sheets are ready to build dining rooms, swimming pools, tiny cabins and not-so-tiny suites, colorful shops, and more! Start your heroes’ vacation by dropping all their luggage in their cabin, carefully tucking it between the blue couch and pillow-filled bed, before heading to the ship’s bow to watch the bridge send the ship sailing into inviting blue water. Let your players choose if they want to relax on a lounge chair under an umbrella on one of the ship’s decks or explore the halls with patterned rugs and sea-themed paintings before enjoying a concert on the ship’s stage. Reward your players for taking a cruise in the middle of the story by offering unique armor in the ship’s shops and buff-granting treats in the fancy dining room, or surprise them with a sudden side quest where they need to help the captain pilot the ship to avoid pirates!

This pack also includes 12 character sprites to add more function to your maps! Keep your heroes from entering NPCs’ rooms with solid white doors (at least until they find a master keycard) and use glass doors and elevators to travel between the ship’s different decks and interiors. Give your heroes the option to ride in a helicopter and challenge dungeons during their vacation, and in an emergency make sure the bright orange lifeboats are easy to get to! If your modern game’s heroes need a chance to breathe between adventures or you want to have a murder mystery where your players know the murderer is among them, pick up the KR Transportation Station - Cruise Ship Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549630/RPG_Maker_MZ__Summerwind_Saga__Abandoned_Mines/

Stock up on all the ores you need with the Summerwind Saga - Abandoned Mines pack! ELV Games continues their Summerwind Saga series with another staple of cozy farming sims: mines full of resources! A5 and 5 B sheets offer up dirt floors and brown stone walls to create mazes of underground tunnels for your hero to explore. Use diagonal walls to give your caves more natural shapes and diagonal stone staircases to make it more interesting for your players to wander while looking for ores. Show that others used to work in the mines with old wooden crates and broken chairs, or have the mine still be active thanks to strong wooden braces holding up the walls and lanterns lighting up the minecart tracks. Keep your players from getting every resource right away by having lower levels flooded until those levels are drained by experienced dwarves, and place a few edible mushrooms in corners so that your players don’t need to stress about running out of energy when deep in the mine. Stud the walls with iron, silver, and gold ores that need to be carefully mined to avoid cave-ins, and event spawning stones so that your players can get a little more ore each day.

Each tileset comes sized for Ace and MV/MZ, so you can easily use them in your favorite engine. Pick up the Summerwind Saga - Abandoned Mines pack to make sure your players have access to all the ores they need to level up their tools!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Furniture - Modern Suites Tileset, Rogue Adventure - Wonders Tileset
notes.notes:
A massive amount of cool furniture for your KR style tilesets! New dungeon tiles for the Rogue Adventure tile series!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549600/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Furniture_Store__Modern_Suites_Tileset/

Furnish the homes of your characters with a style that fits their personalities with the KR Furniture Store - Modern Suites Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a collection of furniture to make sure your modern rooms don’t all look the same. Fill a studious NPC’s office with dark wood and plush green armchairs, a no-nonsense party member’s bedroom with sharp angles and a black headboard, a cutesy NPC pale pink cabinets, and more with this pack!

3 B sheets offer up 10 different styles to help make each space unique, or let your players choose their favorite style so that it’s always nice when they return home after an adventure! Give your players the option of calm beige furniture with soft curves in the bedroom if they want to relax in peace, and help make every meeting feel exciting with rich wood tables and cheerful yellow couches in the living room. Or mix and match the different styles so your hero has blue bookcases, peach couches, and black-and-white dining chairs to help show that your hero’s focus isn’t on style but on fashion.

Each B sheet also comes in a shadowless version, so if you’re using parallax mapping or a plugin to place shadows you don’t need to worry about there being any rogue tile shadows in the room! If you’ve been searching for some more options to help your different houses stand out, or just want the perfect style for your hero’s home, check out the KR Furniture Store - Modern Suites Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549610/RPG_Maker_MZ__Rogue_Adventure__Wonders_Tileset/

Explore desert crypts and underwater palaces with the Rogue Adventure - Wonders Tileset! ELV Games is back with another addition to their Rogue Adventure series, this time with tiles to help your heroes sail the seven seas and visit even more dungeons! 1 A1, 2 A2, 1 A3, 1 A4, 2 A5, and 19 B sheets cover pyramids, underwater temples, and ship exteriors so your heroes can explore the world and help stop the demon lord. Place towering yellow and purple pyramids scattered across your maps to warn your players that there’s a challenging dungeon inside, and build interiors filled with twisting hallways, cryptic symbols, and deadly monsters if your heroes are brave enough to enter! Turn boring trips across the ocean into interesting cutscenes on the deck of your hero’s sailing ship, or let them choose whether to rest in the treasure room or chat with party members around a table while they wait to reach a new location. And add an element of surprise to any normal sailing trip with the chance to stumble across an underwater temple that offers great rewards if your heroes can solve the puzzles before they run out of air!

This pack also includes character sprites for torches, buttons, doorways, underwater plants, and more to help bring your dungeons to life! Have seaweed sway in the current while your heroes activate statues to open up the dungeon doors, and reward exploration with treasure chests tucked into corners and hidden behind puzzles. Each tile is sized for Ace and MV/MZ, so you can easily add them to your favorite engine. Pick up the Rogue Adventure - Wonders Tileset and let your heroes travel across oceans and plunge deep into the sea to find even more loot!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Brand New Overworld Tileset, Summerwind Saga - Dark Castle
notes.notes:
New overworld tiles from Kokoro Reflections! A new Dark Castle tileset for the Summerwind Saga Series!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549560/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Brand_New_Overworld_Tileset/

Connect your towns and dungeons with a detailed world map with the KR Brand New Overworld Tileset! Kokoro Reflections zoomed out their focus and created a bunch of gorgeous MV/MZ-sized fantasy tiles to help you make interesting maps for your players to enjoy as they explore your game’s world. Let your heroes travel across grassy plains with rolling hills as they visit small farming villages and wander through forests with massive trees and mushrooms that lead to a magician’s tower. Journey across oceans with deep waters and whirlpools that leads to shipwrecks along a kingdom’s beaches, where an enormous castle city is trapped beyond a poisonous swamp that can only be saved by activating the 8 colorful crystals scattered in the mountains, forests, deserts, and tundras on the continent!

A1, A2, A4, and 5 B sheets offer up a variety of villages and cities to populate your maps, as well as a bunch of colorful doorways and crystal entrances to give your heroes all the dungeons they could want to explore! Mark the level of different areas with 1 of 8 different colors (red, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, white, and black) for a number of tiles including man-made monuments, wells and doors, piles of stones, mushrooms, and crystals so your players can easily judge if they should be exploring a certain region or if they should backtrack and level up some more. If you’ve been wanting to give your world map an upgrade, then pick up the KR Brand New Overworld Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549570/RPG_Maker_MZ__Summerwind_Saga__Dark_Castle/

Send your heroes into a castle controlled by the demon lord and dungeons filled with creepy statues with the Summerwind Saga - Dark Castle pack! ELV Games is back with another addition to their Summerwind Saga series, this time offering dark brick walls and stone floors that are perfect for evil castles and abandoned fort basements filled with puzzles. This pack’s 8 B sheets have all you need to create a variety of rooms, and with brown and purple versions of each tile you can give different dungeons their own vibe or mark rooms that contain more deadly enemies! Diagonal walls make it easy to build hexagonal rooms and hallways without sharp corners, and thick pillars built into the walls can support the dungeon no matter how many levels down it goes. Block off passages with short stone fences and mark important paths with bright red and orange lines of magic carved into the floor, and remind your heroes that the dungeon is dangerous with scattered skulls gathered around horned statues that have eyes that seem to glow in the dark. Gather red and purple orbs from stands around the dungeon to solve puzzles and unlock new routes, and reward your players for exploring with treasure chests and items hidden inside pots!

This pack also includes character sprites for stone doors and flickering torches. Have your heroes travel between rooms with split stone doors and give the boss room a unique doorway that raises like a gate after defeating all the monsters in the room. Give your players a spooky dungeon to explore with the Summerwind Saga - Dark Castle pack!

notes.title: Official DLC: Anime-style tile sets, retro graphics, and a collection of songs!
notes.notes:
This week's offerings include a tile set that allows you to create an anime-style cityscape, a tile set that allows you to recreate a fire scene, and two background music collections with retro walking graphics.


"NEONPIXEL - Anime Countryside Set" is an eye-catching tile set with gorgeous colors. It is perfect for expressing an anime-style world view!

notes.title: New DLC: Another World Heroine Generator 6, KR Legendary Palaces - Slime Tileset
notes.notes:
More pieces to make generate heroines with! A new Slime themed Palace tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549530/RPG_Maker_MZ__Another_World_Heroine_Generator_6_for_MZ/

Deck out your heroines with new dresses, eyes, horns, and hairdos with the Another World Heroine Generator 6 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft continues their fantasy generator part series with 40 more MZ-style pieces to give your characters a makeover. 5 Beast Ears, 20 Clothing, 5 Eyes, 5 Front Hair, and 5 Rear Hair generator parts are ready to turn your generic female NPCs into vibrant and exciting characters! Dress your heroines in armored outfits when they’re exploring dungeons and lightweight dresses when they’re visiting towns, and help them keep their hair out of their faces with ponytail and bun hairstyles. And give your heroine’s cheerful childhood friend wide, friendly eyes and cute braids tied into loops while she smashes through monsters.

Want to give your villains a new look? Then grab this pack’s 5 horns to add a monstrous detail to them, with sharp angled ones and curving sheep’s horns so you can pick the ones that perfectly fit your villainess. Give your healer wearing a pink scrub dress some small devil horns to hint to your players that she may not be fully on their side, and give all of the dungeon bosses matching horns so that it’s obvious that they’re all working together. If you’ve been wanting to fill a hospital with unique nurses or need some more demonic lady knights to join your party, pick up the Another World Heroine Generator 6 for MZ pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549540/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Slime_Tileset/

Create a quartet of castles that hide powerful secrets in their gooey walls with the KR Legendary Palaces - Slime Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is giving our favorite starter enemy the attention they deserve with an MV/MZ-sized tileset ready to turn a boring dungeon into a slime’s paradise. A1, A2, A4, and A5 tiles come in red, yellow, green, and blue so that you can build bright rocky halls that lead to smooth rooms with puddles of goopy slime and pits that lead deeper into the dungeon. Slow your heroes down with adorable mini-slimes that coat the floor, and mark important paths with decorative tiles carved into hardened goo. Pillars, statues, and round windows fill this pack’s B sheets, which come in each of the 4 colors as well as versions with and without slime faces on the statues so you have 8 B sheets to choose from! Have your heroes explore blue hallways with ramps that lead to upper levels and surprise them with blank slime statues that come to life with grinning faces before a battle starts, or use the faceless versions to mark less important areas. 

This pack also includes character sprites for fires, treasure chests, and sparkles that match the tiles’ red, yellow, green, and blue themes so you can keep a consistent color for the dungeon, or try using green or yellow sparkles in a blue room to make sure it catches your players’ eyes! Pick up the KR Legendary Palaces - Slime Tileset and remind your players that slimes are more dangerous than they appear!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Spirit of England Tileset, Summerwind Saga - Fortress & Dungeon
notes.notes:
Two new tilesets are here to bring new environments to your game! Kokoro Reflection's Spirit of England Tileset will transport you directly to London, while ELV Games' Summerwind Saga - Fortress & Dungeon expands the Summerwind Saga style with fantastic new options!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479560/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Spirit_of_England_Tileset/

Build a bustling city filled with stone shops and double-decker buses with the KR - Spirit of England Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another tileset inspired by historical architecture, this time focusing on busy streets and shops you could find in cities like London. A1, A2, A3, A4, and A5 tiles can create all the exterior and interior maps your city could need, and 5 B sheets are filled with the little details to really bring your cities to life. Create city blocks where dark asphalt streets mark important areas and smaller cobblestone roads offer paths to hidden treasures and side quests, and keep a consistent look to every storefront with white stone walls and black shingle roofs over floor-to-ceiling windows that show off the shop’s goods. Set your players up with a cozy hotel room with wooden furniture and small beds to act as their base of operations during their stay in the city, or let your heroes live in their own home that’s located over a local pub filled with green booths and pints of beer. Let your players go shopping for fresh fruits and new casual outfits in the shopping district, and give them the option to start a new side quest by having red phone booths scattered around the city streets. 

This pack also includes character sprites for fireplaces, tall wooden doors left brown or painted white, and a bright red double-decker bus that can travel along all the city roads! Use the bus to add some extra movement to your maps, or use it as your game’s fast travel system so your players can quickly move between the districts. Pick up the KR - Spirit of England Tileset and build cities filled with towering stone buildings and secrets hidden in rich wooden rooms!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479540/RPG_Maker_MZ__Summerwind_Saga__Fortress__Dungeon/

Create dungeons to challenge your players with the Summerwind Saga - Fortress & Dungeon pack! ELV Games continues their Summerwind Saga series with stone walls and decorations to help you make interior and exterior maps that you can fill with treasures, traps, and monsters! A2 and B sheet ground tiles offer up grass options for the four seasons so you can have time pass while your heroes are adventuring, and 2 A5 and 4 B exterior sheets and 1 A5 and 4 B interior sheets are ready to help you create stone fortresses that contain underground dungeons. Build a small fort surrounded by thick stone walls where guards and soldiers can offer healing and skill training to your heroes, and use its tall watchtower to spot new areas to explore. Or create an abandoned fortress deep in the forest with its windows and entryway blocked to try to keep people out and use it as a high-level dungeon for your heroes to challenge when they feel like they’re ready. Let your heroes explore cold stone hallways and rooms with broken wooden furniture and crates that were flooded after monsters overran the dungeon, and reward your players who solve the dungeon’s puzzles with treasure chests and stairs that lead to more dangerous levels.

This pack also includes character sprites for torches to light up fortress walls and doorways for double doors, lifting gates, and a portcullis made of spears to keep your heroes from reaching certain areas before they're ready. If you’ve been building a Summerwind Saga world and have been waiting for tiles to create manmade dungeons for your players to explore, pick up the Summerwind Saga - Fortress & Dungeon pack!

notes.title: New DLC: Heroine Character Generator 10 for MZ, Pixel Battlers Monster Pack 2
notes.notes:
New heroines from Gee-kun-soft! New pixel enemies from ELV Games!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479520/RPG_Maker_MZ__Heroine_Character_Generator_10_for_MZ/

Dress your heroines for success with the Heroine Character Generator 10 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft is back with another set of MZ-style generator parts to give your party members and NPCs recognizable appearances, offering up military-inspired uniforms, quirky cloth armor, and fantasy outfits that you can top with accessories and shining eyes. This pack’s 60 pieces include 5 AccA, 8AccB, 20 Clothing, 2 Wings, 2 Ears, 2 Eyebrows, 5 Eyes, 2 Faces, 2 Mouths, 2 Noses, 5 Front Hair, and 5 Rear Hair are ready to give your characters striking new looks.

Designed to work easily with this pack’s shaded faces, each part can be mixed and matched to perfectly fit your game’s world! Give a party member pointy elf ears and sparkling eyes while she’s dressed in a crisp white uniform to add some fun fantasy to your sci-fi game, or reveal a secret about your medieval-inspired world with some hi-tech space suits and helmets that your heroines can wear into battle after exploring an ancient temple. Let a sorceress have a cute cat-like familiar float next to her who can offer new spells for a price, and have your favorite female party member start wearing an adorable feather or stylized skull hairpin after the main character takes her on a date.

This pack also includes body bases that work well with the lightweight outfits as well as gradients with some additional colors so you can make your heroines stand out with unique outfit and eye colors. Pick up Heroine Character Generator 10 for MZ and prepare your heroines for dangerous space battles, strategic military operations, and parties where flamboyant outfits are required!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479530/RPG_Maker_MZ__Pixel_Battlers_Monsters_Pack_2/

Battle bulls, bats, behemoths, and all-around baddies with the Pixel Battlers Monsters Pack 2! ELV Games is back with another set of front view pixel art battlers, sized for Ace and MV/MZ, for your heroes to face in combat! 36 different monsters are ready to turn any map into a creature-filled dungeon. Battle fish and slithering dragons on beaches, snakes and goblins in forests, bats and demons in caves, and more with this pack! Keep your players on their toes with tons of different enemies they could fight at any moment and keep them thinking with upgraded troops that can’t be defeated by mashing attack. Teach your players the basics with small horned demons and charging bulls early in the game, and then challenge them with evolved versions where the demons have magical swords and shields and the bulls are replaced with axe-wielding minotaurs! Or let your players decide if they want to turn a normal fight into a deadly boss battle with increased rewards by having three-eyed mob monsters turn into six-eyed demons and cute little wildcats become muscular werecats if the battle lasts longer than 5 turns.

Each monster also comes in 4 different colors, bringing the pack total to 144 battlers! Fight a horde of green, blue, yellow, and red goblins who each have their own elemental strengths and weaknesses, or switch between the black, brown, purple, and red minotaurs so that battles don’t feel exactly the same even when your players are grinding to finish a challenging collection side quest. notes.title: RPG Maker MZ has been updated to v1.9.0
notes.notes:
RPG Maker MZ has been updated to version 1.9.0.
The update contents are as follows:

[list]
[*]Added Character Generator assets in dlc/BasicResources/generator folder. Import the assets following the steps written in a text file which exists in the same folder.
[*]Face and icon images can now be selected from multiple size standards, supporting asset standards from the previous series.
[*]In the database [System 2] - [Editor Settings] - [Message Width], you can now change the position of the guideline for a new line break displayed in the "Show Text" event command. It is specified by the number of characters. It supports both cases with and without a face image.
[*]You can now exclude specific files during deployment. You can exclude files/folders that match the extensions specified in "Exclude extensions" and the names specified in "Exclude files/folders" (include the extension for files) to export the game folder.
[*]In the database [System 2] - [Advanced Settings] - [Pictures Upper Limit], you can now change the maximum number of pictures. You can set up to 500.
[*]When you select "Save as Image" by right-clicking on the map, you can now set four levels of reduction scale. In addition, it is now possible to export an image at the same magnification even for large maps of 64x64 or more.
[*]The amount of Parameter Changes for weapons/armors can now be set up to -9999 to 9999 for Max HP and Max MP, and -999 to 999 for other parameters.
[*]There is no longer a coordinate limit when placing enemies in "Troops". If you place it off-screen and cannot click it, use "Align" to reset it.
[*]In all text boxes where control characters can be used, you can now select "Insert Control Character", "Insert Color Number" and "Insert Icon Number" when you right-click.
[*]When you specify a Switch/Variable in "Event Searcher", the search results now include events where they are used in the Conditions.
[*]In "Plugin Manager", the scroll position when it was last opened is now restored.
[*]In the database [System 2] - [Editor Settings] - [JSON Format Level], you can now select the formatting level of the JSON files output by MZ from three levels. Put 0 for no formatting. Put 1 for the minimum length that creates a new line at every data unit (same as before version 1.8.1). Put 2 for the maximum length that creates a new line at every comma or bracket.
[*]You can now select maps on a map selector dialog by specifying "map" or "location" for the annotation "@type" of the plugin parameter. If you specify "map" for @type, the ID of the selected map will be set as its value. If you specify "location", you can select a map and the coordinates on the map and an object (string) containing the map ID, X coordinate and Y coordinate will be set as its value. ex) {"mapId":"1","x":"0","y":"0"}
[*]When "file" is specified in the annotation "@type" of the plugin parameter, you can now specify the "movies" folder as the value of "@dir".
[*]Fixed an issue that the scroll bar could not be moved when using a touch screen (such as an LCD tablet) on Mac.
[*]Fixed an issue that the scroll bar movement status was stored when another event editor was opened with the scroll bar moved horizontally in the event editor.
[*]Fixed an issue that when there was a map that existed on the map tree but its data file did not exist and you deploy with "Exclude Unused Fils" enabled, the actually used assets were unintentionally deleted.
[*]Fixed an issue that when "%1" was entered in the message of a newly created Skills/States and restarted MZ, an extra "%2" was inserted.
[*]Updated Launch plugins "AltMenuScreen2MZ.js", "AnimationMv.js", "BattleVoiceMZ.js", "DevToolsManage.js", "EventMovableLimitation.js", "EventReSpawn.js", "ItemCombinationMZ.js", "MessageWindowPopup.js", "NovelMessageMZ.js", "ShakeOnDamage.js", "SmartAutoBattle.js" and "TemplateEvent.js" (\dlc\BasicResources\plugins\launch folder).
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479490/RPG_Maker_MZ__Summerwind_Saga__Forest__Mountains/

Climb steep cliffs and search for herbs and mushrooms under lush canopies with the Summerwind Saga - Forests & Mountains pack! ELV Games continues their Summerwind Saga series with a variety of trees and rocky cliff faces to add all new areas for your heroes to explore and your farmers to use as new spots to farm! A2 ground tiles are ready to be covered with 29 B sheets filled with grass edges to make smooth transitions, trees and plants to fill an area with nature, and cliffs that can be mixed and matched to create towering mountains. 

Create forests where the trees have different sized canopies and twisting trunks in two different colors so that it doesn’t feel like each grove is a copy, and scatter small red-capped mushrooms in the shadows that your heroes can collect to cook or craft with! Use enormous fallen logs as magical portals between areas and keep your new heroes safe by setting up fences and signs so they don’t end up fighting monsters way beyond their level. Let your heroes climb grass-covered hills to find rare trees or climb even higher until dirt and stone is all you can find. Show that time is passing in your game world with spring, summer, fall, and winter versions of the forest and tree tiles, and turn a safe mountain pass into a frigid challenge with the snow-covered winter version. Give each season their own collectables and monsters, or let the changing seasons subtly prompt your players into action to stop the final boss before it’s too late!

Each tileset sheet comes in 2 sizes, 32x32px for Ace and 48x48px for MV/MZ, so you can use it in your favorite engine! If you’ve been wanting to expand your farming game with some more locations to forage in or need some variations to show different seasons as time passes in your game, check out the Summerwind Saga - Forests & Mountains pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479480/RPG_Maker_MZ__Summerwind_Saga__Village/

Build a cozy town for your heroes to call home with the Summerwind Saga - Village pack! ELV Games is here with a set of tiles ready to create villages for your heroes to live in and visit. This pack’s A2 ground tiles and 29 B sheets can make a bunch of buildings that you can decorate to match your vision! Choose between 1-tile and 2-tile tall walls and top them with gabled roofs covered in blue, red, or black shingles so you can give each town a consistent look or mark important buildings with a roof that stands out compared to the normal houses. Decorate each house with chimneys and round, arched, or square windows, and don’t forget to give the gardeners flowers on their windowsills! Place cobblestone paths between businesses so it’s easy to get to them and mark each with a wooden sign above their door so travelers know which is the item shop and which is an inn with a quick glance. And make the whole village feel more lived-in with boxes piled high against walls, and wooden swings and teeter-totters for the kids of the village to play with while their parents are busy with work.

Normal and snow-covered versions of each house tile makes it simple to show changing seasons with the buildings themselves, or make sure that a village hidden deep in the snowy mountains is properly coated with fluffy snow. Each tileset sheet also comes in 32x32px and 48x48px-sized versions, so you can easily use them in Ace, MV/MZ, or your favorite engine! Pick up the Summerwind Saga - Village pack and give your heroes a nice place to return to after hours of adventuring and foraging!

Want to make sure your rocks match the rest of the region? Don’t worry, each rock comes in four different colors: brown, yellow, gray, and rainbow! Add yellow stones that stick out of your deserts so your players can navigate the large areas, and drop rainbow rocks around the world that can act as healing and save points. As if that wasn’t enough, this pack also includes versions with and without shadows, bringing the B sheet total to 64! Use shadowless tiles when you’re adding the lighting and shadows a  different way, or switch between the versions when night falls and the moon isn’t reflecting a lot of light. Pick up the KR Stone Quarry Tileset and you’ll never take good rocks for granite again!

Create textured floors with marbled muscle and gooey puddles of blood cells, and replace boring pools of water with noxious green stomach acid! Let your heroes travel between pointed ribs that stab up from the floor and follow angled walls to find the center of the dungeon where carved platforms and basins offer a chance to finally escape. If your game could use a cleaner set of tiles, then grab this pack’s bright white and dreary gray tiles to form floating platforms and rooms where pools of healing potions offer up a quick respite. Have your heroes wander up and down diagonal stairs to reach new heights or teleport with glyphs carved into the floor to make a maze of interconnected rooms.

This pack also includes 7 character sheets and 3 large character sprites to add creepy movement to your maps and add lights and puzzle elements to break up your battle-filled dungeons. Form walls of pulsing red pustules to force your heroes onto the path you want, and set up glowing blue glyphs to point your heroes in the right direction or to clue them in to a puzzle’s answer. Each tile comes sized for Ace and MV/MZ, so you can use them in your favorite engine. Pick up the Rogue Adventure - Otherworld Tileset and create flesh-filled dungeons and mystical platforms that can help or hinder depending on your heroes’ choices!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409130/RPG_Maker_MZ__Summerwind_Saga__Grasslands_4_Seasons/

Create a world that changes with the seasons with the Summerwind Saga - Grasslands 4 Seasons pack! ELV Games continues their Summerwind Saga series with a pile of tilesets that you can switch between to show time passing in your game! Cycle through spring, summer, fall, and winter while your hero gathers ingredients and explores their world, and create varied spaces with short cliffs and fences. 1 A2 and 17 B sheets off up different colors for grasses to best match the season you want. Each season has their own 4 B sheets filled with plants, stones, wooden signs, and more to help you make busy plains and forests. 

Start your game in a lush and bright world of spring where flowers cover the ground or give your farming game a unique beginning by starting in fall where the crops are ready to harvest and the bushes and trees all have yellowing leaves. The warm weather of summer is perfect for letting your hero hang out on the local lake’s docks to fish, while the freezing winter means iced over ponds and rivers can be safely walked across to reach new areas! Each tile comes in multiple sizes for Ace and MV/MZ so you can easily use them in your favorite engine. If you’ve been wanting to show different seasons as your player explores the world or want to have distinct plant colors for different areas, check out the Summerwind Saga - Grasslands 4 Seasons pack!

notes.title: New DLC: RPG Character Pack 15, Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Mushroom
notes.notes:
Add new heroes to your game with RPG Character Pack 15! Build a new fantasy environment with Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Mushroom!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409080/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Character_Pack_15/

Add monstrous new heroes and villains to your game with the RPG Character Pack 15! Gee-kun-soft is at it again with a new set of MZ-style characters to fill your party and dungeons with demons and beastmen. 16 vibrant characters are ready to turn a normal fight against a succubus into a tantalizing back-and-forth that could result in a new party member, change a boring demon king into a powerful woman, and transform the orc and lizardman enemies into the heroes of their own stories!

Each character comes with walking and downed sprites, front view enemy images, facesets and busts with 8 emotions, and SV battlers, making it easy to turn any of these characters into party members, dungeon bosses, or even NPCs that eventually reveal that they’ve been pulling the strings behind the scene all along! Form a party with a blonde lady warrior who wields a scythe, a trenchcoat-wearing kobold with fluffy black fur, and a green-scaled dragon girl to stop the trio of humanoid demon girls who plan on taking over the world. Face off against an agile bunny girl who flicks her poofy black tail before smashing heads with her oversized hammer, a rogue knight cursed to be a white werewolf until he finishes his quest, and a red-headed fox spirit who uses alluring magic to trick her opponents! 

This pack also includes high resolution versions of each character’s art, so you can fully show them off during their first introduction or resize the images to better fit your game’s screen size. If your game’s party has been needing some scaled and furry companions or you just want to include some cute demon girls in the villain’s army, check out the RPG Character Pack 15!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409100/RPG_Maker_MZ__Winlu_Fantasy_Tileset__Mushroom/

Add a fantastical spin to your forests and world with the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Mushroom pack! Winlu is back with another addition to their Fantasy Tileset series, this time giving you a selection of MV/MZ-sized tiles to create maps that feel like your heroes shrank down to ants on a forest floor. A1 and A2 tiles along with 3 B sheets offer up water, grass and dirt, and cliff tiles to help you build map bases where your heroes can wander and explore before they realize the mushroom forest is known for more than just tasty morel harvests. 

Create submerged stone paths through crystal clear blue water and add mystical purple pools scattered around where your heroes can restore their health and mana, and funnel your heroes in the right direction with rocky cliff faces that are studded with red shelf fungi until the party reaches a hollow tree trunk that has formed a tunnel deeper into the forest. With a quick map change you can transform the world into a magical place where blades of grass stand taller than your heroes and mushrooms loom as tall as trees! Let your heroes travel between red, blue, and orange mushrooms that line the path, and light up dark areas with bioluminescent fungi that reveal a cave entrance buried in a cliff face. This pack also includes some character sprites to add a magical glow to your mushrooms and diagonal corners to add smoother turns to your rivers and lakes. Pick up the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Mushroom pack and fill your magical forests with giant fungi and curling tree roots!

notes.title: New DLC: A Touch of Opulence Tileset, KR Legendary Palaces - Werewolf Tileset
notes.notes:
Two new tilesets bring new looks to your games! Build a rich noble's mansion with the A Touch of Opulence Tileset! Build a new themed castle with the KR Legendary Palaces - Werewolf Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409050/RPG_Maker_MZ__A_Touch_of_Opulence_Tileset/

Have you been trying to give each of your rich noble’s mansions their own look, but ran into the problem of giving them all the same furniture and walls? Then A Touch of Opulence Tileset is made for you! Aqua is here with a variety of MV/MZ-sized plush rugs, detailed wallpapers, and carefully crafted couches to turn your boring noblewomans’ living rooms and princess’ bedrooms into gorgeous interiors that will be the talk of the town. This pack’s 1 A2, 4 A4, and 3 B sheets are filled with everything you need to add some extra grandeur to sitting rooms, kitchens, studies, bedrooms, and even bathrooms! Lead your players through hallways with wooden floors topped with lace-like round rugs and lined with large windows decorated with draped curtains that complement the chaise lounge positioned to get the morning sun. Create a study filled with warm brown wooden bookcases and a large desk with tons of small drawers where your heroes can find useful notes that can help them finish their current quest, or have them stay in a white and pink bedroom with attached bathroom while they wait for the information guild gathers the clues they need.

This pack also includes extra A4 and B sheets to help you make each room perfect. Mix and match wooden baseboards and 24 wallpaper designs to give each house their own cohesive style and use the 15+ recolors of the couches and benches so that you can show off the homeowner’s favorite colors. Give a vampire noble some dark red couches while a castle ruled by a child has bright pink, purple, and teal benches lining the hallways and playrooms. Pick up A Touch of Opulence Tileset and fill every mansion with beautiful furniture and decorations!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409070/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Werewolf_Tileset/

Build the perfect castle for those who love (or loathe) the moon with the KR Legendary Palaces - Werewolf Tileset! Kokoro Reflections continues their Legendary Palaces series with an amazing set of MV/MZ-sized tiles filled with shades of off-white, gray, and blue so no matter the time of day it feels like a full moon is shining down on all of the castle’s inhabitants! Forget cramped caves or normal forest clearings, your werewolf queen deserves to live somewhere nice! A1, A2, A4, A5, and B tiles are ready to turn a fur-filled dungeon into an incredible maze through moonlit hallways until your heroes reach the throne room lined with carved tree trunk pillars. Set up bridges over flowing water to keep out any pesky vampires and place moon-shaped windows along cool blue walls that let moonlight shine down on powerful wolfman statues, and make sure your heroes can easily navigate the dungeon with a multitude of stairs, ladders, and magical circles to help them get around pit traps and deadly spikes.

This pack also includes character sprites for flames to light up the darker corners of the palace and a silver stump treasure chest to reward your heroes for making their way through a werewolf battle rush. Need some inspiration or help figuring out each tile’s passability? Then open up the included MV and MZ projects so you can see the tiles in action. If you’ve been wanting to give your werewolf clan a nicer place to live or your moon-powered cult needs their own dungeon maze, pick up the KR Legendary Palaces - Werewolf Tileset!

notes.title: New DLC: New Music, New Character Gen Parts, New Tiles!
notes.notes:
Three new and varied packs for your games! New Music, New Character Generator Parts, New Tiles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364410/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Wonderland_RPG_Music/

Give your maps and cutscenes the right vibes with the Fantasy Wonderland RPG Music pack! 10 BGM tracks offer up something spooky, something quirky, and something dangerous with their synth instruments and catchy melodies. Use this pack’s three versions of ‘Serenade’ to quickly remind your players of an overarching theme to the quests, with the upbeat piano version playing the first time they learn of the quest, then changing to the spooky version with jingling chimes repeats the melody when your heroes discover the truth behind the quest. When they’ve finally finished, give them their hard-earned rewards while the full version of ‘Serenade’ plays with a bunch of strings, horns, and drums all building to a dramatic end. Fill a lonely cathedral with the haunted organ tunes of ‘Requiem for the Restless’ or use the organ in ‘Stained Glass Shadows’ to add a sense of unease to a quiet village your heroes just reached. 

Get your players’ toes tapping with the upbeat electric guitars and piano of ‘Ghostly Giggles’ while they’re exploring dungeons or mysterious basements, and have them battle phantasmical foes while electric guitars rip in the background thanks to ‘Midnight Mass Murmurs’. Each track comes in M4a and looping Ogg file formats, so you can add them to your current RPG Maker project or use them in your favorite engine! Pick up the Fantasy Wonderland RPG Music pack and set the mood with songs with repeated melodies or tunes with underlying sinister tones in an otherwise peace-looking village!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364430/RPG_Maker_MZ__Hero_Character_Generator_for_MZ/

Turn your hero into a samurai, a cyborg, a space ranger, or even a vampire prince with the Hero Character Generator for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft is back with another excellent MZ-style generator part pack for your male characters, with 57 pieces to dress your heroes for success! 3 AccA, 9 AccB, 2 Beard, 2 Cloak, 20 Clothing, 5 Eyes, 1 Facial Mark, 2 Glasses, 1 Mouth, 1 Wing, 5 Front Hair, and 5 Rear Hair parts are perfect for making all of your male party members and important NPCs memorable compared to the normal citizens in your game. Give your serious soldier party member a short and low maintenance haircut while your brash barbarian has wild long hair barely contained in a ponytail, or show how a character is changing by switching his long flowing hairstyle into a short, loose style with bangs after he makes an important decision. Dress your agility-based fighters in lightweight cloth outfits so they can zip around the battlefield while your samurai are decked out in powerful armor and a gilded helmet to draw the enemy’s attention. Give your game a sci-fi flair with some military uniforms for your hero that he can swap out for strength-enhancing cybernetic armor, and make sure your fantasy hero is properly dressed in a flashy suit when he’s getting knighted by a king!

Don’t forget the little things to take your hero’s design to the next level! Give him a mouth with a fang sticking out to remind your players that he’s not completely human, or add a scar across his face after he loses a fight to his best friend after he’s revealed to be working with the villain the whole time! Let him grow his hair out or grow a beard while time passes in the game, or give your players the choice to switch up his looks depending on what outfits they’ve unlocked. If you’ve been wanting some new looks for your male party members in your fantasy or sci-fi games, pick up the Hero Character Generator for MZ pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364420/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Yeti_Tileset/

Build an icy castle hidden deep in the wild frozen mountains or a dungeon filled with hairy beasts with the KR Legendary Palaces - Yeti Tileset! Kokoro Reflections continues their Legendary Palace series with one ready to chill your heroes to the bone. Create hallways lined with deadly icicle pits, treasure rooms with slippery floors that can send your heroes careening into palace guards, and throne rooms where statues of all the previous yeti kings are carved into ice! This pack’s A1, A2, A4, A5, and B tiles all look cold to the touch with cool blues and whites making up almost every piece. Build a dungeon entrance out of craggy stone with gray, blue, and white ice debris pushed into the corners, and eventually have the stone make way for tiled blue walls and smooth white floors. Decorate with icicles that were carefully carved into pillars and statues of the castle’s fuzzy inhabitants, and place snowflake-shaped magic circles around the palace to make it easy to get from one hallway to another! When your heroes finally make their way to the throne room, take a moment for them to stare in awe at the iced dias and throne before the boss battle begins.

This pack also includes character sprites for glowing ice gems and frozen treasure chests. Help your heroes navigate maze-like hallways by having the wall-mounted diamond-cut gems glow stronger when they’re on the right path, or light up darker parts of the castle with the different sizes depending on how far into the castle your heroes are. And don’t forget to reward exploration with pointed treasure chests carved from hunks of ice that you can tuck away in all sorts of castle corners and behind challenging puzzles or battles! If you’ve been wanting to add a unique take to your ice dungeons or want a good reason to add some yetis to your game, check out the KR Legendary Palaces - Yeti Tileset!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Idyllic Village Tileset for RPGs, Omega Modern Alien Planets

Two new tilesets from two of our fan favorite artists to add to their collections! KR Idyllic Vilage! Omega Modern Alien Planets!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364400/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Idyllic_Village_Tileset/

Kokoro Reflections has crafted another MV/MZ-sized tileset to help you make distinct towns in your game, this time focusing on dark woods and white plaster walls to let you build a quaint village nestled in the mountains far from the hustle and bustle of the kingdom’s cities. Have your hero grow up in a cozy cottage, visit quiet manors surrounded by flowering hedges and lovingly tended gardens, and find the retired swordmaster who lives near the local waterfall by climbing hundreds of stone stairs from the town square with this pack!

A1, A2, A3, and A4 tiles along with 2 B sheets include grass, dirt, and cobblestone paths to lead your heroes from other busy parts of your world to a calm village filled with cottages built from timber and stone. Let them explore paths between pine trees and cross stone bridges over streams, and visit the village square where wooden carts and crates wait to be delivered to their destinations. Use this pack’s modular signs to make it easy for your heroes to find the inn, where they can eat a hearty meal cooked on an old-fashioned metal stove and then fall asleep in wooden beds topped with patchwork quilts. Build the exact house exteriors you want with a variety of diagonal walls, porches, and roof pieces, so that you don’t have to worry about a town filled with copycat buildings. Pick up the KR Idyllic Village Tileset and build new towns and villages for your heroes to find far from dangerous dungeons where they can finally relax in nature.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364390/RPG_Maker_MZ__Omega_Modern_Alien_Planets/

Send your players on a retro adventure among the stars with the Omega Modern Alien Planets pack! Finalbossblue is back with an addition to their Omega Modern series, offering up sci-fi tiles ready for any pixelated visit to the Moon, Mars, and even worlds on the other side of the universe! A1 tiles, 5 A5 sheets, 2 B sheets, and a starry parallax are ready to be mixed and matched to make exciting worlds for your hero to explore. Start your players on an easy mission to the Moon, where long stretches of grey dirt is broken up with craters and stones, and their rocket home stands next to satellite dishes and monitoring computers. Once they’ve succeeded then they’re ready for a real challenge, so sit them inside the round rocket while it blasts off towards a brand-new planet! Visit worlds where yellow sands and noxious green fluids reveal strange plants that offer brown tentacle branches that have powerful medicinal qualities, or spend time in a world where pink grasses cover the ground and the tree-like flora has white leaves!

This pack also includes 8 human characters and 8 aliens so your hero doesn’t feel like he’s alone on his adventure. Keep your astronauts safe in space with pressurized helmets when they’re meeting single-eyed alien envoys or running away from scruffy creatures that live near the planet’s poisonous waters. If you’ve been wanting to send your players on a fun rocket adventure or just want to add to your Omega Modern collection, pick up the Omega Modern Alien Planets pack!

notes.title: New DLC: Summerwind Saga - Characters, Summerwind Saga - Magma & Frozen Caves
notes.notes:
The Summerwind Saga expands! New Characters, New Magama and Frozen Caves Tiles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364310/RPG_Maker_MZ__Summerwind_Saga__Characters/

Fill your farming game with active NPCs thanks to the Summerwind Saga - Characters pack! Elv Games is here with another addition to their Summerwind Saga series, this time offering up a ton of character sprites with matching behaviors so you can give everyone in your game world’s activities. Have armored knights protect townsfolk by cutting through bandits with swords, farmers prepare their fields by hoeing the ground, injured villagers flat on the ground after a surprise attack, and more with this pack!

Have long-haired villagers swing their hoes down into the dirt and then water planted seeds with a metal watering can, or fill a fort with some of this pack’s 96 armored knights who practice their sword strikes against each other and chop down lumber with axes and break stones with pickaxes to help fix any walls damaged by monster attacks.

If your farming villages have been needing NPCs out in the fields caring for crops or you want to let your players choose their hero and hack-and-slash their way to success, check out the Summerwind Saga - Characters pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364370/RPG_Maker_MZ__Summerwind_Saga__Magma__Frozen_Caves/

Send your heroes deep into hot and cold dungeons with the Summerwind Saga - Magma & Frozen Caves pack! Elv Games is back with another tileset to expand their Summerwind Saga series, with all the tiles you could need to make icy caverns and lava-filled volcanic interiors. Create cool caves where snowy floors slowly give way to ice and blue-tinged walls where spikes of jagged ice burst up from the floor, or have brown stone slowly ooze magma the deeper your heroes go in the dungeon!

So if you’ve been needing more variation in your cave dungeons, or just want to add some cool mines for your players to explore, check out the Summerwind Saga - Magma & Frozen Caves!

notes.title: Registration Has Begun! RPG Maker Festival Returns in 2025!
notes.notes:
The RPG Maker Festival has returned for 2025!

▼What is RPG Maker Festival?
February 25th is “Maker Day”, the day we celebrated all things RPG Maker.
And we celebrate by holding the RPG Maker Festival!

RPG Maker Festival celebrates all games made with all versions of RPG Maker and Pixel Game Maker! We want to showcase and introduce more people to the wonderful games that have been made with RPG Maker, and connect as many creators and players together as possible. The more connected we are, the more fun there is to be had!

There’s many anniversaries this year, so the theme for RPG Maker Festival 2025 is “A Tapestry of Old and New Titles”!  


▼RPG Maker Festival 2025: Participants Wanted!
We’re currently looking for developers and publishers who’d like to participant in RPG Maker Festival 2025!

If you have a game made with RPG Maker or Pixel Game Maker, we hope you’ll decide to submit your game! If it’s on Steam, this is a chance to spread awareness of your game to a whole new group of players. So please do consider participating!

【Submission Method】
To submit a game for participation in RPG Maker Festival 2025, just fill out the form linked here:
https://forms.gle/j13eBfcwu7WstGv38

【Deadline】
・Pacific Time: 2024-12-22 (Sunday) 06:59
※Those wishing to use the Steam Broadcast function are very welcome,  but slots are limited and not submissions will be selected.

A variety of species and jobs offer up all sorts of possibilities for NPCs for your heroes to meet, from a gruff orc sailor dressed in fur-lined clothes to stave off the chill when sailing the icy Northern trading routes to a short and cheery dwarf brewmaster decked out in her favorite colorful outfit so she can head off to the beach when she closes up shop for the night. Have your heroes chat with a grinning human fishmonger, a skilled dragonborn chef armed with a holster of spices, and an elf musician to learn the latest rumors in the city, or stick to business by meeting with a serious forgemaster for some new equipment and an elf merchant who’s selling mana from tanks she carries around the market square. Take on new side quests by talking with the goblin innkeeper who always has a contract that favors her ready and the fully armored knight who needs help solving a few situations in less-than-legal ways, and move the main storyline along by gaining the favor of bejeweled trade masters and renowned warriors armed with legendary weapons.

Each image is high resolution so that you can make sure your players can see every important detail and so you can resize them to perfectly fit your game’s screen size! Or shrink them down for a sudden battle if you want to give your heroes more options than just talking their way into new places. Pick up the Galefire Characters - NPC Pack and get ready to have your heroes befriend unique shopkeepers, learn new skills from armored warriors, flirt with armed troublemakers, and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364250/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Summer_Beach_Tileset/

Toss your heroes onto a deserted island where they need to survive until they’re rescued or let them relax in a cozy resort after saving the world with the KR Summer Beach Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a MV/MZ-sized tileset focused on sandy shores and tropical palm trees that are perfect for making your players feel like they’re hanging out on a warm beach. A1, A2, A3, A4, and 4 B sheets can fill a beach map with different textured sand and water that gets darker and deeper as it gets farther from land. Shock your players while they’re sailing on the world map with a sudden fade to black and drop them onto an empty beach with scattered wood planks and broken shipwreck tiles to let them know they’ll be stuck there for a while. Have them wander between leaning palm trees, mossy rocks, and hanging vines as they battle their way through a jungle until they stumble across a small village filled with thatch-roofed houses! Let your players decide if they’d rather collect colorful seashells and coral on the beach or work in the village’s small inn to help fund their escape from the island, or spend their saved gold to relax in rooms filled with comfy wooden furniture until the next ship arrives at the docks.

Making a game that takes place in modern times? Then grab the inflatable floaties and life vests to decorate the beaches, and stick ATMs and emergency exit signs around your resort interiors so that your heroes can always stock back up on cash when they head out to visit the rest of the island. This pack also includes multiple sliding paper screen doors so your heroes can have some privacy in their comfy resort rooms and you can keep your players from wandering into new areas too quickly. If you’ve been wanting to add new seaside maps to your games or need some little bungalows scattered between wooden docks, pick up the KR Summer Beach Tileset!

notes.title: New DLC: Another World Hero Generator 3 for MZ, KR High Seas Ship Tileset Kit
notes.notes:
Make more heroes with Another World Hero Generator 3 for MZ! Then head to the high seas with the KR High Seas Ship Tileset Kit!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308500/RPG_Maker_MZ__Another_World_Hero_Generator_3_for_MZ/

Give your male party members the makeover they deserve with the Another World Hero Generator 3 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft is here with another set of 40 MZ-style generator pieces, perfect for giving your heroes a sleek haircut, new snazzy set of clothes, and some expressive eyes! 2 AccA, 3 AccB, 20 Clothing, 5 Eyes, 5 Front Hair, and 5 Rear Hair generator parts offer up a variety of armors and outfits along with accessories to give each of your characters unique looks or have them change as the story progresses.

Start your main character out as a bandit with a mohawk and simple outfit made up of cloth wrapped around their waist and some metal arm guards they scavenged from someone else, but when a robbery goes wrong and he is forced to become a true hero make sure to update his outfit with some real pants and maybe even a shirt! Show that time is passing during his adventures by changing his hair from a mohawk with fully shaved sides to a mohawk with fuzzy stubble around it, and eventually let him fully grow his hair out if he decides that his new role of hero requires a new hairstyle. Have your hero switch his outfits depending on what he’s doing, so that while he’s crafting he is wearing a tanktop and apron, while he’s sneaking into enemy bases he’s draped in dark robes, and while he’s receiving a reward from the queen he’s decked out in a well-made uniform! Or let him keep his comfy traveling outfit with its long coat while the NPCs around him get to wear layered magician’s robes.

And don’t forget how much the right eyes and accessories can take a character to the next level! Give a naive prince a shining circlet and wide, friendly eyes so that players can instantly tell he’ll believe whatever others tell him, and subtly warn your players about a sneaky merchant by giving him downturned eyes that you can match with a default smile to turn it into a sneer. Pick up the Another World Hero Generator 3 for MZ pack and fill your party and game world with powerful warriors and helpful men who are looking their best!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308620/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_High_Seas_Ship_Tileset_Kit/

It’s time to set sail with the KR High Seas Ship Tileset Kit! Kokoro Reflections is here with an incredible set of tiles that let you make your own wooden sailing ship, so your heroes can have the ship of their dreams while trying to save the world. Use this pack’s ocean A1 tile to give your ship a background to sail on, and the A2 and A4 tiles to build solid decks and waterproof walls that are ready to be decorated with the 3 B sheets. Deck your deck out with curved edges to cut swiftly through the water and short railings to keep any wayward sailors from falling into the water, and set up the wheel near the stern of the boat to let your players control where they’re sailing to next. Towering masts and spider web-like rope riggings can be ducked around while moving between the different deck levels, and wooden crates and barrels can hold food and goods while small lifeboats are stacked behind them just in case of a sudden sinking. Below deck portholes can offer light in the dark maze of hammocks and cannons, while the metal cage and chains of the brig deeper in the hold is lit only by a lone lantern.

When your perfect ship is ready to set sail, make use of the animated sails, flag, and water splashes to show that the ship is indeed moving! With sails that swell in each cardinal direction you can make sure the wind is always blowing in the direction you need, and door sprites can help keep your players out of areas that you don’t want them exploring just yet. If your game focuses on pirates or you just want to make sailing the high seas more than just a world map activity, pick up the KR High Seas Ship Tileset Kit!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Art Deco Exteriors Tileset, Fantasy Dreamland - Town Pack
notes.notes:
A new addition to our KR series of tilesets! Another new addition to the Fantasy Dreamlands series! Out today.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308470/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Art_Deco_Exteriors_Tileset/

Build an opulent city perfect for mysteries, parties, and crimes with the KR Art Deco Exteriors Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is at it again with an MV/MZ tileset that perfectly matches their previous interior set. Now you can create city streets where your heroes can go window shopping, meet up in front of the gilded theater for a date, visit their red-roofed family home, and more! A1, A2, A3, A4, and A5 tiles along with 4 B sheets cover all the autotiles and decorations your city needs to stand out. Create black asphalt streets and white tiled sidewalks detailed with crimson and gold diamond patterns to tie them to the towering buildings in matching tones. Give certain shops massive glass windows that reveal all the meats, baked goods, or lovely outfits inside, or keep things more mysterious with interiors that are either too dark or too bright to easily see through. Angled gilded designs can add an extra layer of fanciness to any building to make sure your players’ eyes are drawn to it, and bright lanterns can make sure the streets are lit even in the middle of the night!

This pack also includes 12 character sprites for 1920s-inspired cars so your heroes can travel the city in style! Pick a hardtop or convertible in red, gold, white, or black and turn your fast travel loading screen into a fun driving minigame, or just let the different cars drive around the streets to make sure your players pay attention when trying to cross. And don’t forget to give each of your buildings one of the 5 bright door sprites so your heroes can easily enter anywhere and everywhere! Give your 1920s game some gorgeous city scenes or make sure your players know that they’re in the rich part of town with the KR Art Deco Exteriors Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308480/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Dreamland__Town_Pack/

Create modern cities and cozy interiors with the Fantasy Dreamland - Town Pack! ELV Games is back with another pack of pixel art tiles sized for Ace and MV/MZ, this time focusing on modern cities where your heroes can walk alongside asphalt streets and visit their friends' homes to plan out their next move.

A1, 2 A2, A4, 2 A5, and 10 B sheets are ready to help you build unique buildings and streets so your heroes don’t have to worry about getting lost when searching for the grocery store! Make sure the streets are safe with traffic lights and signs, and let the city’s kids have fun on wooden swing sets and seesaws in a small park tucked between tall buildings. Create tiered apartment buildings with lots of windows where your hero resides, and decorate their home with filled shelves, comfy furniture and decorative rugs! Make sure your heroes and NPCs have all the necessities they need in their home with toilets and tubs for their bathrooms, stoves and sinks for their kitchens, couches and tvs for their living rooms, and beds and vanities for your bedrooms. And don’t forget to give them some pretty pictures on their walls and potted plants to enjoy some of nature from the comfort of their home! Pick up the Fantasy Dreamland - Town Pack and build the cute modern city your game has been missing!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Aztec Jungle Tileset, Soldier Character Pack 3
notes.notes:
2 New Graphics packs for RPG Maker! Visit a whole new culture with the KR Aztec Jungle Tileset! Tell your scifi military adventures with the new Soldier Character Pack 3!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308460/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Aztec_Jungle_Tileset/

Forget vaguely European villages and start your players in a lush jungle with the KR Aztec Jungle pack! Kokoro Reflections is back with another set of MV/MZ tiles to help you map dense wilderness where hidden temples hold powerful relics and riverside towns offer delicious fruits and handcrafted equipment! A1, A2, A3, A4, and A5 tiles are filled with wall and floor autotiles to make sandy beaches that morph into dirt covered in tall grasses and piled dirt that forms natural walls. Or build a towering temple out of brown stone with interior walls carved with swirly patterns and painted bright red or teal, while the normal houses in the surrounding area keep to simpler stone, straw, and wood walls. Use the 4 B sheets to decorate both exteriors and interiors with palm trees, yucca, moss-covered rocks, and carved stone pillars, and build cozy homes with straw beds and stacks of journals from previous residents. Make an equipment shop where your heroes can pick up new cloth armor along with axes, swords, and shields, and highlight specific things on each map by layering light beam tiles over important details.

This pack also includes character sprites for 3 sizes of flames, side view wooden canoes and rafts for traveling across rivers, a carved wooden treasure chest, and a variety of farm plants so villagers can grow what they need! Give your players a break from adventuring in dungeons by setting up farm plots so they can grow peppers, corn, and fantastical fruits that can offer buffs in battle. If you’ve been wanting to create a tropical getaway for your heroes to visit or need more fitting tiles for your Aztec-inspired story, pick up the KR Aztec Jungle pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308450/RPG_Maker_MZ__Soldier_Character_Pack_3/

Create the sci-fi super soldier game you’ve been dreaming of with the Soldier Character Pack 3! Gee-kun-soft is back with another set of 16 characters to fill your world with all-new party members, villains, and NPCs. Each character comes with a MZ-style sprite, faceset with 8 emotions, SV battler, front view enemy images, and waist-up bust images, so they’re ready for anything, no matter if you want them fighting your heroes, joining the squad, or just hanging out and gossiping in the mess hall! Form a powerful squad with a youthful woman with twin drill ponytails, a royal prince with long blue locks, and a cybernetically-enhanced man with mysterious white hair, and have them battle a scythe-wielding android, a smoking, scruffy, ex-unit leader, and a grinning pink-haired woman who emits sonic waves to take control of unlucky foes. 

10 of the soldiers also have variations for their sprites and images to include helmets so you can make sure they’re all properly equipped to battle titanic space monsters! Let your players know visually when an area’s air isn’t safe to breathe by switching their chipper short-haired fighter to her helmeted sprite, or leave it to your players to keep their party safe by freely equipping their helmets. This pack also includes high-resolution images of each character, so you can have a full body image in your menus or resize them to perfectly fit your game window. Have the snarling cyborg soldier zoom towards the player by having his bonus image quickly go from small to full size before starting a boss fight, or let your players look for clues on the cold ice skater soldier’s image to see if she could have killed a companion. Pick up the Soldier Character Pack 3 and give your sci-fi worlds some space rangers ready to stop evil!
