notes.title: New DLC: KR Gothic Prison Tileset, KR Haunted Swamp Tileset
notes.notes:
Two new tilesets from Kokoro Reflections!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308410/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Gothic_Prison_Tileset/

Lock your heroes up in a large stone building where concrete hallways lead to deadly bad ends and the only exit is past tall iron gates with the KR Gothic Prison Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has created another spooky MV/MZ-sized tileset that’s perfect for making dark prisons, haunted asylums, and unlicensed medical offices. A2, A3, A4, and 4 B sheets are ready to build interior and exterior maps that lean into the creepy vibes of cold gray stone and metal. Each sheet comes in 4 variations (clean light, clean dark, dirty light, and dirty dark), meaning you have 22 sheets to mix and match to make your perfect prison! Introduce the jail with clean walls and floors on the first floor to make your players think all is well, and reveal the evil within by adding more grimy areas the farther your players explore. Or let your heroes jump between timelines to solve puzzles! Traveling back in time to visit the active kitchen with working stovetops available to burn bags of trash to find a thrown-away key and then jump back into the present-day abandoned building to unlock the director’s office where scattered papers and books are spread out over a large wooden desk.

This pack also includes 32 character sprites for prison buses, cell doors, and levers so you can create door puzzles that lead deep into the bowels of the prison, unlock cell blocks with big metal switches to create chaos, and escape on a grimy gray bus as the credits roll. If you’ve been needing cold metal rooms where your hero stages a prison break or want to create a creepy abandoned asylum for your players to explore in search of a forgotten family secret, pick up the KR Gothic Prison Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3243180/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Haunted_Swamp_Tileset/

Seek out a bog witch, follow muddy paths between deep waters, and find cozy cabins to rest in after a long day of tracking monsters in the fog with the KR Haunted Swamp Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with another MV/MZ-sized tileset to help you create new locations for your heroes to explore. A1, A2, A3, A4, and A5 tiles along with 4 B sheets offer up a bunch of natural ground options and plants and rocks to make mazes of swampland between winding rivers and wooden building walls and roofs so small houses can be found deep in supposedly empty bogs. Have your heroes wander between cattails and partially submerged rocks topped with bushy plants in search of useful items, and let them cross deep water by stepping on wooden bridges, stepping stones, and even giant lily pads! When your heroes need to take a break and recover, let them retreat to small thatch-roof huts scattered throughout the swamps to rest in simple beds while their clothes dry out on clothes lines.

And if that wasn’t enough, each tile comes in 3 variations (normal, desaturated gray, and muddy brown) so you can shift the mood of the area simply by switching out tilesets! Warn your players that an area will contain stronger monsters by switching from bright green ferns and pink lotus flowers to desaturated versions, or swap those out completely and replace them with twisted dead tree trunks. This pack also includes 4 fog images to help give your swamp a mysterious vibe and 10 character sprites for wispy flames, openable barrels and crates, wooden doors, and waterfall mist to add more movement to your maps. Pick up the KR Haunted Swamp Tileset and create mystical lotus-filled waterways and small villages that sit on wooden docks over muddy water for your heroes to visit!

notes.title: New: KR Haunted House, KR Legendary Palaces - Vampire, Mystery RPG Music Pack
notes.notes:
Halloween is here, and with it, the perfect spooky new resource packs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308090/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Haunted_House_Tileset/

Send your heroine into a creepy mansion where the walls have eyes and time shifts between every room with the KR Haunted House Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with another spooky tileset sized for MV and MZ, ready to help you build a spooky mansion with cobweb-filled libraries, a house of horror where prepared meals lay rotting on kitchen tables, an overgrown garden locked behind spiked iron fences, and more! 2 A2, 2 A3, 2 A4, and 14 B sheets offer a bunch of decorations and walls to create multiple versions of the same map! Have your heroine enter a manor’s living room where a glowing chandelier lights up comfy couches and a delicious-looking cake on a wooden table, and suddenly shift it to the dark and destroyed version of the map when lightning flashes outside. Confound your players by switching between the different sets each time they enter a new room until they start to doubt their own memory, or have the destruction happen gradually with each painting and statue being replaced with a ruined version as the story progresses.

This pack also includes 4 parallax images to add some spooky fogs to your maps, and 40 object character sprites to help your heroine explore the manor, add some movement to your rooms, and unlock helpful items! Let your players pull on a switch that’s hidden as a normal candlestick to open up a secret door tucked behind a bookcase, or keep things simple with wooden doors that match the rest of the map’s lighting. Set up treasure chests against any wall, and have curtains billow and move in front of cracked windows to draw players’ eyes away from rats scurrying around in the corners of the room. Not sure how to use all of the creepy animations? Then open up the included MV and MZ projects to see how they can be set up! Pick up the KR Haunted House Tileset and give your players gorgeous and horrific houses to search while trying to escape a nightmare!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308080/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Vampire_Tileset/

Give your game’s vampire lord a fitting throne with the KR Legendary Palaces - Vampire Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another entry in their Legendary Palaces series, this time giving us a selection of spooky tiles to build a dungeon where ghouls serve their masters and an iron tang fills the air. Build gray hallways where your heroes walk under seemingly endless marble arches, avoid spiked traps by paying attention to the red stains of blood on the floors, and give your dramatic vampire a fitting home with large statues of bat-winged people and walls and floors absolutely covered in bat mosaics!

A1, A2, A4, A5, and B tiles are ready to help you make all the gray, black, and red rooms your dungeon could need. Have your heroes follow a black cobble path through a maze of gray floors and tiled red walls to reach the dungeon’s main room where the vampire boss rests comfortably on a plush red throne with outstretched wings, or trick your heroes with marked paths that lead deeper and deeper into the dungeon where bloodstains cover the floor and a crudely drawn heart drips down the wall before a wave of battles starts. Use marble stairs and carved ladders to traverse different floors, and help your heroes keep track of where they have been with different statues of vampires for each floor. When it’s time to finally leave the nightmarish red rooms, have a glowing magic circle appear on the floor for a quick escape. This pack also includes character sprites for flickering flames to light hallways and an ornate red and gray treasure chest where your heroes may find a useful item to help them stop the vampire threat! If you’ve been needing a creepy dungeon for your heroes to explore or want a bright throne room for your vampire main character to call home, check out the KR Legendary Palaces - Vampire Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3246070/RPG_Maker_MZ__Mystery_RPG_Music_Pack/

Give your detective games and puzzle-solving subplots some fitting tunes with the Mystery RPG Music Pack! Ayato sound create has created another BGM pack with 10 new songs to keep your players focused on finding the truth and noticing the little details. Explore empty crime scenes, remember important clues while talking to friends, get your pulse pounding when fighting thugs, and more with these tracks! 3 event tracks, 3 battle tracks, and 4 field tracks are ready to turn any modern map into a location teeming with possible dangers and secrets. Turn city streets and malls into places where the hairs on the back of your players’ necks stand up with the electronic beat and haunted human calls in ‘Walk’, or make the maps feel lonely while your players are looking for a lost friend with the slower melody of ‘Gallery’s synth chimes. Jolt your players into action with the sharp alarm beat of ‘Emergency’ as they need to decide if they’ll stand and fight or flee with the info they already gathered, and have them stand tall against their final foe with the mix of warbling techno and piano from ‘Fate’. And when all is said and done, let your players take a moment to remember all they fought for and all they lost while the sharp notes of ‘Sad Song’s music box ring out.

Each track comes in M4a and looping Ogg file formats so you can easily add them to your MV/MZ projects, or use them in your favorite engine! If you’ve been looking for some dark tunes to fit your game’s story or just need to add a bit of danger to a spooky area, check out the Mystery RPG Music Pack!

notes.title: New: KR Wandering Souls Asylum, KR Burial Grounds - Crypt, Catacomb & Mausoleum
notes.notes:
Just in time for Halloween, two new spooky tilesets from Kokoro Reflections!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3243200

Just in time for spooky season, give your haunted buildings a makeover with the KR Wandering Souls Asylum Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a new set of MV/MZ tiles that are perfect for making the entire grounds of an asylum with a greenhouse, laundry room, chapel, surgery room, and more for your heroes to explore! A2, A3, and A4 tiles along with 4 B sheets offer up stone and tile floors and walls to build calm interiors where NPCs can relax in studies filled with bookcases or in pews under stained glass windows. Or remind your players that this isn’t a hotel stay with large communal bathrooms and bedrooms with simple metal-framed beds and trunks at the foot of each bed. Visit the doctor’s office where files on each person are kept in a locked cabinet, and break into the basement level where pipes creak about heads and gurneys equipped with straps wait for their next unlucky occupant.

And if that wasn’t enough, this pack also includes dirty and degraded versions of each tilesheet, so you can switch between tilesets as your hero jumps back and forth in time or when your players slowly realize that the nice place they’re staying isn’t what it appears. 4 glass door and a large metal gate character sheets (along with grimy versions) can help your players visit separate buildings while exploring the grounds, or leave all the doors locked so your players need to find another way to escape the creepy rooms. If you’ve been wanting your players to search a seemingly peaceful facility that hides a dark secret or just need some dirty decorations to fit an old haunted house, check out the KR Wandering Souls Asylum Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3243170

Visit long-dead loved ones and delve deep underground to explore zombie-infested halls with the KR Burial Grounds - Crypt, Catacomb and Mausoleum Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with another death-inspired tileset, this time to help you create modern mausoleum interiors and crypts filled with skeletons. A1, A2, A4, A5, and 3 B sheets include exterior and interior tiles that can build decorative tombs spread out in grassy fields, ancient burial vaults that are missing the coffin’s occupants, and modern buildings where flowers decorate urns and memorial plaques.

Create peaceful rooms with brown tile floors and white walls so the bright flowers and wall plaques draw your hero’s eye, and set up simple wooden chairs around a table so they can meet with rebel leaders without the villain finding out. Have the party wander between collapsing pillars and stone crypts to find the right path down into the underground catacombs where a necromancer has been causing trouble! Dark wall insets and crapped skeletons can turn any brick tunnel into a final resting place, or show just how many have died in this land with long winding paths lined with skulls pressed into the walls. This pack also includes character sprites for flames to help light up dark tunnels and glass doors so your heroes can easily enter and exit the cemetery’s buildings. If your game has been lacking tunnels that are wall-to-wall skulls or you want to include some somber scenes to help cement your heroine’s resolve, pick up the KR Burial Grounds - Crypt, Catacomb and Mausoleum Tileset!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Cruising the Circuits Digital World, Seraph Circle Monster Pack 4
notes.notes:
A new cyberspace themed tileset pack from Kokoro Reflections! New twisted and demonic battlers from Seraph's Circle!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3243160/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Cruising_the_Circuits_Digital_World_Tileset/

Boot your computers up and get ready to explore a non-physical world with the KR Cruising the Circuits Digital World Tileset! Kokoro Reflections glimpsed a sci-fi future and created a new MV/MZ tileset pack to help you create cyber spaces where your heroes can level up, hack into the villain’s mainframe to learn their plans, and try to stop a corrupting force that threatens both the digital and real world! A1, A2, A4, A5, and 3 B sheets are ready to help you build superhighways through the internet and shopping district out of distinct green and blue patterned tiles. Layer translucent floor tiles on top of each other to give different areas unique looks while keeping the maps coherent, and add binary code and microchip detailing to give areas extra tech vibes. Or lean into misunderstandings of digital spaces and decorate the maps with tubes and pipes that send data to computers! 

The digital world isn’t totally safe though, so show that in your game with alternate versions of the tiles that replace the greens and blues with dangerous purples and pinks! Use the included character sheets to add glitching bugs to the corrupted areas and mark important info with floating exclamation points or arrows pointing to open doorways. This pack also includes 9 parallax images to give your maps glitchy backgrounds behind your translucent paths and binary code to show when your heroine is hacking into a computer instead of just cruising the web. Not sure how to set up all these awesome tiles? No worries, since sample projects with maps for MV and MZ are also included! So if you’ve been wanting to give your in-game cyber crimes some actual dungeons or you’ve been needing an online world to fit your story, check out the KR Cruising the Circuits Digital World Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3243150/RPG_Maker_MZ__Seraph_Circle_Monster_Pack_4/

Throw your heroes into horrific battles against twisted human bodies and demonic creations with the Seraph Circle Monster Pack 4! SeraphCircle is back with their incredible painted art style to offer up 16 brightly colored and highly detailed enemy images for your heroes to face off against. Have your heroes prove their strength by defeating the village’s elder, an ancient elf who can control the wind with her magic staff, or throw your heroes right into the thick of it by forcing them to defeat the most dangerous monster in the area: a scarecrow possessed by a spooky spirit! Explore the deep and dark forests to destroy giant bugs and carnivorous plants with tangled roots that keep ruining the crops, and try to survive surprise attacks from the small winged fey and the towering witch of the woods with her flowing sleeves and deadly magical attacks. Turn a normal graveyard dungeon into a nightmare scenario with contorted human bodies writhing on the ground and breaking their own backs to reach towards your heroes, all while a monstrous demon stomps around the area while wearing the face of the last hero who tried to stop it.

Also included are PSD files for each enemy, so you can tweak and resize them to be exactly what you want! Build a swarm of tiny Barzabeux bugs that can appear if your players take too long to defeat a normal one, and have enemies telegraph their health and next moves by switching between versions like Regret with glowing wings, dark tattoos, and swords sticking out if it's back depending on how the battle is going. Pick up the Seraph Circle Monster Pack 4 and let your heroes battle new nightmarish foes!

notes.title: New DLC: 2 New Tilesets! Pixel Monster Battlers!
notes.notes:
Three new packs out now on KOMODO Plaza and on Steam to let you build the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3243120/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Dreamland__Traveler_Pack/

Set off on an adventure into forests and plains with the Fantasy Dreamland - Traveler Pack! ELV Games has another addition to their pixel art Fantasy Dreamland series, this time with tiles sized for Ace and MV/MZ that are ready to help you build incredible exteriors for your heroes to explore! Travel over fields of flowers and climb up and down hills to discover ancient monuments, visit tough stone forts that are the last line of defense for the kingdom, search busy forests for rare herbs and mushrooms, and more with this pack!

A1, A2, 3 A5, and 6 B sheets are ready to turn your ideas into reality! Choose from brown and gray stone to build your castles, or mix and match them to show that this area needed to use whatever they could get their hands on to finish their outer walls. Create hilly areas with cliff walls that are only traverseable by wooden bridges and following carefully placed signs. Want to have a flat grassland but don’t want it to be boring to look at? Add small details like tufts of grass, flowers, bushes, and mushrooms growing around gray stones so that your players always have something to help orient themselves!

This pack also includes 14 character sprites for doors and objects to add more life and possible puzzles to your game! Have your heroes’ path into an old fort be blocked by a closed gate or door that they need to unlock or break down to get passed, or show from a distance that a castle is still in use with flames dancing in stone scones attached to the exterior walls. Check out the Fantasy Dreamland - Traveler Pack and add new forts and castles to your game’s wilderness!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3243140/RPG_Maker_MZ__Pixel_Battlers_Monsters_Pack_1/

Get ready to fight against pixelated foes with the Pixel Battlers Monsters Pack 1! ELV Games has created a pack stuffed with front view monsters in their bright pixel art style for your heroes to defeat! Have your heroes face off against green slimes and little imps in dense forests, battle swarms of demonic bugs that emerge from dark caves, and defeat minotaur minions that stalk mazes with this pack!

36 unique monster designs offer up a wide selection of possible enemies for your heroes to challenge. Have spiked monsters float to avoid melee attacks while wide-mouthed demons take bites out of your heroes, or use some of the evolved versions of enemies to add a new challenge when your heroes take too long to destroy a troop of smiling spheres. Let a small purple 3-eyed monster grow up to be a towering powerhouse with 4 arms, and have simple and normally easy-to-defeat blue slimes merge together to become a king slime with gleaming eyes watching your party’s every move! Form troops where one enemy is clearly more powerful than the rest to draw your party’s attacks to it, or let your sneakier enemies control weaker monsters to form meat shields so they can hit your party with debuffs while they fight their way through small imps.

And if that wasn’t enough, each monster comes with 4 color variations for a total of 144 enemies to choose from! Use brown, red, blue, and tan minotaurs to show their elemental weaknesses. Or have different colors show different power levels depending on which dungeon your heroes are exploring. If your retro pixel art-filled games need some monsters, check out the Pixel Battlers Monsters Pack 1!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3243130/RPG_Maker_MZ__Summerwind_Saga__Interior/

Give your retro heroes calming places to call home with the Summerwind Saga - Interior pack! ELV Games is back with a new tileset series with a cute pixel art style filled with all the furniture your villages could need to make inns, shops, and warehouses for your players to visit and explore. A2, A4, and A5 tiles along with 3 B sheets of brown furniture (with 3 variations of the wooden pieces in a green shade) and a B sheet of extra rugs and doorways offer up a bunch of details to help you make each house unique while still fitting into the general village vibes. 

Start your players in a simple bedroom with blue wallpaper and dark brown planks underfoot where they can nap in a small bed or grab a new outfit out of their wardrobe or dresser. Once they’re ready to go, make sure they make a healthy meal in a kitchen with metal-topped counters that stand on a tile floor or have them visit the local inn for a cheap meal at a long table where they may pick up some new rumors and gossip from the townsfolk. Check barrels and chests for any useful items or loose coins, and then make sure to stop in the village shop where pots of potions and skill books sit on shelves near swords and spears that are ready for your hero to use in their next dungeon adventure!

Each sheet comes in two sizes so you can easily use them in both your Ace or MV/MZ projects, or use them in your favorite engine! Check out the Summerwind Saga - Interior pack and build cozy homes filled with wooden furniture for your farming hero to return to at night!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3243080/RPG_Maker_MZ__Another_World_Heroine_Generator_5_for_MZ/

Give your female characters bells, braids, and beautiful outfits with the Another World Heroine Generator 5 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft is back with another set of generator parts for MZ, bringing us 40 new pieces. 5 AccB, 5 Eyes, 5 Front Hair, 5 Rear Hair, and 20 Clothing choices are ready to make new NPCs, party members, and even villains for your players to meet and fall in love with! Choose wide and sparkling eyes or calmer downturned ones to show an NPCs personality in their faceset before they speak a bunch, or use them to set up a surprise when the naive-looking girl turns out to be a criminal mastermind. Give your energetic heroines messy bangs and wild hair tied back out of the way and your more methodical healers nicely trimmed bangs along with neat twintails or braids, and top off their looks with bells clipped into their hair, a decorative wing hairpin, or even a modest nurse’s cap.

Once you’ve settled on a face for your heroine, make sure to give her an excellent outfit! Healing party members and NPCs can make use of the multiple styles of nursing dresses, while villains and fighters who need to move as fast as possible could dress up in the lightly armored tops and cheongsam-inspired dresses that leave them free to move and twist to strike hard and fast. Let your tanking heroines wear a skirt topped with protective leather lattice work while the princess they’re guarding is dressed in a gorgeous gown. This pack also includes an edited version of the base body so that you can make sure your off-the-shoulder outfits look their best! Add new miko-inspired NPCs, powerful princess party members, and lifesaving nurses to your game with the Another World Heroine Generator 5 for MZ pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3242990/RPG_Maker_MV__CyberCity_The_Silver_Strip/

Build the perfect vacation spot for your heroes to relax at with the CyberCity The Silver Strip tileset pack! PVGames is here with another set for their Cyber City series, this time focusing on sleek and clean interior and exterior tiles that can create a gorgeous resort. Leave your worries at the door and enjoy beachside drinks near beach watchtowers, high-tech recovery spas, walkable trails between tall hotels and large vacation homes, gardens with tons of greenery, and more with this pack of 2100+ tiles!

Designed for parallax mapping, each object comes in multiple views so that you can easily set up a bunch of chairs around a round table or line diagonal walls with lovely paintings. Build your exterior spaces from the ground up with grass, dirt, sand, and water tiles and top them with streets and raised catwalks enclosed in glass to make sure rich visitors can keep their shoes clean. Set up lounge chairs and umbrellas on the man-made beaches for your party members who want to soak up some sun, and add some clean premade buildings to the nearby street for those who prefer to shop for jewelry and antiques. Build a dark bar with bright neon highlights where NPCs can hang out and offer new rumors for a price, and create a cozy office with cushy armchairs and marble-topped counters for your party to meet in to share information or find new side quests. And for those heroes who just want to relax after a successful mission? Let them rest in their own rooms with all the fluffed pillows and comfy bean bag chairs they could need! Pick up the CyberCity The Silver Strip pack and give your heroes a place to relax and a fancy new area of their sci-fi city to explore!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Art and History Museum Tileset, Tyler Warren RPG Battlers - 11th
notes.notes:
A new tileset from Kokoro Reflections! New battlers from Tyler Warren!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195890/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Art_and_History_Museum_Tileset/

Create an art gallery for your hero to take a partner for a lovely date or have your party run through dark halls and between towering displays with the KR Art and History Museum Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another awesome modern tileset for MV/MZ, offering up a selection of displays ready to make natural history museums, art galleries, science museums, and more! A1, A2, and A4 autotiles can make neutral backdrops for your museums so that each room’s exhibits get all the attention they deserve. Set up information signs in front of glass display cases filled with bones, spaceship models, and ancient artifacts, or fill walls with detailed paintings and open floors with carefully carved statues! Even if your game doesn’t take place in a modern world, you’ll likely find useful weapons and outfits for your equipment shops and gilded art to add some extra bling to your castles and dungeons.

This pack also includes 8 character sheets to add doors and other decorations to your museums. Have the interior pool shoot water into the air at set times for a neat display and have your players enter new wings through tall glass doors. Hide bathrooms and back offices behind solid white doors, and travel to new floors in style with diagonal escalators! Set up turnstiles that will open only if your players buy tickets, or use the turnstiles to slow down monsters that are chasing your unlucky night security guard! If you want some gorgeous art to decorate castle walls, a museum for your hero to train their brain, or just some cool dinosaur skeletons, pick up the KR Art and History Museum Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115780/RPG_Maker_MZ__Tyler_Warren_RPG_Battlers__11th__Little_Monsters_and_Robots_2/

Battle even more adorably awful monsters with the Tyler Warren RPG Battlers - 11th - Little Monsters and Robots 2 pack! Tyler Warren’s second addition to his Little Monster and Robots series is here with 40 more battler images so your heroes can face off against even more unique creatures in Tyler’s amazing colored pencil art style! Fight inky purple creatures that ooze out of shadows, technicolor bugs and evolving pink slime in forests and caves, robots that stalk sci-fi stations and are controlled by what may have once been a head in a jar, and more with this pack!

Each enemy comes in multiple sizes, so you could create a pack of small sky jellyfish with one large tentacled monster controlling the rest of them from the back lines or give your players a visual clue that a battle against a huge skeleton draped in blue robes is going to be harder than normal. Not only that, but each monster also comes in a filtered version for a smoother look to their design as well as pixel art versions in 9 different color palettes (included ones inspired by GameBoy, NES, and Time Fantasy) so you could have the same monsters in different digital worlds or upgrade the palette of your monsters as they get stronger and gain more skills as the game goes on!

This pack also includes faceset images for each battler, in various sizes to fit your favorite RPG Maker engine, so they can taunt your heroes during battles or give up important plot points after they’re defeated. Pick up the Tyler Warren RPG Battlers - 11th - Little Monsters and Robots 2 pack and send your heroes against waves of all new foes!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Peaceful Rest Graveyard Tileset, Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Swamp
notes.notes:
Two new tilesets to take you into the dark swamp, and even spookier graveyard!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195870/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Peaceful_Rest_Graveyard_Tileset/

Share a somber farewell with a beloved party member or hunt ghouls in the dead of night with the KR Peaceful Rest Graveyard Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has a new MV/MZ-sized tileset designed to help you create exterior maps filled with tombstones and crypts. Create an intimate gathering for family to say goodbye to your hero before she suddenly revives in the coffin, send your party to explore a cursed cemetery where the ponds are filled with blood, restore a small family plot long forgotten in the center of a rosebush hedge maze, and more with this pack!

A1, A2, and A4 tiles along with 3 B sheets can build all sorts of cozy or spooky cemeteries. Create stone paths weaving between tall headstones and patches of bright yellow flowers, or keep things simple with dirt paths that lead to new graves where the shovels are still next to them and a small bouquet of flowers show that it has a daily visitor. Keep unwanted troublemakers out of the grounds with wrought iron fences, and set up folding chairs under a black canopy for families to gather when saying goodbye. Ruined versions of the tombstones, fences, and flowers can help show just how long it has been since the last person had visited a grave, or destroy a village’s graveyard if the heroes don’t defeat a necromancer in time! So if your game needs a creepy cemetery or you want a calm area where your heroes can remind themselves why they fight, pick up the KR Peaceful Rest Graveyard Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195880/RPG_Maker_MZ__Winlu_Fantasy_Tileset__Swamp/

Send your heroes deep into bogs where solid ground meanders through noxious water and ancient castle walls collapse into nearby sludge with the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Swamp pack! Winlu is back with another tileset for your MV/MZ games, this time filled with all the greens and browns your swampland and marshes could need. A1, A2, and A5 tiles along with 5 B sheets (4 for exteriors and 1 for interiors) are filled with creepy twisted trees and muddy autotiles to create semi-safe paths between pools of brown, blue, green, or purple water so you can show the area becoming more deadly as your heroes journey deeper into the swamp. Have your heroes follow wooden pathways over lilypad-filled waters and mushrooms growing out of sticky mud until they reach the wooden huts that make up a swamp hag village. Step inside a wooden house grown straight from the ground and gather the bowls of important ingredients all while trying to avoid becoming dinner!

This pack also includes 12 character sheets filled with decorations to help add even more life to your swamps! Have tattered and stained banners flutter in the breeze while lanterns hung from wooden posts offer an eerie green light to help your heroes stay on the path. Block off the witch’s hut with a gate formed of magically grown branches that can only be opened by activating skulls with clattering jaws hidden around the swamp, and sink a wooden treasure chest into the murky waters while bubbles of unknown gasses rise from below and burst. Pick up the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Swamp pack and send your heroes on a wild adventure to save a cursed princess or just add a new gorgeous area for your players to explore!

notes.title: Now Available - v1.8.1
notes.notes:
RPG Maker MZ has been updated to v1.8.1.
This is a minor update which focuses on bug fixes.
The updates are;

[list]
[*]Added an option "Enable Message Skip" which enables users to skip message waits when the action button is being pressed and held.
[*]Fixed an issue where files in the "Texture" and/or the "Model" folders which are located in the "effects" folder as a sub-folder were unintentionally removed when a game was deployed with the "Exclude unused files" option enabled.
[*]Fixed an issue where file specification for "Plugin Command" were missing after a file in a sub-folder was specified and the dialog was re-opened.
[*]Fixed an issue where the scroll position did not return home after a certain process was done on the Equipment screen.
[*]Fixed an issue where a dying actor with "Substitute" trait was not protected by another actor with "Substitute" trait.
[*]Improved "Batch Entry" functionality for "Show Text"; Empty lines at the end of the texts are now removed.
[*]Fixed an issue where the menu bar was unintentionally shown at a distant position on a multi-monitor environment.
[*]Fixed an issue where full-width characters were not shown correctly for the preview of "Show Text" on the Event Editor if the name of the project contains half-width spaces.
[*]Fixed an issue where parameters lost the edited values if a plugin parameter was collapsed, other parameter was edited and then the collapsed paramter was re-opened.
[*]Fixed an issue where the zoom rate of the Map Editor was unintentionally over the upper limit and under the lower limit when the tile size was changed.
[*]Updated a launch plugin "StartUpFullScreen.js" (located in \dlc\BasicResources\plugins\launch).
[*]Updated an official plugin "UniqueDataLoader.js" (located in \dlc\BasicResources\plugins\official).
[*]Updated a tileset image "World_A1".
[/list]

notes.title: New DLC: KR Fairy Tale Forest Tileset, RPG Character Pack 14
notes.notes:
More tiles from Kokoro Reflections! More heroes from Gee-kun-soft!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195600/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Fairy_Tale_Forest_Tileset/

Visit magical forests where elves live in the trees and fairies live in giant mushrooms with the KR Fairy Tale Forest Tileset pack! Kokoro Reflections is back with another MV/MZ-sized tileset that lets you add a whole new location in your forest dungeons. Interior and exterior tiles are ready to add natural wood, bright green plants, and squishy giant mushrooms to your forest villages! A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 6 B sheets are perfect for making quirky hedge mazes, flower-filled gnome villages, towering trees that contain treehouses in their trunks, and more!

Create a forest with a selection of normal trees and bushes, but slowly add larger and larger mushrooms until your heroes are walking along small wooden bridges from flat mushroom cap to mushroom cap while giant oyster mushrooms burst from tree trunks and conical mushrooms replace all of the trees. Have your heroes keep walking until they find the arched wooden bridge that leads to the hidden fairy village. Create wooden signs held up with vines so that your heroes can easily find their way to the item shop or inn, and build houses with giant flowers on top of them or stone buildings with grass roofs. Have your heroes rest in rooms where all the furniture is wood and the lanterns are made out of magical flowers, let them wake up with a magical buff so they’re ready for their next adventure.

This pack also includes 6 door character sprites and an animated rock pool of water! Have your heroes knock on arched or circular doors to get blessings from the forest folk, and recover their MP with a comfortable dip in the pool. Pick up the KR Fairy Tale Forest Tileset and give your forest-dwelling characters lush homes to live in and mystical forests some oversized mushrooms!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195640/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Character_Pack_14/

Add more helpful merchants, commanding directors, and plot-heavy nurses to your games with the RPG Character Pack 14! Gee-kun-soft is back with another MZ-styled character pack with 16 new characters to populate your game’s world. 11 women and 5 men are ready to take on important jobs in your story, from nurses who can heal your heroes after dangerous fights to a veteran agent who can offer new quests or teach your heroes a new skill or two if you impress him! Fill your hospital maps with 4 different nurses with different hairstyles and uniforms to denote which hospital wings they work in, take orders from a youthful commander in her dress whites alongside other uniformed agents, form an unusual team with a brunette assassin and wing-eared magician, and more with this pack!

Each character comes with a character sprite, downed sprites, front view battler image with multiple color variations, faceset and bust art each with 8 emotions, and SV battler sheets so you can choose to have each character be as minor or important as you want! Introduce your players to a bear-eared healer who spends her days working at the group’s base until you befriend her enough to bring her out on adventures, or give your traveling a relaxed smile when he is offering new equipment for sale. And as a bonus, this pack also includes a high-resolution full body art for each character so you can size them to perfectly fit your game or give your players a good look at them in your game’s codex. So if you’ve been wanting a few more NPCs in their work uniforms or need to add some uniquely skilled party members to the team, check out the RPG Character Pack 14!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Sewer Central Tileset, Tyler Warren RPG Battlers - 10th
notes.notes:
New Sewer Tiles, New Enemies to fight. Two new packs for RPG Maker, now live!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115730/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Sewer_Central_Tileset/

Make sure you’re wearing some heavy duty boots before climbing down into trash-filled tunnels made with the KR Sewer Central Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another detailed tileset size for MV and MZ, focusing on the damp, grimey, floors and walls you’d expect if you dropped down a manhole and started exploring a sewer tunnel. A1, A2, and A4 tiles are ready to help you build concrete and brick tunnels deep underground, and B sheets offer up a variety of pipes, wall decorations, and trash to help make each path feel unique.

Send your heroes down a staircase to wander next to noxious green or brown water in the hopes of finding a bandit’s hideout filled with barrels and chests. Or let them follow metal pipes along the tunnels to locate where a slime is clogging the pipes so that the townsfolk can safely use their sinks again. Have your heroes follow bright graffiti between piles of trash to confront a young troublemaker who could join the party, and enter the sewer under a castle to gain access to a small jail that’s been forgotten by most of the people living above the ground.

This pack also includes 8 character sprites to add doors and more to your maps. Keep your heroes out of certain areas with metal gates, at least until they pull a lever tucked away on a nearby wall. Light the tunnels with dancing flames and mark a special room with tall wooden doors that open up to reveal a side room where red treasure chests wait to be opened. So if your modern game needs a sewer level or you want to offer a smelly way to sneak into a castle’s jail, check out the KR Sewer Central Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115740/RPG_Maker_MZ__Tyler_Warren_RPG_Battlers__10th__Little_Monsters_and_Robots_1/

Add some quirky lil’ creatures to your battles with Tyler Warren RPG Battlers - 10th - Little Monsters and Robots 1! Tyler Warren is back with his unique colored pencil art style to deliver 40 new battlers for your heroes to challenge. Get ready to battle armored sea creatures, well-dressed cyclops, angry robots, and more! Have your heroes battle against waves of red-cloaked cultists who can summon living tree stumps to ride and bright mushrooms that can release poisonous clouds of spores, or sneak past them by going underground where green-plated insects live in peace with little yellow cyclops and clouds of living smoke. Let your players explore modern city streets and sci-fi warehouses where robots designed for drilling, floating, grabbing, and fighting roam looking for trespassers, and face off against the enhanced Cyclops Siblings after your heroes beat up a baby sea turtle in the hopes of gaining a special shield!

Each enemy comes in multiple sizes so you can simply pick one that fits your game’s screen size without any resizing on your part, as well as pixel art versions with 9 different color versions inspired by the palettes of the GameBoy, NES, TimeFantasy, and more! Have your enemies match the palette of the rest of your retro pixel art game, or use them to show when your heroes are playing a combat-heavy minigame. Pick up Tyler Warren RPG Battlers - 10th - Little Monsters and Robots 1 and add a bunch of new monsters for your heroes to defeat to your games!

notes.title: New DLC: Fantasy Character Pack 2, KR Sky Palace Tileset
notes.notes:
Gee-kun-soft is back with another fantasy character pack, and Kokoro Reflections are back with a new palace tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115990/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Character_Pack_2/

Fill your wild adventures with nature-loving elves, armored beastmen, and dark magic devils with the Fantasy Character Pack 2! Gee-kun-soft is here with another character pack, this time offering up a set of 16 characters who can be party members, deadly foes, helpful NPCs, and more. Complete side quests to help out a human necromancer who smirks whenever you finish a job for her, team up with a beady-eyed sharkman who wants to prove he is strong even out of the ocean, and discover the enemy leader you’ve been hunting was the kimono-wearing princess who can control origami to destroy anyone in her way!

Each character comes with a walking character sprite, SV battler, enemy images, facesets with 8 different emotions, and bust images, so each character can fit into whatever idea you have. Let your players choose between playing as a red-headed princess dressed in medieval armor or a blonde elf who wields a wooden sword infused with plant magic, affecting which villages your players can safely enter during the first half of the game. Or have them play as a furry wolf archer who stumbles into a human strategist’s dangerous plot to remove all the beastmen from the kingdom! Have a pair of bumbling pink-haired devils pop up repeatedly to try to stop your heroes from clearing dungeons, and have a sweet lioness healer join the party to help defeat an armored and battle-crazed lizardman.

This pack also includes high-res full body art for each character, so you can resize them to perfectly fit your game or show off their complete designs in an in-game codex. So if your game has needed some new furry companions or you’ve been wanting some more devil and elf enemies, pick up the Fantasy Character Pack 2!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115960/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Sky_Palace_Tileset/

Reward your heroes for exploring the skies with a marble castle in the clouds thanks to the KR Sky Palace Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another MV/MZ tile pack to add a new palace in your world, with A1, A2, A4, A5, and 3 B sheets (with a color variation each for a total of 6 B sheets) ready to create marble rooms decorated with golden beds and furniture, gardens that float in the middle of the air, throne rooms with silver stairs and carved pillars, and more! Have your heroes visit a temple built in the clouds to gain new buffs from sculptures of ancient warriors, or visit a god who relaxes in a throne in the center of a diamond-shaped room who can just as easily offer a curse if your gift displeases them. Let them enjoy tasty meals while surrounded by gold-leafed trees and rest in softer-than-cloud beds after saving the princess of the sky palace. Just try to avoid upsetting anyone, otherwise your heroes may end up spending a few nights in the palace’s small prison instead of visiting a relaxing sauna!

9 character sprites for metal cells doors and a wall-mounted lever make it easy to keep your heroes out of areas they’re not allowed into yet and to hold captured enemies in the basement of the castle. This pack also includes 31 parallax images so you can show your palace floating high in the clouds no matter the time of day or weather! Pick up the KR Sky Palace Tileset and create your own Olympus for your heroes to visit and rule!

notes.title: Submissions for the RPG Maker Horror Festiva are now open!
notes.notes:

Submissions for the event are now open! Other than the basic requirements listed below, the event is open to all games!

・The game is currently available for sale or distribution on Steam. (Unreleased titles are also allowed if already completed registration with Steam)
※Games that were not made with a Maker series engine such as RPG Maker or Pixel Game Maker MV are allowed.

Please complete one of the following forms to submit your game(s) for consideration.

notes.title: New DLC: Cat Cafe, Lo-Bit RPG Pixel Art Asset Pack
notes.notes:
Two new packs, one for creating your perfect feline cafe, and one for designing an amazing 8-bit retro style game are here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115680/RPG_Maker_MZ__Cat_Cafe/

We’ve got the purr-fect pack for lovers of both cats and coffee today, with the Cat Cafe pack! Yeaka is here with a tileset and character combo pack to create a massive pack that can help you make as many pleasant cat-filled coffee shops and stores as your game could possibly need! A2, A3, A4, A5, and 14 B sheets offer up a variety of wood, carpet, furniture, and cat supplies to fill a full city with a different cat cafe on every corner.

Build a cozy cafe with wooden floors decorated with scattered cat paws and put up some coffee-themed wallpaper to surround tables and chairs where heroes and townsfolk can sit and enjoy cute cats. Keep the kitties healthy with clean litter, fresh water, and bowls and bowls of catfood, and have your players choose which cat toys and collars they’ll give their cats when they adopt them. And if you need a more serious place to meet for coffee, then use the simpler white or black furniture and coffee signs with just a few potted plants as pops of color.

This pack also contains 150 character sheets of cats with various patterns, ears, and tails so that you can give your cat dad a distinct family of kitties. Add some Scottish folds, calicos, hairless Sphynx, and even robotic cats for your allergic heroes to cuddle! And if that wasn’t enough, there are also cat-themed icons, a cat paw faceset, windowskins, and PSD files for the cats so you can make your own perfect cat. If your game has been lacking a cute cafe filled with cat-related art, or you just need more options for cats in your game, then pick up the Cat Cafe pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115630/RPG_Maker_MZ__LoBit_RPG_Pixel_Art_Asset_Pack/

Give your retro-inspired game a fresh coat of 8-bit paint with the Lo-Bit RPG Pixel Art Asset Pack! Finalbossblue is back with a brand new style, focusing on 8x8 tiles mixed and matched in a limited palette to create a gorgeous tileset to help you build villages, forests, castles, caves, and more! A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and a B sheet are ready to create every map you need to tell your story of heroes saving the day.

Craft a quilt of grass and dirt surrounded by water to give your heroes a world map to wander around, and dot it with small houses, castles, and temples to give your heroes more places to visit between exploring dungeons. Make a rock-filled mining town where the NPCs are waiting for enemy bats to be chased off from the nearby caverns and snowy regions where snow-covered trees surround shops that sell incredible healing potions. Send your heroes to visit the king in his extravagant castle before heading deep into the forest to stop the villainous living armor that has set up its base in a trap-filled stone temple.

This pack also includes 2 windowskins that match the look of the tiles as well as 11 character sheets to populate your game!  Have jesters dance and guards pace in place to add more movement to your maps with 64 idle characters (each with a color variation), and let your heroes walk between flickering torches to open treasure chests and battle enemies that stalk around the map. Give your game an old-school look to enhance your story with the Lo-Bit RPG Pixel Art Asset Pack!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Country Cottage Tileset, KR Flower Forest Tileset
notes.notes:
Kokoro Reflections are here with two new tilesets perfect for a cozy game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3011760/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Country_Cottage_Tileset/

Build your heroes a cozy home to return to after years of battle with the KR Country Cottage Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has crafted a soft set of interior and exterior tiles to let you make colorful fields of flowers, meandering paths in a garden, and thatched roof houses for kind witches and cheerful families to live in! A1, A2, and A4 tiles along with 4 B sheets offer up all you need to make houses into homes with cozy furniture and all sorts of decorations to tell players about who lives there without any words. Give a grouchy old man who lives in the small cottage made from wicker and plaster a garden full of potted plants and a large wooden workstation with empty pots and small shovels to show that he has a soft spot for flowers, and give the local witch a home filled with bright and cheery sunflowers. 

Build a base for your heroes to recover with fully furnished bedrooms, bathrooms, and kitchens filled with fresh produce to make some stat-boosting food, or use the sets of wildflowers to add more colors and textures to your outdoor maps. This pack also includes flames to light up the fireplace and wooden doors to give your heroes access to relaxing interiors. So if you’ve been wanting to create a cute little village or need a comfy house in a field of wildflowers, pick up the KR Country Cottage Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062900/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Flower_Forest_Tileset/

Add even more bursts of colors and sweet scents to your maps with the KR Flower Forest Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with a set of exterior tiles to make your heroes sneeze. Filled with larger-than-life flowers and marble pillars and fences, this pack can make magical forests, relaxing parks, a giant’s garden, and more!

A1, A2, A4, and A5 tiles as well as 5 B sheets are ready to turn any outdoors map into a fantastical garden or plant-filled dungeon where beauty hides danger. Show your players how much magic is in the area with grasses that come in greens, yellows, blues, pinks, and white, and scatter mushrooms in the shadows of trees and tall lush hedges. White moonflowers, blue roses, yellow sunflowers, and pink tulips come in multiple angles and sizes so that you can let your heroes wander under towering flowers or walk beside normal-sized flowers growing in beds. Let them walk under arches decorated with the different flowers and explore stone paths around small flowers. And when they’ve had enough of the pretty flowerbeds, have them follow scattered petals that grow in size until they’ve entered a mystical forest where marble fences trap them in pollen-filled fields!

This pack also includes spraying water fountains to add more movement to your garden maps along with a white marble box that can hold all sorts of goodies for your heroes to find. Pick up the KR Flower Forest Tileset and create gorgeous gardens created with magic or dungeons where your heroes shrink down to the size of bugs!

notes.title: New DLC: CyberCity Central Security, KR Desert Kingdom Tileset
notes.notes:
Two new tilesets out now for RPG Maker!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062880/RPG_Maker_MZ__CyberCity_Central_Security_Tiles/

Alert, alert! New tiles to increase the military presence in your game are here thanks to the CyberCity Central Security pack! PVGames is back with another pack in their CyberCity series, this time focusing on cold concrete and metal to create a harsh technology-filled world for your heroes to fight for or against. More than 1,800 tiles are ready to help you build long hallways where your heroes need to avoid cameras and barricades, jail cells where your heroes may make unlikely connections, barracks for the city’s soldiers, and more!

Perfect for parallax mapping, each object in this pack comes in 8 different directions so you can set up your maps exactly how you imagine them. Create war rooms with monitors lining every wall so your villains can keep a close eye on the entire city, or fill your hero’s base with hastily gathered crates and sandbags so they can survive without getting caught by security. Add sentry guns to the tops of buildings to tell your players that they shouldn’t just wander into those places without a plan, and make prisons with sturdy watchtowers and concrete walls that your heroes will need to escape if they are unlucky enough to be caught while searching for info!

Need some buildings to fill out your city or some warehouse interior maps for a short cutscene? Then make sure to use this pack’s 17 pre-built buildings and warehouse space that you can fill with enemy weapons or equipment for your heroes to use! If your game needs some dangerous military bases to sneak into or you want to show just how deadly the corrupt city’s soldiers are, check out the CyberCity Central Security pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062870/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Desert_Kingdom_Tileset/

Build stone cities for your heroes to rest in while exploring sandy dungeons with the KR Desert Kingdom Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another set of tiles to create a full town found in the hot and dry deserts of your game’s world. A1, A2, A4, and A5 tiles along with 5 B sheets offer up a bunch of stone and clay to create your town’s solid base, and then decorate it with tile entryways and draped canopies to help keep the sun off the townsfolk when they’re out shopping and gossiping. Let your heroes recover from battles by resting on comfy large cushions, and have them go shopping to find new curved swords, cooling fruits, and cloth armor that protects them from heat.

Need to make an abandoned building for your heroes to explore, or destroy a town after the final boss releases a deadly plague? Then grab the crack autotiles and the destroyed versions of some of the B tiles to turn a cozy home into a ruined shell! Torn papers, busted vases, and ripped fabric make interiors unlivable while crumbling arches and pillars and cracked domes make building exteriors feel dangerous to enter. This pack also includes carved arched doors to help keep the hot air out of bedrooms as well as a floating magic carpet that your heroes could use to quickly traverse the empty desert dunes! Pick up the KR Desert Kingdom Tileset and create sandy marketplaces, oasis inns, and ransacked castles in your desert areas!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Seasons of Harvest Farm Tileset, More Trees
notes.notes:
Two new tilesets bring the rural outdoors to life, create the perfect pastoral location with the KR Seasons of Harvest Farm Tileset, and then populate a nearby forest with More Trees!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3011780/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Seasons_of_Harvest_Farm_Tileset/

Farming is hard work, so give your players some enjoyable maps to explore when they’re not watering their fields with the KR Seasons of Harvest Farm Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with a tileset that lets you create interior and exterior farm maps no matter the time of year! A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 2 B sheets offer up all you need to make a field for crops, huge red barns for animals, shops selling seeds and snacks, and a cozy home filled with natural wood furniture and soft rugs! Let your players choose between blue, green, purple, and pink fabrics for their rooms and give them a nicely furnished kitchen so that they can cook any vegetables they grow. Or focus on the barn, where they can store baskets of crops and maybe even raise cute farm animals.

And if that wasn’t enough, each tile sheet comes in 4 versions so you can match the look to the 4 seasons! Have your players spend most of their time visiting friendly townsfolk when the color of the world is muted and snow coats all the buildings and let them know work is beginning again with the light greens of spring. Or grow different crops during different seasons, limiting corn to the summer season and letting turnips grow in every season except summer so that your players need to plan before throwing seeds into the ground.

This pack also includes character sheets for wooden doors and fence gates, sliding barn doors, a wooden crate, and 23 plants with different growth stages! Let your players grow grapes and tomatoes to fit your normal world, or have some fun and give them wild fantasy fruits that could increase magic stats or poison demons! So if your slice-of-life farming sim needs a fresh look or you want to give your villages some fields filled with food (and farming minigames), check out the KR Seasons of Harvest Farm Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062850/RPG_Maker_MZ__More_Trees/

Do you like trees? Do you wish there were more trees to fill your forests with? Then the More Trees pack is the pack for you! Plueschkatze knows there’s no such thing as too many trees, so she’s back with another pack of trees to give your maps more variety. 7 different types of trees with multiple sizes for each make turning a boring forest into an amazing and lush woodland to explore! 3 B sheets full of trees are ready to give your towns an ancient 6-tile tall deciduous tree as its centerpiece, your forests pops of color with yellow and red leaves, and trees in different stages of growth to help you steer your players in the right direction by having bigger trees form natural walls.

Tall thin cypress are perfect for adding some trees along the path to a noble’s villa, or use them to subtly block an alley between shops so that your players can’t sneak into areas where they don’t belong. Break up expanses of sand on beaches or let your players know an oasis is nearby with palm trees, or plant one randomly in a town that leads them to an interesting plant-related side quest. Each tile sheet comes in 2 versions, one with shadows under the tree and one without, so that no matter if you prefer parallax mapping with your own type of shadows or you just want to add in trees without needing to change anything you can use these trees! Pick up the More Trees pack and give your beaches some towering palm trees and your autumn maps some gorgeous red and yellow leaves!

notes.title: New DLC: Last Boss Pack Vol.6, Potions Asset Pack 4K Vol 2
notes.notes:
Last Boss Pack Vol.6 and Potions Asset Pack 4K Vol 2 are here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3011840/RPG_Maker_MZ__Last_Boss_Pack_Vol6/

Battle a sultry incubus, a snarling manticore, and even the Norse god Thor with the Last Boss Pack Vol.6! Gee-kun-soft is back with more battlers in their Last Boss series, this time bringing you gods and monsters inspired by Japanese, Ancient Greek, European and Norse mythology for your heroes to fight. This pack has 10 new bosses to choose from, with front view enemies, character sprites, and unique battlebacks for each so you can make each boss battle memorable!

Search for elephant-headed baku and dragon-headed kirin to gain mystical relics, or face off against taloned griffins and furry manticores to prove your strength! If your heroes need some more humanoid bosses to challenge, then let them test their resilience against an attractive incubus or a grinning and buff Loki. Not even the seas are safe from boss battles with this pack’s Echidna and Typhon enemies.! Have your heroes fight for their lives against the snake-tailed mother of monsters and the snake-haired father of storm winds while trying to keep their ship from sinking, or use their large sprites to show ocean areas on the map that your heroes should avoid if they don’t want to face terrible storms.

This pack also includes 62 bonus pictures with the enemies placed in their battlebacks with damaged and attacking versions so you can have cut-ins during battles or show a cool cutscene after defeating the boss! And that’s not all, high-resolution PSD files for every enemy are also included so you can make your own versions of each battler depending on what special attack it will use next or how injured it is. So if you’ve been looking for more fantasy enemies or want some large furry creatures to wander your maps then pick up the Last Boss Pack Vol.6!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2957050/RPG_Maker_MZ__Potions_Asset_Pack_4K_Vol_2/

Fill your alchemists’ pockets with all the bottles of magical liquids they could possibly need with Potions Asset Pack 4K Vol 2! Bis is back with another set of 3D-modeled potion icons to give your items and quests new images, from basic round-bottomed flasks filled with fresh water to gilded glass chalices full of a magical rainbow liquid.

420 images offer up a variety of potion bottle shapes and liquid colors so you can fill your game with healing potions, deadly poisons, crafting ingredients, and more! 10 different bottle shapes come filled with 13 differently colored liquids as well as an empty version so you can give your players empty bottles that they can fill with whatever they want. Each potion also comes in a sealed version and a sealed and tagged version so your heroes don’t accidentally spill a healing potion or try to drink a poison when low on HP! Keep inky darkness safely sealed in a test tube until your heroes can deliver it to a researcher to finish a side quest, or have them take a closer look at a square glass bottle whose tag states “increases your luck” while shopping in a city market.

And if all those weren’t enough, this pack also includes multiple sizes for each potion so you can add them right into your favorite engine! Use the 24x24 pixel icons for Ace, the 32x32 icons for MV/MZ, and the larger 300x300 and 1024x1024 pixel images for cutscenes or custom menus! Still not enough? Then resize the high-resolution 2160x2160 versions to make your perfect potion sizes! Pick up Potions Asset Pack 4K Vol 2 and add even more items for your players to experiment with!

notes.title: New DLC: CyberCity Industrial Sector Tiles, Futuristic Dungeon BGM Pack
notes.notes:
Head to the future with new music, and new environment graphics!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3011750/RPG_Maker_MZ__Futuristic_Dungeon_BGM_Pack/

Send your mercenaries to search abandoned factories or have your heroes break into a power plant controlled by an evil corporation with the CyberCity Industrial Sector Tiles pack! PVGames is here with another addition to their CyberCity series, this time focusing on grimy concrete and metal beams that can build warehouses, industrial parks, and more! With over 1,900 tiles to choose from you can make exterior and interior maps to fill your busy factory districts.

Designed for you to create parallax maps, each object comes in 8 different directions so you can set up your map to look just how you want and make it enjoyable for your players to explore! Create warehouse interiors with robot arms and assembly lines frozen in place and old metal chains and loose wires dangling from catwalks above the ground floor. Or keep your heroes away from the deadly industrial machines by blocking the doors from the building office so they can only interact with metal shelves and a few consoles to gather the intel they need.

Also included are 31 full buildings and 24 large building pieces so you can fill out your map with more buildings to make your cities feel even larger and more alive. Give your sci-fi games swooping concrete buildings in the background where all of the robots and cybernetic implants are made, or add towers supported with rusted metal beams to your modern metropolises. So if you’ve been needing to build some warehouses for your heroes to visit or you just want to make your CyberCity-filled game even more varied, pick up the CyberCity Industrial Sector Tiles pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3011720/RPG_Maker_MZ__CyberCity_Industrial_Sector_Tiles/

Fill your maze-like factories and ancient hi-tech ruins with fitting music thanks to the Futuristic Dungeon BGM Pack! Ayato sound create is back with another music pack, this time with 11 synth and electronic tunes to give any game a sci-fi flair. Give your cyberpunk city’s underground a slightly relaxed track with mechanical undertones, have flowing water tie into quirky beeps and boops while your heroes unlock a spaceship that crash-landed in a lake, and unsettle your players with a droning melody after they discover just what has been going on in the colony’s research facility!

Set the mood in a dungeon instantly and switch it up depending on what your players are meant to be doing there. The first time they visit a dungeon play ‘Detective’, a track full of guitar twang and backed with an electronic beat, while they search for important clues, and then later in the game when they have learned what the villain plans to do replace the dungeon’s music with ‘Reasoning’, a track that carries a much darker tone with its piano melody and heavy beat. Or give each dungeon its own unique BGM, with tracks like ‘Altar’ fitting space elevator dungeons thanks to a rising drone and drum beats and ‘Ridge’ ready for the city streets with its heavy beat and down to earth instruments. Each track comes in M4a and looping Ogg file formats, so you can add them right into your MV/MZ project and not worry about awkward pauses in the music. Add some electronic tunes and metallic beats to your magitech world with the Futuristic Dungeon BGM Pack!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Wild West Tileset, RPG Character Pack 13
notes.notes:
Two new packs for RPG Maker! Head to the Wild West with the new KR Wild West Tileset! Introduce 16 new characters to your game with RPG Character Pack 13!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3011690/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Wild_West_Tileset/

Howdy partners, if you’ve been wanting to make a game all about cowboys then the KR Wild West Tileset is for you! Kokoro Reflections is back with another tileset with interior and exterior tiles to create a dusty town filled with ruffians and troublemakers. Make sandy deserts filled with different cacti that slowly transform into scrubland with yucca and trees where your heroes can track down thieves hiding in closed mines. Create a town where your heroes can rest at the local inn, store their hard-earned gold in the bank’s metal vault, talk to people in the sheriff’s small jail cell, play a hand of poker at the saloon, and more with this pack!

A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets offer up tons of tiles to build a little town at the edge of the wilderness. Focusing on wooden walls and furniture, this pack includes tons of little details to tell stories with just your maps. Leave bags of mail waiting to be sorted into mail slots in the post office to show that it’s understaffed, and hang large hunks of meat next to barber chairs in the grocers/barbershop where the owner is happy to share that he’s also the town’s surgeon. Make sure your heroes easily know what each wooden building is with large signs that proudly state what is there, or just mark the places your heroes will need to visit with small signs next to the doors.

This pack also includes 7 character sprites for flames, chests, and doors. Have your hero find useful items in wooden crates and unlock heavy safes to find more money, or kick open swinging saloon doors to put together a team that will break into the local bank’s huge vault! Pick up the KR Wild West Tileset and build rustic towns for your heroes to protect (or rob!) away from the hustle and bustle of city life!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3011660/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Character_Pack_13/

Add new NPCs and possible party members to your game with RPG Character Pack 13! Gee-kun-soft is at it again with another 16 characters to populate your fantasy and sci-fi games. Receive quests from a chipper pink-haired princess, get healed by a duo of nurses, battle dangerous swordsmen and wicked wizards, and even join a sci-fi crew with this pack! Each character comes with a MZ-style walking sprite, downed sprites, front view enemy images, side view battler sprites, faceset with 8 different emotions, and busts so you can give your new party members a full storyline and detailed menu scenes! Fight against an armored royal guard with a serious face and mohawk to prove that you deserve to meet with the princess, or flee from the royal warrior woman who wears her hair in a loose braid and easily swings a battle ax if she finds you in the castle. Learn new spells from an elderly wizard dressed in his dark robes and compete with his young brunette apprentice until he decides to join your party. Or travel to the edge of the galaxy with uniformed ship commanders and crewmates dressed in lightweight outfits.

This pack also includes high-resolution versions of each character so you can adjust their size to be exactly what you need. Want to have a scene where the blond swordsman gets really close to the player’s screen? Then use the high-resolution image to keep things looking crisp! Pick up RPG Character Pack 13 and add even more heroes, villains, and important NPCs to your games!
