notes.title: New DLC: CyberCity Character Creator Kit, CyberCity Icons
notes.notes:
This week, the CyberCity series expands! Adding characters and icons!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2957040/RPG_Maker_MZ__CyberCity_Character_Creator_Kit/

Create unique heroes, villains, and people just living their best cyberpunk lives with the CyberCity Character Creator Kit! PVGames is here with a bunch of character pieces for their CyberCity series to help you fill your cities with busy citizens. Make tough armored cops carrying multiple guns who block your heroes path, friendly cyborg shopkeepers wearing hoodies who offer blackmarket items for reasonable prices, androids dancers in plastic and metal bodysuits who can offer up helpful rumors, and more with this pack!

You’ll need to be familiar with art programs to make the most of this pack, but if you do then the possibilities are unlimited! With 5 body bases for both male and female characters, you can create fully human, cybernetically-enhanced human, and completely robotic heroes to fit your story and world. Dress your modern characters in t-shirts, hoodies, and leather jackets over black jeans, loose joggers, and athletic shorts before thrusting them into an adventure across the galaxy, or start your story with sci-fi uniforms and strength-enhancing armor so your players know they’re in for a game full of high-tech battles!

And if all those outfit pieces weren’t enough, this pack is designed to give you all the character sprite and portrait images you could want, with each character piece designed to layer over full body portraits with 16 different poses and huge character sheets with animations for walking, running, falling, fighting, and more so you can show tons of emotions during cutscenes. Create your perfect characters and then crop the images to fit RPG Maker’s specifications, or use your favorite character frame plugin to make use of the 8-frame walking animations in 8 directions and other behaviors! So if you’ve been needing some new partially robotic characters to populate your game, or you just love PVGames’ resources, pick up the CyberCity Character Creator Kit!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2957060/RPG_Maker_MZ__CyberCity_Icons/

Give your 3D-style game some fitting high-res icons with the CyberCity Icons pack! PVGames is adding to their CyberCity series with a massive pack of 512x512 pixel images to use in cutscenes and inventory menus. Over 800 icons offer up images for vials and weapons, clothing and accessories that match what your heroes are wearing from the CyberCity Character Creator Kit pack, tasty bowls of food, handwritten notes and old newspapers, boxes and objects to examine up close, and more!

Use these icons in your sci-fi detective game to give your players something to look at when searching a crime scene, where interacting with a potted plant in the bedroom reveals an empty injector and a bookshelf holds a small note from the victim that proves someone was stalking them! Or use the food and take-out container images in a minigame where your players need to choose and deliver the right meals around town to make some extra money to buy an upgrade for their robot arm. Give your players a reason to change their outfits in-game by letting them see a close up of each shirt, pants, and accessory before buying and equipping them, or create loot boxes that could be filled with anything from rare wines and expensive paintings to old robot feet and literal piles of garbage that your players can try to sell or use as fuel for a fire. Grab the CyberCity Icons pack and add some extra pizzazz to investigative scenes and to your character outfit menus!

notes.title: New DLC: CyberCity Core Tiles, CyberCity R&D Tiles
notes.notes:
Get ready to explore the futuristic city with a new series from PVG with the new CyberCity Tiles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2957030/RPG_Maker_MZ__CyberCity_Core_Tiles/

Build cities of grungy concrete, rusting metal, and shining neon with the CyberCity Core Tiles pack! PVGames is back with a new CyberCity series, focusing on the bright neon and grimy technology you want when making a modern or cyberpunk world. This pack contains thousands of tiles for you to play with, so get ready to build trash-filled alleyways, opulent apartments, bars filled with bottles and stages for bands, retro arcades, and streets lined with skyscrapers!

Designed with parallax maps in mind, each tile comes in 8 directions so you can position things exactly how you want them to build your dream maps. Start with floor and wall panels to create your exterior streets (or use some of the included empty interiors for inside shops and houses) and then fill it with detailed 3D tiles to turn it into a busy marketplace where neon signs light up every square foot of space or a trashed side street with barrels filled with wood and broken bottles show that some people are calling that street home. Need a cozy place for your heroes to call home? Fill a room with bookshelves and arcade cabinets so they can relax. Need a sketchy club to find a bad guy? Then create a bar with stools and scattered bottles of booze on every table and install a few lit signs advertising the bar’s shows.

This pack also includes tons of premade building exteriors so that you can easily add more shops and business fronts to your streets without needing to create each one from scratch. Add a record store next to the pizza shop that acts as your heroes’ base of operations so there’s a good reason for new music to always be playing, and line the more busy streets of the city with towering buildings covered in neon signs advertising anything and everything. Pick up the CyberCity Core Tiles pack and get started on your sci-fi adventure!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959080/RPG_Maker_MZ__CyberCity_RD_Tiles/

Add a tech-filled lab for your heroes to call home and deadly factories where AIs slowly take over the internet with the CyberCity R&D Tiles pack! PVGames continues their CyberCity series with another tileset, this time offering more than 2,500 tiles to turn rooms and hallways into a busy research and development laboratory. Build spaces for your heroes to upgrade their weapons and armor at tables filled with tools, medical rooms with healing tanks and high-tech hospital beds for injured party members, shoddily built factories in warehouses that are building killer robots, and more with this pack!

Each tile comes in 8 directions to make building your perfect parallax map even easier, so you can put workstations against every wall in a room even if there are diagonal walls and make it so that a room filled with the same type of boxes won’t feel like a box was just copy-pasted over and over. Turn a grimy room into a tactical base of operations with wires criss-crossing the floor and large monitors displaying info next to bulky computers that are lit up with floodlights, or create a villain’s base that’s full of pieces of androids scattered carelessly around and handwritten notes that reveal the canisters on shelves hold a neurotoxin that will enslave every human in the city if your heroes don’t stop it! No proper sci-fi or cyberpunk game would be complete without a laboratory full of sterile test rooms and dangerous technology, so make sure to grab the CyberCity R&D Tiles pack!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Art Deco Theater Tileset, KR Spirit of Asia Tileset
notes.notes:
Two new packs from Kokoro Reflections! Get the KR Art Deco Theater Tileset and the KR Spirit of Asia Tileset today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2956990/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Art_Deco_Theatre_Tileset/

Visit movie theaters that conceal dark secrets and make unique save points for your game with the KR Art Deco Theater Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with another MV/MZ tileset, this time focusing on the glitz and glam of a theater that could exist in a 1920s mystery game, a modern slice-of-life story, and even a sci-fi world where people want to reminisce about days long past. A2, A4, A5, and 3 B sheets with 4 different color variations and a B sheet of posters offer up all the tiles you could need to make amazing interiors and an impressive exterior with sharply angled art deco decorations and tall towers to draw people in!

Create a happy cinema filled with golden walls and decorations and topped with pops of teal where your heroes can go and recover instead of using an inn, or add an oppressive air to the opera theater where a murder occurred by using the black metal details with dark red highlights. Cover the floors with rugs covered in colorful swirls and lead your heroes to their seats with in-floor lights. Create fancy seating in front of stages hidden behind thick curtains and give the actors dressing rooms in the back hallways of the theater with wardrobes and vanities, or make a more modern cinema with a snack-filled concessions stand and smaller theater rooms where screens can be made as large as necessary.

This pack also includes 6 character sprites for doors and treasure chests in each black and gold style to match your chosen theater theme, along with large film projectors you can point at screens. Use the projectors as save points while your detectives search for clues, or let your players decide which tutorial they’d like to see again by interacting with the projector! Pick up the KR Art Deco Theater Tileset and add some more incredible art deco maps where your heroes can take a break and recover between adventures!
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2956940/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Spirit_of_Asia_Tileset/

Send your European-inspired hero on a globetrotting adventure to gorgeous cities lit with lanterns and into forests of cherry blossoms with the KR Spirit of Asia Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another MV/MZ tileset inspired by Asian architecture and furniture, so you can visit the town your samurai party member calls home and give a mission to sneak into a villain’s mansion a unique look. A1, A2, A3, and A4 tiles along with 3 B sheets and 4 color variations of a B sheet of furniture are overflowing with carefully carved wood and expertly crafted paper screens to help you build lovely inns, active town centers, and relaxing bath houses.

Brown, red, black, and gold paint jobs on most tiles makes it simple to show the wealth of certain houses, or mix and match to give each home their own unique style! Let your heroes cross a raised bridge over a small stream to stop in a small restaurant for a buff-granting meal of dumplings, or have them visit a dojo where a gong stands to the side and tall stone dragons guard the entrance. When your heroes need a moment to calm and collect themselves, let them wander through a garden where manicured trees show off colorful blooms and bamboo stretches high above their heads.

This pack also comes with character sprites for turning wooden water wheels and sliding doors (both 1-tile and 2-tile tall versions) so your heroes can enter buildings through immaculately decorated doors. If your game needs some Asian-inspired towns or you just love having more options for statues and vases, check out the KR Spirit of Asia Tileset!

notes.title: New DLC: EVFX Pierce, Simple Piano Music Pack
notes.notes:
Add even more effekseer animations to your game with EVFX Pierce! Bring in some new single instrument tunes with Simple Piano Music Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2956910/RPG_Maker_MZ__EVFX_Pierce/

Stab through any enemy’s defense with the EVFX Pierce pack! Dreams Circle is back with another amazing animation pack, this time featuring 20 new Effekseer animations for stabbing, perforating, and puncturing foes with swords, spears, and spells! Give your hero a lance instead of a sword to help him stand out, and let him learn power skills that can slice through foes with a well-placed thrust. Start him out with a single quick thrust into the enemy and a throw of his spear to reach further away enemies, and as he gains experience add new skills that can pinpoint enemy arteries to release a spray of blood or launch him into the air to deal a powerful downwards stab into enemy heads!

Equip your ninja party member with 3 new kunai animations, from launching a handful of them one after the other into an enemy to leaping over the whole enemy troop and flinging a bunch of knives down on them like deadly rain. And don’t forget your party’s mage or mechanic! Let them wield a rotating drill of power that can debuff an enemy’s defense or take a few turns to release a burst of drills from beneath the ground that can pierce the enemy troop’s soft underbellies.

This pack also includes 20 SEs that perfectly match the animations and an example project so you can see some examples on how to use each attack! Or adjust the animation’s rotation and add new sounds to create the perfect attacks for your hero’s skills. Pierce through the veil of boring animations and pick up the EVFX Pierce pack today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2956880/RPG_Maker_MZ__Simple_Piano_Music_Pack/

Is your game lacking some calming single-instrument tracks for emotional scenes? Then pick up the Simple Piano Music Pack! This pack’s 10 short BGM tracks focus entirely on pianos, giving it a unique style compared to the common orchestral and electronic music tunes often found in games. Give your villages a distinct sound compared to the bigger cities or the monster-infested dungeons, or fill your pubs with jaunty piano tunes that are being played by the local musician on the upright piano in the corner.

With 2 tracks based around gentle melodies, 5 upbeat pop tunes, and 3 dramatic sad songs you can cover a variety of scenes and situations! Give your modern bar a jazz-inspired track for your heroes to enjoy while they plan their next move over cocktails, and change to a curiously quirky tune when they realize the person they’ve been searching for is sitting over at the counter. Worry your players with a fast-paced sad piece while they race through a castle to save a companion, or mess with their expectations by playing a slow and somber piece when they find a fallen friend only to switch to a calm track once the party’s healer saves them.

Each track comes in M4a and looping Ogg file formats, making it easy to add them right into your current MV/MZ project! Skip the bombastic soundtracks and give your relaxed game suitably chill piano BGM with the Simple Piano Music Pack!

notes.title: New DLC: KR The Motherlode Cave & Mine, RPG Character Pack 12, Winlu Spaceship
notes.notes:
Caves, Spaceships, and animalistic heroes! Check out the 3 new resource packs out today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2903000/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_The_Motherlode_Cave_and_Mine_Tileset/

If you’ve been yearning for the mines, then the KR The Motherlode Cave and Mine Tileset is the pack for you! Kokoro Reflections is delving deep into the earth with this MV/MZ tileset pack that includes dirt, stone, and pits of unending darkness to make all the caverns and tunnels you want. A1, A2, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets include natural and manmade objects so you can make wild caves formed from hundreds of years of erosion, carefully carved mining tunnels, and anything in between! Have your players follow purple rivers deeper underground to discover a magical cave full of oversized mushrooms and giant crystals to gather new resources. Or let them adventure into old mines with wooden beams supporting the ceilings and iron pipes pumping fresh air deep under the ground to find where a bandit group is holding villagers hostage in roughly made jail cells!

This pack also includes 8 character sprites with doors, levers, and mine carts to keep your players out of certain areas at the start of the dungeon and to help them gain access to even deeper caves. Lock treasures behind metal cell doors and pull levers to unlock elevator doors to make it even easier to leave the depths and resume your adventure right where you left off after a quick visit to the nearest town. Pick up KR The Motherlode Cave and Mine Tileset today and build gold-filled caves for your heroes to collect resources from, dangerous abandoned mines to explore, and caverns where monsters could be lurking behind all the fang-shaped stalagmites and stalactites!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902970/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Character_Pack_12/

Expand your party with more non-human members with the RPG Character Pack 12! Gee-kun-soft’s latest pack offers up 16 new characters who all have standout features that include fur, feathers, and scales! Replace boring human Reid with a black-winged bird man, a foxy mage with two tails, a half-fish merman, or even a raging genetically-modified dinosaur! Each character comes with a MZ style sprite, downed poses, faceset, frontview enemy image with color variations, image busts, and SV battlers, meaning you can turn enemies into friends after a dramatic battle or finding out that your bff (best friend fur-ever) was secretly the villain all along!

Create a team of misfit humanoids that includes a trident-wielding warrior mermaid and a wolf-headed brawler who are the only ones able to stop an evil prophecy, or add some interesting new shopkeepers to your cities! Let the pack’s small fox woman run a magic shop and have the youthful dwarf man offer the best weapons around, or create a traveling merchant who can sell your heroes any items they need wherever they are since the merchant just so happens to be a giant bird! This pack also includes a full-size image for each character so you can adjust the size to perfectly fit your game’s screen size. If you’ve been needing to add some fluffy fox and cat girls to your party or really want to have some lizardmen as romanceable teammates, pick up the RPG Character Pack 12!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902960/RPG_Maker_MZ__Winlu_Spaceship_Tileset/

Set your sights on exploring the edges of the universe with the Winlu Spaceship Tileset! Winlu is back with another sci-fi MV/MZ tileset, this time focusing on all the interior tiles you’ll need to make a liveable spaceship! A1, A2, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets are ready to build sterile med bays, busy storage spaces, open bridges, bunk bed-filled bedrooms, cafeterias with hydroponics against the walls, and more! Have your heroes enjoy their time in space with rooms made cozy with potted plants and bookshelves, or force them to explore a creepy alien-infested research ship that’s coated in blood and filled with damaged electronics and missing guns.

Fill your spaceships with all the little animated bits and bobs they need to feel real with the help of this pack’s 32 character images! Give your cockpit monitors that have data quickly scrolling across the screen and holograms that show info about nearby planets, and have the ship’s damaged reactor glow and flicker as the power slowly shuts down and lights fade and doors start to stop working. Place lockers and chests around the rooms so your players can scavenge and find items, and add switches all over to unlock new doors and activate LED signs so your players can know what type of room they’ll be entering before stepping through the thick metal doors. And if that wasn’t enough, this pack also includes 2 parallax images of starry space so that you can show how alone your hero is on their ship instead of having just blackness outside the maps. If your game takes place on a spaceship or you just want a high-tech laboratory for your Earth-bound heroes to explore, pick up the Winlu Spaceship Tileset today!

notes.title: New DLC: MT Tiny Tales - CodeArk Galaxy Frontiers, CodeArk UI Assets
notes.notes:
Expand your sci-fi game with a new tileset and new set of UI assets from MT Tiny Tales!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902920/RPG_Maker_MZ__MT_Tiny_Tales__CodeArk_Galaxy_Frontiers/

Get your spaceship’s shields up and prepare for battle, because the MT Tiny Tales - CodeArk Galaxy Frontiers pack is ready to turn your game into a sci-fi slug fest! Mega Tiles is back with a new series focusing on futuristic and sci-fi designs. This pack includes 19 unique designs for character sprites and pixel art static side-view battlers to add alien invasions, robotic warriors, and challenging fights against technologically-advanced party members!

Send your heroes into an alien-infested world to free the people who live there and have them watch out for insect-like creatures with spiky limbs and long, floating, parasites that can release bursts of energy. Let your players decide whether they want to defeat every enemy on the map or sneak by to find and destroy the floating brain that controls all of the monsters with its tentacles instead! Have robotic dogs, orbs, and humanoid androids guard important factories and labs, or battle humans armed with hi-tech armor, guns, and electrified clubs who have hunkered down in an abandoned space station.

Each sprite and battler come with multiple color variations, making for 125 characters to choose from! Give your players a visual clue on enemy weaknesses by having every red alien be weak to water while the blue ones are healed by water attacks, or just have more color options for your robot enemies to keep battles from looking the same every time. Pick up the MT Tiny Tales - CodeArk Galaxy Frontiers pack and fill your planets with interesting friends and foes!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902950/RPG_Maker_MZ__MT_Tiny_Tales__CodeArk_UI_Assets/

Update your menus with a digital new look with the MT Tiny Tales - CodeArk UI Assets pack! Mega Tiles is here with another addition to the CodeArk series, this time offering up a massive number of pixel art UI pieces to help you build your perfect menus. With hundreds of images split in to windowskins, MV & MZ touchscreen buttons, UI elements, gauges, cursors, and more, you’ll be able to make your game look like it belongs in a cyberspace world or add a sci-fi vibe to your fantasy game to let your players know that there’s something deeper going on in the world. 

Build a unique menu out of pictures to give your players important information by choosing frames with different corners, backgrounds with pink or blue grids, and simple menu icons so it’s easy to navigate the page. Want to make a bestiary with gauges and a picture of the monster in a window? You can make a base for that with these UI pieces! Do you have a plugin that lets you add a cursor but don’t have a good image for the cursor? Then use this pack’s hand and arrow cursors! Want to show your players which button to press when introducing a new mechanic? Grab the keyboard and controller button icons in this pack and add them to your tutorials to make sure your players know exactly what button you’re talking about!

Want to give your menus a makeover without designing your own custom menus piece-by-piece? Then make use of one of the pack’s 90 windowskins! Multiple color options, frame styles, and background patterns give you plenty of options to improve your menu’s look without having to build it from the ground up. Have your digital heroes stand out on a grid pattern in the main menu, and give message boxes a pretty prismatic frame to highlight your dialogue. This pack also includes Aseprite files so you can edit the images to get exactly the look your game calls for. If your sci-fi game needs some tech-based windowskins or you want to make sure your tutorials explain with visuals all of the buttons your players need to press, pick up the MT Tiny Tales - CodeArk UI Assets pack!

notes.title: New: Fantasy Dreamland - Festival Pack/Village Pack, Time Elements Character Exp
notes.notes:
2 new Fantasy tileset packs! A new pixel based character pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2801220/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Dreamland__Festival_Pack/

Let your heroes enjoy some winter and fall holidays with the Fantasy Dreamland - Festival Pack! ELV Games is here with a specialized pixel art tileset to help you add some new festivities to your game. This pack contains tilesets sized for Ace, MV, and MZ so you can add them right into your current project so you heroes can enjoy wintery presents, haunted fall nights, and visit the local blacksmith’s shop!

A1 and A3 sheets can help you build the base of your festival maps, while 2 Halloween, 3 Christmas, and 2 Blacksmith B sheets can add all the little details you need! Fill a spooky village with large pumpkins and carved jack-o’-lanterns sitting under leafless trees and create a large graveyard with different tombstones and cross-shaped torches. Winter in your game’s towns can enjoy footprints in the snow and two sizes of snowmen along with candy cane posts, decorated pine trees in 3 different colors, and piles and piles of presents! If your heroes need to upgrade their weapons after enjoying the holidays, then have them visit the local blacksmith’s shop where coal and buckets of water sit next to anvils and furnaces, and swords and shields sit on shelves ready for purchase.

This pack also includes 5 character sprites for Halloween objects. Light up the night with some torches and unlock a new undead dungeon by having a tomb open to reveal a descending set of stairs. Or add some fun to a fall map with bouncing bat and spider decorations and grinning faces carved into tree trunks and walls. If you need some Christmas decorations for your game or just want to add some extra spooks and winter cheer to your Fantasy Dreamland game, pick up the Fantasy Dreamland - Festival Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2801180/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Dreamland__Village_Pack/

Let your heroes take a break from saving the world in a relaxed town with the Fantasy Dreamland - Village Pack! ELV Games is here with a new tileset, sized for both Ace and MV/MZ, to make sure your heroes can always find a place to shop and rest when they’re exploring your game’s world. Let your heroes have a hometown they know they can always return to, build small farming communities where side quests to kill monsters are always available, and make snow-covered villages in the chilly North of your world for your heroes to visit when they need to warm up!

A1, 2 A2, 2 A5, and 8 B sheets offer up a bunch of wood and stone tiles to help you build a small, cozy, town. Exposed wooden beams and painted brick walls come in a few different shapes so you can make more than just square buildings. Give the town’s buildings all red shingle roofs to keep the look consistent, or help your players easily spot item shops with blue or black shingles in a sea of red roofs. Snowy and blue-toned tiles are perfect for chilly mountain towns and for showing the changing seasons in your game, perhaps offering your players unique cutscenes or quests when they visit their hometown in winter!

A character sprite sheet for wooden doors is ready to let your heroes into their homes or the village’s shops (need some interiors? Then pick up the Fantasy Dreamland - Town Pack!). If you need a hometown village for your adventure to start in or want to visit some snowy mountain towns, check out the Fantasy Dreamland - Village Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902910/RPG_Maker_MZ__Time_Elements__Character_Expansion_1/

Build your heroes from the ground up with the Time Elements - Character Expansion 1 pack! Finalbossblues is back with another pack in their incredible pixel art style, this time adding new outfits, faces, hairstyles, weapons, and more so you can make the character in your head a reality. This pack includes each piece in multiple colors so you can build your perfect character in an art program, or use the included generator to create your hero and see how they will move before you make their character sheet!

Start creating your hero by choosing their head: will they have a scar through one eye and wear an eyepatch, or do you want a skull-like head for an undead hero? Once you have their head picked, give them a short and spiky haircut or a swirl of bangs and long, loose, locks, and decide if you want to top their new haircut with a crown, metal helmet, or pointy mage’s hat. Mix and match tops and bottoms to make armored wizards, suit-wearing bards, and even buff topless orcs! Finish up your adventurer with a backpack to carry all their supplies and a new sword, ax, or wand to make sure they can take on any monster they face. Then you can export your new hero and add them to your favorite engine, and they’ll be ready to walk, climb, jump, and attack in your game!

This pack also includes 5 premade characters with all of the animations ready to go and a selection of cloaked figures who could be helpful sages that teach your heroes new skills or sinister cultists who plan to summon the demon lord! So if you already own the first Time Elements character pack and want to make even more characters or you need some spooky skeleton and overpowered orc party members to join the team, pick up the Time Elements - Character Expansion 1 pack!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Luxury Hotel and Casino Tileset, A Long Goodbye Song Pack
notes.notes:
A new tileset for high rollers from Kokoro Reflections! A new music pack to bring your scenes to life from Ayato Sound Create!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844200/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Luxury_Hotel_and_Casino_Tileset/

Help your heroes relax after a day of dungeon exploration with the KR Luxury Hotel and Casino Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another interior tileset, this time offering golden autotiles and gilded furniture to build opulent casinos and hotel rooms. Let your heroes try their luck with slot machines, test their skills at poker and roulette tables, and get some sleep after a few hours of minigames with this pack!

A1, A2, and A4 tiles along with 2 B sheets (and some extra couches for all your lounge needs) are ready to help you build blackjack parlors with round gilded inlays on the floor and large windows let light in so people know when they’ve spent all day at the tables. Build a nice hotel with red curtains and large chandeliers that hang over each room’s huge tub, and have a black-topped bar with a variety of drinks and meals available to order. And if your game takes place in a modern setting? Don’t forget to include an ATM or two and some security cameras so that your heroes know no funny business is allowed! This pack also includes double doors with spirals of gold and a spout of water for a fountain to add some extra decadence in the casino’s lobby. Pick up the KR Luxury Hotel and Casino Tileset and give your heroes a nice place to rest and somewhere to spend all their extra gold!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844220/RPG_Maker_MZ__A_Long_Goodbye/

Give your modern game some electronic beats with A Long Goodbye! Ayato Sound Create is back with another music pack, this time with 19 BGMs to fill your maps with interesting music and help the emotions in your cutscenes really sink in. Electronic beeps and stings play alongside string and percussion instruments to create tracks that can perfectly fit modern and sci-fi games, or grab a few of these tunes to add a new element to your fantasy game’s magical realm.

Start your players’ adventures with the uplifting strings of ‘Newday’, or let them know right away that things aren’t going well in this world with ‘Hand’s dark electronic hum and screeching metal-on-metal beats. Send them wandering down busy market streets with the thrum of ‘Colors’ pushing them to explore and find secrets, or help them relax in a safe hotel with ‘Kindness’s muted beats and lovely piano melody. Let a pervasive whine weaving between the beats of ‘Simmer’ highlight a character throwing away reason to make a grab for more power, or use it to reveal that there is something very, very, wrong with the seemingly inoffensive office building. When it’s finally time to say a heartfelt farewell to your players, let the touching piano melody and bubbly chimes of ‘Long Goodbye’ help you convey it.

Each track comes in M4a, MP3, and Ogg files formats so you can drop them right into your current project and keep on game making without any worries. Pick up A Long Goodbye today and add notes of melancholy to your somber scenes and up the intensity during a face-off with a longtime foe!

Fill the royal library with pillars holding up the different floors of bookshelves and cabinets of scrolls, and spend some time sitting in a pile of colorful pillows and reading ancient rumors. Hold meetings with party members in restaurants where the tables are separated with wooden screens and potted plants, or visit an underground shop where broken pots and a spilled bag of gold are the only things visible to get your hands on dangerous magical items.

Create an accent wall with a rich red and gold pattern in a living room filled with couches and small tables to place the residents’ wine glasses on, or use the hole autotile to turn a house into a dungeon where your players need to pay extra close attention to where they walk. Add framed paintings and golden beams to walls that need some extra attention, or cover up any boring walls with opulent arched windows or cabinets!

This pack also includes fancy double doors and single doors so you can keep players out of certain rooms (at least until they find the key) and keep the outside world from messing up an excellent party. If your game takes place in the 1920s or you need to make a mansion that’s fit for a murder mystery then pick up the KR Art Deco Interiors Tileset!

notes.title: New MZ Effekseer Animations! Two New Tilesets!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844140/RPG_Maker_MZ__MGC_Animations_Collection_Vol_2/

Give your druid some new nature-based animations and your villains some magic-powered moves with MGC Animations Collection Vol 2! ManuGamingCreations is back with another set of Effekseer animations for your MZ projects. 30 new animations cover a variety of themes, from powerful elemental strikes to mystical arcane attacks and buffs, so all of your heroes’ and foes’ skills can get some updated visuals! Give your priestess party member holy attacks filled with white and golden lights as they strike their targets, and let your time-traveling main character use 3 clock-based animations to rewind a battle or do extra damage during their turn. Battle mermaids that fling bursting balls of water and send geysers shooting upwards at your party and defeat them with lush green leaves that can slash foes and heal friends.

But what if your game is in a sci-fi or modern world? Don’t worry, this pack has some animations for you too! Let your heroes equip taser gloves that release a blast of electricity when they attack and protect themselves from enemies with a sphere of hexagonal shields. Enemies could release toxic purple and green bubbles when they attack, and if all else fails? Give your heroes some grenades and molotov cocktails that they can throw to blow up their enemies in a bright blast of flames and sparks! So if your game needs some more animations for battles or you just want to add more explosive flames to your cutscenes, check out MGC Animations Collection Vol 2!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844060/RPG_Maker_MZ__Plues_Cute_Fantasy_Worlds__Simple_Beginnings/

Give your game an adorable makeover with Plue's Cute Fantasy Worlds - Simple Beginnings! Plueschkatze is here with a brand new pixel art style so your MV/MZ games’ cute stories can have an equally cute tileset. Create a small thatch-roofed farming village for your heroine to grow up in, forests filled with cheery flowers and bushy bushes to explore, an inn and pub stuffed with wooden furniture and comfy beds, and more with this tileset pack!

A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 2 B sheets for exteriors and A2, A4, A5, and 3 B sheets for interiors are ready for you to build cozy villages and towns. Build wooden cabins and brick shops along stone roads for your heroes to visit, and make some small dirt paths that meander between wooden fences and flowerbeds that lead to secret clearings that are the perfect spot for a private date! Give your heroine a comfortable home to return to with cute wallpaper and a comfortable couch with pillows and blankets spread out on it, or make inns with simple beds and cupboards and a connected bathroom with all the necessities.

Also included are character sprites for wooden doors in multiple paint colors and openable chest, barrel, and crate sprites so your heroes can enter houses and ‘borrow’ supplies from a villager’s stock room. This pack also has project files for MV and MZ, just in case you want to see example maps and how each tile’s passability can be set. If your slice-of-life fantasy game needs an adorable aesthetic or you want a fresh pixel art look for your heroes to explore, check out Plue's Cute Fantasy Worlds - Simple Beginnings today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844100/RPG_Maker_MZ__Plues_Cute_Fantasy_Worlds__Magic_Days__Scary_Nights/

Embark on a spoopy adventure with Plue's Cute Fantasy Worlds - Magic Days & Scary Nights! Plueschkatze is back with another MV/MZ-sized tileset in her Cute Fantasy Worlds pixel art series, this time offering up Halloween-inspired and magical goodies to help you create interiors for your heroes to visit. Create pumpkin-filled parties, goth bedrooms, magical classrooms and shops, and even haunted crypts with this pack!

A2, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets offer up a variety of interior walls, floors, and furniture to help you tell your players about the room without words. Give your studious witch a room filled with piles of books next to her bed with a purple comforter and tarot cards spread across her wooden desk, while your busy witch has clothes scattered on her floor and the remnants of spells forming small piles of sparkles in the corners of her room. Have your players visit magical bookstores with shelves full of books and potions (remember to pay at the antique cash register!) and visit themed restaurants that have balloons and jack o’ lanterns as decorations! Learn new spells by attending classes at the magic academy filled with cauldrons, broomsticks, and crystal balls, or adventure into abandoned schools where the desks are all damaged or knocked over and a secret door leads to a bloody circle and stone coffins that are missing its inhabitants.

This pack also includes door character sprites in black, red-brown, and light yellow so your heroes can explore all the rooms you’ve made. Pick up Plue's Cute Fantasy Worlds - Magic Days & Scary Nights tileset today and make your magical world even more adorable!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Mystery Train Tileset, KR Spirit of France Tileset
notes.notes:
Two new tilesets from Kokoro Reflections!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2801360/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Mystery_Train_Tileset/

Send your heroes across continents in style with the KR Mystery Train Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with another transportation tileset, this time focusing on steam engine trains with large moving trains and art deco train car interiors! Replace a signpost fast-travel system with gorgeous trains, let your heroes enjoy a break from hiking all over the world with nice meals and soft beds, solve a murder mystery side quest before the train reaches its destination, and more with this pack!

A2, A4, B, and C sheet tiles are ready to help you create comfortable and opulent rooms for traveling! Rich brown wood and tan fabrics and paints can build nice rooms for your heroes to explore on their trip, and tiles such as place settings, beds, tubs, and decanters full of liquids can bring each room to life. Let your heroes sit on a couch with their luggage on a rack over their heads during a short traveling cutscene, or have your hero visit the restroom or a music car with a grand piano when a murder occurs! Even the railroad engineer can control the train in a comfortable chair while all of the dials and switches are laid out in front of them. And if your game takes place in a modern setting? Give them some flatscreens to read info on!

The character sprites are where this pack shines, with 12 train car images to help you build your perfect train! Put a powerful locomotive in the front with a coal car behind it to pull a bunch of passenger cars so your players can watch the train travel across maps, and have the doors on the passenger cars open so your heroes can get on and off the train easily. Also included are decorative wooden doors so your heroes can wander between rooms on the train, and large puffs of smoke so it's obvious when the train is about to leave. So if your murder mystery needs a contained location or you just love trains, pick up the KR Mystery Train Tileset today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2801350/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Spirit_of_France_Tileset/

Create a city full of love, art, and delicious foods with the KR Spirit of France Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with a tileset inspired by the styles and architecture of France with tall columns and arched doorways leading into bright and busy interiors. Have your heroes stop in bakeries for some healing items with unique buffs, wander hedge mazes to find lost children, visit art studios and cafes to learn new rumors, and even rent an apartment to start a new life in the beautiful city!

A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 3 B sheets are ready for you to use to create city blocks and shop interiors! Create tall buildings with shops and restaurants on the first floors with fabric overhangs over their doors and large glass windows, and set up living spaces above them with green shutters on their windows and small balconies where people can sit and watch the world pass by. Furnish homes with white furniture and a healthy selection of houseplants and make cafes with wrought iron tables and chairs and vintage-looking posters hanging on the wall.

This pack also includes character sprites for wooden and glass doors so your heroes can enter stores and buildings, and a flowing round fountain that can take its rightful place in the center of town square. Pick up the KR Spirit of France Tileset and create your own gorgeous town inspired by Paris or even just a section or your game’s major city filled with bright buildings and busy cafes.

notes.title: New: MT Tiny Tales Heroes - Rebellious Souls, Rogue Adventure 1000+ Icons Pack
notes.notes:
Add new heroes and enemies with a new MT Tiny Tales Heroes pack! Give them tons of equipment, items, and more with the Rogue Adventure 1000+ Icons Pack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2801240/RPG_Maker_MZ__MT_Tiny_Tales_Heroes__Rebellious_Souls/

Create a party of unique heroes (or a team of intriguing enemies) with the MT Tiny Tales Heroes - Rebellious Souls pack! Mega Tiles’ latest Tiny Tales pack focuses on unusual characters to help fill your world with more than just humans! 8 new characters are ready to work with or against your party, with an Amazon barbarian powerhouse, blade-wielding Dark Elf duo, ancient Dragonian mage, Kitsune miko, and more!

Each character comes with a character sprite, faceset with 8 emotions, static enemy battler, and SV battler so they’re ready to jump into action! Start your players’ adventure as a male or female Dark Elf with long, flowing, gray hair and find teammates to help defeat the final boss. Maybe hiring a Tiefling rogue with a poisoned blade or a heavily armored Warforged with a sarcastic attitude will set your players on the right path, or let them challenge a muscular blonde Amazon and green female Orc to a test of strength to gain new party members. 

This pack also includes 12 weapon images so your heroes can have their own equipment in battle! Give your Amazon a massive ax or greatsword to swing at foes while your magic-wielding Dragonian girl uses a mystical gem or whip for when she runs out of MP. If your Tiny Tales game needs some new characters or you just want to finally make your dream game with a buff Orc woman as the lead with the MT Tiny Tales Heroes - Rebellious Souls pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2801250/RPG_Maker_MZ__Rogue_Adventure_1000_Icons_Pack/

Fill your players’ inventory with pixelated icons thanks to the Rogue Adventure 1000+ Icons Pack! Elv Games is back with an icon pack stuffed with weapons, armor, jewels, and tomes to help your players know exactly what each item and menu option means. With a limited palette and black outlines, each icon is easy to read so your players don’t need to waste any time choosing new equipment or the best potion to use! Give your hero a dagger with a simple icon at the start of the game and let them level up and buy newer, stronger, swords or even spears and axes depending on their fighting style. Party members that prefer to stay out of the line of fire can choose from magical staffs and bows, and everyone can make use of the armor options that cover their heads, shoulders, hands, and toes! Reward your players with gems and gold from battles, and gain access to new areas and new skills with keys and books.

Want to add some icons to your menu so your player can quickly tell which option is Save and which is Options? Then make use of the menu icons, with a house, bell, gear, wrench, and floppy disk to turn a boring menu into something that fits the rest of the game’s aesthetics! And if that wasn’t enough, this pack also includes an alternate version of the iconset with colored outlines and some different color choices so you can choose the perfect option. This pack includes iconsets sized for both Ace and MV/MZ, making it easy to add them into your favorite engine. So if your retro game needs some simpler icons or you want to include tons of equipment options, pick up the Rogue Adventure 1000+ Icons Pack!

notes.title: New DLC: Jewels Asset Pack 4K, Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Desert Exterior
notes.notes:
Travel the desert and uncover valuable gems with the latest two RPG Maker graphics packs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2801100/RPG_Maker_MZ__Jewels_Asset_Pack_4K/

Let your heroes gather all the jewels, gemstones, and glittering minerals they want with the Jewels 4k Asset Pack! 264 jewel images are ready to fill your nobles’ houses with rubies, sapphires, and emeralds, turn a simple mine dungeon into a spot for your heroes to locate rare mana crystals, and reward your players for solving challenging puzzles or side quests with gems carved into fun shapes like stars or hearts! 24 different gemstone cuts mean you can mix and match your jewel items to keep things fresh, or set up a minigame where your players can cut raw jewels they find into specific shapes that can be equipped to buff certain traits! Have your mage’s magic attack get a boost from holding oval, royal, and teardrop jewels while your tank’s defense is buffed thanks to rectangular shield-like shapes like emerald, radiant, and baguette cuts. 11 different colors for each shape makes it easy to create red rubies, green emeralds, and purple amethysts, or match the colors to a specific dungeon or stat!

Each image comes in a number of sizes so you can use them as icons, tiles, and pictures. Give your Ace projects some new shinies with 24x24 pixel icons, your MV/MZ projects 48x48 pixel crystal tiles that your heroes can stumble upon, and let your players get a close-up view of a gem that they just picked up with a 300x300 pixel picture. Want to choose the perfect size for your game’s screen size? Then grab the 4K 2160x2160 pixel original size and resize it however you want! If you’ve been wanting to add more item images for gems to your game or need some extra bling for your jewelry crafting minigame, check out the Jewels 4k Asset Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2801140/RPG_Maker_MZ__Winlu_Fantasy_Tileset__Desert_Exterior/

Explore towns built around oases and expanses of heat and sand with the Winlu Desert Exterior pack! Winlu is back with another tileset for MV and MZ, this time focusing on lots and lots of sand and on stone, clay, and fabrics that can turn an empty desert into a livable town. A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 5 B sheets are ready for you to create desert maps with abandoned watchtowers scattered between sand-covered roads and cacti, bustling merchant cities with statues guarding the gates and pots filled with food tucked behind pillows where your heroes can rest, and even rocky cliffs that lead to forgotten mines and partially buried pyramids! Fill the livelier towns with bright fabrics and lush plants between opulent towers and carved edges on flat roofs while smaller villages focus more on survival with simpler walls and windows, and workspaces for blacksmiths and travelers.

Also included are 20 character sheets for objects to add more movement and details to your maps. Have cloth city banners flutter in a slight breeze while the wooden sign above the inn swings back and forth while an event-based clump of trees and large rounded roof nestle between and above all of the other tiles in the map. Fabric and wooden doors are ready to let your heroes into shops, or keep them out if they’re not supposed to be there yet. Need a magical way to enter a dungeon? Have your heroes unlock a mystical door to enter a desert cavern or stumble upon a snake made of sand that can open its mouth to reveal a set of stairs! Pick up the Winlu Desert Exterior pack today and give your heroes an incredible new city in the center of a desert to explore!

notes.title: New DLC: Another World Heroine Generator 4 for MZ, KR Fortress Ruins Tileset
notes.notes:
Another Another World Heroine Generator pack + a new Fortress Ruins tileset from Kokoro Reflections!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743210/RPG_Maker_MZ__Another_World_Heroine_Generator_4_for_MZ/

Create powerful bunny girls and uniform-wearing mages with the Another World Heroine Generator 4 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft’s latest MZ generator pack includes 40 pieces to add new features to your female characters. 20 Clothing options are ready to give your characters some lightweight fabric to wear no matter their class! Give your brawler heroine a bright yellow jacket to distract foes from her fingerless glove punches and thigh high boot roundhouse kicks, while your sorceress wears a decorated pointy hat and robes with flowing sleeves warded with spells to help keep her safe in battle. Modern games can make use of a pantsuit and off-the-shoulder dress, along with a number of uniforms that could fit either a modern or magical academy. Even non-combat characters can enjoy these outfits, give your nurse NPC a lab coat over a dress and have uniforms with a few differences such as gloves or tights so you can keep a company or military group cohesive without having to have everyone dressed completely the same.

5 AccB, 5 Eyes, 5 Front hair, and 5 Rear Hair options can help you show some of your character’s personalities through their appearance. Give your kindest characters soft eyes, or mess with expectations by having the meanest party member have the largest and brightest eyes. Have your by-the-book military woman wear her hair in a short bob with bangs that are also kept perfectly maintained, while the wild archer on the team keeps her hair long and loose with plenty of flyaways. Top your character with a small tilted cap or a beret, or give them a witch’s hat, bunny ears, or a large tiara-type crown to highlight their magic abilities. So if you want more choices for your heroines’ outfits and hairstyles, check out the Another World Heroine Generator 4 for MZ pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743230/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Fortress_Ruins_Tileset/

Explore destroyed castles and forts that were defeated by evil forces with the KR Fortress Ruins Tileset! Kokoro Reflections finished their KR Royal Fortress Tileset and decided that clean and happy castles aren’t the only places your heroes will visit: ruins and war-torn castles are also popular locations! So they turned the bright and cheery tileset into desaturated and destroyed tiles to help you tell the story you want with your maps!

A1, A2, A4, A5, and 3 B sheets are ready for you to make dark and mysterious ruins. Have your players make their way past dead trees and purple poisoned waters until they find an overgrown path surrounded by collapsed stone walls and follow it to an abandoned castle where crumbling roofs and cobwebs show that it’s been years since someone last visited. Or create a demolished version of a fort they visited earlier in the game that they were unable to save from the demon lord. Cupboards falling to pieces and rusting metal pans show how long it’s been since people lived there, while musty beds with the blankets haphazardly thrown aside and rotten food still on plates can help your players realize that this castle was abandoned without warning.

This pack also includes 6 character sprites for large entrance doors, wooden and cell doors, flames, levers, and treasure chests to reward your players for finding their way through destroyed halls and locked rooms. Pick up the KR Fortress Ruins Tileset and create ruins that your hero can slowly repair to turn into their own home, abandoned castles overrun with monsters, military forts for important story cutscenes to goad your players into becoming heroes, and more!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Mage's Tower Tileset, Potions Assets 4K
notes.notes:
Have your players explore a massive arcane monolith with the new KR Mage's Tower Tileset, and reward them with tons of new bubbling freshly brewed potions with Potions Assets 4K!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743190/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Mages_Tower_Tileset/

Build quirky buildings and crystal-topped towers for your mystical mentors with the KR Mage’s Tower Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has donned their pointy hats and magic robes to create interiors and exteriors of towers that any mage would be happy to call home. A1, A2, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets offer up a variety of beige and purple walls and decor to create cool towers. Diagonal and rounded stone walls can be used to make unique towers topped with conical wood roofs and castle-like buildings with angled walls and flat roofs where teleportation magic circles could be placed. Fill your wizard’s rooms with bookshelves overflowing with books and magical knicknacks, and give them a work room where floating crystals and glowing potion pots take up most of the space!

6 wooden door sprites give you choices for if it’s light or dark beyond the doorway and 3 openable objects can take the place of huge treasure chests to reward your heroes for checking every crate and barrel. For a more magical touch to your maps, use this pack’s included books and scrolls that can open and unroll by themselves. Or leave them for your heroes to open and read for hints and tricks! So if your magical heroes need a new place to call home or you want your wizard’s guild to have cool towers as their bases in every city, check out the KR Mage’s Tower Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743200/RPG_Maker_MZ__Potions_Asset_Pack_4K/

Fill your game with interesting potions thanks to the Potions Assets 4K pack! Give your game’s weak HP potions and strong HP potions their own style of bottles so players can easily tell which is which with a quick glance, and use different colors to denote what each potion does. 10 unique glass bottle shapes, including straight-sided jars, volumetric flasks, orb-shaped bottles, and milk bottles offer up an empty version and 13 colors of liquids make it easy to create tons of battle-ready potions. Let your heroes heal themselves with a bright red HP potion and save the light blue MP potion for an emergency, and have them discover a concentrated HP potion with a deeper red that can be used on the entire team later in the game! Bottles with black, orange, purple, and prismatic liquids could be used to poison foes or buff a party member's attack stat.

As if that wasn’t enough, each potion bottle comes in an open, corked, and corked and tagged version, meaning this pack has a whopping 420 potion images! Have your merchant sell tagged potions for double the price of open ones, or add in a sidequest where your heroes learn how to make their own potions in open and empty bottles. This pack also includes resized versions of each potion so you can use them as icons or even tiles! Use the 24x24 pixel versions as Ace-sized icons or the enormous 2160x2160 pixel images to resize to perfectly fit your game’s screen size. Check out the Potions Assets 4K pack today and give your alchemy games more visual options and let your RPG heroes go shopping for all the potions they need for battles!

See below for the detail of the update.

[list]
[*] Added Feature to Display Logo at Game Startup: You can now toggle the display of a splash screen in 'System 1' settings. The image \img\system\Splash.png will be referenced for this feature.
[*] If you are adding this to an existing project, please prepare your own Splash.png, or you can copy and use the Splash.png that is generated when creating a new project."
[*] Improved 'Show Picture' and 'Move Picture' QuickSettings: Now displays X, Y coordinates and allows direct input for these settings.
[*] Added Function to Move Pictures with Arrow Keys in Quick Settings: When using 'Show Picture' and 'Move Picture', you can now move the picture using arrow keys. Holding the Shift key moves the picture to the nearest grid, and holding the Ctrl key moves it by one pixel at a time.
[*] Added Zoom Feature for 'Direct Designation' in 'Transfer Player' and Similar Commands: You can now zoom in and out when selecting locations directly.
[*] Added 'ID' Search Option in Map List: You can now search maps by their ID.
[*] Improved Plugin Parameters to Remember Folded State: The folded state of plugin parameters will now be remembered.
[*] Disabled Message Wait During Event Fast-Forward: While holding down the confirm key to fast-forward events, the message wait is now disabled.
[*] Improved Loading Time for Plugins with Numerous Parameters: Reduced the time it takes to open and close plugins that store many parameters.
[*] Added Fullscreen Support Plugin StartUpFullScreen.js (dlc\BasicResources\plugins\launch).
[*] Added Plugin NovelMessageMZ.js for Fullscreen Message Windows (dlc\BasicResources\plugins\launch).
[*] Updated Plugins AltMenuScreen2MZ.js, BattleVoiceMZ.js, ChangeEquipOnBattleMZ.js, TinyGetInfoWndMZ.js (dlc\BasicResources\plugins\launch).
[*] Added Semi-Transparent Water Tileset Materials 'Dungeon_A1_2.png', 'Inside_A1_2.png', 'Outside_A1_2.png', 'World_A1_2.png' (\dlc\BasicResources\tilesets).
[*] Fixed Dot Art Issue with Outside_B.png (Trees).
[*] Improved UI and Wording of Notification Settings for Better Clarity.
[*] Fixed Issue Where Battle Logs Display Incorrect Text After All Enemies Are Defeated and 'Force Battle Action' Targets an Enemy.
[*] Fixed Preview Position Discrepancy in Quick Settings When Picture Origin is Set to 'Center' and Width or Height is Negative.
[*] Fixed Issue Where Characters Don't Become Semi-Transparent When Changing Bush Attributes in Tilesets and Placing Auto-Tiles in Specific Shapes.
[*] Fixed Issue in Database Animation Screen Where 'Align Bottom' Checkbox Gets Unchecked After Certain Actions.
[*] (Mac Only) Fixed Continuous Loading Issue After Pressing Tab Key Following Tab Switch in Certain Windows.
[*] (Windows Only) Fixed Inconsistencies in Navigation with Tab Key and Shift+Tab Key in Certain Windows.
[/list]
Special Thanks:Sasuke KANNAZUKI, triacontane

Update on Jan. 17:
Since "StartUpFullScreen.js" was the MV version, it has been updated to the correct file (dlc\BasicResources\plugins\launch).

notes.title: New DLC: Doomsday SFX, Heroine Character Generator 9 for MZ
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743140/RPG_Maker_MZ__Doomsday_SFX/

BEEP-BEEP-BEEP-BEEP! That’s the sound effect alarm, letting you know the Doomsday SFX is out! Joel Steudler is here with a massive pack of 350 sound effects to fill your modern and post-apocalyptic games with the sounds of life or the echoes of life, depending on if your hero can find anyone else still alive. Let your players know they’ve found useful items after rustling around in plastic bags, unscrewing jars, and even shoving ceramic pots aside with sounds instead of messages! Add the crunch of glass and clatter of metal under your hero’s boots when they search abandoned buildings and give equipping jeans a proper zipper SE. Fill your battles with the sounds of shotgun blasts, rifle shots, and submachine bursts, or try to skip battles by messing with computers and machines that have all sorts of sounds: powering on and off, engines starting and idling, error alerts, and pinging sensors!

Making a fantasy game? Don’t overlook this pack! Besides the sounds of cloth and GUI boops that could fit anywhere, a number of the non-machine sounds can find a perfect home in your world. Give the inn’s busy kitchen the random sounds of clanging pots and pans and the creak of wooden floors, or have a suit of armor start to move with its screeching metal scraping along the ground. Static could replace your background music after a loud explosion messes with your party’s hearing and archers can always use more bow ‘twangs’ and mages can use flamethrower SEs for their fire spells! Each track comes in M4a and Ogg audio formats so you can easily drop them into your MV/MZ project, or use them in your favorite engine! Give your game all the clunks, bangs, gunshots, and electronic beeps it needs with the Doomsday SFX pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743170/RPG_Maker_MZ__Heroine_Character_Generator_9_for_MZ/

Fill your party with magical maids, towering angelic knights, lab coat-wearing alchemists, and more with the Heroine Character Generator 9 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft’s latest generator pack offers up 47 female parts to help your party members and important NPCs stand out from background characters. Give your punk heroine two-tone hair and a dark coat to wear while your Edo-inspired NPCs dress in gorgeous kimonos.

This pack includes 5 AccA, 5 AccB, 20 Clothing, 5 Eyes, 5 Front Hair, 5 Rear Hair, 1 Facial Mark, and 1 Glasses parts to give your character designs some updates! Create a straight-haired heroine who starts the game as a maid or shopkeeper’s assistant wearing a simple apron over a dress, and who ditches her uniform for a fiery red dress and cape combo or gilded white armor with a matching headdress to match her fighting style. Give your witch party member a dark and spiky cloak or a dress decorated in stars depending on her powers, and have your isekai-ed heroine with long twin-tails keep her more modern and comfortable dress instead of wearing one of the fantastical outfits.

Add even more fantasy to your world with Jiangshi-inspired robes with long sleeves and a talisman attached to a hat, and feathered wings that come out of your heroine’s temples! Smaller pieces like painted face stripes and glasses can add that last detail your heroine has been missing. If you’ve been wanting more options for dresses and detailed robes and some eye-catching accessories, pick up the Heroine Character Generator 9 for MZ pack!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Transportation Station - Airport Tileset, KR Snow Country Tileset
notes.notes:
Two more packs from Kokoro Reflections. Hop on a plane to visit the snowy countryisde!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2711930/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Transportation_Station__Airport_Tileset/

Frequent fliers, it’s time to get to your gate with the KR Transportation Station - Airport Tileset! Kokoro Reflections knows that the easiest way to explore a modern game world is by flying, and this MV/MZ tileset is ready to take off! A1, A2, and A4 tiles can build your buildings and landing strips while 4 B sheets are stuffed with all you could need to make an airport. Let your heroes wait in so, so, many lines to get through security, grab some treats while waiting to get on their plane at a snack bar, and even check out the cockpit 1,000 miles in the air!

Interior and exterior tiles are ready to turn a simple “and then they flew to the next location” cutscene into a full side quest with interesting interactions and rewards! Have your heroes dodge scattered luggage and ignore signage as they sneak up stairs to reach a waiting helicopter, or have them trudge their way through meandering posts and red rope barriers to meet up with a party member who has some important information about the big bad.

This pack also comes with 8 parallax images of the sky with varying clouds, so you could make a full scene while your hero sits uncomfortably in their coach seat! 18 character sprites, including planes and helicopters, are perfect for adding that needed motion to your busy airports. Let your hero watch planes taxi before taking off as they race up moving escalators and through turnstiles to try to make it to their plan on time, and let them just barely make it onboard before the aircraft door seals shut! Send your players on a wild adventure or let them make their own adventure inside a busy transportation hub with the KR Transportation Station - Airport Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2711940/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Snow_Country_Tileset/

Enjoy a winter wonderland retreat or rescue a town from a frozen nightmare with the KR Snow Country Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is sticking with the winter theme for another MV/MZ tileset, this time with a bunch of details to help you build a rustic town deep in your world’s snowy lands! A1, A2, A3, A4, and A5 tiles are ready to help you build snow-covered cliffs and icy grounds that can lead to near-freezing waters, and 4 B sheets have tons of frosted tiles to build a fitting village. Create a hunter’s hideaway cabin deep in a snowy forest, a relaxed village set near the icy sea, frozen caverns, and more with this pack!

Icicles hang from trees, rock formations, and wooden beams to help sell the frigid temperatures of the area, so make sure your heroes are prepared before sending them to the snowy villages! Diagonal walls turn boxy caves into meandering ice mazes or use them under angled roofs to give the town’s houses a unique look. Rustic wooden furniture and fur-lined sleeping bags can be used by the villagers to take a break from the chilly air outside or decorate an igloo where your heroes can rest and recover while out in the field! And when it’s time to get a better look at the area, send your heroes up snowy stairs to visit the top of a frozen lighthouse!

This pack also character sprites for a frosty wooden door and twirling light for the lighthouse so that your heroes can always find their way back to the village even in the dark. Create cute villages filled with igloos and icy towns deep in the mountains with the KR Snow Country Tileset!

notes.title: New DLC: Four New Tilesets from Kokoro Reflections!
notes.notes:
Four new amazing tilesets from Kokoro Reflections!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2711920/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Dark_Academia_Library_Tileset/

Create fitting libraries for ancient schools and castles with the KR Dark Academia Library Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another incredible tileset, this time offering up carved shelves, subtly decorated tile floors, and all the small books and knick knacks that make it so you can almost smell the dusty scent of old books! A2, A4, and 3 B sheets of tiles are ready to turn a boring room into a study hall full of warm brown wood and lit with candles in a large hanging chandelier. Create a maze of bookshelves where comfy armchairs are nestled in corners and surrounded by piles of books, or keep things organized by grouping bookcases with shared topics together and having the tables on a higher level that can be reached with side view staircases. If it’s feeling a little too stifling inside, make sure to add some large arched windows and potted plants to bring some nature indoors!

Of course, what’s a massive library without some secret passageways? Tuck a door behind a sliding bookcase that can only be opened by moving a nearby clock’s hour and minute hands, and lock powerful spellbooks in a safe. Animated books and scrolls can be placed on tables and desks for your heroes to peruse to their hearts’ delight! And if that wasn’t enough, a large book that can open and close could be used as a magical way to travel the world or act as a backdrop when your heroes read one of the hundreds of books in the library. Pick up the KR Dark Academia Library Tileset and start making some gorgeous rooms of wood, parchment, and mystery!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2711870/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Holy_Saints_Cathedral_Tileset/

Build an incredible church or gorgeous wedding venue for your heroes with the KR Holy Saints Cathedral Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has crafted interior and exterior tiles to build stone cathedrals from the ground up and fill them with holy statues and altars to ask the gods for buffs.

This pack’s A1, A2, A4, A5, and 3 B sheets offer a variety of textured floors and walls to fit the city the church exists in and bright and lush hedges and flowers to help connect people to nature. Give your farming village a smaller church made from stone blocks with simple wooden floors, with a single stained glass window overlooking its altar, while the royal city gets a huge cathedral topped with carved spires and walls of windows that stand behind an enormous organ! A fourth B sheet is also included, this one focusing on wedding details. Decorate an interior hall with white curtains and pristine white roses that surround a tiered cake, and keep the wedding party going outside with a decorated gazebo and lovely topiaries!

Enter the church through large wooden doors that rest under a stone arch, or skip the main entrance and go through the smaller carved doors around the back where your heroes may be able to find a white treasure chest filled with goodies. If your game needs some impressive places to revive defeated party members or you just love stained glass windows, make sure to check out the KR Holy Saints Cathedral Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2711910/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Royal_Fortress_Tileset/

Let your heroes visit an enormous castle to see the kingdom’s rulers with the KR Royal Fortress Tileset! Kokoro Reflections’ latest tileset is a crowning achievement: it’s everything you need to build a dramatic castle! Stone walls and floors and royal red carpets are ready to build throne rooms, bedrooms, dining rooms and kitchens, armories, and even a dirty dungeon! A1, A2, A4, and A5 tiles along with 2 B sheets cover interiors and exteriors so you can create your dream castle. Add rounded towers and diagonal walls to make your castle’s exterior less boxy and make sure the villain’s castle looks suitably evil with spikes on the roof and lava swirling around the castle instead of water. Decorate your castle halls with banners and suits of armor while your villain’s lair is full of dirt, decay, and even skeletons!

This pack also includes 6 character sprites to help build your castles! Have large wooden doors topped with gargoyles be the castle’s main entrance and simpler wooden doors act as the normal doors between rooms. Trap your heroes behind metal bar doors in the dungeons that can only be opened by pulling the lever on a nearby wall, or link red side view treasure chests to a lever so your heroes can’t rob the castle too easily! Build towering castles with decorated throne rooms and creepy dungeons with the KR Royal Fortress Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2711900/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Snow_Castle_Tileset/

Did you like the KR Royal Fortress Tileset, but need it to be in a wintery world? Then the KR Snow Castle Tileset is for you! Kokoro Reflections is aware that not every castle is in a warm location, so they’ve made a version that’s perfect for snow-covered mountains or games that have winter seasons while the story unfolds. A1, A2, A4, and A5 tiles as well as 2 B sheets for castles have all been coated in a soft blanket of snow and decorated with chilly icicles to let you build the perfect snow fortress. And if that wasn’t enough, each tileset comes in a ruined version so you can show your players what happens if they don’t stop the villain!

Make the castle of a fallen kingdom with destroyed walls and spiderwebs strewn across hallways and rooms, or create a single ruined tower where broken furniture is coated in the snow that falls through holes in the walls and ceilings. Have your heroes stumble upon a forgotten and ruined castle in the cold north, and let them slowly restore and revive it to become their home base, with bedrooms full of dressers and beds and an armory for holding all their weapons when they’re not off adventuring.

Of course, not everyone wants to sleep in a snowy bed or try to cook with an icy stove so a non-snow B sheet is also included! Character sprites for doors, fire, and treasure chests are also ready to reward any heroes to explore every room in the chilly castle. Pick up the KR Snow Castle Tileset and give your games some strong northern fortresses and frozen ruins!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Wizard's Hideout, KR Everyday Town, Another World Hero Generator 2
notes.notes:
Two new Tilesets from Kokoro Reflections plus a new set of geneator parts from Gee-kun-soft!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2711820/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Wizards_Hideout_Tileset/

Sneak away from the hustle and bustle of cities and dungeons for a short break to practice magic with the KR Wizard's Hideout Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has put on their wizard hat for this tileset pack, offering up mystical crystals and furniture to turn any room into a wizard’s home. A2, A4, and B tiles cover stone cave walls and floors, interior walls made of gray stone and decorated with shimmering crystal pillars, and all sorts of bits and bobs to fill a room with an air of magic.

Send your heroes into a cave where patches of grasses and moss slowly fade away as they go deeper and deeper, until only mushrooms and small shards of crystals sprout out from the ground and a worn path appears to lead to an arch topped with a large green and blue gem. Shelves stuffed with potion bottles, scientific equipment modified with magic, and scattered candles greet your heroes as they slowly creep through the doorway, revealing towering crystals of green, blue, and purple surrounding an intricate dais and a small bedroom area shoved into the corner.

Use these MV/MZ-sized tiles in your favorite engine to build crystal-filled caves or small alchemical labs tucked away in the corner of a dungeon if your game doesn’t include magic. Pick up the KR Wizard's Hideout Tileset and create magical bases where your heroes can learn new skills and find useful items, or create an evil wizard’s hideout tucked under an unknowing town!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2711840/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Everyday_Town_Tileset/

Create a comfortable village for your heroes to grow up in with the KR Everyday Town Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another tileset pack, this time inspired by calm and peaceful villages full of thatch roofs and private plots of crops. Show your hero’s childhood home full of homemade toys and delicious food, visit farms where corn, eggplants, and turnips are grown and sold as stat-boosting treats, and search ruined villages for clues to who summoned the monsters that destroyed it!

A1, A2, A4, and B-E sheets offer up warm and worn tiles to make your towns and villages feel lived in. Instead of gleaming metal or bright tile roofs, top your plaster or woven walls with straw thatch and let dirt paths weave between the buildings to lead your players to the main points of the village: the cozy inn, the busy farm shop, and the town square surrounded with flowers and trees. Each sheet comes with a ruined version for even more ways to tell a story in your game. Perhaps the ruined house on the outskirts of the village belonged to a cruel wizard who disappeared one day, or maybe the whole town ends up destroyed if your players don’t feel the urge to race back from their current quest to save the townsfolk from a monster attack.

Also included are character sprites for flames, openable boxes, and doors so you can let your players explore home interiors and reward them for their searching. This pack’s tiles are sized for MV and MZ, but you can use them in your favorite engine! So if you’ve been wanting to add more homey villages to your game or want to have an overarching story where your hero’s hometown is destroyed and then rebuilt, check out the KR Everyday Town Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2711790/RPG_Maker_MZ__Another_World_Hero_Generator_2_for_MZ/

Give your game some more male eye candy with Another World Hero Generator 2 for MZ! Gee-kun-soft is back with another male generator part pack for MZ to help your heroes dress for success! 1 AccA, 3 AccB, 20 Clothing, 5 Eyes, 5 Front Hair, 5 Rear Hair, and 1 pair of Wings add up to 40 male generator parts ready to turn your imagined hero into a real character!

Let your disguised prince keep a small part of his royal status stay with him with a thin, simple, circlet atop his head and give the captain of the guard a military cap to mark his status. Or have certain equipment affect the character’s sprite by adding an adventurer’s hat held in place with a belt to help keep your heroes cool under the hot sun while the circlet lets them enter royal chambers. Choose slicked back, spiky, hair for your energetic and snarky rogue while your wizard keeps his hair shoulder-length and his bangs long that frame his face to show off that no one gets close enough to cut even a single hair off his head.

This pack’s 20 Clothing options are perfect for swordsmen, mages, militias, thieves, and even dancers! Start your hero off with the right clothes for an adventure thanks to comfortable clothes protected with leather arm guards and a cape wrapped warmly around his shoulders or a bright red scarf to make sure everyone knows who the hero of this story is. Fighters and rogues can enjoy more freedom of movement with stretchy pants and jackets without a shirt underneath, and wizards can dress in multiple layers of robes or distract their foes by wearing a loose cloth around their waist and a decorative golden pauldron on one shoulder. Pick up Another World Hero Generator 2 for MZ today and give your male characters some great outfits to wear while saving the world!

notes.title: Announcing the Steam “RPG Maker Festival 2024”!
