notes.title: New DLC: Raven Fantasy Icons - 7000+, RPG Orchestral Essentials Music FX
notes.notes:
Thousands of icons and hundreds of music effects are here with todays two new releases!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670240/RPG_Maker_MZ__Raven_Fantasy_Icons__7000/

Fill your game with hundreds of items, skills, and states each with their own unique icon with the Raven Fantasy Icons - 7000+ pack! Clockwork Raven has crafted hundreds and hundreds of icons that cover just about everything your RPG could need, from status effects to skills, weapons to crafting components, and even menu and location icons! If you’re tired of RPG Maker’s default iconset and want some new pixel art to enjoy, this is the pack for you.

With well over 7,000 icons to choose from, it’s easy to be overwhelmed with this iconset which is why it’s organized into sections to make it easier to find what you need. Want some seed icons for a gardening side quest? Check the farming and food section. Need a variety of weapons like daggers, scythes, bows, and hammers so your players can choose what weapons each hero wields? Then jump to the weapon section! Give your mages elemental skills to throw fireballs, icicles, stones, and lightning at enemies while your warriors can have skills that coat their weapons in poisons or buff certain parts of their bodies like arms and legs for powerful punches and kicks! Or make a combat-less crafting game where mining and foraging for ingredients and crafting a bunch of potions to sell is the main mechanic.

Many of the icons include color variations so you can collect all 8 colorful diamonds to save the world or have levels of defense for armor made of different metals. Or just choose the colors you prefer and stick with those for a cohesive look in your menus! This iconset comes in 4 different sizes (16x16, 24x24, 32x32, and 64x64) so you can easily use them in your favorite engine. So if you’ve been wanting some new pixel art icons or need a lot of options for your equipment choices pick up the Raven Fantasy Icons - 7000+ pack today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670220/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Orchestral_Essentials_Music_FX/

Need some new MEs for your game, but don’t know what instrument would work best? Want to have a randomized selection of MEs for certain parts of your game so players don’t have to listen to the same jingle over and over? Then the Orchestral Essentials Music FX pack by Jonathan Shaw is for you! With a total of 700 MEs to choose from you can find the right sound for napping at an inn, failing a skill check, finishing a quest, stumbling across a hidden area, and more!

30 unique ME themes offer lots of options for different locations and situations. Let one of the light-hearted failure MEs play when your heroes guess the wrong answer to a child’s question, while a longer, lonelier, failure ME plays if they arrive too late to save a companion, or use different MEs if they’re in a forest dungeon or mountain region. Each ME theme comes in 11 instrument versions, including organs, music boxes, harps, and ensembles, so you can choose the right tone for each moment. Choose the twangy guitar version for energetic port cities and leave the piano or harpsichord versions for noble castle towns, or switch them up each time so your players are pleasantly surprised when they rest at any inn.

And if that wasn’t enough, each ME also comes in a ‘dry’ version without reverb and a ‘wet’ version with reverb so you can find the right sound for each scene. notes.title: New DLC: Fighter Plane Pack Vol.1, Gods of Yore Music Pack
notes.notes:
Two new packs for RPG Maker. Take to the skies with the Fighter Plane Pack, and go even higher with the Gods of Yore Music Pack! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670210/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fighter_Plane_Pack_Vol1/

Live your Top Gun dreams and battle fighter jets and choppers with Fighter Plane Pack Vol.1! Gee-kun-soft is back with another set of military-inspired vehicles, this time offering up 10 aircrafts with sleek shapes and ready to launch missiles. With static battlers, character sprites, and midair backgrounds for each vehicle, you’re ready to literally take your games to the next level, thousands of feet above the ground!

Battle streamlined fighter jets, armored dual-prop helicopters, sci-fi drone jets, and more with this pack. Each battler comes with 2 versions, one for in the air and one for on the ground, so you can use them for more than just battles! Have a cutscene show off a fighter jet resting on its landing gear before a sudden attack forces your players to jump into action, or have the helicopter’s blades stop when a powerful attack leaves it inoperable in battle. Let your players control a jet’s character to fly around for on-map combat, or have them plan out a safe trip while controlling a transport plane full of supplies passed enemy lines.

This pack also includes bonus images with each vehicle placed in its background ready to use as a cutscene picture! Show one of the hi-tech jets blasting lasers before your heroes’ base camp is destroyed, or after a poor choice force your players to watch the burning wreckage of a helicopter hang in the air for a moment before it plummets back to Earth. If you’ve been wanting to add some midair combat to your modern game or you need even more flying vehicles for your military story, pick up Fighter Plane Pack Vol.1!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670190/RPG_Maker_MZ__Gods_of_Yore_Music_Pack/

Get ready to lute and don’t trust a lyre with the Gods of Yore Music Pack! Joel Steudler is here with another batch of beautiful tracks, this time with 20 BGM inspired by both the myths and the music of ancient Greek, Roman, and Norse gods. Joel’s not alone this time, teaming up with skilled performer Nick Vest to bring the sounds of ancient lyres to life with actual instruments based on what could be found back then (and if you want to know more, the pack includes an information packet with details and pictures of each unique instrument). Battle the gods, explore hidden worlds, and take some time to visit the markets with this pack’s tracks!

This pack is split into battle, dungeon, theme, and town tracks, each with 5 songs to help each location stand out. Have hollow beats and plucked strings accompany your heroes as they travel down, down, down to Hades’ town with ‘Persephone’s Dread’, and march into a frozen maze of death with the chilly pipes and groaning strings of ‘Hel’s Domain’. Battle on open water with the horns and drums of ‘Neptune’s Trident’ cheering on your foes or let ‘Odin’s Hunt’ inspire your heroes with chanting voices and powerful drum beats. Rest well in towns with lyres strumming soothing tunes in ‘Frigga’s Hearth’ and learn what fate has in store for your heroes to the bass lyre and haunting pipes of ‘Charon’s Toll’.

Each track comes in M4a and Ogg file formats so you can easily add it to your current MV/MZ project, or use it in your favorite engine. Grab the Gods of Yore Music Pack today and give your dungeons and towns some incredible tunes fit for Mount Olympus and Asgard!

notes.title: New DLC: RPG Character Pack 11, Seraph Circle Crystal Portraiture
notes.notes:
Bring your characters to life with the new RPG Character Pack 11 and Seraph Circle Crystal Portraiture packs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670170/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Character_Pack_11/

Add new warriors, mages, priests, and even circus performers into your game with the RPG Character Pack 11! Gee-kun-soft is here with another set of MZ characters, this time offering 16 new options for 8 general classes each with a male and female option. Have your heroes be healed by a kind blue-haired priestess or black-haired priest who’s annoyed with how often he sees your heroes in this church, learn new spells from an old bearded sage, battle a sneaky (and shirtless) assassin, and more with this pack!

Each characters comes with a character sprite, MZ-style downed poses, a SV battler, faceset with 8 emotions, matching bust images, and 13 static enemy battlers with different color variations so you can face off against friends-turned-foes or gain new party members by defeating them in a battle of wits! Duel a tophat-wearing juggler to earn his respect and have him join the party with his bag of tricks, or chat with a cheery lilac-haired bunny girl to start a side quest to rescue her precious pet rabbit. Fill your team with muscular men like the sturdy martial artist and the serious warrior, or lean into youth with an ageless elf wizard cloaked in dark robes and a brunette adventurer who looks like he may have been pulled from a modern high school into a fantastical world!

This pack also includes high-res versions of each character’s art so you can scale it to perfectly for your game. Fill out your game’s roster and add some new NPCs to teach useful skills with the RPG Character Pack 11!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670140/RPG_Maker_MZ__Seraph_Circle_Crystal_Portraiture/

Give your players some gorgeous faces to look at when they’re talking to NPCs with Seraph Circle Crystal Portraiture! Jo Seraph is back with another faceset pack in their beautiful painted style, this time with neck up images of 24 unique characters. Facesets and pictures for each character let you choose whether you want to use faces in messages or busts in your game, and grayscale and negative versions can help you create the perfect cutscene. Create memorable moments with recurring NPCs such as a troublemaking man with wavy hair and a piercing near his eye and his friend with a bowl cut, a thin-faced woman with hair tied in a bun and her pigtail wearing daughters, a brother/sister duo with curly hair and kind eyes.

Each character comes with 4 hair colors and 5 skin colors, leading to a whopping 576 different images to help you populate your world! Have your heroes buy equipment from a blonde man with a rounded face and infectious grin in one town, while a white-haired version runs the pub in a city across the world. Or have a redhead run every town’s inn but use a different face for each so that it seems like only redheads are allowed to own inns. As a bonus this pack also includes legacy portraits of Jo Seraph’s older works, with even more character facesets in a more anime/cartoon style, so you can choose the right style to fit your game’s aesthetic. Pick up Seraph Circle Crystal Portraiture today and give your NPCs incredible glow-ups!

notes.title: New DLC: The Story of Pixels - Monster Pack, Gothic Blue Halloween Party
notes.notes:
Two more new packs to Steam for this week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2623930/RPG_Maker_MZ__The_Story_of_Pixels__Monster_Pack/

Battle new painted foes with The Story of Pixels - Monster Pack! SourceByte is back with another pack, this time giving you some new enemies in their unique style for your heroes to fight. 8 different creatures have their own character sprite, static enemy battler, and face image so you can create full storylines about them. Let your heroes try to diffuse the situation by talking with an upset green-scaled lizardman before fighting them, or have the spear-wielding lizardman talk to your heroes after they defeat him and share secret skills to strengthen your warriors. Or have lumbering and furry yetis stomp around the mountains while your heroes have to sneak past them to avoid causing an avalanche!

Spooky scary skeletons and rotting zombies can wander your graveyards and ruined cities, or have them hang out in undead bars and offer unsolicited advice to your lost heroes. Battle hulking orcs and wolves with glowing red eyes in forests, and give your dungeons powerful bosses with a flaming volcano creature and an enchanting vampire woman! Each enemy image comes in 3 sizes (big, normal, and sized for MV/MZ) so you can choose the best size for your game or use the different sizes to create boss versions of each monster. So if you’ve been wanting to battle some snake-tailed lizardmen or need some more monstrous sprites to help flesh your world out, pick up The Story of Pixels - Monster Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2623920/RPG_Maker_MZ__Gothic_Blue_Halloween_Party/

Set up haunted parties and creepy mansions with Gothic Blue Halloween Party! Aqua has created a MV/MZ tileset pack to help you create Victorian-inspired interiors that are ready for either a party or for kids to explore after getting dared to enter the town’s “haunted house”. 2 A2, 2 A4, and 2 B sheets offer up floors, walls, and living room furniture perfect for making the scene of a murder mystery or a cheery party after a long day of schoolwork. Set bright orange and purple couches in the center of a room with windows that reveal night is approaching, but don’t let that stop the party! Have your players enjoy colorful drinks from a witch’s cauldron and snack on candies from glass jars while they talk with other partygoers, or have them look at the fake spiderwebs and neon decorations in the corners of the room to avoid their bully.

If your game requires a creepier setting, then skip the Halloween decorations and go straight for the dark and grim gothic blue tileset, where rich blue fabric stands out from the cold black stained wood and tiles. Perhaps a vampire lives there and enjoys the aesthetics they grew up with or maybe the mansion belongs to a writer who just loves macabre decorations. Mix the tilesets together to make a dark mansion with pops of color coming only from forgotten jack o’ lanterns and hanging cobwebs. Pick up the Gothic Blue Halloween Party pack today and make the spoopy party maps of your dreams and the cool and creepy mansions of your nightmares!

notes.title: New: Cursed Kingdoms Monster Pack 2, Cursed Kingdoms Boss Pack, Inanimateness
notes.notes:
Michael Galefire is back with two more Cursed Kingdoms packs, and ayato sound create is here with a brand new soundtrack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670080/RPG_Maker_MZ__Cursed_Kingdoms_Monster_Pack_2/

Battle the twisted creatures that call sludgy swamps and dark woods home with the Cursed Kingdoms Monster Pack 2! Michael Galefire’s latest static monster battler pack is here with 20 images to challenge your heroes with curved claws, ethereal flames, and spittle-covered fangs that could easily end someone if they’re not careful!

Teach your players to avoid bites whenever possible by having them fight a green-tinged wolf that can breathe poisonous gas or a snarling wolf with flames coating its tail and a mouth as hot as a furnace. Or have them learn quickly to always carry antidotes and potions with them when delving into dungeons where spike-covered mutated bears and decaying zombies are simply a warm up for a boss battle against an undead dragon! Create a creepy insect-based cave filled with pot-bellied bloodsuckers and armored worms bursting from the floor, where the final challenge is against an enormous spider queen and her armored servants that are an arachnophobes worst nightmare. 

Not even the forests are safe! Large dead trees could be living creatures in disguise, just waiting for an unlucky adventurer to stumble too close to its roots, and loose dirt on the path could hide and a buried monster that grabs its prey with clawed tentacles. Skull-headed aquatic creatures could dive during battles, changing to a different battler image, to avoid your players’ normal attacks and a heavily armored undead knight astride its undead mount is ready to teach your players’ to think before attacking a secret side boss. Grab the Cursed Kingdoms Monster Pack 2 if you’ve been wanting to add some extra darkness to your wild battles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670110/RPG_Maker_MZ__Cursed_Kingdoms_Boss_Pack/

Prepare your heroes, it’s time to face some horrific bosses with the Cursed Kingdoms Boss Pack! Michael Galefire is back with another static battler pack in his amazing painted style, this time focusing on hulking bosses to challenge your heroes. Battle an ax-wielding ogre with bonelike spikes stabbing up from his flesh and a shiny metal jaw attached to his head, or run from a demonic insect with its bloated body ready to explode in a burst of destructive energy!

7 unique battlers are ready to turn any dungeon into a tomb for surprised adventurers. Challenge cyborg-like liches with decaying armor and twisted limbs in graveyards to free trapped souls and defeat a black shelled alien that evolved from lobsters to stop the ocean from destroying a tranquil beach town. Or leave those bosses to another set of adventurers and focus on the true evils of the land: the Cthulhu-inspired Enslaved Headhunter and Umbral Terror! Purple tentacles squirm beneath glowing green eyes of these deadly foes, with the headhunter’s stained weapons ready to claim another trophy and the terror simply rising from the shadows to crush all who are foolish enough to challenge it.

Each battler comes in a high-res format so you can resize it to perfectly fit into your game, or leave it huge to strike fear into your tiny heroes! If you need some incredibly detailed monsters for important story beats or want to get some more graphics to flesh out your Cursed Kingdoms collection, pick up the Cursed Kingdoms Boss Pack today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670050/RPG_Maker_MZ__Inanimateness/

Need the right synth vibes for your cyberpunk game? Want some bops to turn your modern city into a lonely abyss or place forgotten by the rest of the world? Then pick up to Inanimateness! ayato sound create is back with another music pack with 21 BGMs to fill your game with the feeling of being the only one in the world left or the last hero when all the rest have been relegated to ancient myths. Explore dungeons to the sounds of mechanical beats and guitars, ponder what options your hero has left to a piano-heavy track, and let an almost western-style guitar guide your path when your hero enters a mostly deserted city while searching for a long-lost friend.

Instead of relying on slow and quiet melodies to make the tracks feel somber, this pack keeps solid beats and toe-tapping tunes going while mixing in deep echo-y effects or lonely instruments to give them the right emotion. Battle against enemies with heavy metal guitars roaring in your players’ ears, or turn that track on when your hero realizes that they only have a few minutes to escape a boobtrapped factory! And when it’s time to take a break, play one of the tracks that fills the void with echoing synth and subtle gongs just so your players don’t ever truly relax in such a strange world. Multiple audio file formats make it simple to use each track in your favorite engine. So if you want some new tunes to set the mood and make your players feel your hero’s loneliness, check out Inanimateness!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2623900/RPG_Maker_MZ__Shabby_Cottage/

Create a comfy home for your hero to grow up in and a happy little village with the Shabby Cottage Tiles pack! Aqua’s latest tileset pack may call itself ‘shabby’, but the quality is anything but! Create cozy homes that belong to grandmas with doily-style rugs and flower-pattern couches, childhood bedrooms with patchwork quilts and soft sunlight streaming through lattice windows, and even relaxed villages with cobblestone paths and vines crawling up wooden walls and patio railings with this pack!

A2, A4, A5, and 3 B sheets for interiors include wooden floors and wallpapered walls to help build a comfortable place to rest. Stoves and baskets for kitchens, tubs and towel holders for bathrooms, dressers and privacy screens for bedrooms, and chaise lounges and old-school radios for living rooms are just a few of the detailed tiles you can use to make each house a unique home! Premade sets such as a couch in front of a window and a vanity with curling vines make it even easier to create a gorgeous room without having to delve into parallaxing. A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 3 B sheets for exteriors let you take that comfy feeling from the home into the world! Wander down simple paths to the town cafe, where wicker furniture sits for you to drink some tea and enjoy the views of colorful pink and purple leaves from the magical trees.

This pack also includes door character sprites so you can make sure players can enter all those houses you’ve lovingly created! Wooden doors with rounded tops are a perfect addition to the adorable houses you’ll make with this pack. And if that wasn’t enough, this pack also includes the beta version of this pack, meaning you have another 13 sheets to mix and match with to give houses premade garden beds and other cute additions. So if you’ve been wanting a sweet home for your hero to return to or your cozy game needs some matching cozy maps, check out the Shabby Cottage Tiles pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2623890/RPG_Maker_MZ__Doomsday_Mad_Science_Music_Mini_Pack/

Set the stage for some spooky experiments with the Doomsday Mad Science Music Mini Pack! Joel Steudler is back with another music pack, this time focused on one thing: tracks that can turn a boring lab of white walls and metal tables into a creepy and dangerous place where neither scientists nor experiments are safe! 5 BGMs are ready to give your players a sense of unease, ranging from atmospheric electronic ringing to curious synth melodies to accompany your heroes when they enter a new town known for its less-than-legal labs. Explore abandoned buildings while echoey synth and lonely strings play, or use it to demonstrate just how empty a basement is… At least until your heroes find the hidden trapdoor that leads them into an all-new dungeon. Reveal who was behind the terrible experiments while a deep and dark tune plays in the background, with stings that send goosebumps racing down your heroes’ arms, or introduce the villain with quirky but concerning synths to put your heroes at ease before he strikes.

This pack also includes 1 SFX you can use as an ME to take a lab to another level of horrific. Slowly increase the SFX’s volume as your heroes approach a lab setup and let your players realize the bubbles and whimpers are coming from the creatures floating in glass containers, before they burst forth to attack! M4a and Ogg audio formats mean you can easily add these tracks to your current MV or MZ game, or use them in your favorite engine. Give your laboratories and science buildings some creepy tunes with the Doomsday Mad Science Music Mini Pack!

notes.title: New DLC: EVFX Shoot, Slash, & Strike
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2623850/RPG_Maker_MZ__EVFX_Shoot/

Give your bow-wielding rangers and gun-toting marksmen awesome animations to match their powerful skills with EVFX Shoot! Dreams Circle is back with a new addition to their Evolved Effects series, with 20 Effekseer animations focusing on projectiles! Give your archer some state-causing skills by shooting a heart that bursts into a shower of pink or aiming a noxious arrow coated in green and purple ooze and let your sniper aim carefully before sending a bullet straight into the enemy’s heart with this pack!

With 10 animations aimed at bows and 10 aimed at guns, your shooters are ready to take down any and all enemies. Defeat a lone monster with a spinning arrow to its body or three arrows shot in rapid succession, and take out a pack of beasts with multiple arrows shot at once or release hundreds of arrows into the air to rain down on all foes. Destroy robots in your sci-fi world with rapid-fire bullets and shotgun blasts that spread to cover the entire enemy, and give your gunners some heavy firepower by tossing a grenade and shooting it midair or throwing a hight-ech reflector to bounce the gunfire around to hit all sides of your foe.

Each animation comes with a complementary SE, giving you 20 thwips, thumps, and bangs to take your battles to the next level and add some extra details to your maps and cutscenes. This pack includes a demo project of all 20 animations, making it even easier to add them to your MZ project! Grab EVFX Shoot and let your long-range fighters have cool skills of their own!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2623780/RPG_Maker_MZ__EVFX_Slash/

Get ready to slice and dice your foes with EVFX Slash! Dreams Circle continues their Evolved Effects series with a new set of 20 Effekseer animations for attacks that involve blades. Have your swordswoman make your enemies bleed with a deep cut that leads to a splatter of red, your berserkers rip into foes with both clawed hands at once, your magic knight slam their sword into the ground to summon blades that slice through the ground towards the enemies, and more with this pack!

15 single-blade and 5 claw animations offer up an incredible variety for your skills so each can have its own unique style. Give your swordsman’s slash skill a speedy slice across the enemy’s torso while their chop skill causes an overhead swing of their sword that slams into the ground with violent force. Strike an enemy repeatedly with slashes that randomly cut them up and add in a magical element to it by carving a star into the target. Or surprise your foes with a long-range attack that launches a curved blade of energy at them and damage all of them at once by ripping at the ground below them with your claws and releasing an upwards blast of magic!

Also included are 20 SEs to match with each animation and a MZ demo project so you can see each animation in action and copy it right into your game so you can tweak it to perfectly fit your skills. If you’ve got heroes who use swords, claws, or anything with a blade attached, pick up EVFX Slash to give their awesome skills equally wicked animations!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2623820/RPG_Maker_MZ__EVFX_Strike/

Don’t leave your unarmed fighters out of the fun! Smash craters into the ground and snap bones with violent force with EVFX Strike! Dreams Circles next addition to their Evolved Effects series focuses on animations for punches and staff strikes with 20 shows of power. Turn punches from weak bops into earth-shattering booms and concuss enemies with dazzling slams with this pack’s bright bursts of animation!

5 staff attacks and 15 general strikes are ready to help you give your heroes interesting moves during battle. Help your mage out during combat with a flurry of jabs from their staff to keep an enemy away from them when their MP is low, and have your knight forgo their sword for an explosive slam of their fist into the ground to hit all nearby enemies. Or keep your foes on their toes when facing your party’s boxer, with his normal quick strikes hiding the fact that his ultimate move can cause them to explode from within after getting hit!

Each animation comes with its own unique sound effect, offering you 20 SEs new options for skills and cutscenes! And if that wasn’t enough, this pack also includes a MZ demo project with every animation ready to go. Pick up EVFX Strike and give your enemies the one-two punch with stunningly rendered animations!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Urban Decay Tileset, Doomsday Music Pack Vol 2
notes.notes:
The world isn't ending today... but it may have in your game! And this week we have two new packs that are perfect for building up your post apocalyptic setting!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2574220/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Urban_Decay_Tileset/

Explore destroyed cities and abandoned towns with the KR Urban Decay Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another modern tileset, but instead of shining glass and gleaming metals this pack focuses on the grime and destruction of a long abandoned city. With desaturated and ruined A1, A2, A3, A4, some A5 stairs, and 4 B sheets you can create city exteriors for your zombie-infested or post-apocalyptic stories. Have your hero wake up in a construction site where the machinery is damaged and partly buried in deep piles of dirt and trash with no memory of how they got there, or start the game by following faded road markings and rusted guard rails into a town that is known to be haunted. Explore playgrounds where the equipment is broken and wildflowers spring from the dirt, skyscrapers that have decayed and lost chunks of walls, and even neighborhoods with smashed windows and graffiti and cracks cover the walls with this pack!

This pack also includes 12 sets of doors, with bright and dark options so you can have sunlight and the sound of people streaming out rooms when you open rusted metal doors or give your players a sense of unease when a wooden basement door reveals only darkness and an ominous growl behind it. If your modern game takes place after a natural disaster or years after the zombie plague consumes the world, you need to pick up KR Urban Decay Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2574230/RPG_Maker_MZ__Doomsday_Music_Pack_Vol_2/

Joel Steudler is back with a sequel to his original Doomsday Music Pack, and the apocalypse has never sounded so good! First up we have 20 new musical tracks split evenly between Battle, Dungeon, Theme, and Town tracks to help you quickly find the right song to match your scene. Whether you want the relaxing sound of spanish guitar in the town track Enduring Settlements, or the oppressive beat of the drums in the battle track Weapons Free, you'll find the perfect track to drive the emotion of your post apocalyptic game.

But that's not all you get! There are also 5 variations of some of the theme tracks, including two instrumental versions, and 3 clean versions, to match up with the different vibes you might want. And we haven't even gotten around to talking about the 5 droning sound effects to fill out locations even when the music goes silent, or the 5 post apocalyptic radio ads! If you are making a game set after the fall, you owe it to yourself to check out this pack!

notes.title: New DLC: Classic Fantasy Music Pack Vol 3
notes.notes:
Murray is back with another entry into the Classic Fantasy Music series!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2574170/RPG_Maker_MZ__Classic_Fantasy_Music_Pack_Vol_3/

Fill out more of your game’s soundtrack with the spectacular tracks of Classic Fantasy Music Pack Vol 3! Murray Atkinson is back with another pack of music, this time with 13 BGMs ranging from angelic tunes that turns a forest pond into a mystical center of power to headbanging rock when your heroes face off against a monstrous boss! Seek out adventure to the strong drumbeats of ‘Soaring Skies’, explore mysterious locals to the creeping strings of ‘Spiralling Mysteries’, and wander familiar hometowns to ‘Daydreaming’s peaceful piano. Battle normal foes while encouraging tunes bounce around, and make sure your players know it’s time to get serious when the music shifts to the racing electric guitars of the boss theme.

And if those tracks aren’t classic enough for you, this pack also includes some public domain pieces remade to fit into your game! Have your heroes compete in a duel of wits while violins strum the recognizable tune of ‘Carmen Habanera’, or use it to set the mood during a noble’s grand party. Or create a cutscene where words aren’t needed with the haunting piano of ‘Satie - Trois gymnopedies’ playing as a beloved party member is laid to rest. If you’ve been wanting some classical-inspired tracks for certain cutscenes or just love Murray’s musical melodies, pick up Classic Fantasy Music Pack Vol 3 today!

notes.title: New DLC: Another World Heroine Generator DX for MZ, KR Grand Taiga Tileset
notes.notes:
More parts to make heroines and a whole new biome for them to explore with two new packs out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2531740/RPG_Maker_MZ__Another_World_Heroine_Generator_DX_for_MZ/

Fill your game with princesses and heroines with Another World Heroine Generator DX for MZ! Gee-kun-soft is back with another MZ generator pack, bringing you 79 new parts to help you make even more female characters. Create princesses decked out in gorgeous dresses or give your armor-wearing valkyrie a long flowing dress to help her sneak into a noble’s ball, let your party members wear their hair long and loose or tied up to stay out of the way of their powerful magic spells, and finish any outfit with a sparkling tiara!

20 Clothing options offer up a variety of dresses, from simple robes with lightweight shawls and dresses topped with a white apron to ornate ball gowns with fluffy skirts and frilly hems and party dresses with off-the-shoulder tops. Let your players choose which dress your heroine should wear to a party, with different styles leading to different conversation options, or have siblings all wear the same dress in various colors so your players can easily tell if they’ve found them all. 20 Front Hair and 20 Rear Hair options can help you find the perfect set of bangs for your party members, as well as new ways for them to tie their hair up. Give your close combat fighters looped braids or long hair pulled back into a braided bun while your mages can wear their hair in dangling twintails or completely loose and almost touching the ground. And this pack’s 14 AccB crowns and 5 Eyes are the perfect way to finish up your character’s design! So if you’ve been wanting to make a unique princess for your kingdom or want to give your female party members some new dresses and hairstyles, pick up Another World Heroine Generator DX for MZ today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2531730/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Grand_Taiga_Tileset/

Send your heroes on a grand Northern adventure with the KR Grand Taiga Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here to help you set up your campsites in lush evergreen forests or next to the gentle babbling of small waterfalls bouncing off rocks as they run down cliff faces. A1, A2, A3, A4, and 4 B sheets give you interior wood cabin resources as well as natural dirt, stone, and grass floors for your outside hikes. Let your heroes wander between towering pine trees on their way to a magical pond, or make them run between mossy boulders and patches of mushrooms to reach the safety of their campsite! Search for missing NPCs from a firewatch tower and collect clues in hunting lodges, or visit the nearby fishing pier for a break from monster fighting.

Also included in this pack are 21 character sprites to add more life to your maps and help your heroes get around river-filled areas. Flowing springs of water can turn a normal cliff face into a place to gain some healing water and large boulders with a mist around them can add some interest to large waterfalls. Kayaks and canoes are the perfect way to travel to new locations, or use them in cutscenes where two characters get to know each other better during summer camp. Animated doors and wooden boxes are ready to give your heroes a reason to explore, and a bright flame in the fire pit is a great way to end the day. Search for rare monsters that live near mountain springs or give your relaxed camping game some lovely and detailed maps with the KR Grand Taiga Tileset!

notes.title: New DLC: Winlu Fantasy Tilset - Overworld, KR Legendary Palaces - Fairy Tileset
notes.notes:
Two new tilesets! A superb Overworld tileset from Winlu! A spectacular Fairy Palace tileset from Kokoro Reflections! Both new today.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2531710/RPG_Maker_MZ__Winlu_Fantasy_Tileset__Overworld/

Give your heroes an incredible interactive world map to explore with Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Overworld! Winlu is back with another fantasy set, this time with a selection of tiles to build your perfect world map. Create sprawling desert regions that seamlessly shift into grassy plains, mountain ranges that separate chilly tundra from lands blackened by volcanoes, forests filled with trees that lead into poisonous swampwater, and more with this pack! Angled options for rivers and grounds make it easier to turn a blocky map into a gorgeous world, and separate tiles for single houses and trees mean you can place each exactly where you need them. Create campsites filled with tents, orc strongholds surrounded by wooden walls, and even an imposing demon lord tower hidden away in a rocky valley where the remains of the last bloody battle still stains the ground.

There’s more than just tiles in this pack though! 29 character sheets offer up tons of ways to add movement and life to your world map. Send fluffy white clouds floating across the screen while your heroes happily hike between towns, or make gray clouds gather and lightning slam into the ground when evil magic or bad weather occurs. Town and castle cities have snowy and ruined versions so you can have them change as time passes in the game, or turn a normal mountain into a volcano that is threatening the nearby village. Sail around swirling whirlpools in wooden ships or travel in style by riding a large dragon across the skies! So if you’ve been wanting to make a cool world map for your game or need to show major changes around the globe during the story, pick up Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Overworld today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2531720/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Fairy_Tileset/

Trick your players into thinking things will be easy with a bright and colorful dungeon level thanks to the KR Legendary Palaces Fairy Tileset! Kokoro Reflections’ latest addition to their Legendary Palaces dungeon series offers up shining butterfly wings and golden walls that perfectly reflect the brightness of tiny fairies. Create special altars where your heroes can receive new powers from the Fairy Queen, or turn a happy fairy castle into a deadly maze after your heroes try to steal a treasure from the throne room!

Create rooms with gold, pink, indigo, and black walls and floors that are the perfect backdrop for golden columns and iridescent wing designs. Help your players navigate the dungeon by marking different locations with their own colors, or add some extra magic to the palace by having the entire building shift colors depending on the time of day or mood of the ruler. Send your heroes scurrying up ladders and staircases to find the Fairy Queen’s throne room where golden statues surround the winged throne, or create pools of purple water for your heroes to drink from and recover all their health.

This pack also includes character sheets for large glowing crystals, smaller decorative fairy wings, and jewels that you could use as light sources or teleportation points while your heroes explore the palace, and a golden treasure chest you can fill with all sorts of treats (or tricks, depending on the fairies in your game). Whether fairies are friends or foes in your game, grab the KR Legendary Palaces Fairy Tileset to give them a fitting place to call home!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Fantasy Market - Grocery Tiles, KR Legendary Palaces - Medusa Tiles
notes.notes:
This week, we have a duo release of Kokoro Reflections packs! Stock up at the market before heading in to take down a Medusa in it's own castle!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2531700/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Fantasy_Market__Grocery_Tileset/

Help your heroes stock up on fresh fruits and veggies with the KR Fantasy Market - Grocery Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a set of tiles perfect for turning a simple marketplace with repeated food tiles on every shelf into a bustling market where each shop can have its own unique options for fruit, meat, and baked goods. Add tasty looking veggies to your cooking game, let your players run a butcher shop, or create a bakery where your heroes can grab a bite to eat for special buffs before heading out on an adventure!

A2 and A4 tile sheets offer up nice wood options to build any store interiors you’re lacking, and shelves set up as autotiles make it easy to set up shelves that are whatever size you want. Fill your newly installed shelves and tables with a variety of fruits and vegetables, from apples to daikon radishes and carrots to coconuts, perfect for showing off different village’s local specialities, or create a spice shop where bunches of fresh herbs and piles of colorful spices are waiting for your heroes to buy them to add bonuses to their cooked meals. Each good comes with a version that’s loose and one that’s on a tray or in a container, as well as many having differing amounts so you could show changes if your heroes buy a lot of mushrooms or if there is a shortage of chickens in the village that could lead to a side quest.

This pack also includes a flame character sheet so your NPCs can do some shopping at night, along with wooden doors and openable barrels and crates so your heroes can explore and find some useful goods without having to pay (just make sure they aren’t spotted by the shopkeeper!). So if your game is all about cooking or shopkeeping or you just want to make sure your NPCs can enjoy good food in any village, pick up the KR Fantasy Market - Grocery Tileset today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2531680/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Medusa_Tileset/

Make sure your hero has a mirrored shield at the ready when they dive into a new dungeon made with the KR Legendary Palaces - Medusa Tileset! Kokoro Reflections continues their palace series with one for the most recognizable gorgon, Medusa. Build mazes of teal and purple walls decorated with shining jewels and dark grayscale hallways where the only pops of color come from teal stains in the corners and your heroes. A1, A2, A4, A5, and a B tile sheet are ready to help you create a variety of rooms so you can easily make different areas look unique or create multiple mini gorgon dungeons that all have their own look while sharing a similar style.

Travel between areas using swirling magical rings or stick to the old-fashion way by placing ladders, bridge railings, and stairs decorated with teal and purple gems for your heroes to use to get around. Large statues of medusa and medusa’s head can mark important doorways, and place small snake statues along certain paths to help your players find useful equipment hidden away in treasure rooms. Ethereal blue and purple flame sprites can light the hallways and lead to treasure chests topped with large jewels or a deadly spike trap! Or forget the flames and use magical gems that slowly pulse with an internal glow to light up important rooms. Pick up the KR Legendary Palaces - Medusa Tileset and give your snake-haired boss the perfect lair!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Night Club Tileset, RPG Character Pack 10
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2531650/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Night_Club_Tileset/

Put your dancing shoes on and get ready for an exciting night of partying with the KR Night Club Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another modern tileset to help you create a bustling party location. Create sleek bars and neon-lit dance floors for your heroes to enjoy and build private booths for them to meet up in while an NPC band rocks out on the night club’s stage with this pack’s A2, A4, and 4 B sheets of tiles.

Dark floors and walls are the perfect base for an underground club, while the bright blue and pink neon options can add some cool pops of color. Lead your heroes to the bar first with its backlit shelves of cans and glasses for a drink and possibly an important hint, or send them towards the dance floor where the floor is covered in lights to let loose after a long day of work. Or have your hero work in the club itself, running the sound system from a room full of audio equipment and backup stereos! Make sure your players know where every door leads with neon letters that you can use to spell out whatever you want, or stick with premade options like ‘Bar’, ‘Dance’, and ‘Music’.

This pack also includes some character sprites to help light up the club. Have your heroes enter through glass doors and let their eyes adjust as pulsing lights and colorful spotlights sweep over the crowd, or draw your players’ eyes with a huge spinning disco ball right over the dance floor. If your modern game has been missing that all important dancing scene or you want to include a unique place to pick up side quests, check out the KR Night Club Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2531620/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Character_Pack_10/

Meet interesting military men and team up with powerful uniform-wearing women with the RPG Character Pack 10! Gee-kun-soft is at it again with this pack of 16 new characters, 8 women and 8 men all ready to jump onto the battlefield. Have your heroes take orders from a twin-tailed redhead or tall, no-nonsense, man, and battle alongside an experienced old man and a young long-haired prodigy, or have your players choose which character they want to play as!

Each character comes with a MZ-style sprite, downed frames, SV battlers, facesets with 8 different emotions, waist-up busts with 8 emotions, and even front view enemies in multiple colors so you could face a whole squad of foes! Battle against a cocky blue-haired man whose coat with epaulets is blowing in the wind and defeat him to force him to join your party, and purchase recovery items from a long-haired brunette who worries about how often your party comes to visit him. Make cutscenes where your hero sits down for meals with other female soldiers and talk about camp secrets, or turn the game into a murder mystery after your hero finds their bearded commanding officer dead in his office! This pack also includes bonus high-resolution images of each character so you can resize them to perfectly fit your game, or include their full body images in a character codex! Pick up the RPG Character Pack 10 and give your modern game some well-trained soldiers!

Add unique combat specialists to your game’s battlefields with the Soldier Character Pack 2! Gee-kun-soft is back with another set of 16 characters fit for modern combat. This pack focuses on specialized personnel whose skills are useful on and off the battlefield. Have a tired, no-nonsense, doctor share an office with the army’s colorful poison expert while making sure the 2 lightly armored assassins don’t get into a competition over who can steal the most state secrets! Or have the pack’s 2 snipers compare strategies while the grenade and flamethrower users discuss how to make the biggest boom, all while the older commanding officers groan at the increased paperwork on their desks.

Each character comes with a character sprite, faceset with 8 different emotions, enemy front view battlers, SV battlers, and bust images! And if that wasn’t enough, some of the characters come in variations where they’re wearing hats or helmets so that they’ll be ready no matter what comes at them. Have your commanding officer only wear her hat when in meetings, or give your pair of extraction experts helmets and eye protection when they’re in the middle of a dangerous mission! Most enemy battlers also come with effect versions, so you could switch out the image depending on what status they have or if they’re powering up. Let your players know they need to defend from a powerful attack when the animal handler’s dog disappears from their side, and that they should push to defeat the sniper quickly if the sniper’s glowing aim assist appears in front of them! So if your game has been begging for interesting party members or you just want to flesh out your modern platoons, pick up the Soldier Character Pack 2 today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2493810

Make sure your heroes bundle up before exploring the chilly maps made with the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Exterior Winter pack! Winlu’s pixel art style is visible here even if it’s buried under feet of snow in this icy pack of tiles! With A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets filled with tiles you’ll be able to make all sorts of snow-covered towns for your heroes to visit. Each tile matches Winlu’s previous exterior pack, but now snow drapes over almost every surface and icicles dangle from cool-toned wooden beams so you could make a town previously visited now besieged by an ice wizard’s curse! Show that work has been halted in the village with untouched whiteness covering all of the workbenches and the carts that were normally filled with bags of goods are now filled with snow instead, while the farm’s vegetables are all frost-tipped. Or use this pack to help show the passage of time as your game’s story progresses, with snowy angled roofs in the middle of winter and as spring approaches the bright greens of grasses appear from under the blanket of white.

Also included are 20 character sheets for doors, flames, treasure chests, and more to add more movement to your maps. Place swaying banners along the city walls to show who controls the area and light your paths with lamps and torches. Open cellar doors and pull levers to reveal hidden treasure chests, or keep the town map simple and mark each building that can be entered with a sign stating what type of shop is inside. If your game includes a story arc during winter or you just want to make a cool mountain down where the snow never melts, make sure to grab Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Exterior Winter!

notes.title: Time Machine - Digital Dreams Music Pack, Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Dungeon
notes.notes:
This week we look forward to a new pack by Winlu, "Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Dungeon", adding even more incredible tiles to your beautiful collections. Also, take a listen to the nostalgic, time bending vibes Joel Steudler's latest music pack has to offer with Time Machine - Digital Dreams Music Pack.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2493740

Revisit the 80s with incredible music thanks to Time Machine: Digital Dreams Music Pack! Joel Steudler is back with another installment of his Time Machine series, this time bringing us the sounds of digital synths that dominated the airwaves. Fill your game with 20 synthwave tracks to give it those nostalgic vibes it desperately needs or use them to build your own unique version of cyberpunk or scifi!

Broken into 4 main sections, this pack includes music for battles, dungeons, towns, and general themes so you can find the right track for any situation. Explore creepy lairs with echoey beats in the background and add some cautious curiosity to an abandoned doll factory with bouncy synths matched with long eerie wails. Give your game’s title screen a head bobbing tune with drums and cool synths with this pack’s namesake track or have it play anytime your players are hanging out in the arcade. Let your players enjoy your gorgeous city maps while listening to a calming track or choose one of the town tracks with a stronger drum beat to add a slight edge to the city, as if there’s more than meets the eye. And don’t forget to grab the energetic and darker battle tracks for whenever a punk jumps your players or a score has to be settled through a street race!

This pack’s M4a and Ogg file formats make it easy to add each track to your favorite engine, so what are you waiting for? Add both soothing and stimulating synth to your game with Time Machine: Digital Dreams Music Pack!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2493770

Send your heroes into creepy crypts and deadly mines with the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Dungeon pack! Winlu is back with their incredible pixel art style to offer up a new set of tiles perfect for creating monster-filled cave maps and maze-like cellars. A1, A2, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets are ready to be mixed and matched to make intriguing dungeons, like an underground jail where noxious green sewage separates areas or a simple mine that leads into an icy cavern filled with bright crystals. Place rickety wooden bridges around a map to let your heroes cross bottomless pits or limit their possible paths by having rock arches collapse once they walk on them. Add some nature to the dungeons with bioluminescent mushrooms, or show how only death exists in a crypt with scattered human bones. Whatever type of dungeons your game calls for, you will likely be able to make it with this pack!

This pack also includes 25 character sheets to help bring your maps and puzzles to life! Set the mood of the dungeon before your heroes even step into it by having the entrance be a glowing magical portal or a dark hole in the wall that’s shaped suspiciously like a skull. Dodge spike and flame traps that burst from the floor as your heroes search for treasure chests filled with gold and equipment, and make sure to check every odd-looking wall in case there’s a hidden doorway that could be revealed! And if you want to save your players from having to backtrack all the way to the start, use the included teleportation circle to send them to the entrance instantly. Pick up Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Dungeon today and give your game new areas to explore and secrets to find!

notes.notes:

notes.title: New DLC: Battle Tank Pack Vol1, KR Factory Tileset, Young Protagonist Voice Pack
notes.notes:
We've got tanks. We've got the factories to build them. And we even have a new protagonist voice that you could use to be a tank driver (or any other young protagonist for your game!). 3 New Resource Packs Out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448190/RPG_Maker_MZ__Battle_Tank_Pack_Vol1/

It’s time to roll out, with the help of the Battle Tank Pack Vol.1! Gee-kun-soft’s latest vehicle battler pack focuses on armored tanks that are ready to charge forward and take on the enemy forces. 10 different tanks offer options for combat, defense, and reconnaissance so your players can prepare for any battlefield situation. Each tank comes with a battler and character sprite so you can use them in and out of battles. Face off against armored 8-wheeled vehicles to gain some important intel, and drive anti-aircraft tanks topped with missiles and satellite tanks around the map to stop the enemy from making their way into the hero’s base. Fill your sci-fi games with high-tech tanks that shoot powerful blasts of lasers, and bring out the literal big guns with an enormous tank that travels on railroad tracks.

Also included are 10 background images to help set the scene. Introduce your players to a city with a view of the shining skyscrapers or the city’s main bridge lit up in the middle of the night, and have an empty field behind your characters when they stop on the side of a dirt road after a particularly challenging battle. And if that wasn’t enough, this pack also includes 83 bonus images of the tanks in action that are perfect for battle cut-ins and cutscenes, along with PSD files so you can tweak the tanks to perfectly fit your vision. So if you’ve been needing some extra vehicles for your military story or just love tanks, pick up the Battle Tank Pack Vol.1 today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448180/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Factory_Tileset/

Create a grimy warehouse where villains gather with the KR Factory Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with a set of tiles to help you create those creepy buildings your game calls for, filled with mysterious machines and offices where important clues were left behind by the villain. A1, A2, A4, and 4 B sheets cover a variety of gray and brown details to build a busy factory. Instead of water, the A1 sheet includes rolling conveyor belts that could move your heroes to new locations, and the A2 and A4 sheets include wooden, dirt, and metal options that could work for both interiors and exteriors just in case the factory area includes more than building to search. Dangling wires and small pipes can decorate walls in between warning signs while the larger equipment can be observed from high up on raised platforms. Have your heroes squeeze between large refineries and tanks containing who-knows-what as they make their way to the factory’s main office, where old notes tucked into shelves and computers still left on are waiting to be read.

This pack also includes character sheets for doors, levers, and valves so you can let your heroes unlock new routes the more they explore. Or use the smoke sprites to add to the atmosphere, blocking paths or billowing out of the tops of certain dangerous machines. Pick up the KR Factory Tileset and start building warehouses full of machine mazes and pipe puzzles for your heroes to solve!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408550/RPG_Maker_MZ__Young_Protagonist_Voice_Pack/

Make sure your hero isn’t a silent protagonist with the Young Protagonist Voice Pack! With a whopping 339 English voice clips to choose from, you can be sure that your hero has a line for any situation. The pack’s voice is perfect for an energetic older teen or young adult, so if your villager-turned-chosen-one has been lacking a voice then listen up! Add some hmms, sighs, cheers, and groans to your cutscenes to add some extra emotions, or have your hero speak up randomly while walking around a town when they see something cool. Have him let out a cheer when he levels up and groan a meek “how could it end like this” if he loses a fight. Start a fight with a brave “battle start” or “bring it on” shout, and include a pained grunt when your hero is hit with a particularly painful move during the fight. Or keep the SEs out of battles entirely and use them when he explores dungeons with “hyups” and grunts of exertion as he climbs vines and leaps across chasms to discover new treasures.

Each SE comes in mp3, m4a, ogg, and wav audio file formats, so it’s easy to add them into your favorite engine! Add some extra life to your hero with the Young Protagonist Voice Pack!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Legendary Palace - Dragon Tileset, RPG Character Pack 9
notes.notes:
New Heroines! New Dragon Palace Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448060/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Dragon_Tileset/

Explore scale-lined hallways and throne rooms filled with monuments to the strongest creature of all with the KR Legendary Palace - Dragon Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with another set of tiles ready for use in MV and MZ, this time focusing on dark grays and greens fit for an evil dragon lord. Send your players through maze-like hallways where one wrong step could send them falling into a spike pit, and let them search for gold hidden under large stone statues of dragons. This pack’s wall and ground autotiles offer simple concrete, detailed tiles, and even scales so you can make the perfect dragon-inspired dungeon. Maybe the palace was made by a dragon-worshiping cult that gathered dragon scales to line every surface, or the palace itself is located on an enormous dragon! Stone arches and sculpted wings can turn any normal map into a dragon fanatic’s dream room, and line important hallways with dragon statues and lanterns carved from green gemstones.

This pack also includes animated yellow-green and white flames to light the way and a small black treasure chest that could be tucked in corners of the dungeon to reward exploration. Create puzzles where your players need to change the color of flames to unlock doors or activate magic circles, or use the different sized flames as subtle hints about which rooms are more important or more dangerous while your players search for the throne room. Create a dangerous castle for your dragons to call home with the KR Legendary Palace - Dragon Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448080/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Character_Pack_9/

Add some new female fighters to your party’s roster with the RPG Character Pack 9! Gee-kun-soft’s latest character pack is here with 16 new female characters who are ready to rumble! Add a powerful redheaded wizard to your party to help your sword-wielding main character defeat new enemies, or let your players choose to play as a spunky twin-tailed adventurer when they start the game! Form a team with a lavender-haired fox girl fighter, a young warrior elf who wields a huge ax, and a dress-wearing mage to take on the demon lord, and let the pack’s other warriors and wizards act as NPCs who can teach your players new skills.

Each character comes with a MZ-style sprite and sv battler that are ready for battle, along with downed sprites so you can portray them as sleeping or wounded after a surprise attack. 8 different emotions fill their facesets so you can show them smiling when given a gift or upset after an especially challenging fight. And not only that, but each emotion is also shown on 8 bust images just in case your game doesn’t use smaller face images. But what if your game uses front-view enemies for battles and you want your players to battle the pink-haired archer after she reveals that she’s working for the demon lord? Don’t worry, since each character has 13 enemy images that include different emotions and recolors!

This pack also includes bonus high-res, full body art of each character so you can resize them to perfectly fit your game or appear in a codex so your players can read up on any characters that they’re interested in. If you’ve been searching for some interesting art to match your warrior or spellcaster characters or want to add memorable NPCs, check out the RPG Character Pack 9 today!

[h3]Update: Fantasy Dreamland Starter Pack[/h3]

Fantasy Dreamland Starter Pack has been updated. Update it in your projects through the DLC folder to get the new versions.
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: New DLC: Time Elements - Caves and Dungeons & Time Elements - Hometown Tileset
notes.notes:
It's time to add some more elements to the Time Elements series!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448050/RPG_Maker_MZ__Time_Elements__Caves_and_Dungeons/

Send your players underground to find rare gems with the Time Elements - Caves and Dungeons pack! Finalbossblue is back with another piece of the Time Elements series, this time offering up stone and earth walls that are perfect for any underground location. Let your players step into shallow caves where grass and roots fade into dirt and stones the deeper they go and have them stop to rest at a campfire next to an underground river, or let them follow wooden supports and mine tracks through a confusing maze of caves until they reach caverns filled with gold nuggets and shining crystals.

Make sure your players can see with some light character sheets with lanterns or flames that can be placed strategically around the caves, and have minecarts race along tracks in the mines that are still active. Or add some extra danger to a dungeon with trapdoors, spinning saw blades, and spikes from the floor! Just make sure to use some of the included levers so your players can turn those dangers off or open new paths so they can fully explore the area. And as if all that wasn’t enough, this pack also includes some mining animations set in 2 animation sheets! Give your players some exciting visuals when they mine with gemstones bursting out of the rocks, or have some fun with your battles by creating a skill where jewels are thrown at the enemies to distract them with shinies! Dive down deep into the earth and uncover abandoned mines and forgotten ruins with the Time Elements - Caves and Dungeons pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448040/RPG_Maker_MZ__Time_Elements__Hometown_Tileset/

Give your heroes a place to call home with the Time Elements - Hometown Tileset! Finalbossblue expands his Time Elements series with pixel art tiles to help you build a calm farming village and forest town filled with wooden walls and thatched roofs, the perfect place for your young heroes to spend their youth! A1, A2, A3, and A4 sheets are filled with ground and wall options for all your interior and exterior village needs, and specific A5 and B sheets for inside, outside, and around town contain tons of detailed tiles to make each map stand out. Follow hanging lanterns and signposts through a forest path lined with bushes and scruffy tufts of drying weeds to farmlands surrounded by low stone walls and guarded by pumpkin-headed scarecrows all the way to the town. Comfy beds and busy kitchens lie within brick inns topped with colorful tiles ready for your heroes to rest and recover, or visit the town square where villagers gather to gossip near the town’s well and stone statues of the goddesses in hopes of finding some side quests or important clues.

Don’t forget to add some extra details with 10 included character sheets! Place treasure chests around the town and in houses to reward your players for exploring, and let them open wooden doors that are different depending on who lives inside. Give your game some farming features with 8 plants like tomatoes, carrots, and pumpkins that your players can grow to sell or eat, each with 4 stages of growth. Or use the books with turning pages to show when your heroes are studying and gaining intelligence points instead of just fading out the screen. This pack’s resources come in three sizes so you can easily add them to your favorite engine. If you’ve been needing some tiles to make a relaxed village or have been wanting a new pixel art style to play with, pick up the Time Elements - Hometown Tileset today!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Mermaid City Tileset, RPG Character Pack 8
notes.notes:
Add a new underwater city with the latest pack from Kokoro Reflections! Add more princesses to your game with the latest RPG Character Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2446800/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Mermaid_City_Tileset/

It’s better down where it’s wetter, so make sure your heroes can enjoy visiting an underwater city with the KR Mermaid City Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back and splashing around in the water to find more inspiration for this new pack. Visit statue-filled town squares, gardens overflowing with kelp, enjoy the freshest fish at the local inn! A1, A2, A4, A5, and 6 B sheets are ready to help you create underwater exteriors and interiors with a mix of natural and merman-made objects. Place colorful coral next to tile paths and signs topped with blue gems, and surround statues of Triton with healthy patches of seagrass. Decorate house interiors with hanging nets and couches with carved shell backs, and make a nursery with kelp nests filled with eggs. And don’t forget to give your heroes a comfy bed and stone dressers when they book a room at the city’s inn!

The plant and rock sheets come in two variations, a bright version and a more muted blue version, so that you can choose the best option for your city. Perhaps a city near the beach has a sister city deep in an underwater trench, or the areas around the town change color depending on the time of day. Be careful once the sun goes down, strong monsters may be hiding behind blue-tinted rocks! If you want to give your players a unique underwater town to visit, or you already picked up the KR Deep Ocean and KR Legendary Palaces - Mermaids tilesets and want even more ocean options, pick up KR Mermaid City Tileset today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2446790/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Character_Pack_8/

Add more princesses to your game with the RPG Character Pack 8! Gee-kun-soft’s latest pack offers up more characters in their recognizable style, this time focusing on gown-wearing daughters of royalty. 16 unique characters are ready to reward your heroes for slaying monsters, rule while their fathers are ill, and even join the party to defeat the demon lord!

Each princess comes with a MZ-style character sprite, 3 downed poses, a faceset with 8 different emotions, waist-up bust pictures, enemy images, and a SV battler so they can appear all around your game. Have your players battle a lilac-haired princess who is a master of magic to learn new spells, or give your players the option to have a twin-tailed princess in a blue ball gown join the party while exploring dungeons! Learn secrets of the kingdom from the serious crown princess and take on a side quest to protect her short-haired younger sister while she travels the countryside assisting those in need. Or help a princess in a red dress collect ancient spell books only to find out that she’s working with the demon lord, turning what your players thought was an easy way to get quest rewards into a dangerous boss battle!

As a bonus this pack also includes high-res versions of each princess, so you can resize them to perfectly fit your game’s resolution or include an illustrated codex with information about everyone your players meet. Pick up the RPG Character Pack 8 today and fill your game with new plots based around princesses!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Modern Hospital Tileset, Big Icons Vol.2 - Buffs and Debuffs
notes.notes:
Two new resource packs: big icons to indicate the various status effects your character can have, and a hospital tileset to build a place to go to cure your characters of the negative ones!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408560/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Modern_Hospital_Tileset/

Give your doctor characters and injured heroes a place to call home with the KR Modern Hospital Tileset! Kokoro Reflections steps back into modern times with a pack full of technology and care-related objects to build a functional hospital in your game. A2, A3, A4, and 4 B sheets cover a variety of equipment to let you build an emergency room, operating theater, gym, bathroom, lab, children’s wing, and more!

Introduce your main character’s motivation through a cutscene in the MRI room where the equipment takes up most of the space or standing in front of the maternity ward where tiny cots line walls decorated with adorable animal decals. Or give your game a horror twist by sending your players down into the damp pipe-filled basements and into patient rooms where wheelchairs, gurneys, and IV stands create mazes to search for a missing person in the middle of the night. Even if your game doesn’t take place in a hospital, this pack still has things for you! An exterior B sheet offers up angled roofs, trees, and radio dishes to help you build a unique city, and bathroom and cafeteria tiles can be used in other places such as office buildings or even schools.

This pack also includes 9 character sheets covering ambulances, helicopters, doors, and valves to make sure your hospital is up to code! After losing a battle instead of making it a game over you could rush your injured heroes in a vehicle racing along roads or flying through the sky to the hospital, or have ambulances randomly stop in front of the hospital when your players are exploring the exterior map to make your game world seem more alive. So if your story takes place in a hospital or you want to let your players explore all sorts of buildings in your modern game, check out the KR Modern Hospital Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408540/RPG_Maker_MZ__Big_Icons_Vol2__Buffs_and_Debuffs/

Make sure your players know what’s going on with states in battles with the Big Icons Vol.2 - Buffs and Debuffs pack! Bis is back with another set of stylized icons to offer up more options for your game. Fill your battles with icons warning your players when enemies are powered up and invulnerable to magic, and let them know when it’s time for an all-out attack thanks to a buffed attack stat!

37 colorful icons cover a variety of stats and buffs to add to your battles. Make sure your players know when stats like attack, defense, and magic are buffed or debuffed with bright green or red arrows, and help them plan out when to use a thief’s steal skill to swipe a powerful relic thanks to buffed agility and luck. Commonly seen states like charmed, blind, and confusion each have their own icons to keep your players updated on how every party member is doing. Unique state icons like winged ankles for floating, a cutesy ghost for ghost-ified, and noxious green wavy lines for stinky give you even more ways to add fun and interesting systems. Maybe your heroes end up with the stinky state after a hard day of battling and going to bed stinky means they start the next day with a debuff, or maybe the ghost-ified state means they can visit the undead-only shop hidden in the town’s cemetery!

Want to use larger icons in your in-game guide or during cutscenes? Then use the included 1024x1024 pixel high resolution icons! Resize them to the perfect size for what you need, or have them fill the screen during a silly scene to make your players chuckle. Pick up Big Icons Vol.2 - Buffs and Debuffs today and give your states some new easy to understand icons!

notes.title: New DLC: Elemental Fury Animations Pack, Chiptune Adventures Music Pack
notes.notes:
Bring the full power of your elemental attacks to life with the Elemental Fury Animations Pack, or fill your retro-inspired game with fitting music with the Chiptune Adventures Music Pack, both new today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408530/RPG_Maker_MZ__Elemental_Fury_Animations_Pack/

Strike your foes with powerful new skills with the Elemental Fury Animations Pack! Bis’ latest animation pack offers up 32 animation sheets for the elements to give your skills some awesome new looks. Give your golem party member skill to fling rocks or send a burst of dirt up out of the ground to damage enemies, your mermaid bubbly water spells, and your volcanic spirit roaring fire attacks that are sure to leave burns!

Fire, water, earth, and air each have 8 different animations to give you choices for each spell. Blind your enemies with a spiral of small stones and dust with an earth spell or send spinning green blades of wind to knock them off balance thanks to a powerful wind spell. Use a variety of water spells to slam popping bubbles into your foes, trap them in a swirling torrent of water, and blast them with a high-pressure water spout, each with different possible effects. Or keep things simple and roast your enemies with the hot flames of a growing bonfire or a fiery explosion!

Worried about having to set up each animation? Well, worry no more because this pack includes the animation data files for Ace, MV, and MZ, meaning you can easily add them into your game and playtest right away! So if your mages need some new appearances for their spells or you want to make each elemental skill look as unique as their effects are, pick up the Elemental Fury Animations Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333630/RPG_Maker_MZ__Chiptune_Adventures_Music_Pack_by_Sonancy_Designs/

Fill your retro-inspired game with chipper tracks thanks to the Chiptune Adventures Music Pack! Sonancy Designs is back with more BGM to help you set the right mood in your game. 10 new electronic tracks cover character introductions, happy town soundtracks, exciting exploration of new locations, and even the final confrontation with the big bad!

Give your pixel art words some fitting chiptune tracks, from the happy-go-lucky beeps of a safe town to the fast-paced trills when your heroes face off a surprise boss fight! Send your heroes on their adventure with some pep in their step thanks to an upbeat overworld theme, and switch that track for one of the more nervous melodies when the heroes need to rush and save a kidnapped child. Battle while low beeps bounce around in the background, or take some time to recover the party’s health with happy chirps play. Overwhelm your heroes with a cacophony of racing beats when the final boss appears, and reward them with an excited and upbeat track when they manage to seal the final boss away and save the world!

Each track comes in multiple audio formats, making it easy to add these new tracks to your current game and favorite engine! Fill your dungeons and battles with energetic tracks today with the Chiptune Adventures Music Pack!
