notes.title: New DLC: 4 Rogue Adventure Tilesets!
notes.notes:
This week, we have 4 compatible tilesets all from one artist to build an entire game around! So let's head out on a rogue adventure!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408520/RPG_Maker_MZ__Rogue_Adventure__Graveyard_Tileset/

Seek out ancient treasures that were buried with their owners with the Rogue Adventure - Graveyard Tileset! ELV Games is back with another pixel art pack, focusing on dark and gloomy colors for your more serious games. Create spooky graveyards and damaged crypts with 2 A5 and 6 B sheets filled with stone walls, dark ground, fences, and marble above ground crypts! Choose from two different stone color options, pale gray marble for newer or well-maintained graveyards and muddy green stone for ancient crypts or areas taken over by evil spirits. Or mix them together on one map to show just how long a city has been using the same graveyard! Broken versions of tombstones could tell your players that the area was abandoned years ago, or let them help repair a village’s graveyard through sidequests and replace the broken tombstones with repaired ones as time passes.

Light up your maps with animated flames and candles with this pack’s characters. Keep your players on track when deep underground in stone crypts with lit candles nestled in alcoves and draw their attention to a message carved into stone with flickering flames. Or add some extra evilness to a dungeon with a fountain of blood! This pack also includes a BGM track with powerful drums and tip-toeing piano and strings to remind your players that they could come across some dangerous situations while exploring the crypts. Build creepy crypts and dangerous tombstone-covered hills with the Rogue Adventure - Graveyard Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408510/RPG_Maker_MZ__Rogue_Adventure__Jungle_Tileset/

Explore trap-filled temples and the wild wilderness with the Rogue Adventure - Jungle Tileset! ELV Games is here with another awesome pixel art pack, bringing to life lush forests and ancient stone temples for your heroes to find. 2 A5 and 10 B sheets are ready to make forests full of flowers and grasses, and pink and pale yellow stone temples that lead into vast underground labyrinths. Climb rough rock steps to reach meadows in the middle of the woods, or pause your explorations of the temple to rest inside rooms that from the look of it used to be bedrooms filled with cabinets and closets. Or reward your players with stat boosts from magical stones if they follow the trail of blue-leafed trees deep into the dangerous jungle.

Add some extra movement to your maps with animated flowers and grasses, and light up the area with stone pillars topped with flames. Help your players find healing plants by having the plant’s yellow or green flowers slowly sway, or let them know the area is breezy with tufts of grass blowing in the breeze. Animated traps can challenge your player’s skills if they choose to avoid battles in a dungeon, with three main traps to choose from: spikes shooting up from the floor, trapdoors that blend into the floor, and stone pillars that slam down from the ceiling! This pack also includes 1 BGM track with energetic strings to motivate your heroes to reach the final room in the forest temple. Create an important dungeon deep in the mystical grove with the Rogue Adventure - Jungle Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408500/RPG_Maker_MZ__Rogue_Adventure__Village_Tileset/

Let your heroes take a break in a small town with the Rogue Adventure - Village Tileset! ELV Games has made yet another pixel art pack, this time giving you options to make a relaxed village full of thatched-roof homes and shops stocked with just what your heroes need to conquer the next dungeon. 10 B sheets (5 interior and 5 exterior) come with pre-built buildings that you can mix and match to create towns full of unique wooden homes. Decorate them with windows, chimneys, and signs and place wooden benches and stone wells in an open area to give the small village its own town square. Fill NPC homes with beds, bookshelves, and cupboards so they can have comfortable lives, and give the town’s adventurer guild many tables and scattered papers for wannabe heroes to gather around while they plan out their next quest. Or create a locked treasure room filled with gold and jewels to tempt your players into using their thief’s burglary skills (just don’t get caught)!

3 sheets of animated objects are ready to reward your players for exploring and light their way when they reach the village in the middle of the night. Place treasure chests and boxes strategically inside and around homes to reward explorers, and let your players enter houses through simple wooden doors. Wooden torches and bowls of flames swinging from posts are perfect for marking important paths and buildings, or use the campfire to mark where your players can set up their tents and rest for the night. Don’t worry about your villages being too quiet, since this pack also comes with 1 BGM track that can lift the spirits of your heroes and the villagers while they wander the village. Give your heroes a place to rest and restock after they defeat monsters and clear dungeons with the Rogue Adventure - Village Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408490/RPG_Maker_MZ__Rogue_Adventure__Wastelands_Tileset/

Trudge through murky swamps and solve puzzles deep underground with the Rogue Adventure - Wastelands Tileset! ELV Games has created another pixel art pack for your retro-inspired games, offering up new tiles to help you make creepy badlands above and below ground. 2 A5 and 10 B sheets are here to turn empty maps into muddy and hilly wastelands where only scrub grass and mushrooms grow, and where your heroes can stumble across an entrance to a cavern filled with carved glyphs overflowing with magical power! Have your heroes explore areas where dead trees loom overhead and pools of blood can be found next to stone altars, or let them cross wooden bridges to reach treasure chests left high up on the top of a hill. 3 different stone colors can help make each of your region’s caves stand out, letting you use rich brown dirt for that sinkhole that opened up near the village’s farms and light gray stones for caves that your heroes can find while climbing mountains. Or use different colored stones to show that someone must have brought the rocks into the cave just to set up an important puzzle that guards a powerful treasure!

13 character sheets offer up a variety of animated objects to help take your maps to the next level. Flames can help light up caves, and glowing blue glyphs can reward your heroes with stat boosts, healing, or even just by guiding them onto the correct path to reach a gilded treasure chest. Or add some swaying weeds to your swamp maps to show that only the toughest things can survive there! 1 string-heavy BGM track is also included in this pack, ready to inspire your players with upbeat twangs and powerful drums while they try to solve challenging puzzles. Pick up the Rogue Adventure - Wastelands Tileset and add some new swamps and cave dungeons to your games!

notes.title: New DLC: Megan’s Despair
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379140/RPG_Maker_MZ__Megans_Despair/

Bring tears to your players’ eyes with Megan’s Despair! Richard John S’ latest music pack offers 20 beautifully haunting BGM tracks. All together this pack’s music hugs at your heartstrings and tells the story of a young woman’s struggle with loss and depression, creating a set of tracks that can help you tell a sorrowful sidestory throughout your game. Tie a knot in your players’ chests with violins that play worrisome chords when your hero is left along with their dark thoughts, or when they stumble upon the horrific end results of the villain’s plans. Soft piano tracks can brighten the darkest scenes with their clear notes, bringing a much-needed lightness to emotional scenes. Or use them to lull your players into a sense of security, before hitting them with a tear-inducing loss of a beloved party member all while violins wail in the background.

Certain tracks offer up choral singing alongside the soft orchestral notes, creating an ethereal experience when your hero returns to their hometown and visits their family’s graves to tell them about all of their adventures. Or use them when your hero finally lets go of a past mistake and does their best to move forward. Each track comes in multiple file formats, making it easy to add into your current project that needs an extra touch of heartfelt sorrow. Pick up Megan’s Despair today and fill your game’s saddest and most difficult scenes with melancholic pianos and violins to bring your hero’s desperate emotions to a crescendo.

notes.title: New DLC: Rinobers Futuristic Outlands, Time Machine - The Analog Age Music Pack
notes.notes:
Weird alien landscapes, and cool 80s synth tracks await you in this week's new packs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379130/RPG_Maker_MZ__Rinobers_Futuristic_Outlands/

Step out of the safety of the city and wade into alien environments with Rinobers Futuristic Outlands! Rinober is back with another tileset in his incredible painted style that brings familiar and foreign nature to life. 29 tilesets covering A1, A2, A4, A5, and B sheets offer up a huge variety of details to make each world unique and memorable as your heroes journey across the galaxy. Explore crystalline mountains in the hopes of finding rare minerals, venture to lands where a mix of low gravity and element-rich atmosphere forms floating rings instead of clouds, and interact with gooey aliens who live in fungal forests with this pack!

With recolors of pretty much every tile, you can easily make sister planets stand out by having purple mushrooms instead of brown, or add some variation to the ground and water depending on if it’s safe to walk on or if it can leak poison right through armored boots! Let your Earthlings rest while surrounded by familiar pine trees and flowers or mess with their minds by having familiar plants be taller than they’re used to, such as towering venus fly traps and gnarled thorny vines as thick as their torsos. This pack also includes character sprites for animals such as birds and stalk-eyed aliens, objects like bubbles and statues, and 16 unique humans alongside more than 100 human character sheet variations, enough to populate an entire planet!

And if that wasn’t enough, each character and tileset comes in two versions: one with black outlines and one with colored outlines! So choose which aesthetic perfectly fits your game or mix-and-match to get your maps looking just how you imagined them. Explore wild alien planets and learn why so many people stick to the sci-fi cities with Rinobers Futuristic Outlands!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379120/RPG_Maker_MZ__Time_Machine__The_Analog_Age_Music_Pack/

Give your 80s inspired game some fresh tracks with Time Machine - The Analog Age Music Pack! Joel Steudler is here with another excellent music pack, this time offering up 20 tracks that focus on the fun you can have with synths. Let your players jam out to electronic guitar riffs as they fight the Man, or have slow waveforms lull your heroes to sleep when they finally find a safe place to rest in the busy city. Dungeons, battles, towns, and general themes each get 5 tracks dedicated to them, so you can switch out songs before they get too repetitive or make sure each location has its own unique track.

Introduce your players to their party with the upbeat and quirky Childhood Memory or throw them straight into the action with the fast-paced beats of Mode Nine. Up the creepiness of an underground dungeon with the haunting whines and deep reverberations of Basement Door, or use it to scare your hero when he was a child and alone in the house at night! Time Machine’s strong beats could make for a great theme for the entire game, especially if certain cutscenes involve traveling through time and space. Or keep the game contained to a single city, where this pack’s 5 town tracks can help separate the busy business section from the seedy underbelly.

Each track comes in .m4a and looping .ogg file formats, making it easy to add new background tunes to your favorite game. Give your players some fitting music to listen to while they explore abandoned sci-fi factories or battle against punk biker gangs with Time Machine - The Analog Age Music Pack!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Spirit of Greece Tileset & Sacrifice of Vampire
notes.notes:
Include a new land inspired by Greece with a new Kokoro Reflections Tileset! Or find the perfect tracks for some blood sucking fiends with a new soundtrack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379100/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Spirit_of_Greece_Tileset/

Send your heroes to a terracotta-roofed village or back in time to a marble pantheon with KR Spirit of Greece! Kokoro Reflections is here with another tileset to help you make your world a little more varied with town tiles based on Greco-Roman architecture. Limestone-washed walls let you make bright white buildings that make the red terracotta roofs really pop. Angled red roofs mean you can prevent each home from being identical with a variety of building looks, or use the included marble domes to turn a mansion into a temple dedicated to the gods! Or use this pack’s red and white striped canopies and goods-filled wooden stalls to build a bustling marketplace for your heroes to pick up items and equipment before heading back out into the world.

Exteriors aren’t the only thing getting attention in this pack though! With a wide selection of lounge seats and details like sinks, books, musical instruments, and small dressers, you can easily add interiors for your heroes to rest and recover. Want to make an interesting forest around the town or turn a boring walk to the temple into a twisting path up a mountainside? Then make use of this pack’s B sheet of plants and cliffs to add interesting details to your exterior maps! Let patches of wildflowers sprout around the worn dirt path that snakes between trees as your heroes walk up inclined hills thanks to angled cliff tiles, or test their bravery by crossing a thin bridge of land high about water. 

This pack also includes animated sprites of flames, jets of water to turn any pond into a fancy fountain, a marble treasure chest, and stylish white doors! Create multi-layer landscapes with staggered cliffs and Greek-inspired cities with the KR Spirit of Greece pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379110/RPG_Maker_MZ__Sacrifice_of_Vampire/

What’s the best music for a dungeon full of blood-sucking fiends? If your answer is rock and metal, then the Sacrifice of Vampire pack is the pack for you! ayato sound create’s latest music pack contains 23 BGM tracks filled with powerful guitars, drums, and pianos to get your players’ hearts racing and put them in the right mood for battling dangerous demons. Send your hero spiraling alongside a racing piano when they find out about the secret to their lineage, have them explore an evil underworld to heavy metal guitars, and keep your players’ blood pumping in combat with exciting guitar riffs and heavy drum beats! 

Of course, not every second in your game will be high-energy and require powerful guitars and drums, which is why this pack also contains some slower tracks for those moments. Piano paired with slow electronic beats is perfect for when your main hero finds herself abandoned by her companions after a fight, or when she arrives in a town long forgotten. And when she is reunited with her friends, surging strings or choral cries could help set the scene before they finally face the final vampire lord.

Each BGM comes in a number of file formats, including m4a, mp3, wav, and looping ogg, so you can easily slide these tracks right into your current project! Fill your supernatural mansion with the sounds of organs and drums, and turn the battle against Dracula into an epic rock concert with the Sacrifice of Vampire!

notes.title: New DLC: Sci-Fi and Modern Tileset - Interior + Exterior
notes.notes:
Making a Sci-Fi game? Then this week of releases is for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2338350/RPG_Maker_MZ__SciFi_and_Modern_Tileset__Interior/

Give your sci-fi laboratories and modern apartments a new coat of paint with the Sci-Fi and Modern Tileset - Interior! This pack’s A1-A5 and B-E tileset sheets are filled to the brim with choices to help you build tons of rooms. Create an office kitchenette with basic counters on tiled flooring, fill a kid’s bedroom with stuffed animals and scattered schoolwork, or build a secret villain’s lair where they conduct devious experiments from the safety of their control panels!

Show off some of your NPCs’ personalities through small details like unlit candles and multiple cups of coffee on their desks or potted plants and pictures of nature in their homes. Or turn a lab’s closet into a makeshift rest spot for exhausted employees by adding bunk beds and an alarm clock so they can sneak catnaps on their breaks. 14 alternate sheets offer up even more choices, from recolored A sheets to reorganized B sheets so you can give each room its own personality without every interior needing its own tileset!

This pack also includes sprites for doors, lights, lasers, and even spacesuits so you can make sure your NPCs are safe in space! Give your high-tech labs some sturdy protective doors and your convenience stores sliding glass ones, or create a tricky dungeon with a rainbow of lasers to disable or find ways around. With tilesets sized for both Ace and MV/MZ, it’s easy to add right into your favorite engine. Pick up Sci-Fi and Modern Tileset - Interior today and give your shops, labs, and homes an upgrade!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2338340/RPG_Maker_MZ__SciFi_and_Modern_Tileset__Exterior/

Fill your cities with neon decorations and proper signage with the Sci-Fi and Modern Tileset - Exterior! This pack is stuffed with tiles, with full A1-A5 and B-E sheets ready to create incredible cities with waterways, colorful flower beds, and buildings built from stone and steel. 

Build a city center where skyscrapers with huge glass windows and topped with solar panels tower over a popup market filled with canopy tents and important supplies for your heroes to buy. If your players are lacking in money, you could direct them through a hole in a chain-link fence to explore the dark and trash-filled alleys hidden behind a train station. As if that wasn’t enough, 14 alternate sheets can help you make a bunch of towns without having each one look exactly the same! Create two rival towns with similar layouts but different color schemes, or grow a magical garden with bright crystals and colorful bio-engineered bushes!

This pack also includes animated sprites for doors, cars, traffic lights, and even moving sidewalks to add some movement to your maps! Make traveling around the map quick by letting your players jump into a car to race to the opposite side of the city, or force them to obey red lights (or let them jaywalk and have to avoid getting hit by speeding cars). And keep your NPCs safe from hay fever with masks that you can add to their sprites! Choose from 16 different colors, from plain white and black masks to striped and even rainbow-colored ones, to help disguise your heroes when they need to lay low. This pack comes sized for both Ace and MV/MZ, so what are you waiting for? Give your cities little details that really bring it to life with the Sci-Fi and Modern Tileset - Exterior!

notes.title: New DLC: Battleship Pack Vol.1, Doomsday Music Pack + Pack Updates
notes.notes:
Head to the seas to battle battle ships, or score your latest post apocalyptic games with our newest releases! In addition we have updates to three of our existing packs: Battle Girl characters Pack 1, Modern + Inner Basic Tiles MV, and the Fantasy Character Pack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333650/RPG_Maker_MZ__Battleship_Pack_Vol1/

Prepare for battle on the high seas with the Battleship Pack Vol1! Gee-kun-soft’s latest pack offers up 10 warships to populate your world’s oceans. Have your heroes face off against battleships boasting tons of missile launchers, prepare for battle on the deck of an aircraft carrier, or sneak into enemy territory with the help of a stolen high-tech submarine! With battlers, backgrounds, and characters, this pack is ready to make your maritime dreams come true!

Choose from recognizable modern vessels, like cruisers, battleships, and torpedo-shaped submarines, or jump into the near future with sleek armored ships ready to blast lasers at enemies. Each battleship also comes with matching character sprites, so your players can take control as they patrol the waters! Have your ship safely explore the oceans with the sprite with included waves, or put the ship in drydock after a difficult battle with the full sprite version. Or turn these water-based ships into futuristic spaceships, and fill your sci-fi epic with even more interesting ships!

This pack also includes bonus images of the ships in the backgrounds, great for cutscenes and setting the mood. 75 bonus images means you can choose from a variety of situations, from the ship simply floating through the water to a chaotic battle where every weapon is active and flames are damaging the ship’s hull! And if that wasn’t enough, this pack also includes PSD files for each ship, so you can create the perfect cutscene picture or have your battlers change depending on damage and what weapon they’re currently using. If you’ve been wanting to create a game with in-depth maritime combat, or just want to add some detailed establishing shots for your visual novel set on a ship, pick up the Battleship Pack Vol1 today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333640/RPG_Maker_MZ__Doomsday_Music_Pack/

Set the right scene for your post-apocalyptic game with the Doomsday Music Pack! Joel Steudler is back with 33 new tracks to help you bring your game to life! With a mix of BGMs, MEs, and BGSs, this pack is ready to turn an abandoned building into an irradiated nightmare, fill the silence of a lonely field with soft sounds of the wind, and give the gloomy town bar a lounge singer!

This pack’s tracks are broken into sections, so it’s easy to find one that fits what you need. Need some guitar riffs and drums for a fight against outlaws? Then check the Battle tracks. Want to make the hairs on the back of your player’s neck stand up while exploring an underground train station? Then pick from the Atmosphere or Dungeon sections, or use a mix of both to maximize the effect! Play a spooky Dungeon BGM with the crackle of a radiation leak BGS to make sure your players know they really don’t want to spend too much time lollygagging! Town and Theme tracks lean towards military brass and drums or somber piano tunes, since only the strong and the lucky have survived the end of the world…

Break up the songs on your game’s radio with 5 different ads for in-game items. After all, everybody needs a personal combat razor and preservatory hair tonic! Each track comes with a seamlessly looping OGG file, so you don’t have to worry about odd moments of silence while your players are exploring the lonely wastelands. Find fitting tracks for the fallout after the end of the world with the Doomsday Music Pack!

notes.title: Four official DLC releases with unique characters, tiles, and more!
notes.notes:
Four official DLCs produced by Sloppy Joe Studios are out this week!

The "Pixel Pack 1 Characters - Faces - Tilesets" is a pack of fantasy worlds. Included are monsters such as minotaurs, swines, giants, and hippos, as well as tilesets to build a whole new game with vivid colors. In addition, graphic materials such as easy-to-use icons and battle backgrounds are also included.

notes.title: New DLC: Fantasy Character Pack, KR Spirit of Egypt Tileset, RE-D MUSIC PACK 5
notes.notes:
15 New Male Characters! A New Egyptian Tiles! A New RE-D Music Pack! All out now for RPG Maker.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333620/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Character_Pack/

Create new friends and foes with the Fantasy Character Pack! Gee-kun-soft’s latest pack brings you 15 new male characters to add to your game, each with unique outfits and designs to make them stand out compared to regular NPCs. Fill your game with armored samurai, powerful beastmen, and well-dressed men often found in fantasy worlds like kings and vampires! Each character comes with sprites, facesets, enemy images, SV battlers, and waist-up busts, so you can easily use them as important NPCs, loyal teammates, or tricky villains depending on how your story goes. Each enemy comes in multiple color variations along with effect versions with powerful magic swirling around them to warn your players just how dangerous the fight will be!

Team up with an eagle beastman, a green-scaled dragon knight, and a prince-like lion to take on an overbearing mammoth warrior and gray werewolf bent on taking over the world, or play as one of them to defeat the crowned human king and his heavily armored lancer and hoplite knights. Or have your players play as the villain by controlling a horned demon dressed in a loose kimono who can summon demonic eyes to strengthen his attacks, and battle against armored samurai for control of the country!

As a bonus, this pack also includes high-res full body versions of each character that you can use in status menus or resize for important cutscenes. Give your game’s guys some cool new looks with the help of the Fantasy Character Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333600/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Sprit_of_Egypt_Tileset/

Explore sandstone tombs and deserts protected by statues of deities with the KR Spirit of Egypt Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with another desert-themed tileset, this time focusing on tiles that can build gilded pyramid interiors and the simple towns that sprung up around those impressive dungeons. Make varied ground for your heroes to walk on to keep from having to look at the same sand tile over and over with different colors of sand, packed earth, rocks that were uncovered by warm wind, and even man-made stone paths. Rubble and scruffy grass autotiles can turn a town into an abandoned location, or block certain areas of the map with the stone fence autotile. And a full B sheet of desert plants is perfect for adding subtle signs of life to an otherwise lonely wasteland, or use them to mark the way to a royal pyramid.

This pack includes a huge stone sphinx that can draw the eye to the center of a village or act as the entrance to a deep underground dungeon, that is equal parts beautiful and deadly. Golden statues of animal-headed gods are ready to line the hallways of the tomb, where bottomless pits and spikes stabbing up from the floor are the least of the dangers. Let your heroes wander past carved wall art and under archways as they search for the throne room filled with skeletons and treasure chests, or have them take a break in the shadows of a grand pyramid before their adventure continues. Pick up the KR Spirit of Egypt Tileset and create new desert maps for your players to enjoy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333610/RPG_Maker_MZ__RED_MUSIC_PACK_5/

Prepare for combat on the high seas or far in the starry skies with RE-D MUSIC PACK 5! Gee-kun-soft is back with another set of excellent orchestral tracks, bringing you 10 new BGMs to choose from. Strings, horns, and drums build off each other to create tunes that leave you feeling small compared to the vastness of the world around you, as if it’s just your hero and their crew in the middle of an ocean or the darkness of space. Let your heroes forge ahead with blaring horns urging them forward, or warn them that time is limited with quick, insistent violins punctuated with heavy drums.

Keep the energy up with the rat-a-tat of drums and choral chanting as your heroes fight off an attack from a powerful foe, or have it playing in the background while they race to escape their floundering ship after a surprise attack blows a hole in the hull! And when there’s nothing they can do to win, let one of this pack’s slower tracks play as your heroes are forced to watch the villain succeed in sinking their ship or taking over the kingdom’s castle. But not all is lost! Let your heroes use that loss to strengthen their resolve and work hard to gather new companions while powerful drums and horns play in the background, and win the last battle to the sounds of spirited trumpets!

Each track comes in multiple audio formats, making it easy to add these to your current project no matter the engine. So if you’ve been searching for some music to fill your ship’s corridors and add some dramatic orchestral tunes to cutscenes, check out RE-D MUSIC PACK 5!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Sun and Moon, KR Untamed Desert, atmosphere
notes.notes:
This week, we have two new tilesets from Kokoro Reflections, and a brand new soundtrack from ayato sound create!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2297910/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Untamed_Desert_Tileset/

Give your players sun-touched deserts to explore that are more than just the same sand tile over and over with the KR Untamed Desert Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a pack filled with desert-themed tiles to turn boring flat wastelands into unique locations to explore. Have your heroes follow a trickle of water through yellow sand until it reveals a lush hidden oasis where an energetic trading town has sprung up from the ground, with wooden stalls and cooling awnings standing between stone and stucco buildings. If the desert is simply an area for your heroes to train while they search for the next story beat, then create an inn where they can rest and recover in small rooms decorated with shelves and potted cacti.

Make the wilderness more interesting to explore with a full B sheet of plants and cacti, marking the way towards an oasis with patches of grasses and reeds slowly turning into small groves of palm trees. Or show your players just how far they’ve wandered into a dangerous area by only having dead logs and shriveled bushes spread among cold stones and skeletons. This pack also includes animated sprites for fire and doors. Make sure your heroes can see while wandering the market built deep into a mountain by lighting the way with small flames, and let them enter town shops through wooden doors decorated with lattice glass windows. Create parched plains, relaxing oases, and busy towns carved into stone with the KR Untamed Desert Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2297920/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Sun_and_Moon_Tileset/

Harness the power of Sol and Luna with the KR Sun and Moon Tileset! Kokoro Reflections looked to the sky for inspiration in this pack, creating beautiful tiles to help you make magical castles. A1, A2, A4, A5, and B tiles are ready for you to build exteriors and interiors of your palaces and dungeons, letting your players explore bush-filled gardens before wandering into a guest bedroom for a nap while they wait for their turn to meet with the kingdom’s ruler. Multiple stained glass windows, colorful mosaic floorings, and carved statues of the sun and moon can turn any empty room into a gorgeous temple, and simpler details like teacups, filled bookcases, and portraits give rooms a more lived-in feeling.

Both the moon and sun tiles are placed in the same spots of each set, making it easy to create a unique dungeon! Have the dungeon change depending on the time of day, or have your players trigger the change to help solve puzzles to reach the throne room. This pack also includes 10 sprites to add some animated events to your maps! Light the way with orange flames for the sun palace and blue flames for the moon palace, and cover open doors with curtains that can be whisked open. Flowing fountains are perfect for adding some details to the palace gardens and sleek treasure chests can reward your players for searching the entire dungeon. Create palaces for dueling kingdoms and gorgeous dungeons with the KR Sun and Moon Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2297940/RPG_Maker_MZ__atmosphere/

Bring subtle sounds and music to your game with atmosphere! ayato sound create is back with another music pack, this time offering up 12 BGM tracks that focus on atmospheric sounds over bombastic beats and orchestral overtures. Let your players explore your game world as water burbles in the background and birds tweet cheerfully in the trees above their heads, or have wind chimes jingle in the background while they piece together important clues at the latest crime scene.

Not every map or cutscene needs blasting music for its audio, and this pack knows that. Mixing together simple instrumentals melodies with natural background noises, these songs create the perfect tracks for setting the mood without the need to add in extra BGS files. Let a slow piano piece play while rain patters in the background and the creaks of nearby neighbors pop in here and there to remind your hero that they’re not alone no matter how gloomy they feel in the moment, or have the crunch of footsteps and bird songs play as your players wander a not-quite-empty park early in the morning. Set your players off-balance with an eerie electronic tune playing over the thump of feet and muffled calls of children playing during a cutscene where your hero recalls the first time they met the villain, and have the woosh of cars driving by and calmer music ground them in the present once they step back outside into the sunlight. Each track comes in multiple file formats, so it’s simple to add right into your current project. Add in the right ambience to your cutscenes and maps with the atmosphere music pack!

The RPG Maker Festival is an annual Steam Sale Event that saw its first occurring in February 2022. It is dedicated to the RPG Maker series, a non-coding engine series well loved by many indie and hobbyist developers from around the globe. 
Not only will the engines be discounted greatly, the 2023 event will also be joined by over 450 RPG Maker-made game titles created by its enthusiastic and eager fan community, including worldly-acclaimed titles such as The Witch's House MV and LISA: The Painful!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30532/2023_MZ_Festival_SPECIAL/

[b]Release of the 3D Character Converter Tool on Steam![/b]
The 3D Character Converter is a convenient mini-app that can quickly convert humanoid-shaped VRM models into 2D character sprite assets compatible with RPG Maker series. Users can either import custom-made or commercially available VRM models into the converter for conversion. The app can output a total of 5 types of map walker sprites, 18 types of side-view battle character (aka SV-Battler) sprites, and the model’s faces for use as character portraits in dialogue boxes common in RPGs. 

Although the 3D Character Converter app was originally designed for the currently in development RPG Maker Unite, there are also options that would allow the converter to output 2D assets compatible with RPG Maker MV and RPG Maker MZ. The developers hope that the early release of this app can provide RPG Maker users a different means of creating game assets for their games.

(What is VRM: A platform-independent file format designed for use with 3D characters and avatars in the VR era. (Please refer to the [url=https://vrm-consortium.org/en/]VRM Consortium[/url] for detail))

notes.title: New DLC: Another World Hero Generator! Two New KR Tilesets!
notes.notes:
This week we have something you've all been asking for: A male hero generator pack! Plus 2 new KR Tilesets, and a Heroine Generator pack for MV!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2297900/RPG_Maker_MZ__Another_World_Hero_Generator_for_MZ/

Game devs, your requests have been heard: male heroes will be able to have their own glamorous makeovers with Another World Hero Generator for MZ! Gee-kun-soft is here with 40 awesome male generator parts for MZ to give your heroes head-to-toe updates.Get ready to make buff demon lords, long-haired elf mages, armored barbarians, and more with this pack!

20 Clothing options cover all sorts of styles for heroes, from a simple shirt and pants pairing perfect for villagers and long, layered, robes to heavy paladin armor and a cloth samurai-inspired outfit. Dress your barbarian party member in a fur-lined breastplate and loincloth so they have full mobility while they swing their ax at enemies, or create a noble’s son who still wears the kingdom’s red and black school uniform long after the school was destroyed by invading monsters. Give your bard a skintight top (or no shirt at all!) to help distract his opponents, while the tank of the group wears a simple shirt over a stocky body. Other outfits with varying amounts of armor are perfect for creating NPCs, or let your heroes change clothes every once in a while. The Eyes, Front Hair, and Rear Hair sections each get 5 new pieces, letting you make a man with crazy eyes partly covered in bangs, a youthful elf who wears his green hair long and loose, and even a kind healer with downturned eyes and short hair that sticks out in a few spots.

Finish off your hero’s look with 1 Accessory 1, 2 Accessory 2s, and 2 horn options as Beast Ears! Give your demon prince some onyx bull horns and a simple eyepatch, while your prince-turned-hero wears a tiny gold crown to remind people of his status. So don’t wait, give your guys a new look with Another World Hero Generator for MZ!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2297890/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Alien_Worlds_Tileset/

Explore crystalline caverns and long-abandoned alien labs with the KR Alien Worlds Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with another MV/MZ tileset pack, this time focusing on two alien locations: purple-tinted wilderness and ancient alien laboratories lit with glowing amber. Have your spacefaring heroes crashland on a mysterious planet where they must survive until their friends can rescue them, or send your heroes on a research mission to explore strange dungeons full of forgotten machines and technology.

A1, A2, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets are filled with all you need to make detailed alien maps. Grow an alien forest where normal leafy trees are replaced with bioluminescent jellyfish trees and purple pods pop out of the ground protected with brown bark. Or let your players feel a little familiar with the alien plants by picking some of the tiles that appear almost like an Earth plant that was coated in bright purple paint, like a flowering yucca or short bushes. Bluish grass and brown dirt ground tiles are perfect for letting the plants themselves stand out, and purple waters could lead your heroes to a cave where hundreds of huge crystals line the walls and sprout from the ground!

Or have your heroes stumble across a strange brown building where amber screens show that power is still somehow flowing through the machines. Duck under metal arms and squeeze past large generators to reach the center of the lab, where a teleporter stands surrounded by alien runes. Create technology-heavy dungeons and exotic forests on distant planets with the KR Alien Worlds Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2297860/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Ultimate_SciFi_Frontiers_Tileset/

Build an incredible city on a planet far from Earth with the KR Ultimate Sci-Fi Frontiers Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has created a tileset for MV/MZ that brings all the little details you need to create a home and busy sci-fi city on a space station, on an alien planet, or even on Earth in the far future. Give your hero a comfy apartment to relax in, a convenience store to grab snacks from, and a manicured park to take a break after spending all morning holed up in the company lab. Neon blue lights keep everything bright no matter the time of day, and electrified fences form an obvious barrier between explorable areas and places only there for decoration. 24 A4 walls offer up a wide selection of options, from simple gray brick walls to high-tech circuit board ones, and panels of exterior sky shots are ready for your heroes to stare at while they chat with friends. Smaller tiles like microscopes, waste baskets, and exit signs can turn any room into a sci-fi company office, while cash registers, soda machines, and stocked shelves could make it a corner shop.

This pack also includes animated doors and swirling portals to help your players get around your maps. Have your heroes quickly reach distant cities with purple and blue portals, or let them keep their feet on the ground by entering buildings through large bay doors. Glowing signs make it easy for your players to find the closest restaurant or armory, or just use arrows to point them in the right direction! And if you want to make a cutscene play while your heroes are flying to a new location, have this pack’s flying car/plane sprite float across the screen. Give your sci-fi heroes a place to call home with the KR Ultimate Sci-Fi Frontiers Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2297832/RPG_Maker_MV__Another_World_Heroine_Generator_3/

MV users, it’s time for you to enjoy the Another World Heroine Generator 3 pack! Gee-kun-soft has remade 41 generator pieces to match MV’s generator and help you make your heroines look exactly how you imagine them. Give your knight a long ponytail, your mage a floppy black hat, and your martial artist an asymmetrical robe with this pack! 5 options for Eyes, Front Hair, and Rear Hair are perfect for giving your heroines a makeover. Choose the right sparkly eyes for your main character, and then give her some bangs and hair. Long and loose bangs could show that she’s too busy to stop for a haircut, while straight across bangs could fit her studious nature. 4 ponytail choices can reveal even more about personality, with the party’s kind healer wearing a low ponytail while the energetic archer sticks with twintails. And for the warrior woman who can’t stand long hair? Let her keep it loose and shoulder-length.

20 Clothing pieces along with 2 Accessory 2s, 3 Beast Ears, and 1 pair of Wings are perfect for giving each party member her own style. Let the tiny-horned succubus mage wear a lightweight robe so she can easily dodge while casting spells, and have your isekai’d heroine wear a modern jacket that stands out compared to all the fantastical outfits of the game world. Or just let your players choose their favorite outfit to wear while they relax and farm in a quiet village. No matter what genre your game is, update your MV heroines’ looks with new hairstyles and interesting outfits thanks to Another World Heroine Generator 3!

notes.title: 4 New DLC: Icons, Fantasy Dreamland, & MT Tiny Battlers
notes.notes:
For our first release day of February, we bring you more MT Tiny Tales Battlers! More Fantasy Dreamland! And some Big Icons!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2297810/RPG_Maker_MZ__Big_Icons_Vol_1__Magic_and_Skills/

Level up your skill descriptions with Big Icons Vol 1 - Magic and Skills! Bis is here with 34 cartoony icons to help your menus stand out. With icons for elements, weapons, and interesting magical attacks, your party’s battle skills can stand out compared to the common default icons! Upgrade elemental attacks with new icons: a huge wave for water, a spinning tornado for wind, and a bright flame for fire to name a few. Each element icon stands out with unique colors and shapes, so even if your player is racing through the menu to get their next attack in, they're sure to easily recognize which elemental magic they’re using. For more powerful skills, make use of the swirling cosmic icon to mess with gravity or use a skill whose icon is a burning chunk of rock and hope for the best when meteors fall from the sky!

What about your non-magic-user party members? Then give them the weapon icons and ambiguous skill icons that fit! Swordsmen can make use of the sword and powerup icons, bards will love to use the music and charm icons, and even a shapeshifting rogue can find some icons to love, like the transformation and claw attack ones. 

This pack includes multiple sizes of the icons so it’s simple to use in your favorite engine! Grab the 24x24 icons for Ace, the 32x32 for MV/MZ, or use the original size of 1024x1024 to resize the icons to perfectly fit your game’s menus or use them as pictures during cutscenes. So if you’ve been looking for some icons that fit your unique skills or just want to get away from the default icon designs, check out Big Icons Vol 1 - Magic and Skills!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2297780/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Dreamland_Extra_Pack/

Send your heroes into a confounding world of sleep or into a spooky haunted town with the Fantasy Dreamland Extra Pack! Elv Games’ latest pack offers up some interesting extras in their adorable pixel art style to add in even more locations to your game. Give your towns a spoopy makeover in October with a B sheet of Halloween tiles, or create a unique dungeon for your heroes to challenge every time they fall asleep with an A1, A5, and 2 B sheets! Decorate houses with strings of bats, spiders, and ghosts, line paths with jack-o-lanterns, and fill the town graveyard with a bunch of new gravestones. Or turn the local woods into a haunted forest with spooky faces carved into dead trees! Grab the dream-themed tiles to build a maze built into puffy clouds or a nightmare dungeon where the wrong move could send your heroes falling through the purple floor to their doom! This pack also includes A1 and A2 autotiles to help you find the perfect water or grass for your maps. Give your prairies long, lush grasses while the swamps are filled with noxious green ponds.

Tiles aren’t all you’ll find in this pack though, it also includes 10 new human and 6 boss monster sprites as well as flames, spikes, and dreamland doorways. Each human and monster sprite includes a matching SV Battler, so your pumpkin-headed heroes are ready to face off against a grim reaper ghost to save their town from an eternity of Halloween! Give your heroes some dangerous new foes to defeat and a mysterious dreamworld to explore with the Fantasy Dreamland Extra Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2297770/RPG_Maker_MZ__MT_Tiny_Tales_Battlers__Faith_and_Evil/

Turn your battle screens into epic battles against evil with MT Tiny Tales Battlers - Faith and Evil! Mega Tiles is back with another sprite and battler pack in their awesome pixel art Tiny Tales style, with 19 humans and monsters to battle against (or play as!). This pack’s 8 human characters are based around warriors from a church, offering up healers, warriors, and mages dressed in brightly decorated robes. Play as a helmet-wearing paladin accompanied by a sister wielding a magical staff, or battle against a corrupt church’s ancient and bearded archmage who is guarded by swordmasters and zealots.

If your heroes prefer to fight monsters, then choose from 11 creepy foes that can be found in deep, dark dungeons or stalking their prey in the middle of the night! Battle against skeletons, cloaked wraiths, and floating ghost skulls in graveyards, until your heroes finally find the cause of all the undead: a powerful scythe-wielding lich! Or have them challenge animalistic werebeasts deep in a forest. Perhaps the local wolves were cursed and now can stand on their hind legs or the people of a village turned to dark magic to give themselves the power to change into wereboars and werewolves, and your heroes need to stop them before it’s too late!

And if all those options weren’t enough, each character also comes in 4 color variations, meaning there are a total of 76 characters to choose from! Each battler and sprite comes in 3 sizes (original, 2x, and 3x) so you can easily pick a size that fits your game’s resolution. Battle against ghosts and ghouls or play as a monster fighting scary humans with the MT Tiny Tales Battlers - Faith and Evil pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2297760/RPG_Maker_MZ__MT_Tiny_Tales_Battlers__Magitek_Dynasty/

Fill your game with more human friends and foes with the MT Tiny Tales Battlers - Magitek Dynasty pack! Mega Tiles has focused their pixel art style on humans this time, bringing us 19 character battlers and sprites from two very different backgrounds. Meet soldiers from a technology-loving empire who often wear a uniform of heavy armor and helmets, or focus on the dynasty warriors, with their brightly colored and decorated armor inspired by samurai armor. Use this pack to create a world where skilled spearmen face off against powerful wrench-wielding soldiers, and let your players be the deciding factor in which side wins!

This pack’s 9 dynasty characters and 10 empire characters cover a range of battle styles, from sword wielders to long-range snipers! Have long-haired gunners and archers offer support to a team of spearmen on the dynasty side, and surprise your players with an attack from sai-wielding assassins if they sneak into the dynasty castle. Or battle the empire’s heavily armored general and a troop of soldiers armed with swords and shields.

4 color variations for each character means there are 76 total battlers and sprites to choose from, so it’s simple to populate towns with different people or fight against foes with color-coded weaknesses! 3 sizes (original, 2x, and 3x) for each character also makes it easier to choose the right size for your game. Let your players choose whether they want to support the empire or dynasty in your game, or create a vast world with mixed factions with MT Tiny Tales Battlers - Magitek Dynasty!

notes.title: New DLC: 4 Fantasy Dreamland Packs!
notes.notes:
Many of us making games are trying to build our fantasy dreamland, and Elv Games is here to help with their Fantasy Dreamland series of pixel tilesets!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235970/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Dreamland__Starter_Pack/

Give your RPG the perfect pixelated makeover with the Fantasy Dreamland - Starter Pack! Elv Games is here with an incredible pack filled with tiles, sprites, and more to help make your dream game world a reality. This pack’s 44 tilesets (including A1, A2, A5, and a variety of B sheets) cover important locations for your beginner hero; with tiles devoted to villages, grasslands, caves, and deserts you know that your player won’t get bored exploring! Create hot cactus-filled deserts, cheerful grasslands overflowing with flowers, welcoming villages, and curious caves filled with minerals and maybe even a secret blacksmith with this pack’s tilesets.

An incredible world to explore is useless without anyone living in it, which is why this pack also includes a bunch of humanoid and monster sprites! 40 humanoid sprites (including goblins/elves and beastmen) are ready to wander your villages or offer items to your heroes while they search for new dungeons. Or use them to create an all-powerful adventuring party! Monster sprites for slimes, mushrooms and plant critters, and fire elementals can add some movement to a map or act as on-map enemies, and each monster has a damaged version for when they’ve been defeated or are taking a nap. Each humanoid and monster sprite also comes with a matching SV battler, so you’re ready to take your battle screen to the next level!

Also included are a bunch of icons to really help sell the retro feel of your game. Fill your menus with icons for weapons, armor, items, and dungeon keys, or use them in messages to help get your point across! This pack comes ready to use in both Vx/Ace and MV/MZ sizes, so you can enjoy these tiles even if you prefer the older engines. So if you’ve been searching for an adorable pixel art style or want a wider variety of monster sprites, pick up the Fantasy Dreamland - Starter Pack today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2236010/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Dreamland_Adventurer_Pack/

Love the Fantasy Dreamland style, but wish there were even more options? Then check out the Fantasy Dreamland Adventure Pack! Elv Games has tiles and sprites for two new locations to explore: lush forests and lava-filled mountains! Create verdant maps full of trees and flowering grasses where your heroes can hunt for resources, or choose more mystical blue, purple, and red-leafed trees to turn a simple forest into dark woods or the entrance to a fairy village. A wide selection of long grasses, flowers, and mushrooms are perfect for keeping the ground from looking too boring, or use them to mark fairy rings or buried treasures! Or send your heroes up a mountainside with three different ground colors and a selection of stones, from pebbles to boulders, to decorate the barren location. Use the pack’s carved tablets along the mountain paths to cheer your heroes forward, or leave them as warning of a deadly foe ahead! Of course, you could always mix and match to create a tree-covered volcano or a suspicious quarry in the middle of an otherwise pleasant forest.

Tiles aren’t the only thing you’ll find in this pack! Sprites for treasure chests, glowing flowers, and moving puddles of lava in stones are perfect for adding some little details, and 30 enemy sprites ready to add some life to your maps. Get ready to deal with living rocks, insect-like critters, and gooey blobs ready to swallow up unsuspecting adventurers!

Each enemy also comes with a damaged sprite, perfect for once you’ve beaten them or as a surprise for your players, and an animated SV battler, so you could face them on the battlefield or turn them into a helpful friend! And if that wasn’t enough, this pack comes presized for both VX/Ace and MV/MZ, so you can just drop the files into your project and get started building your world. Send your adventurers to fantastical forests and monstrous mountains with the Fantasy Dreamland Adventure Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271690/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Dreamland_Casual_Pack/

Let your heroes visit a modern metropolis and a snowy, cabin-filled town with the Fantasy Dreamland Casual Pack! Elv Games is back with another pack filled to the brim of adorable pixel art, this time focusing on two drastically different places: steel-filled cities and snow-covered villages. Build a concrete jungle for your heroes to explore as they try their best to run a small shop, and send your fantasy heroes to a winter wonderland where frosted trees stand near warm log cabins. 20 sheets of tiles, covering A1, A2, A5, and B sheets give you ample choices for ground and building colors. Build dark gray skyscrapers next to waterways while red-roofed shops line the street near a park filled with swings and teeter-totters, or create a quiet mountain retreat nestled between snowy rocks and trees. Fill your cities with helpful signs pointing the way and add some pops of color and nature with trees and flowers placed in planters. Or create a calm village where footprints in the snow are the only sign of people living there.

This pack also includes 40 unique human characters, perfect for populating your cities and padding out your party! Each person comes with a SV Battler, so they’re ready to fight at any time. There are also animated doors and treasure chests, so your heroes can search snow-covered barrels or rush through a glass door to heal at a hotel. Meet new NPCs in shining cities and chilly villages with the Fantasy Dreamland Casual Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271700/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Dreamland_Explorer_Pack/

Send your players deep into deadly dungeons and squelching through damp marshes with the Fantasy Dreamland Explorer Pack! Elv Games’ cute pixel art style is here to help you create some spookier locations, with tiles to make underground dungeons and swamplands for your heroes to explore! 13 tileset sheets offer up dangerous and dark tiles that are perfect for making a challenging dungeon. Have your heroes get lost in a swamp where dark green grass and shallow water turns into a rocky region where dead trees are the only sign of plant life, or let them escape a castle dungeon only to find themselves lost in a forgotten kingdom’s underground maze where chains on the wall and diagonal walls dropping into bottomless pits hint at a dark history. Variations in ground tiles make it easy to keep a map from feeling one-note, and smaller tiles like ruined furniture, stepping stones, and tree stumps are perfect details for helping your players keep track of where they’ve been while exploring.

Just so you don’t accidentally leave your dungeons and swamps empty, this pack also includes 5 large monsters that can act as bosses, each with 4 color variations. Battle against (or with) stacked shrooms and bloodstained floating eyeballs thanks to matching SV Battlers, and let your players see the proof of their win with a downed sprite for every monster! Give your players options when it comes to exploring dungeons by letting them fight a diamond-headed golem or solve a puzzle to get past trap spikes and locked doors, or challenge them to do both for extra rewards! Battle against fearsome monsters and solve ancient puzzles in underground tombs with the Fantasy Dreamland Explorer Pack!

notes.title: RPG Maker Festival 2023 Steam Sale is Now Officially Happening!
notes.notes:
Behold dear game developers! We are thrilled to announce that we, Gotcha Gotcha Games, the developer of the RPG Maker engine series, will soon be holding our RPG Maker Festival 2023 Steam Sale Event! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38018723/06bf7ebc96151cdc89cd4b152147cd9809c7d887.png[/img]

[b]What is RPG Maker Festival?
[/b]RPG Maker Festival is our annual Sale event held on Steam! This is where we and all RPG Maker indie developers around the world join-hands together and show what the RPG Maker engine series and your great creation is made of and get recognized by game players and fans across the world! As long as your game is made by RPG Maker series or Pixel Game Maker MV and has a Steam Store page, you are eligible to participate! 

So far, we have confirmed that more than 300 titles will be participating in this Steam Sale event, including the widely acclaimed titles like The [i]Witch's House MV[/i] and [i]LISA: The Painful![/i]

[b]We Are Also Looking for Game Videos![/b] ([u]Deadline - January 26, 2023, 06:59 AM Pacific Standard Time / Jan 26, 2023, 23:59 Japan Standard Time[/u])

notes.title: New DLC: Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Interior, Last Boss Pack V.5, Dark Drama Music
notes.notes:
Majestic castles, dynamic space battles, dramatic scenes: All can be enhanced with this weeks releases, let's take a look at what we have!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271660/RPG_Maker_MZ__Winlu_Fantasy_Tileset___Interior/

Create gorgeous pixel art cabins, castles, and cathedrals with Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Interior! Winlu has crafted this pack to give MV/MZ games incredibly detailed medieval and fantasy rooms. With full A2, A3, A4, and A5 autotiles along with 6 B sheets, you can create all sorts of locations, from scruffy hunting cabins and weapon-filled smithies to an alchemist’s library and even a throne room decorated for a feast! Decorate your hero’s childhood home with wooden furniture like bookshelves, benches, and a straw-stuffed bed, with a simple toilet tucked behind a carved wooden screen. Build an adventurer’s guild with stone walls and bearskin rugs spread on the floor, and keep your hero well-equipped thanks to a nearby shop filled with weapon racks and potions. Make sure your hero doesn’t break the kingdom’s laws though, otherwise they may find themselves locked in the castle dungeon, where chains hang from the walls and spiderwebs form in every corner!

This pack also includes animated flames so you can add some movement to your maps. Make sure the fire in the tavern’s kitchen is roaring while the cook makes soup, and light up a mage’s study with mystical blue flames. A variety of wooden doors, from creaky hut doors to reinforced dungeon ones, make it easy to control where your players can go, and 8 animated treasure chests are perfect for rewarding exploration. So if you’ve been searching for some little details to make your maps pop, or just want to add to your Winlu tileset collection, pick up the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Interior pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271670/RPG_Maker_MZ__Last_Boss_Pack_Vol5/

Fill your interstellar epic with star-speckled space backdrops and huge battleships ready for combat with the Last Boss Pack Vol.5! Gee Kun Soft’s latest pack continues to be inspired by sci-fi, this time upping the battler sizes to contain entire armies! 10 space battleships are ready to be used in your galaxy-wide games! Give your starship troopers marine-inspired exploration and spacecraft carrier ships while your heroes travel to the far reaches of the galaxy in a red-detailed aerodynamic rocket. Green ships with 4 powerful dishes that can blast messages into the distance, long purple serpent-shaped ships, and heavy-duty shield crafts can be friends or foes, depending on who your heroes decide to team up with!

Each ship also comes with a matching sprite, so you can have your heroes travel in style when they’re racing for the next planet. And 12 backgrounds (in 2 sizes, 816x624 and 1000x740) are the perfect backdrop for space battles and setting the scene when your heroes reach a new area, whether they’re floating above a calm planet, dodging trash in a shattered space station, or pausing before joining into a laser-filler battle.

This pack also includes 64 bonus images to add even more excitement to your cutscenes! Each spaceship is in its own section of space and comes in multiple variations of combat readiness. Show the serpent ship shooting anything that gets close with 6 turrets along in back right before your heroes have to dive into battle with it, or set the mood with a destroyed medic ship shedding chunks of burnt metal when your heroes arrive too late to help! The calmer bonus images can also make for a great background while traveling through space to a new star system. Give your sci-fi story some incredible spaceship and battle art with the Last Boss Pack Vol.5!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271680/RPG_Maker_MZ__Dark_Drama_Music_Pack/

Give your game’s emotional scenes some subtle music with the Dark Drama Music Pack! Joel Steudler is back with 10 incredible BGMs that are perfect for those moments between deadly battles and cheerful camaraderie, when your players start to realize that not everything is as it seems and the ‘happily ever after’ ending may be harder to achieve than they thought. Slow tempos and somber pianos fill this pack with bittersweet feelings to take a dramatic scene to the next level, without relying on bombastic instruments to surprise your players.

Have Hidden Truths’ pianos and synths swell when your heroes enter a room, drawing their attention to the fact that there’s something off about the floorboards. Or use the heartbeat-inspired beat of Take My Pulse to create an uneasy mood when your players realize that the monster they’d been hunting was much closer than they knew. Make an abandoned station feel even more lonely with Access Denied’s echoing clinks and clanks of metal, and bring tears to your players’ eyes when the bittersweet pianos of I Remember play at a pivotal point in the story. Whether your spacefaring hero finds himself floating alone in an unknown star system or your heroes’ discover one of the party was separated while running from a monster, the Dark Drama Music Pack is ready to help set the mood!

notes.title: New DLC: Modern Day Massive Music Pack!
notes.notes:
Find the next soundtrack to your game with a new pack from Joel Steudler!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235980/RPG_Maker_MZ__Modern_Day_Massive_Music_Pack/

Have you been hunting for even more music tracks to fill your modern adventure? Then it’s time to check out the Modern Day Massive Music Pack! Joel Steulder’s latest pack includes 42 BGMs covering a ton of styles and scenes to help you fill your modern game with fitting music. Rock out to electronic punk battle themes, metal-heavy dungeon tracks, soft and heart-touching songs for cutscenes, retro town themes, and more with this incredible pack!

With the pack broken up into 8 main sections, you’re sure to be able to find just what you need. Need a powerful BGM full of heavy beats to keep the tension up? Then check out the battle, dungeon, or metal tracks, where electronic guitars roar and creepy chords are waiting to send a shiver up your hero’s spine! Want to find the right track for when your hero opens up to a close friend? Then listen to the calm pianos and strings in the conversation and romance sections. Just need some quirky tracks to give each of your shops and streets their own unique vibe? Then the retro, theme, and town tracks are the place for you, with songs that lean into the 80s chiptune vibes sitting alongside acoustic guitar-focused tracks and vaporwave-inspired jazz.

Each track comes in multiple file formats, making it simple to add right into your project. Find the perfect tracks for those scenes that you’ve been struggling with with the help of the Modern Day Massive Music Pack!

notes.title: New DLC: MT Tiny Tales Battlers - Wild Beasts, Last Boss Pack Vol.4
notes.notes:
It's the new year! And you know what that means: Accidentally writing 2022 on everything for the next several weeks! But while you get that done, you can also power up your games with two new releases.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2260590/RPG_Maker_MZ__MT_Tiny_Tales_Battlers__Wild_Beasts/

Battle against nature with MT Tiny Tales Battlers - Wild Beasts! Mega Tiles is back with their adorable pixel art style, this time sharing 18 monsters to fill your game worlds with wildlife. Have your heroes face off against red-winged vampire bats, deer with elemental antlers, chubby raccoons, deadly spiders, and more with this pack!

Snake, slime, and bee enemies are perfect if you want to keep battles familiar for RPG lovers, and add your own spin with odd enemies such as shell-less snails, cockatrices, and plant-themed lizards. Or turn a cave into an acranophobe’s nightmare with three different types of spiders! Fill your forest maps with deer, foxes, birds, and bees, and give your caverns creepy-crawlies including centipede-like bugs and worms that burst out of the ground! Each beast comes with a battler and sprite, so your heroes can see and try to avoid unnecessary fights while exploring the areas. And if that wasn’t enough, every monster has multiple color variations, meaning this pack contains a whopping 90 creatures to choose from! Use the different colored slimes to show their elemental resistances, or choose a fitting color for the toothy worm that matches the dungeon’s themes.

Each image comes in 3 sizes (original, 2x, and 3x), so it’s easy to find a size that will fit your game’s resolution! Add even more creatures to battle against (or tame!) with MT Tiny Tales Battlers - Wild Beasts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2260610/RPG_Maker_MZ__Last_Boss_Pack_Vol4/

Give your sci-fi heroes some incredible robots to battle against with the Last Boss Pack Vol.4! Gee-kun-soft latest battler pack focuses on mechas and armored humanoid robots, with battlers, sprites, and background images to help bring your sci-fi worlds to life! With 10 different robot builds and variations for each to choose from, your players will be able to face robots on land, on sea, in the sky, and even in space! Challenge a red samurai robot to a duel in a dangerous city or have your players try to escape a mecha with four legs that let it roll on land and float on water without slowing down, all while a dark purple robot looms in the distance as the final challenge. Don’t leave your players without a robot of their own, give them a white and blue paladin robot or speedy fighter jet that can help them escape a deadly situation.

Each robot has a matching sprite, so you can let your players control their own mecha while exploring destroyed cities or space! 14 backgrounds (with two sizes, 816 x 624 and 1000 x 740) give you some out of this world choices for locations of battles and cutscenes. Let your players hang out on the streets of a skyscraper-filled town or on a ship’s deck while floating in space, or force them to survive battles in waste-filled worlds or in space while explosions burst in the background!

This pack also includes 26 bonus images with the ready-to-battle robots placed into the backgrounds, perfect for introducing your players to their latest foe before a fight! Show the samurai robot sending powerful sword slashes towards the screen before starting a battle, or have the villain’s dark mecha launch a barrage of missiles in a cutscene to force your players down onto a wasteland planet. So if you need some more robots for your epic sci-fi story or want to add some scenes from a mecha show to your modern game, check out the Last Boss Pack Vol.4!
