notes.title: Four New DLC + The Steam Winter Sale is Here!
notes.notes:
For our final release day of the year, we've got 4 packs to fill you with Holiday cheer, plus the Steam Winter Sale has just begun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235930/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Hint_of_Holiday_Tileset/

Add some Christmas cheer to your games with KR Hint of Holiday Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a small pack to take your maps from “bah humbug” to “merry Christmas”! Deck the halls with garlands and bows, and make your character’s home the cheeriest in the neighborhood with strands of lights and even a large inflatable santa! Carpet autotiles in red or green are a quick way to add some holiday cheer to a room, and use the wooden tables with plaid tablecloths to hold a pile of presents! Ornament filled trees and wreaths are ready to fill a room for any parties, and a colorful train and nutcracker are perfect for distracting any kids from diving headfirst into their presents.

This pack also includes 4 sprites to help your characters explore more of the world. A red pickup truck is ready to take your player to the Christmas tree farm and home again, with a variation that includes a tree in the truck bed. Or let your characters enjoy time together while they travel through snowy landscapes in the decorated red and gold sleigh! An oversized snow globe could be a simple decoration at a party or turn into a tool used by a dastardly villain, kidnapping one of your character’s friends and trapping them in the globe! Let your players know when a scene is happening in your game with some festive extras or create an adorable Christmas game as a present for your loved ones with KR Hint of Holiday Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235950/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Snow_Town_Tileset/

Tell the tale of a small winter town over many years with KR Snow Town! Kokoro Reflections must have had to put on their heavy winter coats while working on this snowy version of their Everyday Town tileset, with a fluffy layer of snow coating everything! Build a comfortable town with thatch roofs and cobblestones paths near chilly rivers and snow-topped farmland. With a full B-sheet of decorative tiles for interiors, you can make sure your villagers enjoy their time by reading books from the shelves, cuddling around the fireplace, cooking hearty stew in pots, or even just watching the snowfall from the comfort of their windows! Crops, crates, plants, signs, and more are all frosted to fit the chilly village exterior, so you can fill your maps with lots of little details.

This pack isn’t meant for just happy towns though! The ruined versions of tiles include cobwebs and cracked wood, snow-covered furniture, moldy food, smashed building walls, and more! Have your heroes feel the pain of being too slow to stop monsters from attacking a small snowy village and seeing the destruction they’ve left behind. Or give your players some hope by letting them watch an previously abandoned town slowly be repaired and populated by hard-working farmers over the years your heroes are adventuring.

Sprites for flames to help the villagers stay warm during winter and doors that can close to keep out the chill are included to help build your towns. And give your players more of a reason to explore with three different simple treasure chests, based on boxes and barrels! Create a safe place for your heroes to recover while exploring icy mountains or have them arrive too late to save a village with the KR Snow Town tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235940/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Victorian_Mansion_Tileset/

Build a fantastic house for your heroes to explore or live in with the KR Victorian Mansion Tileset! Kokoro Reflections time-traveled to the 19th century to get some insight into the style of the era and brought it all to life with this pack! Filled A2, A3, and A4 autotiles sheets can create both interiors and exteriors for the mansion with polished wood, opulent wallpapers, and tile roofs can create spooky spaces or warm living rooms depending on how you decorate them. Light up the room with lamps with decorative shades and create a noisy wall of clocks with 12 different choices, or keep a living room simple by matching drapes to the color of the fainting couch. A variety of themed tiles mean you can make each room unique, from a kitchen full of cast iron pots to a bathroom with a copper tub and even a kid’s room with bassinet and toys!

Create a gorgeous garden with a full B sheet of trees, shrubs, and flowers! Give your rich nobleman a well-manicured flower garden with trimmed bushes while the abandoned mansion on the top of the hill has a desolate yard covered in mushrooms and grassy weeds. Animated autotiles for ponds and waterfalls are perfect to bring some subtle movement to the gardens, whether they’re inside or outside. Fill your Victorian story with proper furniture or give your modern horror story an old-school feel with the KR Victorian Mansion Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235960/RPG_Maker_MZ__Christmas_Holiday_Music_Pack/

Set the holiday mood with the Christmas Holiday Music Pack! Murray Atkinson donned a Santa costume to deliver the gift of Christmas music to us all, with 7 musical tracks to choose from. Pump these orchestral remakes of public domain songs through your game while snow falls on your heroes to complete your winter wonderland, or have them play on repeat in an item shop as a nod to the radio’s love for them in December.

Introduce a beautiful home while Deck the Halls plays in the background, or use it in place of your normal castle themes during the winter season. Carol of the Shchedryk’s dancing strings could be the perfect tune while your heroes explore a bright snow dungeon or have it blast from speakers while they visit a town’s winter festival. Let your heroes relax to the gentle strum of strings in Silent Night as they have a calm fireside chat, or have the haunting melody of What Child is This play over a scene of a sleeping town. Or turn a snowball fight into an incredible battle scene while electric guitars rip through familiar tunes thanks to the track Jingle Bells Punk Rock!

Want to give your fantasy winter town a holiday-ish theme without using a recognizable song? Then let Atkinson’s original song Christmas Town’s upbeat jingle bells fill the air with cheer! Give your holiday game some fitting background tracks or help sell this cheery time of year in your modern adventure with the Christmas Holiday Music Pack!

In addition, be sure to browse all the deals on RPG Maker and RPG Maker resource packs in the Steam Winter Sale that just started today!

notes.title: New: The Story of Pixels: Sunny Village, Another World Heroine Generator 3 MZ
notes.notes:
It's the perfect day for a brand new pixel based village tileset, and even more heroine generator pieces for MZ... luckily, that is just what we have for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235910/RPG_Maker_MZ__The_Story_of_Pixels_Sunny_Village/

Send your heroes on an adventure through a bright pixel art world with The Story of Pixels: Sunny Village! Source Byte Sp. z o.o. is here with a unique pixel art style to help you create a lighthearted world to explore. Explore dark caverns with pools of deadly lava, survive sandy deserts where the only life is cacti, and rest and refill your bags in a cheery walled village!

Autotiles along with decorative B-sheet tiles can create exteriors, interiors, and dungeons, just what you need to make an exciting adventure! Fill caves with rocks and stalagmites, a forest with birch trees and fluffy bushes, and deserts with abandoned tents and palm trees for your heroes to explore, or keep your players contained to a farm town where crops are grown for the kingdom. A mix of interior tiles makes it easy to create either a modern or medieval world. Want to make daily chores easier on your hero? Give them a flat-screen tv and microwave so they can eat on the couch in the evenings! Or fill your farmer’s home with barrels and crates of fresh produce, while the town’s rich nobleman stocks his rooms with tables topped with sleep tablecloths and tea sets.

This pack also includes sprites to bring life to your new world! Sprites for an adorable snake, slime, and cow offer up some animals for you to fill your maps with, and 5 treasure chests are ready to reward your players for exploring deep caverns and small paths. Animated doors can let the pack’s 8 human sprites wander in and out of the town buildings. If you’ve been hoping for a new style of pixel art to play with or just want to make a small and cute farm game, check out The Story of Pixels: Sunny Village!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235900/RPG_Maker_MZ__Another_World_Heroine_Generator_3_for_MZ/

Equip your sorceresses, healers, and martial artists with new outfits and hairstyles with the help of Another World Heroine Generator 3 for MZ! Gee-kun-soft is back with another MZ generator pack that adds 41 new parts to the female generator, covering clothing, hairstyles, and small accessories perfect for showing your characters’ personalities! Create a twin-tailed brunette in a jacket who is a master hacker, a fighter with long bangs hanging in her face and an armored claw on one arm, a horned demon with tiny wings dressed in a shawl draped over a lightweight top, and more with this pack!

20 clothing options cover a variety of styles, from tight tracksuit-like tops paired with gloves and layered robes to a flowing dancer’s outfit and dresses with ruffled white sleeves sticking out that a vampire queen would love. Find the perfect top with flowing long sleeves for your healer to wear while the foe-turned-friend succubus wears a skintight piece topped with a comfy scarf. 5 rear hair and 5 front hair choices bring new bangs and 4 new ponytails to the generator. Want something simpler? Then grab the shoulder-length hair option instead. And with your base heroine made, finish them off with 2 AccB, 3 beast ears, and 1 set of wings to truly let your character shine. Hair clips shaped like shields are a nice addition to your warrior maiden, and 2 different horn types are ready to help you add demonkin to your game world.

So pick up Another World Heroine Generator 3 for MZ today and give your heroines some lovely makeovers!

Particle System Plugin - RPG Particle MZ Update

An update for this pack has been made on Komodo Plaza and on Steam.

・Fixed a bug that occurred to a waiting_actor during the battle when it's granting state
・Particles properly dissipates when all states were released such as inability to fight

You should find these files automatically downloaded to your DLC folder. Be sure to update the files in your project with these updated files.

notes.title: New DLC: Time Elements - Character Core Set, Melancholic, NPC Male Priests Vol 1
notes.notes:
Another release day, another new set of packs to make your game sing. Make brand new pixel based characters, score the slow and somber portions of your game, and give some male priests a voice with the latest three packs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228670/RPG_Maker_MZ__Time_Elements__Character_Core_Set/

Build your characters from the ground up with the Time Elements - Character Core Set! Finalbossblue has created new pieces to help you build your perfect heroes! These pixel art pieces are designed to fit a 16x16 pixel grid, meaning that they can be resized to easily work in whichever RPG Maker you want. And with more than 50 pieces, covering hair, shirts, pants, wings, weapons, and more, you have tons of options to fill your game with characters! Fill your game with even more excitement by making use of the animations such as jumping, holding something, swinging a weapon, and sleeping to add in extra movement to cutscenes and dungeon exploration.

Making your own hero can be tough if you’re not used to art programs, so this pack simplifies things by containing a generator! Create your characters with a few clicks of the mouse and then export it in the size you need for Ace or MV/MZ so you can add it right in! Create a bat-winged warrior decked out in red armor, a bearded thief in a green hood, a spear-wielding lady knight, and anyone else your game calls for by choosing the right pieces or hitting the randomize button for new inspiration!

Overwhelmed by the generator and not sure what NPCs to make? Don’t worry, since this pack also includes 16 ready-to-use NPC sprites (including children) and 5 prebuilt heroes so you can add them in and get right to the game-making! A PDF guide is also included, just in case you need some help figuring out a specific thing with the generator or character pieces. Start creating all the pixel art sprites you want with the Time Elements - Character Core Set!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228680/RPG_Maker_MZ__Melancholic/

Find the right emotional track for your quieter cities and cutscenes with Melancholic! ayato sound create’s latest music pack offers up 23 BGM tracks to fill the pensive moments in between exciting battles and rushed rescues. Give your players a chance to catch their breath and think with jazz-inspired tunes and other haunting tracks that leave out the powerful electric guitars and drums seen in so many energetic battle themes. Instead, let strings like pianos, violins, and cellos take the lead. Accordions are ready to fill a new city with their familiar trill, and pianos can add a wistful mood to the campfire when your heroes have to take a break in the middle of nowhere.

Think your fast-paced game doesn’t have a spot for any of this pack’s tracks? Think again! This pack doesn’t only have slower and softer tunes, it also has a few tracks with darker vibes. Let the deep notes of a double bass warn your players that the alley they entered probably isn’t the safest place, or have almost choir-like strings and a crackle of electronic beats play when your heroes discover a secret that should have stayed buried. Each track comes in multiple file formats, so you can add them right into your favorite engine. Let your heroes take a break while soothing piano plays or explore a city of love to the tunes of an accordion with the Melancholic music pack!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228660/RPG_Maker_MZ__NPC_Male_Priests_Vol1/

Give your devout men some voices with NPC Male Priests Vol. 1! TK.Projects is here with even more Japanese voice clips, this time focusing on 12 different characters that you could run into in and around the town’s church or hospital. And with 10 SEs each, you’re sure to find a voice that will fit the scene. Have the son of a healer laugh happily as he runs between pews, older men grumble about a recent monster attack outside the building, a suspicious man laugh to himself in the shadows, and more with this SE pack!

With a spread of ages covered in these voices, you’ll be able to find something that works no matter your character. Give your fatherly priest a voice that sounds appropriately middle-aged and kind, while your handsome healer’s voice is pleasant when he laughs. Let your heroes listen in to an elderly man scolding a teen boy for falling asleep on the job, and discover a new clue to help solve the town’s mystery when the boy sighs and tries to explain himself. Or have an eerie moan wake your heroes up from a nap, only to discover that they’ve been kidnapped!

Adding these SEs to your engine of choice is simple since each track comes in multiple file formats, so what are you waiting for? If you need some voice clips for the town’s head priest or a creepy laugh to warn your players that the man who has a quest for them is untrustworthy, check out NPC Male Priests Vol. 1!

notes.title: New: Krachware Fantasy Town Ext., MGC Animations Col. V1, NPC Female Priests V1
notes.notes:
For our first release day of the holiday season, we have a huge release of 3 new packs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228590/RPG_Maker_MZ__Krachware_Fantasy_Town_Exterior_Tileset/

Build a cozy village for your heroes to live in and explore with the Krachware Fantasy Town Exterior Tileset! Bring your hero’s childhood home to life with this pack of tiles, be it a farming village, rustic port town, or even an abandoned village forgotten by the kingdom! A1, A2, A3, and A4 autotiles are ready to help you create an adorable little town. Fill the tiny farming village with dirt paths and rustic wooden homes and let your heroes walk down stone paths between brick and stucco storefronts. Create small wood-lined waterways in a small forest village, while larger towns rely on brick canals flowing alongside the stone streets. Angled roof tiles make it easy to add variations to your buildings, so they don’t all have to look like cookie-cutter squares! Wooden barrels and crates, clay pots, benches, row boats, and other tiles are ready to decorate your village streets and alleys, or keep things natural with flowers and shrubberies.

If all those tiles weren’t enough, there are also destroyed options to let your players see the wear and tear of time on an unlucky town! Damaged signs, cracked roof tiles, shattered windows, and web-filled crates can make any town look down on its luck. Will your players be able to save the poor villagers from total destruction? This pack also includes 12 wooden door sprites to give your players access to the village buildings! Give tiled-roof homes doors with matched tiles on their overhang, and make it easy for people to enter the local tavern by giving them arched two-tile wide doors! Create a cozy wooden town for your heroes to grow up in or have a broken down village that your players need to repair with the Krachware Fantasy Town Exterior Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228580/RPG_Maker_MZ__MGC_Animations_Collection_Vol_1/

Update your MZ game’s coolest skills with some awesome animations with MGC Animations Collection Vol 1! ManuGamingCreations is back with another incredible pack of 30 Effekseer animations ready to take your magical attacks to another level. Strike foes with leafy slashes, dark magic explosions, jolts of ball lightning, and even a powerful blast of purple energy to finish off those more challenging enemies!

10 different themes, each with 3 animations, cover a variety of buff/debuff and elemental situations. Equip your wizard with elemental skills themed around lightning balls, nature, earth, flames and dark energy to blow your enemies away, or give them the raw power of magic with beam and neutral animations focusing on bursts of red, purple, and white light! Haste animations that spin to speed allies up and power-themed ones to drain foes or fill your heroes with a burst of strength are perfect for your support party members, or keep things simpler by letting your warrior charge up and hit harder with impact animations.

This pack includes a MZ project so you can see each animation in action, with SEs set up for the full experience. Let these inspire you to adjust the speed and angle of the animations to turn each one into the perfect addition to your skills! If you’ve been wanting to replace default animations or have been searching for the perfect nature animation for your warlock party member, check out MGC Animations Collection Vol 1!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228560/RPG_Maker_MZ__NPC_Female_Priests_Vol1/

Is your game’s churches as quiet as a graveyard when your heroes revive? Do you want to give your healers some verbal cues when they greet passersby? Then it’s time to check out NPC Female Priests Vol.1! TK.Projects newest SE pack brings us 120 Japanese voice clips to fill your churches and hospitals with greetings and laughter of the women who work there. Instead of overexplaining with messages, have a priestess sigh when your heroes need to be revived after losing a fight to a slime or let a healer chuckle if a party member needs to be healed after getting food poisoning.

12 different character voices offer up options for multiple ages and levels of belief. Have a young girl give a shy hello from her spot in a pew when your heroes walk by, or a middle-aged woman sob outside to attract your players to talk to her and start a new quest. Soft-spoken priestesses and believers can hum in thought before suggesting blessings to help in combat or cry in joy when your heroes manage to recover the town’s lost relic. Don’t give only your good NPCs' voices though! The fanatic SEs in this pack are perfect for followers of the demon lord or villains who are trying to trick townsfolk into giving away all of their hard-earned money.

Each SE comes in multiple file formats, so you can easily add them to your favorite engine without needing to edit them. Add more voices to your NPC healers and quest givers with NPC Female Priests Vol.1!

RPG BGM and Battle SE Pack" contains a total of 12 tracks, including BGM for towns and inn breaks necessary for RPGs, as well as music and SEs that can be used in battle scenes. (BGM: 7, SE: 5)
It also includes BGM inspired by the ending music after the game is cleared, which is a nice to have, so if you are wondering what music to use for your piece, check it out!

notes.title: New DLC: NPC Male Soldiers Vol.1
notes.notes:
In our last release day of November, we bring you a new voice pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2217660/RPG_Maker_MZ__NPC_Male_Soldiers_Vol1/

Ten-hut! It’s time to add voices to more of the men in your games with NPC Male Soldiers Vol.1! TK.Projects’ latest voice pack offers you another 120 SEs to help your NPCs find a voice of their own. Give your guardsmen cheerful greetings to the people passing through city gates, let noble knights offer thoughtful advice when your heroes need it, and have the kingdom’s gruff general let out a deep belly laugh when an overconfident soldier challenges him to a fight for command!

Each character voice comes with 10 SEs covering a variety of uses, including greetings, angry shouts, concerned sighs, and screams of terror. Let the hellos and hums add some much-needed sounds to long conversations, punctuated with loud laughter or angered grunts when the speaker feels like your hero’s attention has started to wander. Or use the voice clips as audio clues for your players to realize certain NPCs have sidequests to offer. Worried sighs from middle-aged soldiers at the bar could lead your heroes on an adventure to reclaim a prized helmet, and an excited “wow” from a nervous new recruit reading a book in the barracks could start a quest to turn those young men from zeroes to heroes!

Multiple file formats make it easy to add these voices in your favorite engines and use them right away. Fill your guard posts and battlefields with the sounds of living people with NPC Male Soldiers Vol.1!

notes.title: New DLC: Soldier Character Pack, NPC Female Soldiers Vol1, IDEAL
notes.notes:
Sometimes it is hard to make a game, but you just have to soldier on. And this weeks releases are here to help, with two soldier themed packs, plus a new modern style soundtrack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2206630/RPG_Maker_MZ__Soldier_Character_Pack/

Ten-hut devs! It’s time to storm the battlefield with new characters from the Soldier Character Pack! Choose from 16 characters to lead your players to military success, whether it’s on land, on sea, or in space! Each soldier comes with a sprite, enemy image, faceset, bust, and sv battler! And if that wasn’t enough, every character comes in 2 variations, one wearing a hat or helmet and one without, so you can switch it up when your characters need to be more formal or when they’re kicking back and relaxing.

Dressed in crisp black and white uniforms, 10 of this pack’s characters are prepared to join your heroes in a modern tale of bravery and monster-butt kicking! Turn your players into brunette male or female recruits and have them befriend the other soldiers in the barracks, whether they’re the cheerful blonde flirting with the others or the serious raven-haired man who has something to prove. And when it’s time to receive their next orders, have your heroes visit the gray-haired and resolute commanders in their metal-decorated jackets.

But what if your game takes place in a sci-fi world of spaceships and intergalactic battles? No worries, because this pack includes 6 characters specifically designed for it! Team up the serious purple-haired female space soldier with the blue-haired boy genius to fix a damaged panel outside the ship, while the starry-eyed sharpshooter fends off drones with the help of the academy’s red-headed bad boy.

This pack also includes 16 high-res images of the characters as a bonus, so you can find even more places to use them in your game, along with 6 SV weapons to give your party some new equipment for battles! Prepare your game world for war with the Soldier Character Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2206620/RPG_Maker_MZ__NPC_Female_Soldiers_Vol1/

Give your battle-ready female characters some fitting voices with the NPC Female Soldiers Vol1! TK.Projects suited up and jumped into making a new pack of Japanese voices, this time focusing on character voices that could be found out on the battlefield. Forget the squeaky voices of children, this pack’s 120 SEs include more mature voices for your favorite ladies. Find the perfect voices for your game’s female guards, knights, and generals in this pack!

12 unique character voices offer up a plethora of possibilities in your game. Even if your city guards all wear the same uniform, make them stand out with their own personalities displayed through their voices! Perhaps your heroes need to go through a gate guarded by two female soldiers, one serious and the other friendly, and your players need to choose the right dialogue choices to talk their way past the guards. Or maybe the SEs just add some extra pizzazz to a cutscene your heroes can listen in on between the nervous new recruit and the tired veteran. Give the powerful lady knight in your party some voice cues during battles, or save them for the times your party takes a break to relax around the campfire! This pack comes with multiple audio formats so you can drop the SEs right into your projects, so what are you waiting for? Add some extra chatter to your game’s barracks with the NPC Female Soldiers Vol1!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2206640/RPG_Maker_MZ__IDEAL/

Dive into a cyberspace world with the thrilling tracks of IDEAL! ayato sound create’s latest music pack brings you 24 tracks to bring your modern game into the 21st century. Featuring slick instrumentals and energetic electronic beats, this pack is sure to put your players right into the action!

Kick off your hero’s adventure by having them jump straight into cyberspace, where Now Online plays a consistent drum beat and chiptune-inspired tunes keep the mood cheery while the digital world loads around your players. Fight against hackers and virus-turned-monster foes while high-energy techno tracks like Battlefield and IDEAL race in the background, or turn battles into problem-solving moments by slowing things down with the waves of electronic hums from Anxiety.

When it’s time for something less intense grab Intermission, with its bass guitar strumming a nice melody for your heroes to enjoy while they visit the local virtual hangout. Or have your hero take some time to hop offline and meet friends in the real world to compare notes while Secret Account’s piano plays a jazzy track in the background. The slow whistle-like music of Massage is perfect when your hero needs to take a break from all the hustle and bustle, and the electronic beeps and boops of More and More are ready to meet them once they’re jumping back into cyberspace! Each track comes in multiple file formats, making it simple to add into your favorite engine. Fill your modern and sci-fi worlds with toe-tapping techno from IDEAL!

notes.title: New: Another World Heroine Gen. 2, KR Leg. Palaces - Arachnid, NPC Male Adv. V1
notes.notes:
This week, we have a variety of new packs to help you make your games: More Generator Parts, a new Legendary Palace Tileset, and more voices!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1884910/RPG_Maker_MZ__Another_World_Heroine_Generator_2_for_MZ/

Are you a MV user who has been searching for some beautiful generator parts? Then you need to check out Another World Heroine Generator 2! Gee-kun-soft has painstakingly recreated their MZ generator part for MV, meaning you can finally give your characters a dream makeover! With 42 parts that include accessory, hair, eye, and clothing options, this pack is here to help you find the perfect pieces for each of your female characters.

20 different clothing options cover all sorts of possible personalities and classes. Dress your mages in caped outfits or two-tone asymmetrical dresses, while the party’s dancer captures the enemies’ attention with her moves in her body-hugging crop top and pants! Top the outfit with one of 5 accessories to really tie the look together. Maybe your sage wears a lightweight crown with decorative curves, or your maid-turned-assassin still wears her ruffled headband!

With 5 front hair, 5 rear hair, and 5 eye options, you’ll have an easy time giving each heroine a unique faceset. Different eye shapes can turn a simple smile into an honest grin from a young and positive archer or a knowing smirk from the party’s resident bad girl. Keep long hair out of your warrior’s face by tying it in a low ponytail or up in a braided bun, or let her keep it simple by cutting it off at her shoulders. And to finish your beast girl party member, make sure to add in this pack’s fluffy ears and tail! Each part is numbered in a way to avoid other resources, so you can drop it into your generator folder without a worry and start updating characters instantly. Dress your MV characters for success with the Another World Heroine Generator 2 pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201300/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Arachnid_Tileset/

Arachnophobes, beware! The next palace you must visit may be from your nightmares thanks to the creepy-crawly decorations and cobwebs of the KR Legendary Palaces - Arachnid Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another palace set, this time focusing on the dark and deadly designs of a half-man, half-spider, emperor with walls and floors tinted red and gray. Make sure your heroes keep their eyes peeled while exploring, otherwise they may walk right into a web!

Dark stone and tile floors can be broken up with bottomless pits, but don’t despair! Web autotiles may let your heroes cross safely, as long as they can avoid the sticky sections. Decorative pools of water can break up the monotone rooms with bright points of blue, or keep the creepy atmosphere going with black or red liquids in those pools instead. Fill large rooms with stairs and ladders to hard-to-reach areas (at least, hard-to-reach for non-spiderfolks) where statues and treasure chests carved from stone can be found. Stone pillars that you can top with red jewels or more spider king statues can lead the way to the throne room, where a raised platform stands alone in front of a window made from red glass. As if that wasn’t enough, this pack includes extra spiderwebs to make sure the dungeon looks like no one but spiders have been here for ages! Create a haunted manor where vampires live or a palace ruled by a dark spider king with the KR Legendary Palaces - Arachnid Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201290/RPG_Maker_MZ__NPC_Male_Adventurers_Vol1/

Give your male NPCs time to shine with NPC Male Adventurers Vol.1! TK.Projects has made a companion pack to their female adventurers pack, this time giving voices to 12 different men you’re likely to find in the local adventurer’s guild! Chat with other adventurers, pick up new quests from a sleepy receptionist, practice your skills against the beast of a guildmaster, and try to avoid the town drunkard, each with their own SEs thanks to this pack.

With 120 SEs to choose from, you’ll have trouble keeping your male NPCs quiet! Have your heroes greeted with cheerful hellos from other young rookies or from the older (but maybe not wiser) adventurers, or start a battle with an angry shout from a hot-blooded newbie after accidentally bumping into him on the way to the quest board. Find a hidden quest by taking the time to ask why the normally happy receptionist is sighing sadly, or by waking the snoring drunken ruffian laying on the floor of the bar. Or punctuate important lore given by the guild’s minstrel with melodious hums and main quests from the guildmaster with serious grunts. This pack includes multiple file formats to make it simple to add new voices to your favorite engine! So don’t let your ladies have all the fun, give your guys some voices too with NPC Male Adventurers Vol.1!

notes.title: New DLC: 3 New Spooky KR Packs + New Voice Pack
notes.notes:
It's time for Halloween! And this week's set of releases are just in time to celebrate the horror. Check out 3 new horror graphics packs from KR, plus a new voice pack for female adventurers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185610/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Halloween_Party_Tileset/

It’s trick-or-treat season, so give your heroes some treats with the KR Halloween Party Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with a set of tiles ready to turn your boring party scene into a hauntingly good time! Carve pumpkins, drink witch’s brew punch, and try not to scream in the homemade haunted house!

Give your hero’s home a remodel with wooden floors and striped walls in orange, purple, or gray to give your Halloween party a fitting backdrop, or keep it simple with just a rug and some bright fur wall hangings and cheery banners and bows. Light the place up with strings of skull lights or with lit jack o’ lanterns that you can leave unlit until right before the party starts. Make sure to keep the partygoers’ energy up by laying out tables of cakes, hors devours, and cupcakes alongside cauldrons of colorful punch! Decorations like white ghosts, hanging webs, and cutout bats are just what you need to turn plain hallwalls into a haunted house to scare your young heroes! But what if you need something truly scary? Then grab the gray hanging ghouls and tombstones to turn a normal backyard into a dangerous graveyard.

This pack also includes a spooky moonlit parallax image, perfect for showing that night has fallen during the party or shifting the scene towards a scarier mood. Throw a spoopy fall party with the KR Halloween Party Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185630/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Horror_Kit_Tileset/

We’ve seen the treats from trick-or-treat, which means it’s time for some scary tricks thanks to the KR Horror Kit Tileset! Kokoro Reflections dove into our nightmares to create a set of tiles that’ll leave your heroes terrified. Create houses where the walls have eyes, cities where ghostly shadows loom behind windows of buildings you swear were empty, and graveyards full of bloody warnings with these spine-chilling tiles!

Bloody water autotiles and gruesome flesh floors can turn any normal map into a horrific local, or keep things subtle by adding oozing blood or gross mud to the edges of otherwise pleasant maps thanks to a selection of autotiles. Cover a murderer’s playground with a variety of blood stains, from bloody footprints leading to a trap or a trail of droplets left by the previous victim to warnings written in red and even a splattered heart painted on a wall. Ruin a house with shattered glass and cracks in the walls and floors, and show that a paranormal presence isn’t happy with your hero being there by switching to cracks that are dripping blood! A grinning mouth full of fangs and realistic eyes appearing on walls may be the last warning your hero has to escape. Also included in this pack are 10 fog images to help give any map a dark and dangerous feeling. Maybe the town is fine during the day, but once night falls and the fog rolls in? Who knows what could happen… Add some extra scares to your horror game maps with the KR Horror Kit Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185650/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Witchs_House_Tileset/

Do your heroes need the help from a swamp witch to get a magical artifact? Or perhaps village children have been disappearing and a witch’s mansion deep in the forest was where they were last seen, but you need some tiles to make that mansion extra witchy? Then you need to check out the KR Witch’s House Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with another tileset pack, this time offering you all you need to make a purple-themed home that any witch would love!

With tiles for both the exterior and interior of a witch’s house, you’re ready to create all the witchy maps you need! Create a house with wild beams and railings that relies on magic to stay standing, while twisted trees and bushes of herbs grow nearby a small river. Inside, build rooms out of light brown or dark gray walls and floors where your witch can sleep, study, and eat. Hanging pink and purple bead curtains can make for excellent wall decorations or act as separators to break up a large room, and bottles and orbs can keep the color scheme going all over the house. If your witch is more scary than sweet, skip the shiny crystals and decorate the house with cobwebs, hanging herbs, and skulls to create the right atmosphere. Don’t forget to include a witch’s necessities: cauldrons, candles, and a broom!

This pack also includes sprites for a small magical treasure chest and a purple door so your heroes can enter the house! Create a unique home for your game’s resident witch with the KR Witch’s House Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185600/RPG_Maker_MZ__NPC_Female_Adventurers_Vol1/

Add some extra liveliness to your adventurer’s guilds and pubs with the NPC Female Adventurers Vol.1! TK.Projects latest SE pack includes 120 new female voice clips you can add to cutscenes and events to bring NPCs to life. 12 unique characters offer you a good selection for possible combat-curious NPCs. Introduce your heroes to brave adventurers, polite receptionists, tough guild masters, and more with this pack!

Give your heroes a central location where they can take on new quests with an adventurer’s guild, where different receptionists can help them find an exciting quest. Maybe the youngest receptionist is ready with suggestions for cool (but difficult) quests with a happy cheer, while the quieter middle-aged receptionist is more likely to calmly recommend one that she knows your heroes can handle. If they prove themselves, maybe they’ll even get to meet the guild master, a clever woman who responds to battle challenges with a hearty laugh before throwing the challenger out the door. Have your heroes listen to a local minstrel warm up her voice with some “la-la”s while turning in a finished quest, or start a hidden quiet with a surprised shout from a normally calm warrior out in the forest. Each SE comes with multiple audio formats so that you can easily add them to your favorite engine. Fill your maps with some energetic voices with the NPC Female Adventurers Vol.1!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Legendary Palaces - Kraken Tileset, Hainuwele, NPC Male Nobles Vol.1
notes.notes:
New tileset from the deep, new set of tracks, and another voice pack are here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185580/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Kraken_Tileset/

Avast me hearties, it’s time to seek a deadly ruler found well below the ocean waves with the KR Legendary Palaces - Kraken Tileset! Kokoro Reflections searched the briny depths for inspiration, this time settling on the enormous cephalopod of legend: the kraken! Craft a palace that Davy Jones would love on the seafloor, where sunken ships were combined to form a maze of wooden hallways and flooded rooms.

Waterlogged wood and old metal grates can form the floors and walls of your submerged palace, with water, moss, and rocks forming natural blockages in some rooms. And for some man-made blockages, grab one of the deadly spike tiles that burst from the floor! Natural decorations like seashells, coral, seaweed, and hanging kelp make it easy to show your players just how long it’s been since any living had last set foot in the palace. As your heroes make their way deeper into the building, cover the walls with ropes and porthole windows that make way for detailed wooden carvings of the mighty kraken as they near the throne room. When they finally enter that last room, let them see the powerful ruler of the palace lounging on a throne carved into huge tentacles of a wooden statue… Or have them discover the skeleton of the last king, resting next to the throne he ruled from thousands of years before.

This pack also includes a wooden chest sprite, so your heroes can receive some booty after risking their life to explore the monster-infested castle! Make a dungeon only a pirate could love with the KR Legendary Palaces - Kraken Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185590/RPG_Maker_MZ__Hainuwele/

Give your valuable scenes some fitting music with Hainuwele! This music pack from ayato sound create includes 24 BGMs that mix instruments with electronic beats and rhythms to make tracks to cover a wide array of scenes, from heart pounding battles to relaxing village visits and even twisted reveals of who is truly friend and foe!

Start your hero’s journey to the haunting tunes of an echoing xylophone as they listen to the village elder’s tale of an almost forgotten treasure tucked away in a lost dungeon. With that tale still swirling in their mind, send your hero off to find it with a new beat joining the xylophone to turn the music from haunting to intriguing. Meet and befriend quirky companions to a track of plucked strings, growing the party until they’re strong enough to explore the dungeon with its dark tunnels and mysteriously slow music tracks replacing the energetic toe-tapping ones from above ground.

And when your heroes finally find the lost treasure, play a track with odd vocal pops to set them on edge as they realize that there was a very good reason for that treasure to be forgotten! Battle against hordes of monsters to fix what they broke while drums and synth chimes blast in the background. Once the day is saved, let your heroes return home as calming pianos play and the knot of stress in between their shoulder blades dissolves. This pack includes multiple audio formats for each track so you can easily add it to your favorite engine. Give your heroes’ origin stories some stellar BGM with the Hainuwele music pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185570/RPG_Maker_MZ__NPC_Male_Nobles_Vol1/

Don’t let your noblewomen have all the fun, give your men some voices too with NPC Male Nobles Vol.1! TK. Projects’ latest SE pack brings us another set of Japanese voice clips to help liven up your games. Fill your noble districts and castles with the sounds of cheerful young boys, grouchy eldery patriarchs, and suave butlers with this pack of 120 SEs!

Give your NPCs their own voices with 10 unique characters, each covering a variety of situations from greetings and laughter to angry shouts and screams of terror! Give your heroes some options when they are searching for a way to enter the kingdom’s castle, with the cheerful laughter of a young boy leading them to a quest where they must play with the prince until he welcomes them into the castle or have them race after the scream of an elderly nobleman who made the mistake of entering a dangerous alley. Once they have access to the gilded hallways, let busy noblemen offer a quick hello when your heroes walk past and the bearded king gives a grand laugh during his introduction. Though if they want to hear about the true troubles of the kingdom, have your heroes talk with the handsome butler who often lets out a tired sigh. Multiple file formats allow you to use these SEs in your favorite engine, so add in another way for your players to connect with your NPCs with NPC Male Nobles Vol.1!

notes.title: New DLC: NPC Female Nobles Vol.1
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171180/RPG_Maker_MZ__NPC_Female_Nobles_Vol1/

You’ve added voices to your game’s rural towns and villages to help them feel lived in, but what about the noble’s mansions and royal castle? Well, it’s time to give those areas some voices of their own with the NPC Female Nobles Vol.1 pack! TK.Projects is back with another Japanese voice pack, this time offering 120 SEs to help your noblewomen speak out.

12 different characters cover a wide selection of possible NPCs, from young ladies awaiting their debutante ball to cheerful elderly women and the maids who serve them. After your heroes hear the screams of a young woman, send them on a quest to rescue her before the city realizes their beloved princess was kidnapped! Or have them earn a letter of recommendation from a lord by babysitting his spoiled daughter and putting up with her angry shouts and tantrums. Listen to demure greetings of noblewomen when you walk in the front door, or hear them shriek in surprise when you suddenly burst out of the ground during their tea party after you spent hours defeating slimes and rats in the sewers! Each file comes in multiple formats, making it simple to add them to your favorite engine! Fill your cities’ noble areas and castles with the voices of the people who live there with NPC Female Nobles Vol.1!

notes.title: New Official DLC: Creepy Land Tileset Pack, Plus,Original Fantasy Character Pack
notes.notes:
“CreepyLand Tileset Pack Plus” is the second collection of the “CreepyLand Tileset” series! 
This tileset is suitable for creating outdoor and indoor scenes of a cute and creepy world where demons live their days at ease.
Some of the tileset also include animated character chip version.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2115442/RPG_Maker_MZ__Creepy_Land_Tileset_Pack_Plus/


This is a handy collection of character data that is great for depicting a fantasy world!
8 classes are included in this collection: warrior, fighter, hunter, assassin, wizard, merchant, monk, and necromancer.
Standing pictures, window icons, and walking graphics that can be used in a variety of worldviews are included!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967142/RPG_Maker_MZ__Original_Fantasy_Character_Pack/

notes.title: New: KR Transportation - Subway & Train/Cars Trucks & Gas, Future Cyberpunk V.2
notes.notes:
This week, we have several packs that should help you with your modern or near future games! Have your characters travel the world in modern transportation with the two new Kokoro Reflections Transportation packs, and give them some great cyberpunk tunes to listen to from T.K.Projects!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171170/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Transportation_Station__Subway_and_Train_Tileset/

Hurry up and grab your luggage, you don’t want to miss the KR Transportation Station - Subway and Train Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is ready to help improve your modern game’s public transportation with tons of tiles to build the best underground rail station around! Rush down the stairs and pass through turnstiles to reach the tunnels full of posters and advertisements decorating tile walls, and check the flatscreen TVs for any changes to the train schedule before standing near the tracks to wait for the subway cars or bullet train. Just make sure to keep your players safe by marking dangerous areas with warning signs and yellow and black stripes on the floor!

Don’t have your players only explore the station, thanks to this pack you can also have them jump onto the train itself! Shadows and rounded black tiles help you build train interiors that are ready to be filled with seats, tables, and beds so that your characters can travel in comfort. Build sleeping cars with luggage tucked away about bunk beds for long trips, or keep things simple with seats against the walls and poles for those extra-busy rush hour trips across town. There are even control panels and monitors to let you build the train’s control room in case your players need to stop a runaway train! Create a unique location for your players to fast travel from or set up an entire game on a moving train with the KR Transportation Station - Subway and Train Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171160/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Transportation_Station__Cars_Trucks_and_Gas_Tileset/

Take a break from your exciting cross-country adventure to stock up on snacks and fuel with the KR Transportation Station - Cars Trucks and Gas Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with all the tiles you need to turn an empty map into a gas station with all the amenities! Create outdoor parking lots with signs, fuel punks, and store signage, or build a small convenience store with posters in the windows and an ice machine next to the door. Let your heroes step inside the air-conditioned shop to grab any snacks they want from the metal shelves and refrigerator sections, or sit down at the small red tables to enjoy a fast food meal before running to the store’s small (and possibly dirty) bathroom to prepare for the rest of the road trip.

That’s not all though! This pack also contains an incredible selection of large vehicle sprites to fill your parking lots and speed through your map streets. Choose from 12 different vehicles (with 20+ color variations each) to find the perfect cars for your heroes and villains! Give your hero a motorcycle or topless jeep to get around, while the evil CEO drives a blood red sports car. Have a large party? Then make sure they all have a seat with the van or RV sprites! Even if your heroes never step foot into a car, make your cities feel full thanks to traffic with different sedans, hatchbacks, and semi trucks driving around. If your game takes place in modern times and you’ve been wishing you had some more large car options, grab the KR Transportation Station - Cars Trucks and Gas Tileset today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171140/RPG_Maker_MZ__Future_Cyberpunk_Collection_Vol2/

Fill your sci-fi streets with toe-tapping techno tunes thanks to Future Cyberpunk Collection Vol.2! TK.Projects’ latest music pack offers up 21 EDM tracks to keep the energy up while your players explore neon-lit cities and adventures through space. Find just the right tracks for your heroes’ battles against rampaging robots, descents into a mad scientist’s basement, and even taking a break to dance in a cyber city’s nightclubs!

This pack’s high-energy tracks are sure to turn every battle into a heart-racing fight for victory, with fast beats and upbeat synth instruments. Have your heroes explore new locations like open space and abandoned asteroid mines while techno tracks have your player’s head bobbing along to the music. Pick a track with a comfortable beat and cheery beeps when it’s time for your heroes to visit a city to stock up on equipment, or when they’re taking some time to rest while their spaceship flies itself to their next mission.

Looking for a track that could fit a sadder moment in your game? This pack has that as well, with synth pianos playing a slower tune that is perfect for the moment your heroes realize that one of them will have to stay on the self-destructing spaceship to make sure the monster doesn’t escape. Each track comes in multiple file formats, so it’s easy to add some EDM to your favorite engine! Give your futuristic world the synth music it deserves with Future Cyberpunk Collection Vol.2!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Candy Shop Tileset, RE-D Music Pack 4
notes.notes:
Another release day is here, and this time we've got something sweet! A new candy shop tileset and some awesome new orchestral tracks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2151240/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Candy_Shop_Tileset/

I hope your heroes have a sweet tooth, because KR Candy Shop Tileset is here with tons of tasty treats! Kokoro Reflections has donned candy cane-striped caps and listened to their inner child for this pack, offering us all sorts of goodies and fitting cases to display them! Create bright and cheery interiors with gold, white, pink, and purple floors and walls, and bring that brightness to the exteriors with colorful roofs, awnings, and large signs ready for you to add the shop’s name to it! Make a wall of candy bins thanks to some autotiles, or keep those sweets in large glass jars. Large curved displays are ready to be topped with cotton candy, lollipops, bonbons, macarons, and more, or leave the displays empty until your players complete the ‘sweet treats’ sidequest. This pack isn’t just sugar and spice and everything nice though, since this is meant to be a shop! Make sure customers pay for their sweets at the cash register and tuck an ATM in the corner to make sure they’ll be able to afford all the candy they want.

This pack also includes 9 sheets of doors (for a whopping 216 choices!) to give your players access to all the shop’s rooms. Enter the shop through doors decorated with shiny pink glass, and hide employee-only areas behind white wooden doors. Don’t forget to include a bathroom, with plain doors decorated only with a sign! Let your players take a date to the candy store, work behind the counter, or just stop in for a sweet healing item with the KR Candy Shop Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2151250/RPG_Maker_MZ__RED_MUSIC_PACK_4/

Gather your brave adventurers for the final push to defeat the demon lord with RE-D MUSIC PACK 4! Gee-kun-soft’s latest music pack features 10 beautiful orchestral tunes to ground your cutscenes and prepare your players for what’s to come. With tracks for battles, exploration, and emotional cutscenes, you’re sure to find a track to fall in love with in this pack!

Give the final fights different battle tracks, with 3 different tracks intended for challenging fights. Pick one that gives your players a boost of confidence thanks to powerful trumpets to help them defeat the demon lord’s guards, and give the demon lord his own track with steady drums and a cacophony of strings and brass. Search ancient ruins or a destroyed city while a lonely guitar plays in the background, eventually joined by other soft instruments when your heroes discover just what happened there. If your heroes are giving an impassioned speech to scared soldiers, grab a track with soaring melodies to help raise the mood and morale of not just the NPCs but also your players! 

When it’s finally time to rest, let a music box play a soft melody as your heroes return home to their loved ones. Or use it to rouse them from a magic-inflicted slumber, reminding them that they still have important things to do, like saving the world!  Each track comes in multiple file formats, so you can add them right away to your favorite engine! So if you’ve been looking for more orchestral tracks to fill your game’s soundtrack, check out RE-D MUSIC PACK 4!

notes.title: New: KR Skyscraper Tileset and PSYCHO DIVER Music DLC Packs!
notes.notes:
With this week's releases we're heading to the top of world, or at the least to the top of some very tall buildings, with a new tileset for Skyscrapers, plus cyberpunk music to listen to while you're up there!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2151220/

Let your modern cities touch the skies with the KR Skyscraper Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another modern masterpiece, this time focusing on the necessities to build multi-level office and apartment buildings. Get ready to delve into pipe-filled basements, soulless open-plan offices, and even an opulent penthouse perched on the top of a 50-story skyscraper with this pack!

Tiles for both exteriors and interiors offer up just what you need to help you make modern maps for your game. Create an oasis of nature with a colorful mass of flowers and some trees next to an asphalt parking lot, or add to the city’s grimy backstreets with piles of trash and overflowing dumpsters. Take a step into the buildings to find offices with desks topped with laptops and paperwork, printers watched by security cameras to make sure no one is stealing the ink, and filing cabinets next to the room’s large glass window. Or fill the skyscraper with apartments, with tiny touches like paintings, an ironing board, and different shelf decorations to help your players know who lives there. If your players search hard enough, maybe they’ll come across the maintenance area of the building, with utility switches for the power and access to every floor thanks to metal diagonal stairs.

This pack also includes sprites to help bring even more animation to your maps! Blinking lights and small water spouts can add some extra pizzazz to rooms and fountains, while a parking ticket machine with a raisable arm is ready to keep your players from wandering away into areas they’re not supposed to have access to yet. And if that wasn’t enough, this pack also comes with a left and right-facing helicopter! Park it on top of the building for a quick escape route or have it fly across the screen to warn your players that their boss is coming back to the office. Have your game reach new heights with the KR Skyscraper Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2151230/

Fill your modern or cyberpunk game with electronic jams with PSYCHO DIVER! ayato sound create is here with a pack of 25 tracks perfect for any game that needs great bops with synth instruments while your players explore streets lit with neon or travel between galaxies. Find music for sorrowful scenes, exciting getaways, battles against robot drones, and more in this music pack!

Give your busy cities high-energy tracks with solid beats to emulate the bustling streets, or choose a slower track that highlights a piano to echo the loneliness of your hero while they travel through empty space. Let your players relax with guitars twanging in the background, or send them to a rave where the music’s beat is strong enough to feel like their heart is beating to the same rhythm. Or throw your players off balance with tracks that feature cascading beeps and boops, making the whole scene feel ‘wrong’ without giving them a specific thing to put their finger on. Maybe that guy who gave them the security overwrite code isn’t as good as he seems to be…

This pack comes in multiple file formats, so you can easily add it to your favorite engine! Let your players tap their toes along to some great synth tunes with the PSYCHO DIVER music pack!

notes.title: New Releases: Nemo's Desert Battlers Pack 1, NPC Male Villagers Vol.2
notes.notes:
This week we have two more packs to help you make your latest games! Battle in the desert with Nemo's Desert Battlers Pack 1, and expand the voices of your town with NPC Male Villagers Vol.2

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2135120/

Grab your water canteen and prepare for the heat, because it’s time to face the fierce foes found in Nemo's Desert Battlers Pack 1! TheArtOfNemo searched for inspiration in sandy dunes and lush oases to create this pack of 38 gorgeous battlers. Fight against light-footed bandits, armored sand crabs, possessed pots, and more!

7 unique enemy designs offer up a variety when it comes to desert fiends. Have your players fall into a buried trap and battle a terrifying antlion, with armored sides and a pair of huge pincers! Or dodge a sand crab’s crushing claw and the beak of a vulture-like alicanto when your players approach a shady oasis. And forget about safely searching pots, since it’s likely that something dangerous is living inside. Not even night is safe, since those welcoming lights in the distance may be the deadly flames of will o’ wisps in disguise!

Each enemy comes with multiple recolors, so you can mix-and-match to make battles look more interesting or use those recolors to clue your players into some elemental weaknesses! This pack also includes high-resolution versions of each battler, which you can resize to perfectly fit your game’s resolution. No need to worry about a tiny battler on a huge screen when you can shrink the HD version down to the right size! Fill your deserts with some fitting and deadly foes with Nemo's Desert Battlers Pack 1!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2135130/

Fill your towns and villages with happy greetings and quest-starting cries with NPC Male Villagers Vol.2! TK. Projects is here with another enormous voice pack, with 120 Japanese voice SEs to help you flesh out more of your NPCs and characters. Give your villages’ cheerful boys happy shouts of hello, the local merchant a depressed sigh when his shipment doesn’t come in, and the grouchy old nobleman an angry screech if your heroes enter his house!

This pack’s 12 different voices come with 10 SEs each, giving you options for all sorts of situations. Have screams from middle-aged men clue your players into a dangerous situation in the village marketplace, or have a young farmhand give a surprised yelp when he finds a horde of carrot-chomping jackrabbits in the veggie patch! Happy greetings could help your players realize which villagers they should talk to first, or let those greetings give NPCs more to do than just walk randomly around the village.

You can also use these voice clips to spice up a cutscene. Maybe a village’s timid boy who sells crafting materials refuses to say more than mumbled greetings to strangers until your heroes prove that they’re friendly. Or the village elder who spends most of the day sleeping finally wakes up with a happy shout right when your heroes are showing a relic they found and gives that last clue they needed to find the demon lord! Give even more of your NPCs a voice with NPC Male Villagers Vol.2!
