notes.title: New: KR Jackpot - Casino, NPC Female Citizens Vol.1, SeraphCircle Pixel Monsters
notes.notes:
Three new releases for your projects: Kokoro Reflections is back with new Casino Tileset, more NPC Voices, plus a pixel monster pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2135070/

Grab your gold and hope Lady Luck is on your side, because the KR JACKPOT - Casino Tileset pack is here! Kokoro Reflections has created the perfect pack for all of your gambling minigames. With tiles to make walls of slot machines, roulette and poker tables, and bar details to celebrate your hero’s winnings (or drown their sorrow after they turned 100 gold into a single coin), it’s time to give your game’s casino an incredible makeover!

Choose the right floor and walls from this pack for your casino depending on the location and just how rich the clientele is, the underground gambling house hidden away in a port town may stick with simple brown tiles and brick walls while the upscale casino near a city center goes with decorative tile floors topped with cheerful rugs and nice wood or stone walls. Or if your game is set in a modern or sci-fi world, then go wild with the neon teal and pink options, with geometric floors, neon floor lights and walls, and sturdy metal walls with built-in neon stripes. Fill your casinos with tables for card games like poker and blackjack or dice games like craps, topping some of them with dice, card, and chip tiles, or create walls of slot machines for NPCs to sit and play. Don’t forget that a casino needs more than just gambling to run! Make an in-house bar with plenty of drinks out of this pack’s shelves and counters, and set up a cash-out area with computers, cameras, and ATMs so your players can turn their hard-earned chips into gold.

This pack also includes 3 large door sprites to help you welcome your players into the casino with bright glass doors and decorative white patterns, or use the plainer white doors as a way to sneak into the casino’s back rooms to find out which villain is stealing people’s winnings. Give your game’s gambling club a bright and exciting upgrade with KR JACKPOT - Casino Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2135090

Bring some new NPC voices to your game with NPC Female Citizens Vol1! TK. Projects is back with another voice pack, this time focusing on a variety of women you could find in a castle city. With voice types from cheerful young merchants to creaky elderly women, this pack’s 12 Japanese voices are ready to help you add some cheer (or fear) to the town’s commerce section.

10 different SEs for each voice type means you have 120 SEs to choose from! Find the right voice clip for every situation with options for greetings, anger, agreement, questioning, thinking, worry, laughter, happiness, surprise, and fear. Have an energetic female blacksmith shout in anger when someone belittles her works, or give a happy cheer when your players agree to buy her unique and powerful weapons. Diversify your shop stall merchants with different voices, so that you could use the same NPC sprites in different cities but give them unique SEs to make them really feel like new characters. Let the same sprite be a happy middle-aged fishmonger in one town and a scatterbrained young shopkeeper in another. Multiple file formats make it simple to add these SEs to your favorite engine, so what are you waiting for? Pick up NPC Female Citizens Vol1 and give more of your NPCs voices!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2135080

Is your game lacking some gorgeous pixel art enemies? Have you been looking for more options when it comes to plant foes? Do you just want to include some unique creatures in your battles? Then it’s time to check out SeraphCircle Pixel Monster 1! SeraphCircle went outside and touched some grass to find inspiration for this pack’s incredible nature-themed battlers, with 58 unique battlers to choose from. Get ready to battle against the rose-themed half-man/half-plant alraunes, staff-wielding druids, sharp-toothed fish, hordes of flies, and man-eating plants found in this pack!

Have your heroes fight hornets, centipedes, praying mantises, and even spotted ladybugs when they explore a fairy’s garden, and let them face gross flies and cockroaches when they jump down the well to explore rotten underground tunnels. Or battle against trees, vines coiled around skulls, and puckering flowers while searching a forest poisoned by dark magic. If you need some more magical foes, then throw some butterfly-winged sylphs and glowing spheres of energy into the mix. Each battler has 2 versions, which include recolors and small variations in weapons or body parts, meaning this pack contains 116 ready-to-use battlers! Face off against teams of lightning-wielding yellow jaguars and water-wielding blue jaguars, or try to survive against a duo of green and red orges who are armed with a club and battleax, respectively.

And if that wasn’t enough, every battler also comes in 5 different scales, making it a breeze to find a fit for your game’s resolution and style. Use the 1x or 2x sizes for smaller screens so that the monsters don’t fill the entire screen or grab the 4x or 5x to create battles where the foes tower over your heroes! Fill your dungeons with weird and wild creatures and plant monsters with SeraphCircle Pixel Monster 1!

notes.title: New DLC: Beast Man Generator MZ, NPC Female Villagers Vol.2, Paladin Dream Music
notes.notes:
September is here and we have a beast of a release day for you! New generator parts for MZ, a new soundtrack, and more NPC voices are here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117780/

The title of this pack already tells you everything about its content, but let's take a closer look! This is a conversion of the Beast man generator pack for MV, which was carefully ported and reworked to fit the different poses and style of MZ. With it you get the parts to create brave big cat based, terrifying wolf based and majestic dragon based male characters straight from the generator.

With all the different horns, ears and tails you can individualize them to your liking, maybe you want a canine with floppy ears and a bushy tail or a more lion based feline with a tail with a tuft of fur at the tip and round ears? This and a lot more is possible with this set, and due to the huge amount of additional clothes to dress your beast men up, this pack could also be interesting for people that don’t necessarily plan on even having beast characters in their game.

With four different head pieces, a whopping twenty different outfits and four front and rear hairs each, this is a gold mine for everyone who is looking just for some more variation on male character parts as well. From fabulous armors to fabric clothing there is a lot to get, and you can round the look of your characters up by adding the little crown or the dashing and delicate golden headpiece made out of chains on their heads.

For all of you looking to add some further variation to your male characters, here you go!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117760/

Have your heroes adventure into a paladin’s dreams with the Paladin Dream OST Music Pack! HitherYon Games has released their game’s music for other RPG Maker devs to use, with 24 tracks that can find a home in your own games.

Start a somber journey to the slow Explore, with low horns and a music box’s chimes ready to play in the background as your heroes prepare to leave their destroyed home town. Once they’ve regained their will to fight, have your heroes explore their world to the steady beat of Wilds, or take a break while the jaunty tunes of Tavern plays. When it’s time to face the final boss let Evil play, with its calm pianos ready to trick your heroes into thinking this foe isn’t anything special right before it shifts into a life-or-death duel. Grab one of the pack’s vocal tracks such as Chant3 or Hymn to add some extra oomph to a scene. Why have your heroes enter a possessed church to a normal song when you could make the moment stand out with drums and a mysterious woman singing? Or have your credits roll while a song about heroes plays.

Alongside BGM, this pack also includes shorter ME tracks like Defeat, Game Over, and Victory so you can replace the defaults like you’ve been meaning to. With multiple file formats this pack’s tracks are simple to add to your games, so you don’t need to worry about hearing the perfect track but not being able to add it to your preferred engine!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117770/

Give more of your townsfolk voices with NPC Female Villagers Vol.2! TK. Projects is back with another set of 12 character voices to help bring life to your towns and villages. Have cheerful girls yell hello as your heroes walk by, a sleepy young shopkeeper groan if you wake her up without buying anything, or an elderly woman gasp in fear when your heroes ask for advice about a magical book they stumbled upon in a dungeon.

With 10 different SEs for each character voice, you’re ready to add some more emotional reactions to your female NPCs as they wander their hometowns. If your heroes start the game when they’re young, fill their village’s small schoolhouse with the calls of young girls as they play and try to avoid doing classwork. Teach your players the basics of side quests by having them hear the high-pitched whine of a scaredy-cat classmate who needs them to rescue her favorite toy from the basement. Or skip the childhood chapter of your game entirely, and use the middle-aged and elderly female voices for shopkeepers and townsfolk to add some extra noise to your game’s villages so that it has human chatter in the background. This pack is ready to drop right into your favorite engine, so if you’ve been wanting to add some extra liveliness to your NPCs then check out NPC Female Villagers Vol.2!

notes.title: New: Fantasy Heroine Character Pack 8, Bit by Bit Sound - 16 Bit Fantasy Music
notes.notes:
More characters, more music, it's time for another release day!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117700/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Heroine_Character_Pack_8/

Find some new fun and fabulous characters for your game in Fantasy Heroine Character Pack 8! Gee-kun-soft is back with another pack stuffed with character content. With 16 characters to choose from, ranging from a young lady knight and a flower shop-owning elf to a spunky twin-tailed grim reaper and powerful winged valkyrie, you’re sure to find a new character whose backstory writes itself for your game!

Each character has a sprite, a faceset with 8 emotions, front view enemy battlers, bust images, and a SV battler, giving you everything you need to form a story for your newest party member (or villain)! Find helpful allies in the armored solemn assassin, pink-haired berserker, staff-wielding monk, and brunette defender, or fill your towns with NPCs who can do more than just sell items, such as the young dark elf, careless elf doctor, and the cheerful maid who seems to have an unusual knowledge of ice magic. 

If you’ve been seeking some more mythological heroines, then this pack has you covered! Have an onyx-armored demon woman strike your heroes with dark magic, or turn a normal battle into a puzzle when a jiangshi hops into the battle and refuses to stay dead! Have the pink-haired grim reaper face off against an almighty goddess, joined by a mace-wielding 3-eyed fighter and an upgraded catgirl: a tiger girl! As a bonus, this pack also includes high-res images of the full body battlers, meaning you can turn them into larger busts or scale them to better fit your game’s resolution. Create memorable NPCs, dangerous foes, and adorably powerful allies with Fantasy Heroine Character Pack 8!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117690/RPG_Maker_MZ__Bit_by_Bit_Sound__16_Bit_Fantasy_Music/

Find that perfect retro-inspired track you’ve been searching for in Bit by Bit Sound - 16 Bit Fantasy Music! Bert Cole has created 9 stunning BGMs for you to use in relaxed towns, moving cutscenes, and creepy dungeons. With inspiration that seems to come from our beloved childhood RPGs and a mastery of synth instruments, this pack is full of the feelings of old-school games without relying heavily on robotic chiptunes.

Soar over the world with We’re Bird People Now, an upbeat track with a chipper beat and trumpet that has you imagining rolling fields of green just waiting for you to explore! Or have your heroes search the world for a powerful crystal to the beating drum with Onward!, which uses harps and horns to add a touch of seriousness to the track to help remind your players that they have something to lose if they fail. When your heroes discover a dark and forgotten cave, make sure they’re aware of the possible dangers they could awaken with Through The Grotto’s mysterious slow strings and echo-y chimes. And after the adventure is finished (or when your heroes need a nap!), have them visit a village where Feels Like Home plays with its calming tunes ready to help them relax and recover.

Each track comes in multiple file formats so it’s easy to add right into your game! So if you’ve been waiting to find just the right track for certain scenes in your fantasy adventure, tune in to Bit by Bit Sound - 16 Bit Fantasy Music!

notes.title: New DLC: Asian Empires Music Pack/Expansion, Super Retro World Characters Pack
notes.notes:
It's Wednesday, and that means it is... an early release this week! Check out the new expanded Asian Empires set from Joel Steudler, or a fantastic new set of characters for the Super Retro World style!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117620/RPG_Maker_MZ__Asian_Empires_Music_Pack/

Joel Steudler has revamped and expanded the Asian Empires Mini Bundle and created the Asian Empires Music Pack! Containing extended and remastered versions of the 8 tracks from the original pack, plus 12 all new tracks sharing the same Asian inspirations!

The three new battle tracks all focus on very different settings, Sunset Duel being lighter and grasping the carefully placed strikes, with Seven Samurai and Horse Archers being more gravid. They all would also greatly serve as the music to play during more intense cinematic scenes. Seven Samurais for example would fit an army marching up, ready for a fight. As the only dungeon track in this new songs, Prison Cells is very slow and quiet, with some sudden and distant noise, as if a door fell shut somewhere else.

Since your heroes probably won’t stay in one place there are four new tracks that would carry them to other locations. The Great Steppe, Pyroclastic Plateau, Shogun’s Domain and Ten Thousand Miles all have that “being on a journey feeling” to them, but each has its own unique sound patterns and vibe. And where are your heroes traveling anyways? No matter where they are going, they will likely stop by in a town, and with Fishing Boats and Peasant life you can pick the style of settlement they come to. Is it a calm place, by a sea or a river, or is it a little more lively, a place filled with hardworking people working on their chores?

To round the new tracks up, we have Jade Princess and Eternal Dynasty, two tracks that could work great as theme songs for characters or a dramatic scene.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117710/RPG_Maker_MZ__Asian_Empires_Expansion/

Already have the original Asian Empires Mini Bundle and want to upgrade to the full Music Pack? Then pick up the Asian Empires Expansion. This pack completes the mini bundle with the remaining material included in the full Music Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117610/RPG_Maker_MZ__Super_Retro_World__Character_Pack/

Depending on the type of game you make, this pack is either some fantastic looking additional assets or an amazing set that gives you everything you need to implement the battle mechanic you want!

But first things first: As every other iteration in this series, the Super Retro World - Character Pack comes in a charming 8 bit look and works with every other pack from this series or most other retro styles. If you look at the new characters, you might see some familiar faces… Basil, is that you? Due to the size the iconic characters are just recognizable if you really know them, and they all come with a recolor version so you have some additional diversity without putting any extra work into them. On top of that, you also get a whole bunch of monsters, most four directional and some static ones to have something to put against those heroes. And fight they can: as the special feature of this set is the Action RPG compatibility. Each of the character sheets in this set comes with a folder full of attack animations for all the human characters to be used in map battles!

With a whole pool of different shields, swords and staffs, you can not only cover a full range of classes, but also have the visuals change whenever your characters change their equipment.

In addition to the graphics you will also get a small tutorial on how to use them in VX Ace, MV and MZ with existing scripts and plugins!

And even if you don’t plan to have on map battles, those extra poses and characters still look dashing! Check them out and see if you like them!

notes.title: New: MT Tiny Tales Heroes - A New Beginning, NPC Voice Series Male Citizens Vol1
notes.notes:
New releases are here, this week focused on bringing new characters to life! Whether you are looking for a fantastic set of heroes for your pixel art game, or a set of voice SFX for your male NPCs, you've come to the right place.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111270/RPG_Maker_MZ__MT_Tiny_Tales_Heroes__A_New_Beginning/

Give your retro game the perfect team of heroes with MT Tiny Tales Heroes - A New Beginning! Mega Tiles' latest pack brings a crack team of 8 heroes to life in the Tiny Tales pixel art style, ready to battle against the dastardly demon king! With a sprite, face, SV battler, bust, and even an enemy battler for each character, you’ll be ready for anything with this pack!

Start your game dev journey by choosing one of the 8 heroes to be the main character. Will you choose the maroon-haired swordswoman or the brunette male fighter to lead the team, or go with the elven blonde archer with her long hair and cloak billowing out behind her? Maybe the childhood friend who joins the team is a hunky spikey-haired thief or an adorable blue-haired mage. Let the lightly-armored dancer or the female samurai be the enemy-turned-companion your heroes need to defeat before they join the party, or just have them offer their services for a price. The last, but certainly not least, hero is the dragon knight, decked out in heavy red armor and ready to lend a hand in a crucial fight! The dragon knight has two versions, one wearing a helmet and one without it, so you have have a special reveal of who is really is after he has helped

This pack also includes a weapon sheet with 12 unique weapons to help you equip your heroes! Give your samurai a swinging katana and your dragon knight a mighty spear, or have some fun by letting your mage wield a whip instead of a staff and giving your main character a heavy hammer instead of the expected sword. This pack also has a pixelated windowskin, so your messages and menus can match the party. Find a brand new team to inspire your next RPG with MT Tiny Tales Heroes - A New Beginning!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111280/RPG_Maker_MZ__NPC_Male_Citizens_Vol1/

Bring some chatter to your cities with NPC Male Citizens Vol.1! TK.Projects is back with another pack to help you give your NPCs a voice! With 12 different Japanese voices to choose from, get ready to bring your young shopkeepers, middle-aged merchants, and burly blacksmiths to life!

Each voice comes with 10 SEs for all sorts of situations, from friendly hellos and laughs to angry shouts and screams of terror. Let your heroes visit shops where the owner’s young sons call out cheerful greetings while they help stock or manage the register, or show that the young shopkeeper is new with some confused “eh?”s or murmurs to himself while he tries to remember how much the healing potion costs. Give the city’s big blacksmith a mighty laugh when your heroes tell him they want to buy the biggest sword he has, and then have the blacksmith shout in surprise when the healer lifts it one-handed! Have older shopkeepers grumble angrily or sigh when your heroes decide to leave without buying anything. Or have a handsome and mysterious fortune teller beckon then into his shop with a pleasant greeting, and then laugh when he realizes his crystal ball says he needs to join their adventure! With multiple file formats for each SE, it’s simple to add them to your favorite engine. If you’ve been wanting to add some talkative NPC men to your game, then check out NPC Male Citizens Vol.1!

notes.title: New: Shop Materials Tileset , NATHUHARUCA Door Tilesets, Fantasy Armor Parts
notes.notes:
The first release day of August is bringing a triple threat of fantastic new graphics packs: a shop tileset, fantastic doors, and tons of armor pieces for the generator!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2003831/RPG_Maker_MZ__Shop_Materials_Tileset__Interior__Exterior/

Have you been wanting to make your town’s shops all different but are lacking weapon tiles to do that? Do your restaurants need more food options? Is your wandering merchant camp lacking well-stocked shop carriages? Then you need to check out the Shop Materials Tileset - Interior/Exterior pack! Y-pot CO., LTD.. has created an incredible pack of tiles to turn your shops into true centers of commerce, with tilesets for A1 to A5 and B to E for both outside and inside maps!

Create towns with wooden or stone buildings off of paved roads and surrounded by white picket fences, or make a town center where large carts wait for people to approach and buy their wares and eat food from snack carts at round tables topped with umbrellas to protect people from the sun. Smaller details like shrubs, flowers, and hanging pots can bring some nature to busy city streets, and make sure to show your heroes the way with signposts and labeled boards so they can easily find the weapon shop. Once your heroes find the shop they’re looking for, use the interior tiles to make incredible layouts of weapons, armors, items, and food. Weapons and armor each have their own B sheets, offering you more than a hundred options! Give your starting shop simple weapons like daggers and wooden staves, while the royal city’s shops contain powerful golden greatswords, deadly tridents and glaives, and even gilded rifles! Have your armor shops display their multitude of chest plates, shields, helmets, boots, and capes on wooden stands or decorative display racks.

Animated sprites for flames, transparent water, and lanterns can help you add some movement to certain shops, and overworld sprites for the 8 carts mean your heroes can find places to shop even on the world map! As if that wasn’t enough, this pack also includes weapon sheets for all of the weapon tiles! That means you have 155 weapons for your party to wield, from slashing sabers to smashing mace and flying boomerangs! If you’ve been wanting to give your shops a major upgrade, pick up Shop Materials Tileset - Interior/Exterior today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072491/RPG_Maker_MZ__NATHUHARUCA_Door_Tilesets/

What great adventures lie beyond these large portals? May it be that they lead to large dungeons filled with treasures and monsters, ready to be explored and cleared by your heroes? Or are they magical passages to new worlds, acting as a bridge between different dimensions and timelines? Or maybe the architect of an important building felt like it needed a really impressive entrance?

Whatever it is, the NATHUHARUCA Door Tilesets brings plenty of options to add a special design to your key passages. From ones made out of natural materials such as the large arch shaped out of plants to massive standard doors to several other unique styles that could easily lead to a temple or different plane of existence, there is a lot to be found in here. All of the portals come in a version leading to light and dark and in case they have actual door panels, they have a closed version as well, so you can easily build quests around unlocking them. The arches on the other hand come with a transparent option, so you can add in yourself where they lead to in your game!

Explore exciting new worlds by passing through the NATHUHARUCA Doors!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072490/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Generator__Armor_Parts_Set/

With the daring adventures you are sending your heroes on, they should probably be well equipped to face whatever crosses their paths on this journey!

With the Fantasy Generator - Armors Part Pack, there is no need to worry for their safety! Since there are nearly hundred parts for each male and female included in this pack there is no way to describe all the goodies with just a few words! First of all, nearly all parts of male and female line up, so you can basically create males and females with matching outfits, which is amazing for enabling players to select the gender they want to play as or to uniformly equip the soldiers of a whole country!

This pack focuses on headgear, clothing and cloaks, all of them coming in all shapes and designs one could wish for!

Whether it is a flamboyant mage in a richly ornate robe and with exotic headgear, a more classical and down to earth soldier with simpler garments and a pointy hat or your typical guard with a practical helmet and chainmail, they all can get their whole outfits from this pack. Since it covers not only all the different types or armor but also so many different levels of quality and value, you can create an enormous variety of heroes and NPCs. You could even consider changing the outfits for your heroes once they worked their way up and were able to obtain better gear, saving legendary items like the dragon helmet and the matching body armor for your endgame!

If your game is set in a fantasy setting and you plan on using the default style characters, this pack is a must! Check it out to see yourself what treasures it holds!

Additionally, we have updated Particle System Plugin - TRP_ParticleMZ on Steam. to fix the following:
[list]
[*] Fixed group tag
[*] Fixed group command (call update immediately after execution)
[/list]The updated version of the plugin will automatically downloaded to your DLC folder. In both cases, you will need to manually update the plugin in your project to the latest version.

notes.title: New DLC: KR - Steampunk Airship Tileset, Retro RPG SFX Pack
notes.notes:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097310/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Steampunk_Airship_Tileset/

Gather your sense of adventure and leave your fear of heights behind with the KR - Steampunk Airship Tileset! Kokoro Reflections latest addition to the steampunk style offers up all the tiles you need to send rustic airships around the world! Have your heroes plan their next move while they sit in leather seats on a passenger ship, or give them their own airship where they can store their gear and fight off pirates with cannons!

5 different balloon sizes gives you options when it comes to airships such as longer trips requiring bigger balloons meaning your heroes will need to upgrade their ships as the game progresses, or use those different sizes to show airships floating by in the distance. Give airships small pre-built cabins when a cutscene calls for it or create your own hanging ship that your heroes can explore, full of crates, ropes, and barrels. Interior maps can contain the necessities for airship travel, with bunk beds and a hammock for sleep, chairs and tables for mealtimes, and even globes and maps to make sure your heroes don’t get lost!

Alongside all these tiles, this pack also includes animated sail wings and propellers! Make sure your heroes are never stuck mid-trip because the winds died down! And if that wasn’t enough, this pack also has 4 parallax images of different skies so that your heroes can fly so high in the sky that they can’t even see the ground. Take your stories to the skies with the KR - Steampunk Airship Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097320/RPG_Maker_MZ__Retro_RPG_SFX_Pack/

Are you tired of your retro game’s menus sounding like every other game? Then it’s time to check out the Retro RPG SFX Pack! Daydream Sound is here with a pack stuffed full of chiptune SEs ready to upgrade your game’s sounds. Ditch the defaults and add an extra layer of polish to your retro game with new SEs for your menus, battle animations, and cutscenes!

With over 200 SEs to choose from, this pack covers all your SFX needs! There are multiple options for menu movement and confirmation sounds so you can find the perfect one for your game. Beyond the menus, tracks for finding items, jumping around the map, and short jingles to help sell the mood. Did your hero fail to solve a puzzle? Then play a sad negative jingle. Just make sure to play them a cheerful positive jingle when they finally succeed! Your battles can also get an upgrade, with SEs for damage, defeats, physical attacks, and magical powers ready to be added to animations and skills. Blow your enemies sky high with fire magic and explosion sounds, or buff your party members with a chipper ‘w-w-woop’!

Each track also includes a version with an echo effect, giving you even more options! Use the echo version of an explosion SE to make an upgraded attack feel even more powerful, or give your menu a more sci-fi feel with beeps that sound like they’re bouncing off metal walls. The pack includes multiple file formats, so it’s easy to add these SEs to your favorite game engine. Give your retro game some new beeps and boops with the Retro RPG SFX Pack!

notes.title: New: KR Concert Hall Tileset, RPG Characters 7, Japanese School Girls - Music
notes.notes:
It's Thursday again, and that means new releases! And this week, we have 3 fantastic new packs for you, a new tileset from Kokoro Reflections, a new character pack, and a brand new set of tracks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090270/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Concert_Hall_Tileset/

Grab your tickets and glowsticks, it’s time to rock out with the KR - Concert Hall Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has created a set of modern tiles focusing on the rooms and equipment needed to build stages. Get ready to create maps where your heroes can dance the night away in neon clubs, lobbies with ticket windows where they can meet up for a first date, and even backstage rooms where your heroes can meet their heroes and see how they make that amazing music!

Concrete and metal grate floors make for easy cleanup after parties, and use neon light borders to help show paths when the room goes dark. Line the stage walls with speakers and large screens so the people in the back can enjoy the show too. Don’t forget the rows and rows of seating, and metal scaffolding that all the lights hang off of! Or skip the show entirely and have your game take place in the lobby and outside the building, where large signs tell people just what can be found inside. Add instruments like guitars, drums, and pianos to your backstage maps to show that those rooms are used for more than just naps, or set up an entire recording studio with sound dampening panels and microphones.

This pack also includes animated sprites for glass doors (tinted both blue or red to fit your building) to let your heroes into the building and all the backstage rooms, as well as glowing lights to light up the stage. Bright spotlights in red, green, blue, and pink could pulse in time with the band’s music, and sweep across the audience while they cheer. Smaller lights and sparkles can add some extra excitement to the maps (or help your heroes find their way when they need to sneak out mid-song). Give your heroes some exciting memories of rock concerts and raves with the KR - Concert Hall Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090260/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Character_Pack_7/

One of the cool things about an RPG is that you can often play and meet characters that are very different from what you know in real life. Here, demons, different kinds of elves and even demigods can be encountered and interacted with which opens up many interesting gameplay and narrative possibilities. Those and more new humanoid yet not fully human characters wait for you to tell their story in RPG Character Pack 7!

Meet the joyful Gorgon, who doesn’t need any heavy armor since the gaze from her petrifying purple eyes keeps any enemy at a distance… forever. Are the two dark and light elves each siblings, couples or maybe they are just enabling your player to pick whether they want to play a male or a female?

And talking about options, with the devil queen and a male devil alongside three different demons you can either fill up a town of demonkins or add a full group of matching antagonists to your game!

As always, the RPG Character Pack comes with large artworks, Charsets, SV Battlers, Battlers and Busts and Faces with emotions, so you can use the characters for any role in your story.

Is the cute blue-haired fairy an enemy or a friend? Will the Valkyrie be a helpful ally or is she up for something sinister that her smile would never lead you to think of?

Your game is the stage, and these amazing demihumans will play whatever part you assign them to!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090290/RPG_Maker_MZ__Japanese_School_Girls__The_Music_of_Their_Stories/

No matter how good a game looks, the music plays a huge part in transporting the mood and the emotions to the players. And if you are making a light-hearted game, perhaps one in a modern setting, the Japanese School Girls - The Music of Their Stories pack is just what you need to communicate the right vibes!

The thirty brand new tracks cover basically any situation you might want to score with matching music. Fitting the theme of the pack, even the more somber tracks are not deeply depressing, but rather soft with slow piano tunes. But those are comparingly rare, as most of the content of this pack is joyful and uplifting! Some of them are geared towards different times of the day, others are written to compliment situations as the classroom tracks or the “comical” one, which on its own might have you write a matching scene just so you can use the fun track in your project!

From the “opening” to the “ending”, there is not much left to ask for, but the pack even tops that and compliments the background music with twenty short jingles that you can add to highlight certain run-ins, events or the start or certain episodes! Sleep for example could be the tune that plays when there is a transition between different days in your game, or the Episode Halloween could mark the start of a halloween themed level!

Listen in and be inspired by all the great content in this pack!



‍

notes.title: New DLC: KR Steampunk Exterior & Interior Tilesets, 8bit Devils Castle Music
notes.notes:
Need some last minute additions for your IGMC entry? Doing something Steampunk, or perhaps something retro? Then maybe today's releases will be for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2077840/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Steampunk_Exterior_Tileset/

Grab your copper goggles and steam-powered weapons, it’s time to explore a brand-new town with the KR Steampunk Exterior Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has hopped onto the steampunk wagon airship to bring us all the tiles we need to create a city full of pipes and shiny metal decorations. Build shiny city centers, grimy industrial areas, and busy market places with this pack’s tiles!

Choose from wooden, stone, and metal walls to make your town’s buildings and top them with flat walkable roofs or angled shingled ones, with pipes sprawling between buildings and pumping steam power through the walls. Mark important buildings like the local inn or armory with signs, and let your heroes get a peek into not-so-important places with windows that let them see some of the goods for sale inside. String ropes between buildings and place filled crates in the industrial areas where railroad tracks lead out of town. And don’t forget to give the town’s kids a place to play with stylized swings, slides, and teeter-totters ready to be placed in a field near the town center’s fountain. Even the town’s plants have been touched by the steampunk style, with flowers blooming in metal pots and the trees seemingly growing strange decorations.

To make sure your heroes make it to places on time, this pack includes movable clock hands that match the large clock faces so you’ll always know what time of day it is. Have them solve puzzles using valves and levers to unlock copper-coated doors, or make them dodge old-fashioned cars that drive wildly on the roads! Bring your steampunk stories to life with the KR Steampunk Exterior Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2077830/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Steampunk_Interior_Tileset/

Let your heroes kick their feet up in a gear-encrusted inn or visit well-stocked shops with the KR Steampunk Interior Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with another steampunk pack, this time offering up tiles to help you map steam-powered laboratories and elegant studies. Create rooms with copper-toned wood, tile, or metal floors and decorative wallpaper, and show that certain areas of the floor are heated or lit with steam by adding piping autotiles around the room. Stairs that match each floor type can help you make multi-floor maps, giving you ways to lead your heroes down metal stairs into a dangerous basement or up carpeted stairs into a library stocked with rows and rows of bookshelves. Fill shops with crates of goods like bread and fruits or stock a clothing store with mannequins and steampunk outfits, with employees waiting for you by the cash register. Add couches, chairs, and food-covered tables to public areas of inns or taverns to give people a place to rest after a long day of work, all lit by a huge chandelier hanging overhead. When your heroes are ready to call it a day, let them relax in a hotel room with a soft bed in a decorative copper bed frame and an attached full bathroom.

Along with all of the small decorations, this pack also includes large pipes and hanging chains and ropes to build busy warehouses and labs full of gadgets and gizmos. Sprites for turnable valves, levers, and a copper-topped trunk give you options for interesting interactable scenes. Maybe your heroes need to turn off a pipe to draw a guard’s attention away from an office, or they want to steal some files from a villain’s hotel room. Create the perfect steampunk homes and labs with the KR Steampunk Interior Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2077850/RPG_Maker_MZ__8Bit_Devils_Castle_Music/

Find the perfect chiptune track to listen to while defeating the final boss in 8-bit Devils Castle Music! MoppySound’s music is full of chipper notes that are an excellent choice for retro games or for scenes that call for a nostalgic touch. 20 BGM options cover just about every occasion, ranging from high-energy boss battles to dramatic tracks perfect for an emotional cutscene and even a relaxed ending track to let your players know they’ve truly beaten the game while the credits roll. With 8 different field tracks to choose from, you can give each dungeon a specific BGM to make them stand out. Maybe the open mountain area can use a track with a straightforward rhythm, while the bandit’s hideout calls for a more mischievous track with toe-tapping tunes. And make sure to give the final dungeon its own dark and dangerous tune to keep your players’ guard up!

Also included in this pack are 13 MEs you can use to tie your whole game together. Make sure your victories and defeats have fitting chiptune tracks, and let your players know when they’ve solved a puzzle with a cheery set of chirps. Make sure your players can get fully invested in your retro game with tunes from 8-bit Devils Castle Music!

notes.title: New DLC: Never Ever Clean Up Tileset, Odyssey of Fantasy: Enemy Pack
notes.notes:
Sometimes, you get busy on your projects and things get a bit messy... well this release day we have a tileset to make maps in your game messy, plus a whole mess of new enemies!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2003830/RPG_Maker_MZ__Never_Ever_Clean_Up_Tileset/

Do you think your interior maps are too clean? Have you been trying to show that someone skips chores or that a place has been abandoned? Then it’s time to check out the Never Ever Clean Up Tileset! Wataru Nakanami has created decorative tiles for MV and MZ that can help add even more humanity to your maps with kitchen knick-knacks, hobby items, and more. The pack includes a filled B sheet for fantasy worlds and one for modern stories, making it easy to find the perfect addition no matter your game!

Grab the fantasy sheet to help stock a doctor’s office with shiny metal tools and stacks of books that haven’t been properly placed back in the bookcase, or a seamstress’s room with a wooden spinning wheel and old-fashioned sewing machine. Create the home of a gardener filled with potted plants and tools hanging on the wall, all lit by the soft glow of colorful lanterns. There are also translucent windows that you can add to certain shelves that can help tell stories all on their own. Have expensive books locked away behind closed panels, or show that thieves have already been here by having shattered glass in front of empty shelves. 

A modern setting can use the other sheet to turn boring rooms into filled apartments. Give your gamer NPC a multi-screen computer setup, with all of their electronics plugged into the closest outlet. Or give a home chef a proper kitchen with dark marble countertops and a four-burner range. This sheet includes two versions of certain tiles (clean and dirty), making it easy to show that some teens threw a party while their parents were away and forgot to clean up the pizza boxes, or just how much effort your hero went to turn a disgusting apartment into a livable place. And if all those tiles weren’t enough, this pack also includes some sprites to bring some gross and grimy movement to your maps! Have cockroaches run around the ground when your heroes explore the city sewers, or show that a room is disgusting by having swarms of flies and writhing maggots near rotting food. So if you’ve been thinking your maps are a touch too sterile, or just want to add some grime to your lazy NPCs’ rooms, pick up the Never Ever Clean Up Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621342/RPG_Maker_MZ__Odyssey_of_Fantasy_enemy_pack/

While the cause your heroes are fighting for is what makes your game interesting, the enemies they face on that way are what makes the actual fighting exciting!

With the Odyssey of Fantasy Enemy Pack you get 46 new obstaclesfor your party to overcome on their journey. Watch out when you enter the goblin territory, as they not only have standard little soldiers, but also archers, warriors, a general wielding a massive ax, a king that seems to possess spiritual powers and shaman-like wizards which wield their totem staff and one of five different magical orbs ready to attack! Better look closely to find out which element you need to resist, they could possess fire, water, thunder, grass or darkness powers!

And in the same fashion as the goblins, there is also a full orc tribe ready for your heroes visit! And the pattern of those five elements is woven into the whole pack, not only do the orc wizards fight with those as well, but there are also several other elemental creatures in here that have their own unique version for each element: There are cute elemental orbs, but also hauntingly beautiful female elemental spirits and dragons.

The whole set is rounded up by various ents, from a small stump to a normal sized one with a bushy crown to a bare one to a giant old one wielding spiritual powers plus more dragons, such as a baby dragon, a general dragon leading the armies of evil and a powerful yet elegant royal while king dragon. Your heroes should have their gear ready when they meet those, but the battles will be legendary!

[h3]Update: Particle System Plugin - TRP Particle MZ[/h3]

This plugin has had an updates. The following changes have been made:
[list]
[*]Added a new function to release the image cache automatically in editor (when use animation select picker)
[*]Updated the internal processing around the enemy state (to avoid plugins conflict)
[/list]The version in your DLC folder will be automatically updated, be sure to replace the plugin in individual projects to upgrade to the new version.

notes.title: New DLC: KR Deep Ocean Tileset, Into the Depths Music Pack
notes.notes:
It's hot out there, the perfect time to head to the ocean... or maybe under it. This week we have two releases that will take you on an adventure under the sea!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2068590/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Deep_Ocean_Tileset/

Have your heroes visit an underwater wonderland with the KR Deep Ocean Tileset! Kokoro Reflections must be able to hold their breath for ages to gather up the inspiration of this pack, since all of the plants and coral tiles come from the bottom of the ocean! Create a mermaid’s garden for your heroes to enjoy on their travels or dive even deeper to visit an old sunken battleship that may hide untold treasures.

Create ocean floors covered in short underwater grasses and sharp barnacles that lead to a forgotten pirate ship, with the unlucky crew’s bones scattered alongside gold coins and crates of stolen goods. Or send your heroes through a kelp forest, where lush aquatic plants form a maze between large shells and healthy coral growths. If you want to give your players more reasons to explore this underwater world, have them investigate sunken planes that possibly crashed during a brutal war, or show that people used to live in the area by placing carved stone arches and pillars where paths may have been.

Each decorative tile includes a deep water version to help you show just how little light is reaching the area. Let your heroes realize they may need to turn back for more oxygen before entering an underwater dungeon by replacing the bright green kelp with the blue-tinted deep water version, or have those bluer versions appear when night falls and the sun no longer shines down through the sea. If you’ve been wanting to have your heroes visit the ocean floor, dive in with the KR Deep Ocean Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2061900/RPG_Maker_MZ__Into_the_Depths_Music_Pack/

Exploring new worlds that we could never visit in person is one of the perks of gaming. And Murray Atkinson’s newest musical pack takes us somewhere, where we all probably have never been: deep, deep under the sea.

Into the deep is a collection of beautiful tracks that lets you feel as if you were under the water. Tune in, close your eyes and follow the music: visit the Reed Village, and enjoy the light hearted tunes and atmosphere or go on an adventure in the Secret Submarine, where the soft beeping of the machine itself, the mysterious sounds of your sonar and lamps and the bubbles in the water create their own unique and alien melody.

You can enjoy calm moments or get winded up in a sudden thrill - like a Shark Attack or the Triton Escape. Will you make it or will you find your resting place far under the waves?

If those are a little too exciting for you, how about going on another adventure by exploring the Underwater Caves? This track catches both the calmness of the water and some light sounds that resemble bubbles or light rays that could make their way through holes in the ceiling.

Those and more are among the fourteen amazing tracks this pack has to offer, listen in and let them take you and your heroes to the bottom of the ocean!

notes.title: Steam Summer Sale + 3 New DLC!
notes.notes:
It's that time of year everyone! The Steam Summer Sale! While you are looking for more games to play, be sure to head over and upgrade to RPG Maker MZ (if you haven't already!) or pick up some more DLC to flesh out your RPG Maker projects! And speaking of DLC, we have 3 brand new ones for you:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2061890/RPG_Maker_MZ__Winlu_Fantasy_Tileset__Exterior/

Have your magical adventure start right with the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Exterior pack! Winlu’s latest pixel art pack focuses on medieval-inspired buildings and foliage to help you make an incredible world. Create rural towns, flower-filled forests, stone cathedrals, and even a demonic castle with this tileset!

Build multiple towns with different building styles and groundcover thanks to well-stocked A1, A2, A3, A4, and A5 tilesets, along with diagonal roofs to help you make more interestingly shaped houses. Give areas custom looks with a wide selection of windows, and show which parts of town are ignored and overgrown thanks to winding leaf-covered vines that crawl up walls and dangle off roofs. Show how busy the business section of a city is with equipment like anvils, tanning racks, crates, and two-wheeled carts filled with goods. Or create a calm farm where piles of hay are stored next to the house and a scarecrow stands between crops while bright flowers spring to life outside the fields. 

The trees in this pack are designed to be modular, meaning you can mix and match to make custom forests in your game where similar tree trunks have different amounts of leaves instead of repeating the same tree over and over. This pack also includes animated decorations such as rotating water wheels, glowing lanterns, and banners that flutter in the wind to help bring your maps to life. Let a flame flicker in the town’s forge, and give each building a fitting door or gate with more than 10 to choose from! Unlock closed gates by pulling a wooden lever, or let your heroes rummage through treasure chests and boxes that they can open. Craft a beautiful pixel world with Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Exterior!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2062740/RPG_Maker_MZ__NPC_Male_Villagers_Vol1/

Are you worried that your male NPCs are a bit too quiet? Do you want to add some extra liveliness while your players wander town maps? Then it’s time to give NPC Male Villagers Vol1 a listen! 12 different types of male voices offer you a wide selection of short Japanese shouts, from cheerful young boys to energetic teens and even serious elders, perfect for giving your male villagers a voice no matter their age!

Each voice set comes with 10 different sound effects to let you choose the right one for the scene. Have your adult villagers say hello while your players walk by while boys run laughing and shouting happily as they play. Let your shopkeeper give an angry shout if your players try to swipe something from the store, and have a young man let out a worried sigh when asked about if they have any side quests to offer. Pepper an old man’s monologue with “oho”s and “eh”s, and have him huff if your players try to cut his hour-long story short. Or jolt your players into realizing this town isn’t as happy as it seems when a child’s piercing scream and mens’ horrified cries cut through the previously silent night. Every SE comes in multiple formats, so that you can easily add them to your favorite engine! Give your men some audio love with NPC Male Villagers Vol1!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2061880/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Mad_Science_Lab_Tileset/

Grab your lab coats and safety goggles, it’s time for science! Kokoro Reflections’ Mad Science Lab Tileset is here to help you build grungy dungeons where a killer zombie virus was created and an overconfident scientist brings a monster to life. Or give your heroes an underground bunker to recover in, where a ragtag team of scientists work on powerful machines to help the heroes defeat the robot overlords. 

Give your lab’s different areas unique looks by wielding 12 brown-tinged walls and wooden and concrete floors together with a selection of dirty details like rusty edges or rubble to make rooms at different stages of disrepair. Once your rooms are squared away, add in counters where you can store all of your scientists’ tools! Medical journals, note-covered papers, beakers and flasks filled with unknown liquids, microscopes, and even a brain in a jar can help your players judge exactly what type of person runs the lab. Beyond those modern tools, there is also a wide selection of machinery and sci-fi technology glows with an alien green tint, just what you need to explain where all the vicious chimera or robot enemies are coming from.

This pack also includes some animated levers and valves to help you add some puzzles to your lab dungeons. Have your heroes twist valves to get past leaking pipes and pull levers to open locked doors instead of just creating a huge maze to get through to reach the final lab! So if you’ve been looking for some tiles to give your mad scientist boss the perfect lair or want to create an alien hideout hidden away in a modern apartment building, pick up KR Mad Science Lab Tileset!

[h3]Resource Pack Update: Super Retro World - Exterior Pack[/h3]
The Super Retro World - Exterior Pack has been updated! Included in this update is the following:
[list]
[*] New autotiles A1 to A5 : animated water, waterfalls, roads, houses and dungeon walls
[*] Reorganised tilesets : more cliffs, grass textures, rocks, pillars, tents, trees (with snow and desert variation)
[*] New animated characters : cart, doors, chests, crystals, torches, switches, farming plants
[*] Fixed elements : indoor tiles, prebuilt houses, non animated water tiles
[/list]The version in your DLC folder will be automatically updated, be sure to replace the files in individual projects to upgrade to the new version.

notes.title: New DLC: Character Variety Pack, KR High School Tileset, NPC Female Villagers V1
notes.notes:
This week we have 3 new packs ready for you to bring your game to life. Let's take a look at all of them!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2053880/RPG_Maker_MZ__Character_Variety_Pack/

Do you want to spice up the roster of your game with some unique and cool female characters? Those twelve beauties are ready to play any role in your story, from heroine to NPC to enemy, they can be whatever you want. Is the fire sorceress with the eyepatch a strong and seasoned adventurer and part of your party or a bounty hunter that challenges you? And is the purple skinned demon girl with the feisty look in her yellow eyes an ally or an enemy?

As all these come with not only a sprite, but also an SV and enemy battler graphic, busts, and faces with a full range of emotions, there is nothing you can’t do with them! Plus with the large extra artwork for each of them, you can even put together a title screen or custom menu! And the mixture of various different characters is what makes this pack so versatile and fun! On top of the ones we've already mentioned, you also get an Alice in Wonderland like girl with a matching blue and white dress and innocent face, a mysterious kyubi lady wielding a fan, amd a princess who decided to serve her country as a knight in fashionable yet sturdy armor and ready to protect her loved ones, and more.

Another added bonus is that two sets of the heroines - the kimono lady and the yurei, plus the princess knight and the SFX heroine, share the same base and hairstyle, giving you the chance of implementing them as one character in different outfits!

So find the heroine of your next game with the Character Variety Pack

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2053870/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_High_School_Tileset/

If you’ve been searching for tiles to help you build the perfect classrooms for your high school-based game, your search is over thanks to KR - High School Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a modern tileset perfect for creating unique school locations. Let your players show off their athletic abilities on sporty maps, confess their love in the music room, or search for a cure to the zombie virus in the science lab!

Choose from tile, brick, and linoleum flooring to find the best option for each classroom depending on how much is spilled each day, or send your players outside during recess to play on grass and concrete covered in jungle gyms, swing sets, and slides. Let your PE class do more than just run laps thanks to tiles for diving boards, basketball hoops, and white lines to outline a football field. Have your players spend their time after school with the science club in the lab classroom with test tubes set up on each table. Or let the drama club perform on the school’s stage, with spotlights shining on the stars and speakers playing music in the background. Even the school hallways get some love in this pack, with lockers and two-tile high windows ready to fill the walls alongside the mandatory fire alarms and exit signs.

Make sure your players can get to school on the large school bus sprite, with two versions (one with ‘school bus’ on it and one without) to choose from. And don’t forget to show your teachers some love with a teacher’s lounge stocked with coffee makers and desks covered in computers and notes. If you’re making a game based in a school, make sure to add more details to each classroom with KR - High School Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2053860/RPG_Maker_MZ__NPC_Female_Villagers_Vol1/

Adding voices to your game can add a lot of depth to the emotions expressed, but hiring a full cast for every character can quickly add up by a lot. But if you still want that little extra, the NPC female villagers pack is just for you! This pack gives you a variety of expressive voiced sounds designed to give a little voice to each of your characters. Have the scared villager actually scream when the orcs attack or have the little girl make a sound of joy when she greets you. Sprinkling over your dialogue to express various emotions and situations can give your female NPCs so much more character! 

Each of the twelve unique characters comes with the same set of ten expressive sounds. From greeting to laughing to joy to surprise to fear, a full range of emotions is here! And the characters themselves also cover a broad roster of personalities and ages, from an eccentric old lady type to a mischievous girl!

Give your NPCs the voice they deserve with the NPC Female Villagers Vol.1 pack!

Classical Favorites Update

Additionally, we have updated the Classical Favorites Pack. If you own this pack on Steam, the version in your DLC folder will be automatically updated. Remember to update the files in your projects where you are using them!
