notes.title: New DLC: KR Palaces - Chimera, Blood Animations, Suspense Music Library V1
notes.notes:
This week, we have a lineup of three new packs. Get new tiles, new animations, and new music!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025150/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Chimera_Tileset/

Does your steampunk kingdom have a ruler who can’t decide whether a lion, a snake, or a goat would be the best national animal? Give them the option to choose all three in a single creature with the KR Legendary Palaces - Chimera Tileset pack! Kokoro Reflections took the Greek chimera and built some interesting tiles based on it so that you can create a fantastical steampunk castle for your heroes to explore. Traverse copper halls, avoid deadly spike pits, and explore rooms with huge gears poking out of the walls all while statues of chimeras guard the halls!

Metal flooring and walls show their use with rust and dirt, making it easier for you to create a busy place without pristine halls, perfect for a dwarven castle or an academy where experiments often run wild. Bright green crystals decorate columns and statues of the mythical chimera, ready to light the way when your heroes are lost or to lead them to a trap. Wander under arches topped with gears and leaping chimeras, or pause in front of a large clock window to make sure that you’re not late to a meeting with the queen. What if you wanted to create an ancient castle? Then make use of the grimy moss and cracked autotiles to weather the floors and add to the palace’s apparent age. Hopefully your heroes notice when they wander into a room that was recently cleaned, because whoever or whatever is living there may not be happy to meet them…

Light your castle rooms with two different green-tinted flames, and let your heroes swipe royal goods from treasure chests shaped like decorative pots. If you have been wanting to make a palace with a steampunk theme, need a rusty dungeon, or just feel like showing some more love to the monstrous chimera in your game, make sure to check out KR Legendary Palaces - Chimera Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025140/RPG_Maker_MZ__Blood_Animations_Pack/

Blood, the juice of life. Inside our body it is vital and keeps us going, and what it can do outside of it is what you can see in this pack! The blood animation pack comes with 20 unique blood effects to be used in battle or on the map. Whether you have a caster with more sinister spells in your party, want to give your demonic enemies the properly matching graphics for their attacks or just want overlay gory scenes with a little extra splatter, there are many reasons to pick this pack up!

With animations such as a bloody slash with tornados or explosions made out of blood, this pack will not only give you the needed graphics for spells you already had, but also inspire a whole new set of techniques! The blood heal animation might accompany a powerful healing spell that comes with some darker side effects, or the blood spear could be a powerful attack that draws some health from the caster. And we all know that the blood rain animation will accompany something that will not go well for the other side of the battle.
 
Thirsty for more blood? Then be sure to check this pack out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025160/RPG_Maker_MZ__Suspense_Music_Library_Vol1/

Does your game need some electronic music to add the right mysterious tones to a scene? Has your cyberpunk hero been blamed for a crime that they didn’t commit and now needs to prove their innocence, and you need some fitting background tracks? Then it’s time to check out Suspense Music Library Vol.1! TK. Projects’ latest music pack brings you 20 BGMs perfect for setting the scene and keeping your players’ attention on the story.

Have one of the pack’s intriguing tracks play while your players explore a crime scene at a bar, with New Evidence or Plan2’s electronic rhythm playing in the background to help them keep their mind focused on finding hidden secrets. Or let Crafty, with its quick beats and electronic strings, fill the room while your players rush to put together the clues to solve a puzzle and get one step closer to finding out who is causing all the trouble. For those quieter moments grab a song like Tragedy, where bells and strings take control and offer up a tune fit for realizing just who set your hero up or for exploring a normally cheerful location at night when everything is dark and silent. And if your players make a mistake and blame the wrong person for the crime? Let Disastrous Scene play its slow piano and ticking clock while your players see just where they went wrong.

Don’t overlook this pack even if your game is focused on battles! Since many of the tracks have a rapid-fire beat and toe-tapping rhythm there are plenty of choices when it comes to battle tunes! Find the right tracks for your modern mystery or your sci-fi adventure with Suspense Music Library Vol.1!

notes.title: New DLC: 8bit Retro Graphic Materials AiO, Particle Plugin - TRP Particle MZ
notes.notes:
It's June! Summer is here (for those of us in the Northern Hemisphere). And that means... staying inside in the AC working on your game. Man, it is hot out there. And we have new releases to carry you through! This week we have a new all in one retro style graphics pack and a plugin for enhancing your game with particle effects.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967141/RPG_Maker_MZ__8bit_Retro_Graphic_Materials_AllinOne_Pack/

There are many retro packs out there, but their biggest flaw is that most of them cover just a small portion of the graphics you need for a game, such as the battlers or maybe the tiles. The 8bit Retro Graphic Materials All-in-One Pack stands out, as it is REALLY an all in one pack!

It doesn't just include all the tiles to make an extensive fantasy game from the deepest dungeon to the highest tower and even a matching world map, no! There is an extensive collection of heroes and NPCs - human, animal and monster! And not only do all of them come with a matching face graphic, but all the heroes have SV battlers and there are even unique battle weapons to go with this new style!

And if you'd rather use a front view system, each actor also comes with a unique battler for that style as well, as well as basically everything you could want to battle in such a setting, such as sandworms, trolls and skeletons, just to name a few. And if you now think, wow, that is a really well rounded set, there is even more: with 93 different animation sheets you can create the matching animation for basically every spell or attack you might need, plus it includes everything you need for your UI: buttons, icons, balloons and the windowskin have all been taken care of. There are even battlebacks and a wide selection of premade title screens and overlays you can combine with them!

If you ever wanted to make a game that just looks and feels like the JRPGs you played on your handheld many many years ago, you don’t have to look any further: all you need is this and you are set!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2003832/RPG_Maker_MZ__Particle_System_Plugin__TRP_Particle_MZ/

Does your fire dungeon need some flickers of sparks floating in the air and smoke rising from pillars of flames? Do your rivers and ponds need ripples as raindrops hit them while your heroes run to get out of the storm? Do your heroes need to kick up some cartoony clouds of dirt while they run? Then it’s time to check out Particle System Plugin - TRP Particle MZ! Thirop Games. is here with a set of plugins to help your particle dreams come true!

With a wide selection of preset particles to choose from, you can easily add some impressive effects to your maps. Have your campfires send smoke into the sky while fireflies lazily float around the edges of your camp, or turn up the heat in a volcano with angry red magma highlights and raging fires spewing out of cracks in the ground. When your heroes explore the icy tundra make sure that there are snowflakes falling on them, or make the empty plains dangerous to cross because of a cascade of lightning bolts raining from the clouds! You can even send your heroes to the bottom of the sea (in a protective air bubble of course) where the entire map ripples and shadows of fish swim overhead.

Beyond the presets, this pack also includes an edit function to help you tweak your particles to perfectly fit your map. No need to adjust a number in an event and then playtest to see it in action, this edit function lets you do it all while the game is running so you can see all the changes as you make them! This barely scratches the surface of this particle system, so if you’ve ever wanted to add some extra sparkles to your game check out Particle System Plugin - TRP Particle MZ today!

notes.title: RPG Maker MZ - v1.5.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello RPG Makers!

We would like to thank you for your patience. The highly-anticipated v1.5.0 update is finally live! In this update, you will be able to select different tile sizes and have a smoother experience with all the other fixes. As always, we appreciate your support! We hope you are enjoying it so far.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new feature to change tileset size starting from "16", "24", "32", and "48."
[*] Added the ability to copy/paste tileset settings on a page-by-page basis.
[*] Added "Toggle Skip" function to disable event commands for specified range.
[*] Added a new feature to the shadow pen. When holding down Shift, it will turn to rectangle mode.
[*] The maximum number of major database items can be increased up to 9999. Previously, you can only go up to 2000.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated Effekseer version to v1.62d. This fixes a minor bug.
[*] Added "Switch" template (for example: levers, buttons, etc.) to Easy Event Creation.
[*] When making an event using Easy Event Creation, you can now give it a name.
[*] Fixed issue with NW.js window remaining after closing battle test.
[*] Fixed an error in combat where enemy characters whose images are set to "None" would cause a crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where repeatedly opening and closing the "Select Image" window could force the editor to close.
[*] Fixed an issue with "Fade: None" in "Move Location" that would cause a momentary rendering glitch.
[*] Fixed a bug in the tutorial.
[*] Updated "official" plug-ins:
     * PluginCommonBase.js
     * TextScriptBase.js
[*] Updated the following launch plug-ins:
     * BattleVoiceMZ.js
     * EffekseerForRPGMakerMZ_Ex.js
     * ScreenZoom.js
     * SimpleMsgSideViewMZ.js
     * SimplePassiveSkillMZ.js,
     * SubMembersAttendBattle.js
     * SVActorPositionMZ.js
     * TinyGetInfoWndMZ.js
     * WeatherOnBattle.js
[*] Removed "CommonEventStepRegion.js" from v1.5.0 because some functions do not work. For RPG Maker MZ 1.5.0 and beyond, please use "RegionBase.js" instead.
[*] Updated some events in dlc "RemakeMapResourcePack". 
[/list]

[h2]How to update your project(s):[/h2][list]
[*] [b]Create a backup of your project or only its data and js folders.[/b] Updating can sometimes cause your project to break so this is for the safety of your hard work!
[*] Update your project by going to the Main Tool Bar -> Game -> Update Corescript option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38018723/231654061e5d79959bb5829e5427f6ecebebb9f1.png[/img]
Latest Corescript version: [b]1.5.0[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: New DLC: KR Legendary Palaces - Golem Tileset, Heroine Character Generator 8 MZ
notes.notes:
Release day! Two more packs are here to make sure your games look just the way you want them to! First up, we have a new Palace tileset ready to rock, and then we have more MZ generator parts for your heroines!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2009890/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Golem_Tileset/

Your heroes might just have wandered into something that looked like a cave from the outside, but what they found on the inside will leave them in awe. Here, underground, someone - or something? - has built a beautiful structure that looks like it could have been here since ancient times. The walls and floor seem to be mostly created out of the surrounding ground, shaped to form a place where someone or something reigned centuries ago.

Did a golem or a golem maker sit on this throne? And are those statues or golems that froze in place and waiting to be resurrected again? Stalactites have formed on some of the decorative elements since they were made, hanging down from gems and archways. What might lie hidden in the treasure chests your heroes can spot in the mysterious blue light that the torches emit? And is that murky water or floating sand that they see in giant basins and falls?

This palace surely does look like it was left a long time ago, but maybe something is still lurking around, ready to protect it… from adventurers like your party.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2009900/RPG_Maker_MZ__Heroine_Character_Generator_8_for_MZ/

Being ready to battle is one thing, but looking dashing while fighting is another! With the Heroine Character Pack 8 for MZ you get plenty more outfits and design choices for your female party members, NPCs and antagonists!

From witchy parts for your magic driven characters to modern and eastern inspired parts, there are many new options you might want to try. Wrap your heroine in a super long sleeved dress to make her a mythical spellcaster or choose a nice jumpsuit with gloves for a fierce spy lady.

Or maybe you rather want her to be a cute girl with a fashionable dress with ruffles? You could round her design out with many different headpieces, and if you are in the mood you can place a little chick on her head. For more animal companions that are constantly with your heroine you also have a parrot which can be added on the shoulder!

And of course this pack doesn't just come with a whole load of new wardrobe items: with the fancy new hairdos and unique eyes you can add more character to your… well, characters! Innocent or feisty, the faces of a character should reflect their personalities, and with those five new pairs of eyes you have a whole new range unlocked!

Do you prefer open long flowing hair or pigtails? Well, you can have both and a combination now, plus two braided looks that are gorgeous! With the added five bangs ready to mix and match, there is no doubt you can create a beautiful heroine you will love!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Legendary Palaces - Griffin Tileset, MT Trees
notes.notes:
Thursday is here again, and we have two more Resource Packs ready for you to use for your game. Another new Palace Set from Kokoro Reflections and a whole lot of tree tiles from Mega Tiles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2001890/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Griffin_Tileset/

Let your players soar through the air to discover a castle in the sky with the KR Legendary Palaces - Griffin Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with another pack, this time creating gleaming tiles inspired by the regal griffin! Create incredible rooms of marble and gold, decorated with fitting statues and windows that any fan of griffins will love.

Build high walls of golden bricks atop animated clouds and let waterlily-filled waterways of bright blue or deep purple run next to marble paths. Create pits of spikes to keep your heroes from wandering too far from the action or use the spikes to create a puzzle where they need to climb ladders to find a new route. Large statues of gold griffins, wall hangings of pure white silk, and embossed wings can turn any castle room into a gorgeous location for your heroes to take a break from exploring. When they’re ready to move on once more, golden archways can help tell your heroes which paths are most important, with the arch decorated with pouncing griffins leading into the throneroom where the ruler sits on a dais covered in gold and emerald jewels. 

Make sure your players can see the full glory of each room with golden flames illuminating the white marble walls, and reward them with gold-lidded treasure chests for exploring forgotten rooms in the palace. If you’ve been wanting to create a gilded castle in the sky or a surprising palace buried deep in the mountains, make sure to check out the KR Legendary Palaces - Griffin Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2001900/RPG_Maker_MZ__MT_Trees/

Do you be-leaf your maps could use more trees? Is the root of your map’s problems the lack of stumps and bushes? Then it’s time to find some fitting foliage with MT Trees! Mega Tiles new pack offers up a great selection of trees to help grow your forests and gardens.

The basic trees come in 3 different sizes so you can create areas with newer, smaller trees while the ancient dead locations contain thick-trunked leafless trees and old fallen logs. Give your forests healthy undergrowth with bushes, roots, and saplings that can also serve to keep your players from wandering off the intended path. If you want to make sure your players know your game takes place in spring, then grab the sakura trees with their soft pink foliage and dot your maps with them. Each tree comes in 5 different colors, so you can create an autumn feel with orange leaves or a magical forest full of blue-leafed trees without needing to edit anything.

Beyond the trees, this pack also includes extra plants such as cacti, snow-covered evergreens, and flowers to help bring other biomes to life! Let your heroes hop onto giant water lily pads to cross rivers, or create a dangerous garden of carnivorous plants that can’t wait to eat them. If you’ve been thinking that your outdoor maps have been looking a bit drab and lifeless, up your gardening game with MT Trees!

notes.title: New DLC: Grid Map Tiles RPG Maker Edition, NPC Voices
notes.notes:
This week, our releases feature a brand new gorgeous tileset, and some amazing English voice acting!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967140/RPG_Maker_MZ__Grid_Map_Tiles__RPG_Maker_Edition/

If you ever wondered how you can fuse a grid based style and beautiful painterly assets into one perfect set of map assets, the Grid Map Tiles are all you need to see.

With enough tiles to create a full game in a fantastic medieval inspired setting there is not much left to ask for: the set even comes with day and night and winter versions for each outdoor sheet! There is so much to love about this set: from the creative and charming designs to the perfectly matching structures, each piece itself has its own beauty!

In a world built with these tiles, your heroes can explore various places: They can wander around on plains, admiring the large and detailed trees and the unique flowers and mushrooms, perhaps resting at the crystal clear water of a lake. But they could also enter a cave, natural or man made, maybe their quest led them into an abandoned mine? In the end they will get back to civilization, and there is so much to see here that they might not even want to go back adventuring!

The large selection of market stalls invite them to stay a little while, maybe they buy a giant swordfish, get their armor repaired at the blacksmith shop or just get some brand new armor from a different stall. After that they could visit the local castle, look for an inn to stay or visit some of the NPCs' homes. Whichever option it is, there is so much to explore, as each of the tilesets in this pack are crammed with carefully designed lovely details, from the optional fish to the little board next door where the inhabitants store their key and purse.

This whole description scratches the surface on what this amazing pack has to offer, so you better go check it out and see what else it has for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1993880/RPG_Maker_MZ__NPC_Voices/

Voices can add a lot more flavor to any game, but getting good voice actors can be difficult and pricey. With this amazing pack you get the work of six talented English language voice actors to implement them into your story!

The three male and female artists each recorded the lines for each archetype, giving you 6 variations of 6 different archetypes to choose from, allowiing you to choose the speaker for the role you consider the best fit for your story. That means it is up to you if you want the barkeeper to be female or the villager to be male. You could also decide to use all of them for the same type of character and have six voiced shopkeepers all with different voices! On top of the barkeeper, villager, and merchant lines: you also are provided for voices for guards, refugees and priests. 

The writing and acting is on point, matching the different personalities and moods and creating believable characters that could inhabit your adventure!  Being it a lone survivor of a burnt down village telling your party “If you leave me here, I will surely die” or the gentle cleric offering “Let me help you, just come this way”, the snippets are ready to bring some more depth and life to the interactions with your NPCs. Rounding out the whole pack is a nice collection of high resolution pictures to represent the various characters!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Legendary Palaces - Harpy Tileset, Welcome to My Nightmare
notes.notes:
For our first release day of May, we have another new KR Legendary Palaces set, and another fantastic music pack from ayato sound create!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1986740/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Harpy_Tileset/

Are you tired of making dungeons themed around boring, commonly seen, monsters like goblins or dragons? Create a castle themed around an unusual creature with the KR Legendary Palaces - Harpy Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another addition to their Legendary Palaces series, this time focusing their attention on half-man/half-bird harpies. Build a colorful castle with bright marble floors and copper art deco-inspired decorations!

Choose from copper, green, purple, and black marble to build your walls and floors. A poor harpy could get their talons caught in carpet, so those are wisely left out and replaced with simple and complex tiled designs to show important paths to your heroes. Large dark holes let harpies fly between floors, but make sure to use the included railings to keep your heroes from falling to their doom! Diagonal stairs help your heroes explore other floors filled with angled art and impressive statues of harpies in the castle, and to help them reach new heights you could also use the pack’s ladders to wander the different levels on a floor that harpies can easily fly to. Perhaps those ladders can lead your heroes to a magic circle that can send them straight to the demon king’s palace!

With this pack’s animated green and reddish-orange flames, you can light your heroes’ way to the throne room… Or the way to the treasure room, where copper containers can have their tops knocked off and the goodies inside taken. Just be aware that this move is certain to turn the harpies from friendly doves to furious raptors! Build a unique castle or hideaway for your heroes to discover high in the mountains with the KR Legendary Palaces - Harpy Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1986750/RPG_Maker_MZ__Welcome_to_My_Nightmare/

Give your rough and tough scenes some fitting rock music with Welcome to My Nightmare! This pack’s 20 tracks take a uncommon approach to background music, relying heavily on guitars, base, and drums over orchestral instruments to craft rock tunes that are a perfect fit for modern games. Bring a rocking club to life, explore dark alleys, and take on deadly gangs with this pack’s tracks!

Put your players on edge with the addition of a buzz to an electric rock song, warning them that there’s something not-quite-right about this building they’re exploring. Or create an underground rock club where your players can gather some intel that blasts electric guitar riffs and rhythmic vocals from the band on stage. When it’s time to fight for their lives, make sure your heroes have an appropriately rocking track! Pick one of the tracks with raging guitars or solid drum beats to keep the adrenaline pumping. And when it’s finally time to take a breather, let your players take a step into cold night air and watch the glowing neon signs that decorate the tall walls around them while calmer beats float out of a nearby restaurant’s door. Or grab one of the few tracks that forgoes guitars entirely and consist of a steady beat to help keep your players’ focus as they search an abandoned building for clues.

Each track comes in multiple formats so that you can easily add them into your favorite engine. So if your game has been begging for some rock songs or you’ve been searching for some guitar-heavy tracks to help set the mood in your modern cities, check out Welcome to My Nightmare!

notes.title: New DLC: Pixelated Animations Pack Vol.2, Sprite Height Modifier
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1978680/RPG_Maker_MZ__Pixelated_Animations_Pack_Vol2/

Getting a consistent look over all the different graphical resources in your game can be a huge chore, especially when you aim for a clear and pixelated style, matching animations are hard to find. The second iteration of the Pixel Animation series fills this gap with 32 amazing and unique animations for your projects - no matter whether you use Ace, MV or MZ. With not only the sheet but also set up animations and instructions on how to import them they are as quick and easy to use as they can be and they look dashing at the same time!

You get eight different animations each for fire, water, wind and earth, allowing you to have a range of skills with distinct patterns! From softer blows and small tornados to water bubbles and fountains, there are a lot of cool tricks your heroes can pull off with these!

And if you go with a matching style for your sprites and tiles, many of the animations will look amazing on your maps as well, for cutscenes or you can pull out the burn animations for your typical RPG village getting burned down…

There is a lot you can do with those, so check them out and see what you want to make out of them!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1925963/RPG_Maker_MZ__Sprite_Height_Modifier/

Sometimes the default resources just don’t match the tone of the game you are going for. This can especially be the case with the default character sets, as no matter how cute and well made they are, the 1:1 head to body ratio can look way too cute for the setting of your game.

The Sprite Height Modifier is an easy to use plugin that helps those out who want a shortcut to taller characters without reworking all the graphics! By adding it to your project and setting the ratio you are going for, the plugin automatically stretches everything below the head by the value you chose, giving the chance to choose the size that works for and looks best to you.

You can even go as far as using different ratios for different characters, allowing you to have characters of varying height in your game without any extra work! This also allows you to exclude chest and object sprites from being affected by the change. To have the adjusted sprites blend in even better, the plugin also affects the height of the bushes.

So if you ever considered having taller characters and were intimidated by the amount of work that goes into this change, maybe this is the route you want to go?

notes.title: New DLC: P. KONEKO Monster Design Pack FV, P. KONEKO Monster Design Pack SV
notes.notes:
This week's release is special! Two complimentary packs that recreate monsters with the same names, but completely different designs! One for Front View, and one for Side View (Though many can be used for either!) So let's look at the P. KONEKO Monster Design Packs!

Give your players some new fearsome foes and enthralling enemies to battle against with two packs this week: P. KONEKO Monster Design FV and P. KONEKO Monster Design SV! Parabyo Koneko. created these packs using a painted style to bring some incredible enemy ideas to life. With 37 enemy types in each pack to choose from, get ready to battle against banana slugs (emphasis on the banana), moon-devouring wolves, and musicbox mimics in the FV pack and pink bunny slugs, demonic three-headed wolves, and a decidedly UN-happy meal burger mimic in the SV pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1925961/RPG_Maker_MZ__P_KONEKO_Monster_Design_Pack_FV/

The FV and SV packs share the same naming conventions for each battler, but put their own spin on them! The FV dragon’s red scales and six-limbed design are reminiscent of European dragons while the SV dragon’s serpentine body bursts from the ground as its extra eyes search for its next meal. Have your fantasy heroes face off against the FV dullahan who wields a spinal cord whip from horseback, or send your heroes to a steampunk or more modern world with the SV dullahan who rides a magic-powered motorcycle! The FV and SV taur enemies switch which body parts are monstrous with the FV being a bull-headed minotaur and the SV a green-furred centaur, and even the most common of enemies, slimes, have their own unique looks! Battle the FV slime in the field where its bulbous body that holds a small heart inside can bounce along the ground, and find the SV slime (in an adorable gummy bear form) in a magician’s tower where it escaped the bottle where it had been imprisoned! With other enemies such as skeletons, fairies, merfolk, dragonewts, and even satan, you’ll be sure to find fitting foes for all over your game’s world!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1925960/RPG_Maker_MZ__P_KONEKO_Monster_Design_Pack_SV/

Each battler comes in three sizes: normal for smaller resolutions or common mobs, big for larger resolutions and boss monsters, and the original size (which is the largest so that you can shrink them down to perfectly fit your battles). And if having three different sizes to choose from wasn’t enough, each pack also includes an arrangement folder where you can find each battler split into separate parts for its body, effects, and shadow so that you can tweak it to better fit your vision! Want to have an extra option where the FV mimic chest doesn’t have coins and drool spilling out of its mouth? Then leave off the effects image. Or show that you’re facing off against the SV lesser daemons high in the sky by removing their shadows! So if you’ve been searching for some new monsters for your heroes to face or just love seeing an unusual style to kickstart your brainstorming session, check out both P. KONEKO Monster Design Packs!

notes.title: New DLC: MT Tiny Tales Battlers Elemental Forces, KR Legendary Palaces - Naga
notes.notes:
Another week, another set of releases. The KR Legendary Palaces and MT Tiny Tales sets grow yet again, with a new palace style and more Tiny Tales battlers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1970950/RPG_Maker_MZ__MT_Tiny_Tales_Battlers__Elemental_Forces/

It’s time for your heroes to battle against storms and nature itself thanks to MT Tiny Tales Battlers Elemental Forces! Mega Tiles is back and this time is bringing elemental enemies to life with pixelated battlers perfect for side view fights. With elemental options for water, fire, wind, earth, ice, storm, nature, light, and dark

18 unique monster designs give you options for all sorts of elemental battles. Face off against golem-like earth elementals and  tornado wind elementals high in the mountains, or sail the high seas while battling wave after wave of water elementals and storm elementals that appear as living thunderhead clouds crackling with lightning. If battling literal elements doesn’t quite fit your game’s world, don’t despair! There are also prime elementals in this pack, which gives each element a more humanoid form to fight. Battle against a witch wielding lightning, a wrestler with rock skin, or even a well-dressed woman with icy blue skin instead of the lesser elementals, or use these prime versions as bosses. Each design also comes in 4 variations, giving you 72 battlers to choose from! Warn your players about poisonous attacks by using the purple-vined nature elemental or turn an earth elemental into a metal one by picking the shiny gray version.

This pack also includes sprites for each battler, meaning you can have flame elementals chase your heroes before the battle starts or turn a prime elemental into the unusual owner of a village magic shop. And each monster graphic comes in three sizes (original, 2x, and 3x) to make it easy to add into your favorite engine! Add to your Tiny Tales collection and give your heroes some new challenging battles with MT Tiny Tales Elemental Forces!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1970960/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Naga_Tileset/

Ssslither into a brand new cassstle with the KR Legendary Palaces - Naga Tileset! Kokoro Reflections’ latest pack brings gorgeous serpentine-inspired palaces to life with waterways, floors, walls, and statues to create a space unlike any other. Brilliant teal, pink, black, and gold wall and floor tiles are ready for you to build stunning rooms for your heroes to explore!

Keep snakes in your players’ minds with scalloped tiles reminiscent of scales on the walls or floors, and tell them without words just who rules this palace with golden statues of naga coiled around arches and columns. Mark the important routes with wavy gilded edges to the floor and glowing orbs on the walls and topping sculptures, and warn your heroes not to go a certain way with sharp spikes blocking their path. When your heroes finally reach the throne room, give your naga queen a comfortable place to rest with a cushioned low throne instead of a generic gilded chair.

This pack also includes pink and teal flame sprites to help light up your naga palace’s floors and waterways, with thin flames ready to be placed on decorative pillars and a raging fire for when your heroes have pissed off the castle’s ruler. And one way you could upset the naga ruler is by opening their gilded treasure chest, which you can animate thanks to the included treasure chest sprite! So if you’ve been wanting to give your naga characters a palace to call home or have a rich nobleman who has an obsession with snake-tailed women, pick up KR Legendary Palaces - Naga Tileset today!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Legendary Palaces - Winged Unicorn Tileset, Heroine Character Genera
notes.notes:
It's release day, and this week we have new entries in a pair of our resource pack series: Make some new heroines with our latest Heroine Character Generator for MZ pack, and give them a fun new place to visit with the latest KR Legendary Palaces pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1964070/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Winged_Unicorn_Tileset/

Who doesn't love unicorns? And wouldn’t it be amazing to visit a floating unicorn themed rainbow colored palace above the clouds? With the newest entry in the Kokoro Reflections Legendary Palace series this dream can become reality for the heroes of your game!

Visit this spectacular building and gaze upon the beautiful craftsmanship that went into it. With giant gems shimmering in all colors of the rainbow encrusted in ornaments, statues and pillars out of pure gold there is a lot to see and enjoy while being there. Who might reign about this fantastic palace, sit on the winged throne, maybe flanked by giant unicorn statues? Maybe someone who adores unicorns or maybe one of the magical creatures themselves? And how did you come here? Maybe you flew here, maybe you walked up on the included rainbow tiles.

As always this pack is well rounded and comes with everything you need to turn the beautiful maps you make with it into fully fleshed out dungeons: animated flames in matching colors, twinkles and a matching chest animation, a whole set of water to utilize if you wish to have some, various beautiful parts to customize the building to your liking and even a matching cloudy parallax to lift the palace up into the sky!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1964060/RPG_Maker_MZ__Heroine_Character_Generator_6_for_MZ/

If you are lacking just the perfect parts to individualize your heroines, you have come to the right place! The sixth iteration of the heroine character generator part packs for MZ is here and it comes with a lot of goodies you won’t want to give a pass!

Dress your ladies into one of 20 different new base outfits and combine it with one or multiple of the twelve matching accessories to get just the perfect look. Maybe you want a nun, complete with vestment and matching veil to be the cleric of your party, or maybe you are aiming for a beautiful kimono girl with flowers in her hair. Or maybe you just want a modern cute dress that you mix with the adorable short cape decorated with a ribbon and round the outfit up with the matching off centered small hat with a ribbon as well.

Whatever you are going for, there is more in here beyond just clothing. Five unique pairs of eyes will help you to make your heroine's faces stand out as well, and so do the five front and rear hairs each that allow plenty of fancy combinations! From a high ponytail with a braided element to various types of tied up hairs, the rear hairstyles this time make sure the hair does not get into the way when fighting too much. Mixed with one of the cool bangs in the pack they will make a great choice for your female characters!

[h2]Resource Pack Updates[/h2]

The following packs have all had their animations updated to fix some slight issues:
[list]
[*] KR Legendary Palaces - Reaper Tileset
[*] KR Legendary Palaces - Dryad Tileset
[*] KR Legendary Palaces - Mermaid Tileset
[*] KR Legendary Palaces - Phoenix Tileset
[/list]
Additionally, the following packs have had updates to the windows contents:
[list]
[*] User Interface Material 1
[*] User Interface Material 2
[*] User Interface Material 3
[*] User Interface Material 4
[*] User Interface Material 5
[*] User Interface Material 6
[/list]
These files will be automatically updated in your DLC folder. Any versions in your project files will need to be replaced with the new versions.

notes.title: New DLC: MT Tiny Tales Battlers - Monstrous Uprising, RPG Character Pack 6
notes.notes:
For this release day, it's time to add some characters to your games! Choose from a new set of pixel monsters, a set of 16 new heroines, or pick up both!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1948590/RPG_Maker_MZ__MT_Tiny_Tales_Battlers__Monstrous_Uprising/

Do you have just the perfect retro tiles for your game and are looking for some monsters to populate your maps? The MT Tiny Tales Monstrous Uprising matches the tiles from this series but can also come in handy for other styles as well!

This set comes with 18 unique monsters that all come with several color variations, resulting in 86 ready to use monsters! Or are these even monsters? Given that they all are humanoids, you could even use them as heroes in your game, if you like! There is a full tribe of orcs that even have their own shaman and are ready to battle.

So are the naga, from the one dual wielding swords to the beautiful naga queen with a trident they will not be too happy to have an adventurer walk into their realm. The same is to be said about the kobolds, those three guys have picked up spear, sword and staff and don't seem to be happy to meet your party!

All of these come not only with multiple well rounded color variations, plus a unique sprite and battler each which means you can have on map encounters for all of them as you wish! For more convenience, the files all come in the original size or scaled for either VX/Ace or MV/MZ, so you can just plug and play them in the engine of your choice!

Get your weapons out and be prepared to meet those creatures! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1948600/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Character_Pack_6/

Every RPG is just as good as the characters you can play or interact with. And if you are looking for some more possible options to illustrate such a cast, you came to the right place! The 6th iteration of the RPG character packs brings you a total of 16 heroines to spice up your roster!

If the place for the spellcaster in your party is still vacant, why not have one of these girls jump in? You can choose between a confident elemental master, a young and perhaps a little inexperienced healer going on her first quest, a powerful magic master with a gorgeous custom dress, a cute magician girl with a witch’s hat and a fancy short dress or a warrior priest, who combines metal elements and a super sweet outfit into one cool design.

There are even more options for classes that fancy physical attacks, each with their own well rounded look and iconic weapons. It is totally up to you, if you want a more exotic class such as a grim reaper, complete with scythe and a black hood or you rather go with something more common as the forest guardian, a beautiful sword wielding blonde lady ready to fight for her home! No matter which role you want to give to these characters - hero, NPC or enemy, they come with all the files needed: busts and faces complete with emotions, static and animated battlers, a full charset with three downed poses each and even a full artwork that you can utilize as you want - maybe on your title screen or in a custom menu.

Check out these cool ladies, you might want to have them in your game!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Legendary Palaces - Reaper, MT TIny Tales Character Sprites NPC Adv.
notes.notes:
We're back again to expand two Release pack series with some awesome new entries. A brand new Legendary Palaces set, visiting the land of the dead, and a whole bunch of new characters for the Tiny Tales series!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941480/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Reaper_Tileset/

Send shivers down your heroes’ spines when they step into a fearsome new castle with KR Legendary Palaces - Reaper Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another palace set, this time focusing on a grim and spooky underworld. Explore dark throne rooms decorated with looming statues of a grim reaper and courtyards full of dead trees and gravestones, but keep an eye out for spike traps! This deadly castle doesn’t expect you to leave alive.

With a monochrome palette, this tileset feels like it has drained the life out of the world. Deep purple-tinged water and unearthly purple glows are the only pops of color beyond your heroes, making your heroes a prime target for anyone who doesn’t want this dreary place to change. Use special wall tiles that fade into a light grey at the bottom to seamlessly blend the walls into the foggy floors to twist rooms into places where it feels like the whole space could just disappear into a dreamlike fog.

Certain tiles, including archways, statues, and the throne, have a version with a light glow around the bases to blend into the foggy grounds and a version without. These versions are perfect for showing when the area becomes ‘alive’ or when your heroes have accidentally released the castle’s cruel ruler who had been sealed away for centuries. This pack also includes some fog overlays, so that you can add another level to your reaper palace’s spookiness! Create an ethereal underworld castle with KR Legendary Palaces - Reaper Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941500/RPG_Maker_MZ__MT_Tiny_Tales_Character_Sprites_NPC_Advanced/

Create busy towns and castles with MT Tiny Tales Character Sprites NPC Advanced! Mega Tiles latest release is stuffed with adorable character sprites to help you populate your retro games. Fill your taverns with adventurers, your battlefields with knights, and your castles with nobles so that your heroes never feel lonely when they visit new locations.

With more than 150 sprites to choose from, it’s easy to make sure your towns don’t suffer from identical twins living next to each other! Station bandana-wearing sailors around a city’s port while lightly armored soldiers patrol alleyways, keeping an eye out for scarred rogues or angry warriors dressed like vikings. In taverns or shopping in the marketplace you can place townsfolk in simple outfits and with different hairstyles, from young girls with ponytails to older merchants with a large balding spot where his luscious hair used to be. Use some of the heavily armored knight sprites to keep your towns safe, or have them join your heroes on their adventure. Each knight has two sprites, one where they’re wearing a helmet and one without, meaning you could have cutscenes where the mysterious knight is revealed or just have the off-duty soldiers be more comfortable without their horned helmets. When your heroes visit a kingdom’s castle, make sure that they say hello to the grey-haired king wearing an impressive crown or to the princess in a silver circlet before they start exploring the rooms where well-dressed noblewomen and men meet for business.

Each sprite comes in 3 sizes (original, 2x, and 3x) so you can add them right into your favorite engine without needing to change a thing. And if all those options weren’t enough, this pack also includes base templates so that you can create your own custom characters! So if you’ve been wanting some more pixelated people to choose from or just love the Tiny Tales style, make sure to check out MT Tiny Tales Character Sprites NPC Advanced!

[h2]Update: Degica Dream Pack MV ｰ Modern[/h2]

There has been an update to the Degica Dream Pack MV - Modern pack to fix a bug.

● In the MV folder> Fixed a bug in the "DDP_M_01" image in faces.

The files in your DLC folder will be automatically updated. Just replace the file in your projects from the DLC folder.

notes.title: New DLC: Meal Time Tileset - Modern Edition, Fire and Flames Sound Pack
notes.notes:
Today's releases are making me hungry, with a whole new tileset of delicious modern style food, and a second pack that covers the sounds of every kind of flame you can imagine! Ever wanted to cook a burger with a dragon's firebreath? Then you need to get these two packs together!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1925962/RPG_Maker_MZ__Meal_Time_Tileset__Modern_edition/

What is a visit to the cinema without a giant bucket of popcorn? A romantic dinner date without a nice meal, such as sushi? A Sunday breakfast without croissants and a beautiful loaf of bread?

Food can do a lot to round a scene out or even serve as the main star of it. The Meal Time Tileset - Modern Edition now comes with all of the mentioned plus more. Plenty of meals, drinks, and dishes to feed your heroes through your game!

From beer to various soda - bottled or canned - and wine, no one has to stay thirsty anymore! With all these tiles, you can set up a fun bar or pub scene with a drink matching every characters' taste. The cute teacup on the other hand might be used at home, it can be placed on the table while the bronze kettle stays on the stove.

And for the actual food… well, whether your heroes want to eat at a fast food place and consume hot dogs or a burger with fries, if they want a salad or sushi at a restaurant, or if they rather have some sandwiches and some fruit at home - there are so many options. Have them enjoy some ice cream with friends or serve some ham and cheese plates to their guests - adding those foods to various situations or even building some around them will add a lot to your game!

Check out this amazing set and don’t blame us if you are hungry afterwards!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934490/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fire_and_Flames_Sound_Pack/

Fire has its place in nearly every game, as a magical element, a background feature, or the centerpiece when the party relaxes around a campfire.

Every kind of fire can make it's own unique sound and this amazing pack by Daydream sounds brings you an astounding 102 different atmospheric noises that flames in your game can make!

Whether it is a fireplace in a room as the weather comes down outside, or a huge bonfire at a campsite, you can be sure to have the perfect match in this pack. There are even loops for even more specific situations such as a burning forest where your heroes might venture forth to save someone. And while not technically a flame, your lava can now either gently bubble or gently flow, scorching everything in its way… at least on the audio side of things!

But this pack has more than ambient sounds, a huge part of the pack supplies you with everything you want to keep your mage’s fire spells exciting and diverse. From meteors crashing onto your enemy over various whooshs and bamms to sounds that match a fire shield being cast in defense. Dragon fire, burning paper, gas flames and even ones meant to be used when a fire skill misses… even by just naming most of the tracks and giving suggestions where to use them we could spend hours.

So best you listen in and decide yourself which you like best and where you want to use them!

notes.title: New DLC: Heroine Character Generator 5 for MZ, SF Beats Music Pack
notes.notes:
It's Thursday, and that means it's time for new releases! What new packs are in store for you today? Another Heroine Character Generator pack makes its way to MZ and a new soundtrack for your Sci-Fi world!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928950/RPG_Maker_MZ__Heroine_Character_Generator_5_for_MZ/

Get ready to create powerful angel warriors and Asian-inspired noblewomen with the Heroine Character Generator 5 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft’s latest pack includes 47 MZ generator parts to help you create the heroine you’ve been imagining. 

With 20 different clothing options to choose from, you can make sure each character has her own outfit to fit her personality. Give your sneaky ninja a flowing scarf and pants while your royal mage rocks a flamboyant dress with large sleeves and a dramatic cape. Or make a magical girl inspired game with modern tops and colorful skirts. The pack also includes 5 eyes, front hair, and rear hair parts, so you can give them an even more unique face. Give your youthful heroine large eyes and hair half up in twin tails, or have her feel more mature with kind eyes and long hair tied in a low ponytail.

Clothing and hair options aren’t the only thing to be found in this pack though, its accessories, tails, and wings can also help you make the perfect character! Create a powerful kitsune that may help (or hinder, depending on their mood) your party with nine fluffy fox tails and perky fox ears, or give your demonic teammate a spike-tipped club tail. Use some of the generator parts to show changes instead of just telling the player about them, such as giving your angel character a halo and huge white wings until someone frames them for a crime and strips them of their angil status, leaving them with the tattered bat wings of a fallen angel. Or give your heroine a decorative tiara when she’s earned a reward for saving the kingdom’s youngest princess. Create amazing heroines with Heroine Character Generator 5 for MZ!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903000/RPG_Maker_MZ__SFBeats_Music_Pack/

Give your not-so-perfect sci-fi cities some fitting music with the SF Beats Music Pack! Perfect Circle has created 12 BGMs that will help you tell the story of your game’s world without words. This pack knows that not every science fiction world should have perfect electronic music, and mixes instruments with sound effects like dripping water to create the right ambience for seedy cities or dangerous taverns.

Give your heroes a sense of hope with electric guitars and a positive beat as they enter a new city, or warn them right away that something’s not right with a slower track with an almost uncomfortable tone. Instead of a recognizable drumbeat during a song, grab one of the tracks that uses a deep pulse to keep the beat to add to the uncertainty of the location. That pulsing beat must be coming from the pipes that run all over the city and not from anything more sinister, right? And if your heroes do find out the truth, add some fitting music with furious beats to the scene where they confront the monster who’s ruining the city.

With multiple file formats to choose from, it’s easy to add these tracks to your favorite engine. Give your players another way to explore your dangerous steampunk or sci-fi world with the SF Beats Music Pack!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Legendary Palaces - Dryad Tileset, RE-D Music Pack 3
notes.notes:
The first release week of March and we have two new packs for you to enjoy. The KR Legendary Palaces sets expand with the beautiful nature of the Dryads, and the third RE-D Music Pack is here to add even more tracks to your game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1922430/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Dryad_Tileset/

You can smell the heavy and sweet odor of the large mysterious pink blossoms as well as the earthy scent of the tree bark as you enter the Dryad palace. Whoever built this place, architecture and nature are woven into one, leaving you with the beautiful combinations you are now exploring. While one room might be made out of ornamented tiles and walls, the next could already be fully covered in leaves.

This symbiosis of grown and formed things also reflects in everything else you can find in this structure. On a throne out of stone you can find flowers and vines and roots and leaves are wrapped around delicate pillars.

Whether this place needs additional water or not is up to you, but there is a full set ready to use, complete with water lilies and a waterfall, so you can shape the location just as you want it to be.

To bring some more interactive elements into this area, there is also a matching treasure chest as well as some mysterious pink and green flames, which would be great for puzzles or to light it up.

Adventures lie ahead, and watch out… whoever built this place, might still be around!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1922400/RPG_Maker_MZ__RED_MUSIC_PACK_3/

Do your heroes need a little break from fighting all the time? How about some more scenic and mostly relaxed parts?

The RE-D Music Pack 3 brings you ten beautiful and diverse tracks for your game to add a lot of atmosphere to various places and situations your party could encounter.

Such as a nice and upbeat shop soundtrack that makes getting new gear so much more enjoyable! A lot more tense is the track that was labeled "Thinking", a great piece to underlie situations where your heroes have to make a tough decision. Will they accept the offer of the villain or stand their ground, even if the chances of winning are low? Or is it about which path to take, knowing that each of them has its own risks?

Five of the tracks are called “Scene” and they could not be more different. From lighthearted and playful "Scene02" to the grave and danger implying "Scene04", everything in the emotional range in between is reflected.

The other three beautiful tracks are just what their names suggest: a fun and relaxed tune for ""Hot Spring", music that suggests something is lingering in the dark for "Horror" and a carefree atmosphere for "Picnic", but we're sure you can find a lot more scenarios to use them than the names suggest. Listen in and find out where you want to use them!

notes.title: RPG Maker MZ 1.4.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello RPG Makers!

The latest update, Version 1.4.4 is live! 

Thank you for using RPG Maker MZ. As always, we appreciate your support! 
We hope you are enjoying it so far.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented a countermeasure to the problem that may cause the NW.js process to not terminate normally in Windows environment.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the cursor position would move to a different page when any frame was selected in “Create MV- compatible data” and the frame was deleted while editing the frame view.
[*] Fixed an issue in which events would appear at unintended coordinates after switching maps and loading events with “Autorun” events.
[*] Fixed the problem of "File name "None", Volume 90%, Pitch 100%" when "Play SE" is edited in ”Set Movement Route”.
[*] Fixed an issue in which fade-in was not performed when loading data if the project data had been changed.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues in v1.4.4[/h2]
There is an issue where the game does not automatically close after executing Enemy Group -> "Battle Test".
Workaround.
・Please close with "X".
・Restore main.js to a previous version (update the core script).

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
We will share the updating information regarding this issue with you as soon as possible.

[h2]How to update your project(s):[/h2][list]
[*] [b]Create a backup of your project or only its data and js folders.[/b] Updating can sometimes cause your project to break so this is for the safety of your hard work!
[*] Update your project by going to the Main Tool Bar -> Game -> Update Corescript option.

Latest Corescript version: [b]1.4.4[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: New DLC: Ann - Art School Tilesets, Darkest Hour
notes.notes:
The vibes for this week's releases aren't going to be bright and cheerful. With a set of tiles perfect for a horror school setting, and a brand new soundtrack perfect to bring the edge to your game, these packs can help make your grim game even grimmer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903001/RPG_Maker_MZ__Ann__Art_School_Tilesets/

If you’re a fan of horror games and pixel art, then you need to check out Ann - Art School Tilesets. Karrina and Rongrong have teamed up to release a pack of tiles from their horror game Ann! With tiles focusing on an art school vibe, this pack’s A5 and 4 B sheets are ready to help you make a world for your student hero to survive.

Create a school with fashion, music, and art departments by keeping things in separate buildings, or combine them all to make a huge museum for your players to explore! Create common areas with vending machines and couches to relax on, and don’t forget to include the small offices for professors. With a selection of paintings and sculptures (along with broken pieces) to choose from you can make sure your maps look well-used by students and visitors. Don’t worry about those red stains near the wall, I’m sure they’re just leftover paint. But maybe avoid the old wing of the school where the floors are warped, the walls are grimy and torn, and you swear the piano just moved closer…

Also included are exterior tiles to help you build modern city streets. Create tall white buildings that loom over busy streets, and keep your walking NPCs safe by adding crosswalks and streetlights to your maps. Or create a small outside roof map for your hero to get some fresh air and escape any dangers inside. Just don’t linger too long, because who knows what could follow them up the stairs.

The pack also includes sample projects for MV and MZ, so you can see how the tiles all work together. If you’ve been hoping to add a new museum (haunted or not) to your game, or just love the look of Ann’s tileset, then pick up Ann - Art School Tilesets today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1890440/RPG_Maker_MZ__Darkest_Hour/

Have you been worried about your game’s music being too cheery and upbeat for the story’s tone? Then it’s time to check out the Darkest Hour music pack! ayato sound create’s newest pack contains 20 tracks to give your game the right background music for your moodier scenes.

With a focus on electronic beats, this pack is perfect for modern or sci-fi games! Explore cyber cities or busy malls while the beats thrum in your players ears. Battle against thugs with the strumming of electric guitars playing in the background, or choose one of the tracks with a heavy and fast paced beat to keep your players focused on the fight. Or grab the more haunted tracks with creaks and almost ghostly wails to turn an empty building into someplace creepier and much more dangerous. Even the more upbeat tracks still carry a bit of underlining darkness, meaning that you can give your players a slight feeling of unease even during happy moments. After all, that cheeriness can’t last forever, right?

And with multiple file formats for each song, it’s easy to drop them into your favorite engine and start using them right away! Give your busy streets and lonely bars some fitting tunes with Darkest Hour!

notes.title: New DLC: MT Tiny Tales Dungeon Tiles, Heroine Character Generator 4 for MZ
notes.notes:
The RPG Maker Festival continues! But for now, it is time for our favorite day of the week: Release Day! We have two new packs ready to go, another pack in the Tiny Tales series, and another Heroine Generator pack are here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1662630/RPG_Maker_MZ__MT_Tiny_Tales_Dungeon_Tiles/

Did you like the MT Tiny Tales Overworld Tiles or do you like well made, pixelated retro tiles in general and can’t get enough of them? Lucky you, as today the Dungeon Set for the series has arrived!

No matter whether you fancy a modern maker as MV or MZ or if you would rather stick to VX or Ace, you will find that this set comes set up for both, so you can just import the version you need and are good to go! And going for what? Well, there are four main themes in this pack, each coming with a broad variety of tiles to make maps for it.

Maybe their journey has led your heroes into a mine, either still up and running with tracks and carts and tools or abandoned, with broken barrels and plants slowly overgrowing what was left. On the other hand, maybe they visit a well guarded city, with a giant wall around it? With additional color options and even snowy versions, this construct could be placed anywhere in your world. It could be a centerpiece, an amazing “sneak past the guards into the town” part of your game, or the place where your heroes stand and stare into the distance as the enemy's army arrives.

And while any larger town could have such a wall, you might want to have an actual dedicated fortress - and this pack gives you a great one! With various gates, wall options, tiles for a protecting moat around it. There are many adventures that could start here!

If you are looking for a more special type of dungeon, the last one might be just for you! The tech fortress tiles can be used to map both inside and outside of said building, combining medieval-like features with somewhat contemporary technical devices. Did a time traveler strand here? Was an evil scientist able to develop technology that is far superior to anything we find in the world around? Or maybe a certain group of people was able to proceed beyond the rest of the world, but has mysteriously vanished and your heroes explore their remains?

What it is is totally up to you and you can probably come up with many more ways to use these amazing tiles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1890441/RPG_Maker_MZ__Heroine_Character_Generator_4_for_MZ/

If you are wishing there was just a little more variation when it comes to the MZ generator and your heroines, well, there is no wishing anymore!

The Heroine Character Generator Pack 4 was optimized for MZ and is ready to add some great pieces to select from for your beautiful female characters. With 38 unique pieces and additional custom battle weapons it will take a while until you run out of options again.

Does your heroine sport an imaginative hairstyle which includes her hair being formed into a bow tie on her hat or does she have a cute bun and ponytail on one side? These and a simple but beautiful short cut rear hairs can be combined with any of the three available bangs for many fun combinations.

And talking about fun combinations, don’t the witchy dress and the demonic wings go perfectly with each other? Probably as well as the two sets of beast ears and tails, allowing you to create a red panda girl character, complete with a matching furry outfit! Or do you want a fairy, with translucent wings and matching antennae? You can dress her up in any of the twenty different outfits. With the pompoms and a matching sports dress, she might even become a cheerleader at your fantasy school?

And that's just the beginning of the themes found here, from a watery dress with a matching headpiece to a chinese style or cowgirl parts, there are many more great things to create your heroines with!

notes.title: RPG Maker MZ Planned Upgrades / "RPG Maker MV & Soaring Machinariae ”bundle
notes.notes:
[h3]■RPG Maker MZ Planned Upgrades[/h3]

Hello, RPG Makers.

Thank you for your continued journey with the RPG Maker series.

With the excitement of the RPG Maker Festival in full swing, we’d like to take this time to also announce the many thrilling features coming to the latest title in the series, RPG Maker MZ, later this year.

[h3]v1.4.4 (coming soon)[/h3]
-Will implement a countermeasure to the problem that may cause the NW.js process to not terminate normally in Windows environment.
-Will fix an issue in which the cursor position would move to a different page when any frame was selected in “Create MV- compatible data” and the frame was deleted while editing the frame view.
-Will fix an issue in which events would appear at unintended coordinates after switching maps and loading events with “Autorun” events.
-Will fix the problem of "File name "None", Volume 90%, Pitch 100%" when "Play SE" is edited in ”Set Movement Route”.
-Will fix an issue in which fade-in was not performed when loading data if the project data had been changed.
-Will fix an issue in which a weapon with a sealed shield and a weapon set to "Dual Wield" in the traits could be equipped with a weapon with a sealed shield if the dual wielding weapon was equipped first.
-Will fix an issue in which the weapon in the second slot (shield slot) would remain in the event command "Weapon = None" when the feature "Dual Wield" was set.
-Will fix an issue in which the target of HP recovery was taken away when the feature "Substitute" was set.

[h3]v1.5.0 (Spring 2022)[/h3]
-Will add the ability to select tile size from "16", "24", "32", and "48".
-Will add the ability to copy/paste tileset settings by page.
-Will add the ability to switch the shadow pen to draw/erase rectangles by holding down the Shift key.
-Will change the limit on the number of database items.
-Will add the ability to temporarily disable event commands in a specified range.
-Will add "Switch" (assign images of levers, buttons, etc. on the map to any switch number) to Easy Event Creation.
-Will add the ability to add the corresponding event name to the name field in the easy event creation.

We have been listening to your feedback, and we hope you look forward to seeing your opinions shape the future of MZ.

We thank you for this opportunity to further improve RPG Maker MZ with help from all of you.


[h3]■"RPG Maker MV & Soaring Machinariae ”bundle[/h3]

This is a bundle set of the 2D action RPG "Soaring Machinariae" and RPG Maker MV.
*Soaring Machinariae project files and materials that can be used for game production are not included.

About Soaring Machinariae:
A girls' adventure story, told through a traditional action RPG!
Control Iris the Machinariae to explore fields and dungeons, and fight against monsters with sword combos, items, and special moves!

notes.title: RPG Maker Festival: Discounts, Tutorials, Streams, Contests, and More!
notes.notes:
Welcome to the RPG Maker Festival Sale! RPG Maker Day is here again, and we’re kicking off a weeklong celebration of all things RPG Maker.

First up, we have an exciting announcement! A new, parallel iteration of RPG Maker is coming: RPG Maker Unite! RPG Maker Unite is based on Unity and contains a stash of new and convenient features to allow users making more compelling games than ever! You can learn more about RPG Maker Unite and wish list it today here.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1650950/RPG_MAKER_UNITE/

To continue our celebration of RPG Maker, we would be remiss if we didn’t also celebrate the RPG Maker Community itself!

That is why not only are we having a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/rpgmaker_festival]huge sale across all RPG Maker products[/url], we’ve also reached out to devs all around the world who have used RPG Maker to fulfill their dreams of making games to include them in the sale. Check out the full sale page to see tons of fantastic RPG Maker resources, as well as a huge collection of stellar games made by RPG Maker devs on Steam!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/rpgmaker_festival][b]Be sure to check out the full sale here![/b][/url]

But there are many people in the RPG Maker community who haven’t reached that goal yet. Many people have taken only the first few steps into the wilder world of game making, and are still unsure how to make that dream a reality. And that is where we celebrate one of the best things about the community: All the helping hands out there reaching down to give new users a hand up.

With tutorials, graphic and audio resources, plugins, and just general troubleshooting the community helps take a neophyte maker and turn them into a veteran who can help the next generation of makers.

And that is why on top of the fantastic deals across our RPG Maker products the focus of our RPG Maker Festival will be bringing that same feeling to Steam! Have a tutorial to share? Some resources you’ve made? Or maybe you are here to learn, we have a plethora of events throughout the week for everyone!

[h1]Daily Broadcasts![/h1]

We will be rebroadcasting our Making in MZ Streams as a Marathon starting tonight, and in addition, every day over the next week, we’ll have at least one completely new broadcast for you to watch at the top of the RPG Maker MZ page! RPG Maker tutorials, Game Design advice, and even interviews with some of the most successful RM devs. You can find the full schedule here:

[list]
[*]Monday, Feb 14th, 4:00 PM: Guiding a Player Through Your Maps with Studio Blue
[*]Tuesday, Feb 15th, 4:00 PM: GDD Creation with Studio Blue
[*]Tuesday, Feb 15th, 6:00 PM*: Developer Interview: Rakuen
[*]Wednesday, Feb 16th, 4:00 PM: Developer Interview: Pocket Mirror
[*]Wednesday, Feb 16th, 6:00 PM: Developer Interview: To The Moon
[*]Thursday, Feb 17th, 8:00 PM: Basic Events with Driftwood Gaming
[*]Friday, Feb 18th, 8:00 PM: Basic Database with Driftwood Gaming
[*]Saturday, Feb 19th, 6:00 PM: Developer Interview: Ara Fell
[*]Sunday, Feb 20th, 4:00 PM: How to Format an Autotile with Touchfuzzy
[/list]
All Times in Pacific
*May be delayed if previous stream goes long, will begin directly after.

[h1]Daily Official Guides![/h1]

Every day at 10am Pacific we’ll be posting a new beginner focused Steam guide written by the RPG Maker staff or a veteran member of the community.

Our first guide is already up and can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2753572309]here[/url], be sure to check back in daily to see the next guide!

[h1]Guide Drive![/h1]

We want to see even more guides for RPG Maker MZ in Steam, and to do that, we are holding the RPG Maker Festival Guide Drive! Have a tutorial you’ve written somewhere else, or maybe you want to write a whole new tutorial? Add it into the Steam Guides and be entered to win a prize!

The RPG Maker staff will pick their favorite guide submitted during the Festival week to receive a $25 Steam Gift Card! Additionally, one random guide submitted during the Festival will also win one.

[h1]Resource Drive![/h1]

Do your skills lie more in creating graphics, music, or code than in teaching others? Don’t worry, we have an event for you as well. Let’s fill the MZ Workshop with tons of materials for everyone to use in their game! This will be held just like our Guide Drive. You can submit any materials you created to the Workshop, old or new, as long as it hasn’t been on the MZ workshop before.

Our favorite new resource wins a $25 Steam Gift Card, as well as one random workshop creation uploaded during the drive!

[h1]Festival Map Contest![/h1]

And for the final event of our magnificent festival, we need a festival atmosphere! Create a map with a maximum pixel size of 1920x1080 that you think screams “festival” and submit it as a screenshot. Make sure you have permission to use all the materials you use in your map, and include both the credits and the word “FESTIVAL” in all caps in your screenshot description!

We will award prizes for our top 3 maps!

1st Place: $50 Steam Gift Card
2nd Place: $25 Steam Gift Card
3rd Place: $10 Steam Gift Card

The deadline for this event, and all of the other events in this contest are the end of the sale, on February 21st at 10am Pacific.

So what are you waiting for! Join the week long fun of the RPG Maker Festival! Join in on the contests, watch our broadcasts, and learn even more about how to make your dream game!

notes.title: New DLC: Pixelated Animations Pack Vol.1, Tyler Cline's Horror Music Pack
notes.notes:
Another week, another pair of DLC releases! Let's jump right in and see what new packs are in store for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892170/RPG_Maker_MZ__Pixelated_Animations_Pack_Vol1/

Bring some more pixel art love to your battles with Pixelated Animations Pack Vol.1! Bis has created a pack of 62 pixel animations to help level up your battles! Now you can make sure that your pixelated game keeps its aesthetic even in the middle of a fight.

With a selection of physical, magical, and status-changing animations, this pack covers plenty of possible skills! Common magic attacks like fire, water, earth, darkness, and light all have 3 different animations so that you can give more powerful spells fitting animations. Give your weaker wind skill a simple swirl of green magic and save the twisting tornado animation for your powerful whirlwind spell. You don’t have to give only your mages some new animations though, since this pack includes weapon slashing, piercing, and hitting animations perfect for warriors. Each physical attack also has fire, ice, and thunder variations, so your magic swordsman can make the most out of both the magical and physical animations!

Battles aren’t the only place these animations could be used. Play the poison animation when your hero accidentally steps on a trap, or have death’s purple skull appear over an assassin’s unfortunate target. The burning meteor could be an attack from an enemy’s ballista or forewarning of a volcano’s eruption!

Beyond the animation sheets, this pack also includes the animation data for Ace, MV, and MZ so you can drop them right into your game to save yourself some time while setting them up. Pick up Pixelated Animations Pack Vol.1 and give your retro game some suitable skill animations!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892120/RPG_Maker_MZ__Tyler_Clines_Horror_Music_Pack/

Add a touch of terror to your games with Tyler Cline's Horror Music Pack! Tyler Cline’s latest pack features 12 tracks to send chills up your players’ spines while they explore dark dungeons and creepy houses. Keep your players on their toes with ghostly winds and nerve wracking beats, and make them worry when the BGM suddenly changes!

Creep through forgotten graveyards while a haunting track plays to remind your players that they’re not alone, or have fast-paced metallic beats pound while they try to outrun a faceless monster. If jumpscares and chase scenes aren’t your thing, then grab one of the quieter tracks with low tones and light taps to add an uncomfortable ambience to the abandoned building your heroes are searching.

Don’t skip over this pack if you’re making an RPG though, since horror games aren’t the only ones that can make use of these tracks! Use one of the tracks with steady drums and haunting winds when you introduce a character who seems untrustworthy, or when exploring an empty town that was teeming with life the last time your heroes passed through. Maybe instead of a bombastic track your heroes’ encounter with the villain needs music that’s slower and much more ominous, causing your players to think that maybe they aren’t actually ready for that final fight.

Each track comes in WAV, OGG, MP3 and M4a formats, making it easy to use in your favorite engine. Update your game’s music from ‘kinda spooky’ to ‘downright terrifying’ with Tyler Cline's Horror Music Pack today!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Legendary Palaces - Mermaid Tileset, Otani Pixel Fantasy Enemy Vol 3
notes.notes:
February has just begun, and it is time for two new RPG Maker packs to make their debut. A second Legendary Palace from Kokoro Reflections, and even more fantastic enemies in the Otani Pixel Fantasy series!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892130/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Mermaid_Tileset/

Get your scuba gear ready, we are about to dive into an amazing pack that is just waiting for you to explore it! This Kokoro Reflections set from their Legendary Palace series brings you a breathtakingly beautiful Mermaid Palace with everything you need to make it a part of your game.

Has the sea level decreased and this mysterious structure has appeared from it? Or did your heroes actually have to go underwater? No matter how they found it, this impressive place is always worth a visit. With a pearly shimmer on everything, this place is enchantingly beautiful. Maybe the merfolk who lived here are long gone and algae has grown over the place or perhaps it is still inhabited and someone resides on the shell shaped throne. The builders for sure were very crafty people and did a great job at shaping the various detailed statues or mermaids and pillars encrusted with blue gems. Mysterious large snail shells and starfish decorate the site as well as giant mirrors which might be ancient magical artifacts with mystical powers, or maybe they are just nice to look at.

This whole set of course comes with all the needed wall and floor tiles as well plus a matching treasure chest and a ghostly blue flame that might even burn under water. And in case it is not below sea level for you, there are also some beautiful water tiles to surround and further decorate this palace!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874600/RPG_Maker_MZ__Otani_Pixel_Fantasy_Enemy_Pack_Vol3/

Every hero needs a villian to stand up against, an enemy to fight tense battles against to show off their power. The third installation of the Otani Pixel Enemy series comes with a lot of creatures you can use to build challenging fights that look splendid. The ten types of retro style-pixelated battlers come with three unique variations each, totaling to thirty different beings. Those variations are much more than just a recolor, with special additions, details and patterns it is ensured that you know you have a totally different being in front of you, even though it might be from the same family.

For example the giant demons are all fierce horned monstrosities chained to the ground, but while the purple one is just that, the pink one is partly dissolving into thick smoke and the brown one is surrounded by floating rocks. This makes it much easier to assign them to different elements and levels as you need them.

From spooky ghosts to scary gargoyles and fishlike mermans to beautiful mermaids, there is so much more to find in here. The abominable gazer might not be the thing you want to meet, but your heroes should definitely do so for an exciting and challenging fight that will be remembered! They should have their weapons ready, as with this set, they will have a lot of work to do!
