notes.title: New DLC: City Exterior Tileset, Another World Heroine Generator 2 for MZ
notes.notes:
This week, we have two new graphics packs ready for your games: a tileset to spruce up your city exteriors, and a whole new set of MZ generator parts for your heroines!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874590/RPG_Maker_MZ__City_Exterior_Tileset/

Let your heroes visit cheerful circuses and downtrodden neighborhoods with the City Exterior Tileset! Wataru nakanami has crafted a wide selection of tiles to help bring your cities to life. With tiles for markets, parks, slums, and more you can add more worldbuilding lore to your maps without ever writing a word!

Build a busy popup market with rough wooden signs hung above crates of fresh veggies and fish, while small carts full of candy hang out under colorful awnings. Or create streets full of shops with decorative metal signs hanging off the building and large glass windows giving a peek at the goodies inside alongside townhouses. If your heroes need to explore the city’s forgotten areas, then make use of the cracked ground that reveals dirt under paved streets and piles of trash to limit where your players can walk. Trailer homes can find a place next to ramshackle buildings, with clothing lines strung above the paths. You can also make use of the sheet’s separate manhole and manhole cover, to let your players know that they’ll be exploring the sewer sometime in the future

Let your player know your game takes place in a not-so-distant past with a penny-farthing bike leaning its huge front wheel against a wall and old-fashioned cars parked on the street. More modern cities could make use of the large hospital and gas station signs, or decorate office buildings with billboards advertising makeup or vacations. And don’t forget to put a food truck near the city’s park!

This pack includes sample projects for both MV and MZ, so you can see how each tile can improve your towns. Create maps that truly feel lived in with the City Exterior Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1884910/RPG_Maker_MZ__Another_World_Heroine_Generator_2_for_MZ/

Get ready to update your heroines’ appearances with Another World Heroine Generator 2 for MZ! Gee-kun-soft is back with another MZ generator pack, this time offering up 42 new female generator parts to help you create the heroine of your dreams.

Choose from 5 eyes to add some new features to your heroines, then take your heroines to the salon to try out the 5 front hair and 5 rear hair options! Keep their hair out of the way with a braided bun or by pulling it back into a long ponytail, or cut it to shoulder length to make sure it doesn’t get caught in any weapon swings. Give your shy heroine bangs that cover one of her eyes, or use the slightly shaggy bangs to show that your character is too busy to waste time brushing her hair.

With 20 clothing options to choose from, outfitting your heroines has never been easier! Give your druid a shoeless green outfit to help them stay in touch with the earth, and let your speedy gunslinger move easily with a shoulder holster-inspired top. Or let them show off their personalities with a two-tone asymmetrical dress, elbow length gloves matched with thigh-high boots, or a lightweight dress with fluttering sleeves and hem. Give your players some hints about a character’s backstory with their outfit. Is the helpful mage with the red corset and fancy cape also a dangerous vampire? And once you’ve picked your heroines’ outfits, make sure to give them one of this pack’s 5 accessories to finish their look! Top an outfit with a ruffle headband or hairpin, or bring a magician’s appearance to life with a tiny tophat.

Along with all these generator parts, this pack also includes an adjusted female base to make sure the off-the-shoulder clothing options look the best they can. Bring your heroines to life with Another World Heroine Generator 2 for MZ!

[h2]Japanese Anime Voices: Female Character Series Vol.1～Vol.9 Update![/h2]

The Japanese Anime Voices: Female Character Series packs have been updated:
[list]
    [*]Updated the voice files to work with the plug-in "Battlevoice" for RPG Maker MV /MZ.
    [*]With this update, you can now copy/paste the plugin, voice file and command text to your game project to more easily add the voices.
    [*]Added MV and MZ sample project
[/list]
The files in your DLC download folder will be updated automatically.

notes.title: New DLC: Pop Fantasy BigMonster and NPC Face Set, Valor And Villainy Music Pack
notes.notes:
Release day is here again! For our first pack, we have an expansion on the previous Pop Fantasy Battler and Face Set Pack, and to go along with it we have a brand new set of tracks from RPG Maker Music Pack veteran Joel Steudler!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874580/RPG_Maker_MZ__POP_FANTASY_BigMonster_and_NPC_Face_Set/

Did you like the Pop Fantasy Battler and Face Set Pack and crave more? Or are you just looking for some super cute facesets and battlers for your game?

Then be ready for the Pop Fantasy BigMonster and NPC FaceSet pack!

For an idea of what is included, just take a look at the Big Monster Battlers and all the People and Nature facesets in MV and MZ and you will know the characters you are getting! You have never seen the Irongiant as cuddly or a God of light that was as huggable - fierce and totally adorable at the same time!

These redraws give a new spin on all these Monsters and since their sprites are contained in the makers by default, you won’t have any problem with incorporating or missing matching graphics. On top of that, all of the NPC faces are loaded with lovely character as well and allowing you to have the full line up of the appearing characters in your game that all have a faceset in this style! With their big round eyes and chubby cheeks they are as adorable as the default characters can get and will give your game an unique look while using the default sprites!

Check out these sweeties and be ready for them to steal your heart!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1876640/RPG_Maker_MZ__Valor_And_Villainy_Music_Pack/

The line between Hero and Villain can at times be very thin. Joel Steudler is back and he brings another fantastic set of tracks with The Valor and Villainy Music Pack featuring ten brand new epic pieces!

Three of them are geared towards battles, giving you the tools to bring various moods to your fights. Looking closer at one of those battle themes, we have “Endless Enemies”, where gentle strings lie on top of more heavy tunes, a both heroic and grim track that grasps the feeling of fighting a never ending fight.

Other items in this pack are designed perfectly for various story environments, such as “Sacred Sepulcher”, with drums and strings fusing to create a magical atmosphere that would fit the burial site of an important hero from legendary times.

The pack also includes three more character or party driven themes: with “Infamous Evildoer” being the perfect piece that plays whenever your antagonist enters the screen, with epic orchestral music porting his power and presence. “Noble Defenders” on the other hand is much friendlier, with soft tunes combined with more strong parts, perfectly to underlie your upright and determined party on their way to face this or another enemy and let highlight them in their strongest moments.

But that isn't the only way these tracks can be used. There are many more ways you can use these tracks, just turn them on, and let them carry your thoughts… this music in combination with your own setting will lead to some legendary scenarios the people of your world will talk about for centuries!

notes.title: New DLC: Last Boss Pack Vol 3, Retro Future Music Pack
notes.notes:
For our second release day of the year, we have some new tunes with retro sound, and a new collection of ready to go bosses for your game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1869750/RPG_Maker_MZ__Last_Boss_Pack_Vol3/

Bring even more flames and fangs to your battles with the Last Boss Pack Vol3! Gee Kun Soft’s latest battler pack focuses on a favorite enemy type for fantasy games: dragons! Add in new fights against two-headed terrors, armored behemoths, and lithe serpents with this pack.

With 10 unique enemies to choose from, you can find a suitable dragon for any location. Battle a green-scaled dragon to save a princess from a tower, or fight an aquatic serpent to keep it from capsizing your ship! Be careful when exploring mines since your heroes may stumble across a dragon with crystal claws and tail and a nasty attitude. Even the sky isn’t safe, with lightning-summoning dragons coiling and dancing through the clouds!

And if that wasn’t enough, the dragons also each come in a special variant: undead! Surprise your heroes with another fight against the same dragon they’ve already defeated, but this time it’s fresh from the grave with empty eye sockets and tattered flesh. Maybe the true villain has been bringing these dragons back to life, or cursed them to rage forever until they’re defeated. Each enemy also comes in a high-res size, so your heroes can face off against a huge dragon during the final fight! 

This pack also includes sprites for each battler, so your players can see just what they’ll be facing next! Have a large dragon stand in front of its gold hoard as a deterrent, or let an undead drake stalk your heroes as they explore an ancient ruin!

As a bonus this pack also includes images of the dragons attacking, perfect for putting some fear into your players before the battle starts! If you’ve been hoping to add some more dragons to your game, then make sure to pick up Last Boss Pack Vol3!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1869740/RPG_Maker_MZ__Retro_Future_Music_Pack/

Grab your hoverbikes and get ready to explore an incredible world with the Retro Future Music Pack! Joel Steudler’s latest music pack brings old-school sci-fi to life with 20 rocking synth tracks that cover exploration, dramatic cutscenes, and even combat! With a focus on instruments that bring a nostalgic synth feeling to each song, this pack is ready to bring any 90s cyberpunk or sci-fi style game to life.

Explore marketplaces lit with neon and full of all sorts of robotic customers while ‘Midnight Market’s drums and electric beats play in the background, and give your players a warning about possible dangers lurking in the alleys by switching to the less cheerful ‘Street Brawl’. Battle against cyborgs and hoverbike gangsters to the fast-paced beats of ‘Pedal to the Metal’ or roaring electric guitars of  ‘Rocket Racer’. Have your heroes hunt down a contact who is hiding life-or-death info in an underground nightclub to the toe-tapping rhythms of ‘Techno Trouble’ and then travel through high-tech teleportation stations with the chipper beeps in ‘Route 88’.

Even if your story isn’t focused on sci-fi, these songs could find a home in your game. Maybe your modern arcade could use some synth tunes to match the flashing lights and general cheer of the place, or your villain has the power to throw your heroes into a pocket dimension where fantasy and sci-fi meet! Give your game the perfect vibes with the Retro Future Music Pack!

notes.title: New DLC: Winlu Cyberpunk Tileset - Exterior, Combat Whooshes Sound Pack
notes.notes:
It's the New Year, and it's time for New Releases! For our first release of the year, we have 2 superb packs ready for you: a new Exterior set to go with the Winlu Cyberpunk interior set, and a whole pack of amazing combat sound effects!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1857280/RPG_Maker_MZ__Winlu_Cyberpunk_Tileset__Exterior/

What might the future have in stock for us? Well, if you go by WinLu’s Cyberpunk Exterior Tileset Pack, it will be both dark and gritty but also progressive, with some preserved trees, impressive futuristic cars and many many neon signs!

With a wide and creative range of autotiles you will get the perfect base for diverse and engaging cities, with a broad selection of tiled floors and all different kinds of walls. Even if your game is “just” modern and not futuristic, you will find some very nice pieces you might want to use here!

The additional tiles fit the Cyberpunk theme perfectly with every kind of decoration you can think of. There are windows with darkened and lit versions, or even a pane with optional bullet holes for a really rough part of town. You can add gritty fire exit stairs to your multi story buildings and have some trash bins stand around in their backyards, as well as visit the local market to buy some fresh produce or futuristic guns… or both! Some parts of the city might be in worse shape with all different kinds of holes, visible pipes and broken concrete structures. And no matter which section of the town you are in, the blinking neon signs will help you navigate - or just make your city look a lot more alive. On top of the tileset sheets, you also get a huge number of different doors that could lead to many interesting places.

So go ahead and check out this amazing pack, you will not regret it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1857290/RPG_Maker_MZ__Combat_Whooshes_Sound_Pack/

Whoosh! says the great battle axe, as it is swung by your barbarian hero in the direction of your enemies.

Whoosh! is the sound the giant fireball makes, when your wizard channels his magical powers to cast this spell.

Whoosh! is also the sound of the arrow, shot by your hunter heroine, who tries to take her opponents out from the distance.

And while you can use that simple word to describe those sounds, it would be a lot cooler if each of them had their own distinctive whoosh, right? And wouldn’t it be even better if there were several sounds for all different kinds of weapons and attacks, to make your battles much more immersive?

The Combat Whooshes Sound Pack brings the sounds your attacks make to a new level! With 100 distinct types of swings, shots, castings and punches there is not much left to ask for and no matter if it is an elegant sword, a slow cast spell or a futuristic whoosh - maybe coming from a blaster - this pack has it! And all those small yet powerful effects will help to make your game as immersive as it can get. 

Whoosh! makes the torch, as it is lit up to be able to see something in the dungeon. Good luck, adventurer!

[h2]RPG Character Pack 4 Update[/h2]

Additionally, we've made a small update to RPG Character Pack 4 to fix an issue with the downed sprites.

For Degica Shop purchases, please redownload from your purchase email. For Steam users, the files in your DLC download folder will be updated automatically.

In both cases, for any projects where you were using the pack, you will need to replace the files in your project with the updated files.

notes.title: New: NATHUHARUCA RPG Monsters, Rinobers Futuristic Characters, MGC Animations MZ
notes.notes:
It's time for our final release day of the year! So let's send it off with a bang... or three bangs! Three new packs to make your games come to life. And we'll be back after the new year to deliver even more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1837122/RPG_Maker_MZ__NATHUHARUCA_Fantasy_RPG_Monster_Pack/

Find new foes for your heroes to battle with the NATHUHARUCA Fantasy RPG Monster Pack! NATHUHARUCA put together a pack of drawn monsters to help you bring more fantastical fights to your RPGs. Battle twirling dragons, possessed stones, living flowers, and more!

This pack includes 13 different monsters each with multiple recolors to fit different regions, so even when your heroes explore new areas they can still find familiar foes. Battle against red-petalled man-eating plants in lush forests while blue-stemmed ones seek out snacks in caves and tundras. Or fight solid treants with different colorations depending on their weaknesses. Explore ancient ruins while dodging magical machines and angry zombies that were accidentally brought back to life by your players, and face off against a deadly demon with rippling muscles and sharp spines in the treasure room. Search caves filled with rock bugs and tick-like spiders for a powerful blade, and battle the spirit guarding the blade to earn it! 

As a bonus, this pack also includes battleback images to create a dramatic battle on a mountaintop with light spilling through dark clouds, the perfect place to fight against your biggest foe! Let your players challenge all-new enemies with NATHUHARUCA Fantasy RPG Monster Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1853730/RPG_Maker_MZ__Rinobers_Futuristic_Characters/

Add some more people to your sci-fi games with Rinober’s Futuristic Characters! Rinober’s latest pack is here, with 12 hand-drawn characters to help bring your world to life with their own vibrant style! With spritesheets, facesets, and full body art for each character you can add more personality to your heroes and NPCs.

With the characters covering 4 women, 5 men, 2 kids, and 1 robot, you can create a living world for your players to enjoy. Make a crew out of a shorts-wearing smoothtalker, a gruff and buff cyborg, and a cheerful female pilot, or explore a futuristic city as a jacket-wearing average Joe. The facesets and full body art come with different expressions to help you really show the mood during cutscenes. Have your friendly doctor smile when talking while the no-nonsense business woman glares at your players when they fail to bring her a requested item. If your hero ends up in a crash, the injured set brings the damage to the forefront with scrapes and blood.

Along with the walking sprites, each character also has a sheet of behaviors to help add some extra movement to your maps and cutscenes. Have your kids laugh at a funny joke, or let the ship’s robot shake its head ‘no’ when something isn’t possible. Let your heroes gesture with their hands while they talk or when they need to push a button, and have random NPCs blink while your players explore the maps.

Each character comes in two versions, one with black outlines and the other with colored outlines, so that you can choose the perfect look for your game. Get ready to add more characters to your sci-fi games to populate your worlds with Rinober’s Futuristic Characters!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1853740/RPG_Maker_MZ__MGC_Animations_MZ_MegaPack_1/

Have you been searching high and low for more MZ animations? Your search is over thanks to the MGC Animations MZ MegaPack 1! ManuGamingCreations has created a pack filled with explosive elemental attacks to help you bring your game’s skills to life. Choose the perfect animation for your skills from a pool of 189 options!

These animations’ bold and bright style can add extra flair to your battles, turning a simple magic missile skill into a projectile that blasts across the battlefield to strike your foe in a fiery explosion! With single target and AoE animations for your favorite elements like fire, water, thunder, wind, and more, you can give each skill its own unique appearance. Create a whirlwind attack with a green swirling tornado that surrounds your enemy, or strike them down with a dragon head formed from flowing water. For skills that don’t need as dramatic an animation, choose from the different colored fireballs and impacts. Along with the elemental attacks there are slashes, explosions, healing sparkles, and shield animations so you can give your non-magic users some love too! 

Many of the animations also include leveled up versions, so when your pyromancer learns a more powerful fire skill you can make sure its animation lives up to its damage! Or have an energy beam visually show the power level of your hero with extra flashes and arcing energy.

Each animation is ready to be added to your game, so you don’t even need to touch Effekseer to use them. Give your skills a colorful and bombastic update with MGC Animations MZ MegaPack 1!

notes.title: New DLC: Modern JP Interiors & Phoenix Palace Tilesets, Retro Electronic Tracks
notes.notes:
The holidays are here and the year is almost over, but that doesn't mean we don't have more releases for you! This week we have three new packs to enhance your project.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1837121/RPG_Maker_MZ__DorapixelMapChips__Modern_JP_Interiors/

Give your busy stores and offices a pixel art update with DorapixelMapChips - Modern JP Interiors! Dorapika (Pika's Game) is back with a new pack of gorgeous tiles to bring your Japanese-inspired rooms to life. Create cozy homes, stocked grocery stores, and sleek business offices for your players to enjoy!

With floor types including wood, tiles, concrete, and even tatami it’s easy to create tons of different styles of rooms. And with a selection of 24 walls, along with slanted vertical side walls, you can create unique and comfy spaces for your players to explore. Fill a convenience store with shelves bursting with colorful treats and useful items, and don’t forget to include an ATM so that your players can afford all the goodies they’ll pick up when they stop at the register! Take a break at a small sushi restaurant with seating at both tables and the wooden bar, or let your players return to their home to recover in their own bed for the night. And to make sure your players can get around your busy city, create a full subway station with billboards, platforms and train tracks!

This pack also includes some animated doors for your interiors. Keep your players from wandering into a store’s back room with a locked metal door, or welcome them to an item shop with automatic sliding glass doors. Sample maps for both MV and MZ are included, to spark your map-making inspiration. If you’ve been wanting some beautiful modern pixel interiors or just want to expand your DorapixelMapChips collection, pick up DorapixelMapChips - Modern JP Interiors today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844840/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Phoenix_Tileset/

Welcome my friends, in the realm of the phoenix. May it be the heraldic animal of the ruler of this castle or the actual beast, that is up to you. But no matter what you go with, there is an amazing sight ready to be experienced!

The Phoenix Palace seems to be built right into a volcano, with flowing lava falls and open pits full of bubbling molten rocks. The whole architecture embraces the theme as well, with loads of fascinating statues of the legendary bird with glowing highlights against the dark rock they were made out of. With beautiful pillars topped with gemstones, carefully crafted handrails and portals there is a lot to use to decorate your own palace maps. And at the heart of the castle you can place the Phoenix Throne, a luxurious and breathtaking piece that shows the power of whoever has the right to sit on it. But watch out, this place can be dangerous as well!

There are open fires and spiked pits that might make your heroes question whether they should have opened those tempting ornate treasure chests…

The Legendary Palaces - Phoenix Castle pack by Kokoro Reflections brings you everything to place an unique and brand new location into your game! Get it while it is still hot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844830/RPG_Maker_MZ__Retro_and_Electronic_Game_Music/

Does your game have a retro vibe and is set in the future? Then this pack is just what you need to add a great soundtrack to it! With 24 amazing brand new chiptune tracks you have nearly every possible situation covered.

Get ready to fight some space bugs or other enemies to the sound of Action Phase or perhaps face, as the title says, a Giant Robot T-Rex Battle? Each of the tracks is unique and inspiring on their own, listening to them will get your imagination going with all the scenes you can build around them. For example, in the Laboratory theme you can hear the different gadgets and bubbling fluids in the tunes of the track.

Other tracks are don't have themes that are nailed down, but that makes them versatile to fill out the rest of your soundtrack. Do the sounds of Space Dance underlie an actual dance? Or is the dance a battle against someone your characters thought was their friend? Listen in and decide for your own what you want it to be in your world. From dungeon dwelling background music to cities, puzzles, cutscenes, and fights, this pack has everything you need and more!

notes.title: RPG Maker MZ Touch the Stars Game Jam Winners Now Free on Steam!
notes.notes:
Want to see what can kind of games can be made only one month with RPG Maker MZ? We've released the 3 winners of our Touch the Stars Game Jam as free games on Steam!

[h1]1st Place: Berry[/h1]

The itsy-bitsy spider may have gone up the waterspout, but Berry performs a marathon of fantastic gameplay and amazing fun. Join this adorable arachnid on their adventure to find the tastiest of flies. Along the way you’ll dodge fire bugs, leap across platforms, and follow the dubious advice of questionable cockroaches. Once you get the controls down, you can overcome obstacles and defeat bosses with a sense of pride and accomplishment. Just don’t forget to climb up that proverbial spout again and again until you reach the stars!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823370/Berry/

[h2]2nd Place: Buffet Knight[/h2]

Let loose your inner hunger as you follow the powerful Buffet Knight in his quest to rid the land of the nefarious Demon Chef. Along the way, gobble up just about anything and spit it back at your enemies, defeating them and growing in power. Don’t grow too much, though, or you may not be able to contain your insatiable appetite. With gameplay inspired by a game with a certain hungry pink hero, and two very different endings, this game is for anyone who’s a glutton for adventure.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823360/Buffet_Knight/

[h1]3rd Place: Forest Star[/h1]

Take on the role of a cute little monkey who witnesses a star falling from the sky and goes on a grand adventure to find it. Along the way, the adorable simian meets a cast of animals, each with their own motivations for joining our hero. The companion you take affects your ability to overcome certain obstacles, as each possesses their own unique power and personality. Make friends, help others, see the world, and enjoy a multitude of different fulfilling endings.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823350/Forest_star/

notes.title: MZ Battle Animation Showdown
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38018723/daeb1da78ffb649a17319b4cf2263f9015f3f561.jpg[/img]
To go along with our publisher sale, RPG Maker MZ has also been updated to the latest version! And included in those updates are two much anticipated upgrades to the Battle Animations tab:

Effekseer integration updated to the latest version!
The ability to use MV Style Frame Animations!

To celebrate, in conjunction with the Effekseer team, we’re hosting the MZ Battle Animation Showdown!

And what will you do for this contest? Making Battle Animations!

The contest will have two different categories, one for MZ Effekseer Particle Animations, and one for MV Style Frame Animations. You can enter one, or both.

Make the best animations you can using the rules below and see if you can take the prize!

[h3][b]How to Submit your Entry[/b][/h3]
Download the Template Project Linked at the bottom of the post.
After editing the Template Project for this event, please upload it using File → Upload to the Workshop from inside of RPG Maker MZ

When uploading, use the following Tags
Category：Resources, 
Resource Type：Animations, 
Flavor：Optional
Description: Please include a description of the participating categories, an introduction to your work, and a list of credits for the materials you used.

[h3][b]Rules[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] To submit your animation to the contest, add it to the workshop as a MZ Project using the template included at the bottom of this post. (this submission should be an unencrypted project, not a deployed file).
[*] Place your animation in the 1st slot in the Animations tab of the database.
[*] You may add any materials to the project you need to showcase your animation. The judging will be done based on the preview in the MZ engine.
[*] You may only use user-created resources that are available for modification and commercial use. Proper copyrights and/or credits must be included in the entry.
[*] You can use your own resources, but you must include copyrights and/or credits.
[*] You may not create a character that infringes on third party copyright or trademarks.
[*] You reserve the right to delete your entry even if it has already been posted and voted on.
[*] You may edit your work and/or the description after posting (we may contact you for confirmation if the character has changed significantly since the original posting).
[*] Submissions including adult materials such as extreme violence and/or nudity will not be accepted.
[*] Only one Particle Animation entry and one Frame Animation entry per user.
[/list]
[h3][b]Prizes[/b][/h3]
After the submission deadline, our judges will determine the best of the best in each category. There will be separate 1st through 3rd place prizes for each.

[list]
[*] 1st Place: $50 Steam Wallet Code
[*] 2nd Place: $25 Steam Wallet Code
[*] 3rd Place: $10 Steam Wallet Code
[/list]
[h3]Bonus Particle Animation Assets from Effekseer![/h3]

As a special bonus, the Effekseer team has sent a special pack of Particle Animation assets, free for everyone! You are free to use them in your entry, or in your latest projects!

[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/14lOEtzF4SOwqstCNJGqA7tOr3N7iQX5I/view?usp=sharing  style=button]BONUS EFFEKSEER PARTICLE ANIMATION ASSETS[/url]

[h3][b]Contest Dates[/b][/h3]
The contest will [b]run from December 9th until January 3rd 11:59PM Pacific[/b]! Get your entries in before then!

[h3][b]Entry Template[/b][/h3]
The entry template is a RPG Maker MZ project stripped down to the bare minimum for smaller file size. You must use this as a basis for your submission. You can add any materials needed to highlight your animation (including enemy graphics and backgrounds for the animation preview).

[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1qVGqKb6nixfUwnMliE4hOur8F-9G1HUD/view?usp=sharing  style=button]ENTRY TEMPLATE[/url]

So enjoy the Publisher Sale! Get RPG Maker engines, packs, or maybe even check out some of our other games for inspiration. And get to work on those Animations. We look forward to seeing them!

notes.title: Steam Publisher Weekend! New Releases!
notes.notes:
On top of our releases today, we also have a Steam Publisher Weekend! That means huge deals not just on tons of RPG Maker engines and resources, but also on a whole slew of amazing games, from RPGs, to Shmups, to Fighting games! Check out the full publisher sale [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/degica-publisher-weekend]HERE[/url]!

But it is still release day as well, so let's take a look at what's new for RPG Maker!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1841130/RPG_Maker_MZ__MT_Tiny_Tales_Overworld_Tiles/

Give your retro adventure a cute pixelated world with MT Tiny Tales Overworld Tiles! With over 20 tileset sheets to choose from, you can create amazing outdoor and town maps for your heroes to explore. Craft bright forests, desert towns, snowy mountains, and more with this pack!

Fill your forests with lush trees and flowering bushes, and use darker dirt to mark the paths next to flowing streams. Give your rocky mountain regions some pops of green with pine trees and your tundra a bit of humor with random snowmen between frosty bushes and leafless tree trunks. And when your heroes need a break from exploring all these locations, build them a town to rest in. With different roofs and walls to choose from, you can give each town its own style.

If all that wasn’t enough, this pack also includes interior tiles! So don’t worry about stocking your town’s shops, with armor, weapons racks, and bagged supplies your heroes will always be able to find what they need! Decorate the local bar with bottles and tempting meals, or give each room in the inn fresh flowers and cheery curtains. And a selection of bookshelves, cupboards, and pots give your npcs options to decorate their homes however they want.

All the tiles come in sizes for MV/MZ and Ace, along with the original 16x16 size, so it should be easy to add these tilesets to your favorite engine. Give your heroes some adorable towns and outdoor maps with MT Tiny Tales Overworld Tiles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1837120/RPG_Maker_MZ__Otani_Pixel_Fantasy_Enemy_Pack_Vol2/

Have you been waiting for some detailed pixel art battlers for your heroes to fight? Your wait is over thanks to Otani Pixel Fantasy Enemy Pack Vol.2! This pack contains 30 gorgeous battlers to give your heroes brand new challenges in battles. Will your heroes defeat a toxic slime or will they run when facing off against a muscular and angry centaur?

10 unique monsters cover a range of possible foes to face. Battle against gooey snail-shaped slimes and wooden treants in forests and sunny plains, and challenge armed lizardmen and snake-haired naga in caves and on mountain trails. Larger enemies like rearing centaurs and hulking cyclops are perfect for wild boss battles. If you’ve been wanting a ship-based boss fight? Then grab the jellyfish-like kraken!

And with each monster having 3 variations, you can make battles even more interesting. Give each fire spirit its own battle style, with yellow summoning explosive butterflies, green healing its allies, and red wreathed in blazing flames to stop close combat. Or use the three distinct vampires as sisters who rule a dark castle together, meaning the only way to escape is to beat all three in combat. But be careful of the different zombies that wander the castle halls!

This pack’s battlers come in two sizes, so you can easily choose the size that better fits your game. Pick up Otani Pixel Fantasy Enemy Pack Vol.2 today and get ready to fight some incredible enemies!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832590/RPG_Maker_MZ__Castle_of_Shikigami_2/

To celebrate the Steam release of Castle of Shikigami 2 we made a FREE character pack for RPG Maker users based on the game! These materials include battlers, face, walking sprites, and standing picture graphic for the seven characters from Castle of Shikigami 2. Download it for free at the link above, and check out the game at the link below!

notes.title: New DLC: RPG Character Pack 5, Time Fantasy Add on Animals 2
notes.notes:
We're kicking off December with two new graphics packs! All new characters to star in your latest game, plus additional animals for the Time Fantasy series.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833440/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Character_Pack_5/

If you want to tell an engaging story, you need unique and creative characters to fill it with life and depth. The RPG Character Pack 5 brings you a great opportunity to expand your roster of interesting personalities in your game. With each of these unique heroes coming with a charset and additional down pose, a battler, a SV battler, Portrait, faceset with eight different emotions, and a large beautifully drawn artwork the be used wherever you like, there is no role those cannot fill!

Let the bunny king lead your party to victory or maybe rather make him an NPC with a fascinating background story. The fox girl is as beautiful as she is deadly, she would make a great heroine or as an assassin that is after your party! And maybe that party includes the lady that dances on her bladed shoes, ready to deliver some deadly kicks? Or the sage apprentice, who is young and energetic, looking for an adventure and new experiences to learn from! Human or humanoid, male or female, caster or physical fighter, this pack might just have the exact new character you need!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833430/RPG_Maker_MZ__Time_Fantasy_Add_on_Animals_2/

Fans of Time Fantasy, have you been waiting to take your players on a safari or to the zoo? Your wait is over with Time Fantasy Add on Animals 2! With more that 60 animal sprites, this pack is full of critters to add to your game’s exotic locations. 

Explore American-inspired plains with herds of large bison grazing, or check out a dark swamp where frogs hop around and owls fly silently overhead. If your game includes a long period on a tropical beach, why not add some sea turtles and crabs? You could even include a shark fin out in the water to let your players know that swimming there isn’t recommended. Camels can help your heroes travel across deserts, leading them to savanna teeming with life. Create a pride of lions with cubs running around and huge elephants being followed by happy babies that move around your savanna maps. Add some pops of color to your jungles with brilliant red parrots and bright-billed toucans, or give an area a humorous feeling with some monkeys eating bananas and hopping up and done. Smaller sprites like bugs and fish can add some extra movement to your maps without blocking your players’ path, which is great for any small, crowded maps.

This pack comes with sizes ready-to-use in Ace and MV/MZ, so you can drop these sprites right into your favorite engine and start adding them to your maps! Pick up Time Fantasy Add on Animals 2 today and liven up your maps with some exotic wildlife!

notes.title: New: Japanese Modern Cityscape, Japanese Four Seasons- Tree Tiles, Ambient Works
notes.notes:
A hearty gobble gobble to all our fans from the US having Thanksgiving, and a hearty "THREE NEW RESOURCE PACKS!" for everyone. It's another release day, let's see what is in store... for the store.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823531/RPG_Maker_MZ__Japanese_Modern_Cityscape_Tileset/

Bring a compact and busy feeling to your cities with the Japanese Modern Cityscape Tileset! Grayfax software’s tileset contains pixel art tiles to help you build a city inspired by modern Japan, with road signs, soda machines, and even a small shrine to help your city look lived in.

Let your players take a break in a small park with swing sets and a bouncy panda between tall buildings, or make a railroad station into your game’s fast travel system. Fences made out of stone, metal, and even plants can keep your players from wandering into people’s yards while still letting them see little details like dog houses or bicycles that show someone really lives there. Certain autotile walls with windows help you build tall apartment buildings or skyscrapers while others are perfect for creating unique two-story houses, giving you ways to break up the monotony of buildings in your cities. The tile sheets with windows also come in three versions so you can choose if the windows are lit or not, perfect for distinguishing between daytime and night on your maps.

Also included are some sprites to help bring some movement to your cities. Keep your streets busy with compact cars and buses, or have some small train cars rattle past on railroad tracks with flashing crossing lights at all the crossroads. Or set up a security camera that turns to keep an eye on things above a convenience store’s glass doors.

MV and MZ sample projects can help you easily set up passability in your game, and give you examples for how to use all the tiles. If you’ve been wanting to give your modern cities a new look, pick up the Japanese Modern Cityscape Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823530/RPG_Maker_MZ__Japanese_Four_Seasons_Tree_Tiles/

Get ready to create gorgeous forests with Japanese Four Seasons - Tree Tiles! Norakoma has created a pack of tree tiles inspired by those commonly found in Japan, perfect for games that take place in Japan or ones that just call for more tree options as your players explore the world.

14 sheets of big trees offer up tons of variations to turn a simple outdoor map into something stunning. Hide secrets behind thick trunks and let your players walk under arching branches as they explore your forest maps, and decorate a garden with wisteria loaded with beautiful flowers. Build a bamboo forest with two full sheets of towering green stalks and lush canopies, or decorate a riverbank with the long and flowing branches of weeping willows.

The trees also have their own variants based on seasons, so as time passes in your game you can switch out tilesets to match! Turn the lush green of summer leaves to red as the days grow cooler, or let your players know that spring is right around the corner with small pink cherry blossoms appearing on icy branches. There are also a few dying trees that would be a great starting point for a side quest! Can your players bring a town’s centerpiece back to life?

This pack also includes MV and MZ sample projects, so you can copy preset tilesets right into your games and start planting trees right away! If you’ve been wanting to decorate your Japanese-inspired maps with fitting trees or just want some foliage to make your forests stand out, check out Japanese Four Seasons - Tree Tiles today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1819730/RPG_Maker_MZ__Ambient_Works/

Have you been looking for a new song for the moment your players discover a ruin full of technological wonders? Or need something different for when they explore an unsettlingly empty shop? Find the right background music for some of your scenes with Ambient Works! This pack’s 13 BGMs blend into your game’s world to help keep your players immersed.

The electronic tracks with solid beats are fitting for any spacefaring sci-fi games, when your players explore the space station’s mall for the first time or just when they’re taking a break on their ship. Give your quiet port an untrustworthy vibe with an echoey guitar and slight background noise that tickles your players’ brains with the thoughts of “something isn’t right here”. Or choose a track with soft marimba-like beats that could slide into any scene where your heroes take a moment in nature to rest and remember why they started their adventure in the first place.

With multiple file formats included for each track, it’s simple to add the songs to your favorite engine. Give Ambient Works a listen today and find the right track for that scene that’s been giving you trouble!

notes.title: New DLC: Meal Time Tileset - Fantasy, Heroine Character Generator 3 for MZ
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1816290/RPG_Maker_MZ__Meal_Time_Tileset__Fantasy_Edition/

What do a birthday party, a king’s dining room and a restaurant have in common? They all call for stunning food, well arranged on the best plates available and ready to let your taste buds tingle!

With the Meal Time pack there won’t be an empty table left in your game, unless you really want it to be. Filled with mouth watering goods, this set has everything your heroes could be craving for. Be it a rustic homemade pie from your main character's grandmother or a three course meal, starting with a delicious vegetable soup, followed by a sushi platter and closing with a dessert of fruit, the possibilities are endless. And for your more adventurous gourmets there are also some more fantastic options available - are you brave enough to give the shark head a try? Do the faces on the vegetables keep you from trying them

So, no matter your game or setting, there is something in here for you. Maybe your too-late-to-school protagonist has to run past the beautiful pancake stack their mom made for them or that your fantasy heroes enjoy a hearty filling meal in a tavern along the way, you will find many scenarios become even better with these. And on top of that, there are also some spoiled dishes included which could be very interesting for horror settings or as details in abandoned places.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1819720/RPG_Maker_MZ__Heroine_Character_Generator_3_for_MZ/

Do you ever feel like you run out of options for your heroines, especially for a modern setting, and are looking for a broad selection of cool new pieces? Then there is no need to search anymore, as the Heroine Character Generator 3 for MZ comes with so many clothes, hairstyles, and accessories that you can spend hours trying out the best combinations for your unique characters!

Maybe you want to have a cute sheep cosplayer be part of your party, fully dressed up from the wooly body suit to the headpiece with little horns? Or you want to be the healer of your contemporary game to be a nurse with the appropriate clothes? You could round this up by tying her hair into pigtails so they don’t get in her way when she cares for her fellow party mates. With a total of twenty different outfits there are many routes you can take. You can even have your characters change clothes midgame! Each of them can be worn with one of the eight individual headpieces that are included as well, so why not finish your character design for example with a sweet little striped bow on the head?

With four of each front and rear hair there are plenty of options on how to arrange your heroine’s hair to give her the perfect look! Do you want it to be tied up in ox horns or maybe should it be shoulder length with cute bangs and a braided midsections? That and much more is possible with this pack!

Enjoy the nearly endless options of combinations and create your perfect strong female heroines, ready to take out their enemies!

notes.title: New DLC: Big Garden Tiles, Hero Music Collection
notes.notes:
A new outdoors tileset with an amazing almost fairy tale style! Plus another epic soundtrack from Ayato Sound Create! Let's look at our latest releases.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1812330/RPG_Maker_MZ__Big_Garden_Tiles/

Have you been wanting to include a game section where your heroes shrink, but don’t have giant plants to help sell the illusion? Do you want to make a cute fairy village where they all live in mushroom houses? Then check out Big Garden Tiles! This tile pack contains tilesets to help add even more nature and magic to your maps!

With flowers that tower over your heroes and acorns the size of their heads, it’ll be obvious that they’ve fallen down the rabbit hole into a new and magical world! Giant beds of roses and tulips along with house-sized mushrooms let you create amazing towns for fairies and garden gnomes, and the included interior sets offer up some perfect furniture to decorate their homes. WIth all sorts of wooden cabinets (some that are still growing!) and beds with a selection of comfy blankets, you can make the forest home of their dreams for these magical creatures.

And if your game doesn’t include adventuring through overgrown parks? Then you could still make use of the normal-sized plants to make great gardens. Add some cheery daffodils to front yards, and show how lazy certain npcs are by covering their lawns with dandelions! Fairy rings made of colorful mushrooms could be used as teleportation spots, or just add some variety to your forests’ undergrowth with morels and chanterelle mushrooms.

Also included are sprites for gnomes and glowing fairies to add even more magic to your mushroom villages! Or use the stone gnome as a cute garden decoration - just be careful if you spot its eyes glowing red. A bright red hat is also included, giving you the option to dress your heroes up in something a bit more suitable when visiting a gnome town.

This pack comes with tiles sized for both Ace and MV/MZ, so you can use it in your preferred engine. Add some fun new tiny adventures to your game with Big Garden Tiles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1812540/RPG_Maker_MZ__Hero_Music_Collection/

Add some more epicness to your games’ soundtracks with Hero Music Collection! Ayato Sound Create has crafted 25 BGMs to help you find the perfect tracks for a variety of scenes! To get your players excited to play right from the get-go, why not pick one of the energetic tunes as your title screen music? When those songs pop up again during battles or scenes, your players will know something important is going on!

With a variety of instruments used, you can easily give different parts of your cities their own tracks to put your players in the right mindset for where they are. An upbeat bass and guitar would be great for an outdoor market or port, while a quirky electronic song is perfect for an underground bar. Play soft piano and strings during your game’s calmer moments, when your heroes finally have a chance to catch their breath and share some secret feelings with each other. And when your heroes finally face the final boss, give them pulsing drums to get them ready for the fight of their lives!

This pack includes ogg, m4a, and mp3 file formats for every song, so you can easily add it to your game in any engine! Give Hero Music Collection a listen today!
